jobs.title: Marketing Sr Director: CareerMD
jobs.excerpt: Healthcare’s helping hand.  CHG shook things up in 1979 by inventing the locum tenens staffing model.
jobs.description:
Healthcare’s helping hand.

CHG shook things up in 1979 by inventing the locum tenens staffing model. We connect doctors with patients who need their care. As the largest physician staffing firm in America, our providers treat millions of patients each year.

Our industry is growing and demand is high. This means you’ll have plenty of opportunities to grow and develop in your career. Keeping healthcare healthy can be as fun as it is rewarding

CareerMD has been one of the most trusted brands in physician recruitment for more than 20 years. We provide career resources for physicians and advanced practice providers, a comprehensive suite of recruitment marketing tools for healthcare employers, and operate the nation’s largest network of in-person career fairs—spanning over 100 cities annually.


Now backed by CHG Healthcare—named to Fortune’s “Best Companies to Work For” list for over a decade—CareerMD is entering an exciting period of rapid growth. We are investing in our platform, expanding our reach, and building the marketing function that will drive the next chapter of our growth on both sides of our marketplace.


Position Summary

The Senior Director, Marketing is a senior leadership role responsible for building and running CareerMD’s full marketing function—spanning both sides of our two-sided marketplace. On the B2B side, this leader will generate the qualified leads that fuel our sales pipeline, strengthen CareerMD’s brand among healthcare employers, and improve measurable indicators of market position including NPS and brand awareness. On the B2C side, they will grow our network of engaged physicians and advanced practice providers, driving user registrations, monthly active users, job applications, and career fair attendance.


Email marketing is CareerMD’s highest-volume channel today, and this leader will be expected to run it with rigor while simultaneously building the multi-channel foundation that reduces our concentration risk and drives diversified growth over time.


This is a role for a marketer who knows their numbers cold. The right candidate is equally comfortable building a performance channel strategy in a spreadsheet and presenting results to the executive team. They bring deep digital direct response experience, strong instincts for what moves the needle in a two-sided marketplace, and the organizational credibility to serve as a true cross-functional partner to Sales, Operations, and Product.


Why us?

CareerMD is backed by CHG Healthcare, one of the most recognized names in healthcare staffing and a perennial member of Fortune’s “Best Companies to Work For” list. CHG is built on a people-first culture that emphasizes employee well-being, professional development, and doing work that makes a genuine difference in healthcare delivery across the country.


Responsibilities

B2B Marketing — Employer Acquisition & Brand

  • Own the strategy and execution of B2B marketing, with direct accountability for generating marketing qualified leads (MQLs) and sales qualified leads (SQLs) that convert to employer revenue.
  • Develop and manage a multi-channel marketing strategy—including email, paid search, paid social, content marketing, SEO, and event-based marketing—optimized for employer acquisition and engagement.
  • Build and strengthen CareerMD’s brand among healthcare employers, positioning the platform as the premier destination for physician and advanced practice provider recruitment.
  • Track and improve brand health metrics including awareness, NPS, and employer satisfaction, using data to inform strategy and demonstrate marketing’s contribution to business outcomes.
  • Partner closely with the Sales team to align on lead quality standards, pipeline coverage targets, and feedback loops that continuously improve B2B marketing performance.
  • Develop account-based marketing (ABM) capabilities to support pursuit of strategic employer accounts.

B2C Marketing — Physician & Provider Network Growth

  • Own the strategy and execution of B2C marketing, with accountability for growing CareerMD’s network of registered and actively engaged physicians and advanced practice providers.
  • Drive measurable improvement across the full physician engagement funnel: user registrations, monthly active users, job applications, and career fair attendance.
  • Manage and continuously optimize CareerMD’s email marketing program—our highest-volume engagement channel—including list segmentation, deliverability, lifecycle automation, A/B testing, and performance reporting. Improve what’s working while building toward a more diversified channel mix.
  • Build and expand a paid and organic channel mix—including paid search, paid social, programmatic display, SEO, and content—to reduce email concentration and create durable, diversified acquisition pipelines.
  • Apply a rigorous test-and-learn approach: design and run A/B and multivariate experiments across channels, audiences, messaging, and creative to continuously improve performance.
  • Develop audience segmentation strategies that tailor messaging and channel selection to physician specialty, career stage, and engagement behavior.
  • Build and grow CareerMD’s organic presence through content marketing, SEO, and community-driven initiatives that establish credibility and trust with the physician community.

Performance Marketing & Analytics

  • Own the performance marketing function end-to-end: channel strategy, budget allocation, campaign execution, and reporting—with a clear line of sight from spend to business outcomes.
  • Establish and maintain a rigorous metrics framework spanning both B2B and B2C: CAC, LTV, MQL/SQL volume and conversion rates, cost per registration, cost per application, email engagement rates, and channel-level ROI.
  • Build dashboards and reporting cadences that give leadership clear visibility into marketing performance, pipeline contribution, and audience growth.
  • Manage the marketing budget with financial discipline, continuously optimizing channel mix based on performance data.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner closely with Sales to align marketing strategy with revenue goals, ensure strong MQL-to-SQL conversion, and support pipeline growth through targeted campaigns and enablement materials.
  • Collaborate with Operations and Product to align marketing strategy with platform capabilities, user experience improvements, and product launches.
  • Partner with CHG Healthcare sister brands to ensure they understand and can articulate the value of CareerMD’s offerings, identifying co-marketing and cross-sell opportunities where appropriate.
  • Serve as a key contributor to CareerMD’s overall business strategy, bringing market intelligence, audience insights, and competitive perspective to leadership discussions.

Team & Function Leadership

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing marketing team, establishing clear roles, accountability structures, and a culture of data-driven decision-making.
  • Identify and implement marketing technology and AI tools that improve execution speed, campaign personalization, and measurement capability.
  • Establish best practices across the marketing function—from campaign planning and creative development to analytics, attribution, and reporting.

Who You Are

We care as much about how you think and operate as what’s on your resume. The characteristics below are not nice-to-haves—they describe the mindset we’re building this team around. If you don’t check every experience box above but you recognize yourself in all five of these, we want to hear from you. In our experience, people who operate this way find a way to win.


  • Bias for action. You don’t wait for perfect information or a green light to start moving. You identify what you can learn, build, or test right now, and you go. You’d rather make a smart decision quickly and adjust than deliberate until the moment has passed.
  • Lifelong learner. You actively seek out new ideas, tools, and perspectives—inside and outside your field. You read, you experiment, you ask questions. You treat every result, good or bad, as a source of signal. You are better at your craft than you were a year ago and expect to be better still a year from now.
  • Test, learn, iterate. You don’t fall in love with your own ideas. You design experiments to challenge your assumptions, measure what actually happened, and let the results guide your next move. You know that the best marketing strategies aren’t declared—they’re discovered.
  • Empirical thinker. You start with evidence, not opinions. When someone makes a claim, your first instinct is to ask: what does the data say? You build arguments from the ground up and are just as willing to change your mind as you are to defend your position—so long as the reasoning is sound.
  • Low ego. Best idea wins. You’re not attached to being right—you’re attached to getting it right. You give credit generously, solicit feedback genuinely, and check your ego at the door when it conflicts with what’s best for the team or the business. You’ve worked places where seniority trumped merit, and you hated it.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in marketing, with meaningful tenure in digital direct response—owning performance channels, managing CAC/LTV economics, and driving measurable acquisition outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success running either a B2B or B2C marketing function with a quantifiable track record: pipeline generated, cost per acquisition, revenue influenced, audience growth, or comparable business outcomes.
  • Deep hands-on experience across the digital marketing stack: email marketing, paid search, paid social, programmatic, SEO/SEM, and content marketing.
  • Proven email marketing expertise: list management, segmentation, deliverability, lifecycle automation, and performance optimization at scale.
  • Strong analytical fluency—comfortable building and owning performance models, attribution frameworks, and executive-level reporting. This is not a role for someone who delegates the numbers.
  • Experience managing and developing marketing teams.
  • Proven ability to partner effectively with Sales, including aligning on lead definitions, pipeline targets, and feedback loops.

Preferred

  • Experience marketing within a two-sided marketplace, job board, or recruitment marketing platform—with an understanding of the distinct acquisition and engagement dynamics on each side.
  • Experience driving traffic acquisition for a job board or employment marketplace, including SEO, SEM, and paid strategies specific to job seeker and employer audiences.
  • Familiarity with the physician and advanced practice provider audience, including how clinicians engage digitally in their career search.
  • Experience in healthcare staffing, health media, or a closely adjacent vertical.
  • Familiarity with AI and automation tools applied to marketing—including content generation, predictive lead scoring, audience segmentation, or campaign optimization.
  • Experience operating within a private equity-backed or strategically-owned business.

Travel

This role requires periodic travel to CareerMD’s Union Square Manhattan office, CHG Healthcare’s corporate headquarters in Salt Lake City, UT, and relevant industry conferences. Frequency will be determined based on business needs and candidate location.


We believe in fair compensation for all of our people, which is why our pay structure takes into account the cost of labor across U.S. geographic markets. For this position, we offer a pay range of $146,200 -- $282,600 annually, with pay varying depending on work location and job-related factors such as knowledge, position level and experience. During the hiring process, your recruiter can provide more information about the specific salary range for the job location.


CHG Healthcare offers starting salaries for sales positions in the form of total target compensation (TTC = base + commission + bonus), which includes base pay, commission, and bonuses. Sales positions receive short-term incentives through commission plans and bonuses. On the other hand, non-sales positions have starting salaries that consist of a base salary and short-term incentives through various bonus plans, which are paid out monthly, quarterly, or annually.

In return we offer:

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Traditional healthcare benefits such as medical and dental coverage, and some unique benefits like onsite health centers, corporate wellness programs, and free behavioral health appointments.
• Flexible work schedules - including work-from-home options available
• Recognition programs with rewards including trips, cash, and paid time off
• Family-friendly benefits including paid parental leave, fertility coverage, adoption assistance, and marriage counseling
• Tailored training resources including free LinkedIn learning courses
• Volunteer time off and employee-driven matching grants

• Tuition reimbursement programs

We welcome applicants of any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status and individuals with disabilities as an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer. We are an at-will employer.

About DayOne Data Centers

DayOne Data Centers is a Singapore-headquartered global digital infrastructure platform that develops and operates next-generation data centers across Asia Pacific and Europe. Trusted by leading hyperscalers and businesses, the company engineers, builds, and operates high-capacity, AI-ready campuses with speed, scale, and reliability.

You'll report to the Group CEO and lead DayOne's business across North and Latin America, with full ownership of the regional P&L. You'll scale our operations: entering new markets, securing land and power, winning anchor hyperscale customers and standing up local teams. Your direct reports will be the Country General Managers and you'll work in a matrix with DayOne's global leaders for Operations, Finance, Commercial, Development and Construction, and Power and Energy, who own their functions across the group, agreeing regional priorities, resourcing and targets with them. The role will require 40–50% travel across the region. In your first 12–18 months, you'll launch our first Latin American market, sign anchor hyperscale contracts there and have Country General Managers in place for priority markets.


Strategy and Growth

  • Set and execute the NALA growth strategy, including which Latin American markets to enter and in what order, such as Mexico, Brazil, Chile and Colombia.
  • Evaluate and lead greenfield development, acquisitions, joint ventures and local partnerships.
  • Work with the Board and group leadership on capital allocation, funding and long-range planning.

Commercial Leadership

  • Act as the senior executive sponsor for hyperscaler, cloud provider, AI and large enterprise customers across the region, working with the global Commercial team.
  • Lead negotiation of large, multi-year build-to-suit and wholesale colocation contracts alongside the global Commercial team.
  • Shape the regional pre-leasing strategy so customer commitments are secured before new capacity is delivered.

Development, Power and Operations

  • Work with the global Development and Construction team on site selection, land acquisition, permitting, design and construction of new campuses, holding delivery to time and budget.
  • Set regional power requirements and work with the global Power and Energy team to secure long-term, cost-effective and increasingly renewable power, including grid connections, power purchase agreements and on-site generation.
  • Work with the global Operations team to hold every site to defined standards for uptime, safety, efficiency (PUE and WUE) and service quality.

Financial Performance

  • Deliver regional revenue, EBITDA and return-on-capital targets.
  • Lead regional budgeting, forecasting and investment cases with Group Finance, managing foreign exchange, inflation and country risk.
  • Support project financing, debt raises and investor communications.

Government Relations, Regulation and Sustainability

  • Build working relationships with governments, regulators, utilities and economic development agencies.
  • Navigate tax incentives, data sovereignty rules, energy regulation and permitting in each country.
  • Lead on sustainability, community engagement and responsible use of water and energy.

People and Ways of Working

  • Lead, develop and hold Country General Managers to account for country performance, including succession planning for each role.
  • Resolve trade-offs between country needs and group standards with global functional leaders, escalating to the Group CEO where needed.
  • Build one culture across North and Latin America that puts safety first, centres on customers and holds people to account.
  • Put in place governance, controls and compliance, including anti-corruption, suited to a multi-country business.

Requirements

  • 15+ years' experience in data centres, digital infrastructure, telecommunications, energy or large-scale real estate, including 5+ years as CEO, regional president or general manager with full P&L ownership.
  • Track record scaling a capital-intensive business, including developing and delivering large campuses or infrastructure projects.
  • Direct experience in Latin America, ideally having entered or built operations in at least one new country.
  • Experience leading through a matrix, delivering results with global functional leaders who do not report to you.
  • Established relationships with hyperscale cloud providers and a record of closing large, multi-year contracts.
  • Strong financial skills across project finance, M&A, investment underwriting and Board or investor reporting.
  • Equally effective opening a new market and running a mature portfolio.
  • Trusted by hyperscalers and able to structure complex, high-value deals.
  • Leads across cultures and builds local teams rather than exporting a single playbook.
  • Sets the standard on ethics, safety and compliance in complex regulatory environments.
  • Credible with boards, investors, governments, customers and frontline teams.
  • Fluent written and spoken English and Spanish; Portuguese strongly preferred.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a private equity or infrastructure fund-backed platform.
  • Deep knowledge of power markets, utility interconnection and renewable energy procurement.
  • Government relations experience in regulated environments across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Degree in engineering, business, finance or a related discipline; MBA or equivalent.

jobs.excerpt: About QC Servion QC Servion is the centralized hub for human resources, change management, program management, sales & marketing, safety, administration, legal, and accounting services across the QC Ecosystem.
jobs.description:
About QC Servion

QC Servion is the centralized hub for human resources, change management, program management, sales & marketing, safety, administration, legal, and accounting services across the QC Ecosystem.

We provide comprehensive operational support that empowers our companies to focus on growth, innovation, and excellence, while ensuring employees thrive in safe, engaging, and well-managed environments.

The entities in our ecosystem include DLB Associates, Galtra Solutions, AI2IO, Fluid2Chip, CEQEL Critical Commissioning, and 2AI-DC Integrators. Collectively, we deliver services across the data center industry.

Position: Talent Acquisition Partner

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Salary

QC Servion recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

Job Summary

The Talent Acquisition Partner helps build the teams behind some of the fastest-growing businesses across the QC Ecosystem.

You may be recruiting an engineer, commissioning professional, or technical field hire one week and supporting a project management, accounting, marketing, operations, or completely new position the next. While this role will sit within our overhead/shared-services organization, your recruiting portfolio will evolve based on where the business needs support most.

You don't need to come in having recruited every role we hire for. We're looking for someone who is curious, scrappy, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out. When you're handed an unfamiliar position, we want your instinct to be to ask questions, learn the business, understand what good looks like, dig into the talent market, and build a search strategy.

You'll own the recruiting lifecycle for the teams you support, partnering directly with hiring managers to define what they need, find and assess talent, manage interviews, navigate offers, and keep searches moving. As you build relationships and learn your teams, you'll have the opportunity to become their go-to Talent Acquisition partner and take real ownership of how you support their growth.

This is a great opportunity for someone who likes variety, moves quickly, doesn't need every step mapped out, and wants room to grow alongside an organization that is continuing to evolve.

Essential Functions

  • Own full-cycle recruiting across technical, field-based, project, operational, and corporate/shared-services positions based on evolving business needs.
  • Manage multiple active requisitions simultaneously while understanding which searches and business needs require the most attention.
  • Lead intake and calibration conversations with hiring managers to understand the role, team, business need, candidate profile, level, and interview expectations.
  • Learn unfamiliar roles and functions quickly enough to confidently source, screen, and speak with candidates about the opportunity.
  • Develop targeted search strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, internal databases, direct outreach, specialized communities, and other creative sourcing channels.
  • Build pipelines of active and passive candidates rather than relying solely on inbound applicants.
  • Conduct recruiter screens focused on experience, capabilities, communication, career motivations, compensation expectations, and overall alignment with the opportunity.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers throughout the search, providing visibility into pipeline health, candidate feedback, market conditions, compensation expectations, and potential challenges.
  • Recognize when a search isn't producing the right results and use market feedback to recommend changes to the candidate profile, sourcing strategy, level, compensation, or other search parameters.
  • Coordinate interviews and proactively manage scheduling, feedback, and next steps so searches continue moving forward.
  • Maintain thoughtful and consistent communication with candidates throughout the process, including searches with longer or evolving timelines.
  • Gather and synthesize interviewer feedback and help hiring teams reach timely, informed decisions.
  • Manage the offer process from compensation alignment and verbal offer through formal documentation, negotiation, acceptance, and pre-employment handoff.
  • Maintain accurate and current information within the ATS so hiring teams and leadership have clear visibility into recruiting activity and pipeline status.
  • Use recruiting data and market insight to identify bottlenecks, adjust strategies, and improve hiring outcomes.
  • Leverage AI, automation, sourcing technology, and emerging tools to improve research, sourcing, communication, and day-to-day recruiting efficiency.

What Success Looks Like

  • The hiring managers you support view you as their Talent Acquisition partner, not simply someone managing requisitions.
  • You understand your teams well enough to represent their opportunities confidently and provide informed guidance throughout a search.
  • You're comfortable picking up a role you've never recruited before, asking the right questions, and figuring out how to find the talent.
  • You proactively build pipelines rather than waiting for applicants to come to you.
  • Hiring managers have clear visibility into their searches and know what is working, what isn't, and what you recommend doing next.
  • You keep interviews, feedback, decisions, and offers moving without needing someone else to continuously push the process forward.
  • Candidates receive timely, honest, and thoughtful communication throughout their experience.
  • You can move between very different roles, functions, and talent markets based on where the organization needs you.
  • You develop trusted relationships with the leaders and teams you support.
  • As your knowledge and credibility grow, you take greater ownership of your recruiting relationships and increasingly complex hiring needs.

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Communications, or a related field or equivalent professional experience in recruiting, sourcing, staffing, HR, or another relevant people-focused field.
  • 3+ years of recruiting, sourcing, staffing, or Talent Acquisition experience preferred, with demonstrated ability to independently manage searches and candidate relationships.
  • Experience recruiting technical, engineering, construction, field-based, professional-services, project-based, or corporate talent is helpful; the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar roles and talent markets is equally important.
  • Demonstrated ability to proactively identify and engage passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, targeted outreach, referrals, job boards, databases, and other sourcing methods.
  • Strong interviewing and candidate-assessment skills with the ability to evaluate experience, transferable capabilities, motivations, communication, and overall alignment.
  • Comfortable partnering directly with hiring managers and asking thoughtful questions when hiring requirements are unclear or still evolving.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build credibility with candidates, hiring managers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Highly organized with strong follow-through and the ability to manage multiple searches, deadlines, candidate conversations, and shifting priorities.
  • Comfortable operating independently, exercising judgment, and moving work forward without having every step mapped out.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Samsara’s Go-to-Market (GTM) Programs team enables a high-performance sales team by leveraging technology, automation, and best-in-class methodologies to sharpen how we go to market, improve forecasting accuracy, and maximize sales efficiency & effectiveness.

The Senior Program Manager will prioritize, implement, and lead the highest priority transformational initiatives across the Sales organization.   • Deliver Impactful Reporting & Results: Measure results of projects and report out on outcomes delivered;drive continuous improvement processes to achieve and maintain operational excellence
  • Champion, Role Model, and Embed Samsara’s Cultural Principles: Focus on Seller and Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Bachelor's Degree from a 4 year institution
  • 6-8 years of program management, management consulting, business/revenue operations or strategy experience, ideally in a SaaS environment or fast-paced technology consulting role
  • Track record launching transformational, cross-functional initiatives that measurably improve the customer experience and support scalability within the business
  • Strong project management skills with expertise in end-to-end delivery (i.e. framing the need, scope requirements, document project roadmaps, partnering with teams, defining KPIs and reporting out on results)
  • Ability to ramp up quickly on business priorities and derive insights from data to inform decisions
  • Strong communication and written language skills including clear and concise documentation
  • Proven track record of building trust and effectively partnering with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, managers, front-line teammates and cross-functional partners
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through issues, skilled at having prioritization conversations and discussing tradeoffs

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with B2B hardware and SaaS products
  • Experience in Sales Ops, RevOps, Sales Enablement, or a GTM Chief of Staff / strategy and operations role
  • Experience applying AI tools to improve program delivery
  • MBA

Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

jobs.excerpt: Drug development shouldn’t be guesswork, not when patients are waiting.
jobs.description:
Drug development shouldn’t be guesswork, not when patients are waiting.

Pathos is building a next-generation biotech with AI at the core. Not as a feature, but as the operating system for how medicines get developed. We believe most drugs don't fail because the science was wrong. They fail because they were tested in the wrong patients, with the wrong assumptions, in trials that couldn't answer the real question: who benefits, and why?

Pathos exists to change that. We're building the largest foundation model in oncology and pairing it with proprietary AI systems, deep oncology expertise, and 200+ petabytes of multimodal data linked to patient outcomes, so we can make development decisions with more precision, much earlier.

This is not theoretical. We’re well-capitalized and have the leadership to build a generational company. We invest in and advance our own clinical-stage programs, using our AI platform to sharpen trial design, patient selection and biomarker strategy. So therapies reach the patients most likely to benefit, sooner.

How We Build

Pathos does not operate like a traditional biotech. There is no middle management. There are no layers of approval. The company is designed, from the ground up, around small teams of 2–4 subject matter experts who each command hundreds of AI agents to do the work that used to require dozens of people.

Everyone builds. Everyone ships. Every function at Pathos — from clinical execution to asset selection to the foundation model itself — runs on this model. Our product velocity delivers meaningful outcomes in hours instead of weeks. This is not a future aspiration. It is how we operate today.

The people who thrive here are operators: deep experts who can specify what needs to happen, orchestrate AI agents to execute at scale, and make high-judgment calls that compound over time. If you have spent your career building and shipping AI systems at scale, this is the environment where that experience becomes a superpower.

About the role

Applications will be reviewed continuously, with priority consideration for submissions received by December 7, 2026.

You will play a major role in advancing the foundation model and building the agentic systems behind Foundry, the AI platform that informs every drug decision at Pathos, and make them continually improve over time from real-world feedback.

You will own how we train and adapt frontier open-weight models specifically for drug development. You will leverage 200+ petabytes of multimodal, multi-scale oncology data spanning over 8 million patient records linked to longitudinal outcomes, alongside live data streams from clinical trial sites. Supported by a dedicated large-scale GPU cluster and our internal wet lab for experimental validation, your models will directly inform design and execution of clinical trials. You will operate within a lean, high-velocity team where every builder maintains end-to-end ownership over key platform capabilities.

If you want to build the intelligence behind how new medicines are developed, and prove rigorously that it gets better, this is the place to do your career’s best work.

What You’ll Build

  • Advance mid- and post-training of our oncology foundation model across SFT and RL, including reward design and verifiers for scientific and clinical tasks whose correctness is hard to check automatically.
  • Run and debug training at scale, addressing instability, divergence and reward hacking.
  • Build the harness for scientific and clinical workflows: memory, context management, orchestration and tools, plus methods that optimize the harness automatically and evolve it together with the underlying model.
  • Design evaluations for open-ended, long-horizon scientific, clinical and operational tasks, calibrate them against expert judgment, investigate where they fail, and use them to decide what ships.
  • Build pipelines that generate, filter and curate training and evaluation data, with safeguards for quality, provenance and contamination.
  • Turn expert feedback, wet-lab results and real-time signals from clinical trial sites into improvements to models, harness and evaluations, so the platform learns from experience with very high sample efficiency.
  • Work directly with oncologists, biologists and the clinical team to translate drug development needs into tractable ML problems, and publish in top ML and scientific venues.

Who You Are

We’re looking for researchers and engineers who have gotten models or agents working at scale, care as much about the drugs as about the models, and want their work to reach patients. You take ambiguous problems through experiments to results people can use.

We’re hiring across levels, from exceptional early-career talent to experienced researchers.

Must-haves

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one of the following, which we value equally:
    • Mid- or post-training at scale, such as SFT, RL, reward modeling or preference optimization, with direct ownership of training runs and results.
    • Evaluation, data and agent harness design, such as evaluation and feedback design for scientific, clinical and operational tasks, synthetic data pipelines, or harness optimization spanning memory, context management, orchestration and tools.
  • Rigorous scientific judgment, including when ground truth is limited, delayed or disputed.
  • Strong engineering skills in Python, with production-quality code.
  • Clear communication of evidence, limitations and uncertainty.
  • Willingness to learn biology and drug development, and work closely with domain experts.

Publications, research software and deployed systems are all valid evidence. Publications are welcome but not required.

Bonus

  • You’ve built self-improving agentic systems, for example through self-play, synthetic data generation, self-training on past trajectories or test-time learning, or systems that automate ML research.
  • You’ve built AI systems for real-world scientific workflows, such as agents that generate hypotheses and design, run and analyze experiments using lab or clinical data.
  • You’ve built RL environments or task suites for training agents on realistic, long-horizon tasks.
  • You’ve modeled multimodal biomedical data, such as genomics, transcriptomics, pathology and radiology images, clinical notes and EHRs, ideally combining several modalities in one model.
  • You’ve worked on uncertainty estimation, calibration or causal inference, especially where model outputs inform high-stakes decisions.
  • You’ve built or scaled infrastructure for efficient training and inference, such as distributed training, custom kernels (CUDA or Triton) or high-throughput serving.
  • You’ve shipped ML systems that real users rely on, then monitored them in production and improved them from user feedback.
  • You have a background in oncology, drug development or clinical research, or a track record of working closely with clinicians and biologists.
  • You’ve worked with patient-level or clinical trial data under privacy and regulatory constraints, such as HIPAA.

None of these are required. We value depth in one area over breadth across all of them.

Location

The preferred location for this position is in our New York City HQ, though exceptional remote candidates will also be considered.

Compensation

We are hiring across levels. The anticipated salary range is $220,000 to $350,000 plus equity, and we have flexibility for exceptional candidates.

jobs.title: Programme Lead
jobs.excerpt: Alliants delivers its platform into live hospitality and senior-living operations that can't go dark — and we're looking for a Programme Lead to own large, multi-workstream client programmes from integrated plan to cutover.
jobs.description:
Alliants delivers its platform into live hospitality and senior-living operations that can't go dark — and we're looking for a Programme Lead to own large, multi-workstream client programmes from integrated plan to cutover.
The role at a glance
  • Title: Programme Lead
  • Location:Remote, Canada (Eastern Time preferred), with regular travel to client sites in Washington DC and the Greater Toronto Area
  • Compensation:CA$105 – CA$125 per hour (equivalent to CA$158,000 – CA$182,000 per year)
  • Contract:6-month fixed-term contract
  • Team: Services, reporting into Services leadership and leading the Technical Project Managers across eight workstreams
This is a senior delivery leadership role in our Services team, and it's focused on two key areas:
  1. Ownership of the whole programme. Where our Technical Project Managers own execution inside each workstream, you own what joins them up — one integrated plan, one set of risks, one governance rhythm and one senior relationship with the client's executive sponsors. You decide what gets prioritised when demands compete, and you keep delivery predictable through periods of significant change.
  2. Responsibility for the program's commercial health. You hold the programme to its SOW — change requests, scope control, budget and burn — and you report it to Commercial and Finance alongside milestones. The goal is simple: risk surfaces early, and there are no commercial surprises for the client or for Alliants.
Services-wide strategy, the Services P&L and new-business pricing sit with Services leadership. This role owns delivery and commercial control of the programmes it leads.

Role Focus & Operating Context
You'll work across active client programmes in North America, including engagements in the Greater Toronto Area and Washington DC, moving between the portfolio view and delivery detail as the situation needs. Much of the work is phased transformation — legacy-to-modern platform replacement with parallel running and staged cutovers — so protecting live services is part of every plan.

You'll set the governance: steering committees, executive reporting, decision logs and RAID, with reporting that rolls up cleanly from workstream to programme to portfolio. You'll use AI tools day to day to speed up reporting and documentation, and you'll partner with architecture and engineering leadership so technical direction supports the programme's phasing.

You'll sit at the centre of the programme: leading the Technical Project Managers, working with architects and engineers on how the work gets built, with Commercial and Finance on how it gets paid for, and with the client's executive sponsors on what it needs to achieve.

What you'll work on and own
  • The integrated plan — one roadmap sequencing releases, dependencies and resourcing across eight workstreams
  • Programme governance — steering committees, executive reporting, decision logs and escalation paths the client trusts
  • The commercial position — SOW alignment, change control, budget, burn and utilisation
  • The RAID — risks, issues and assumptions surfaced early and driven to closure
  • Cutover day — phased rollouts and transitions to live service where nobody on the client's side notices the switch
  • The delivery standard — how the Technical Project Managers plan, report and escalate, consistently across every workstream

Responsibilities

  • You'll own end-to-end delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams, giving each client a single point of programme accountability.
  • You'll establish and run programme governance — steering committees, executive reporting, decision logs and escalation paths — so reporting rolls up cleanly from workstream to programme to portfolio.
  • You'll build and maintain integrated programme plans and roadmaps that sequence releases, dependencies and resourcing, and make clear prioritisation calls when demands compete.
  • You'll lead the Technical Project Managers across the programme, setting delivery standards and keeping projects consistent.
  • You'll own the programme-level risk, issue and assumption registers, escalating early and driving mitigation to closure.
  • You'll hold commercial accountability for programme health — SOW alignment, change requests, scope control, budget and burn — so there are no surprises for the client or Alliants.
  • You'll partner with architecture and engineering leadership so technical direction supports programme outcomes and phased transformation goals.
  • You'll plan and govern phased rollouts, cutovers and transitions to live service, protecting operational continuity for clients.
  • You'll act as the senior delivery counterpart to client executive sponsors and programme owners, building trusted, outcome-focused relationships.
  • You'll contribute to the continued evolution of Alliants' delivery model, tooling and programme management practice.

Requirements

What you'll bring
  • 10+ years in technical delivery, with at least 5 years leading programmes of multiple concurrent workstreams
  • Experience leading project managers or delivery leads — not only running individual projects
  • Ownership of programme governance and executive stakeholder relationships on client-facing, large-scale digital programmes in complex, multi-party environments
  • Strong commercial acumen — SOW-driven delivery, change control, forecasting and margin awareness
  • Programme reporting that leadership and clients trust — executive status, milestone tracking, dependency views and RAID
  • Technical fluency in modern, cloud-based software delivery — enough to engage credibly with architects and engineering leads (Node.js, AWS, React, APIs and technical documentation)
  • Hands-on experience with delivery and work-management tooling (Jira, ClickUp, Monday or Smartsheet), including cross-project dependency tracking and portfolio views
  • Experience managing resourcing, utilisation and burn through time and reporting systems such as Salesforce
  • Excellent executive communication — you simplify complexity and drive decisions

To thrive in this role, you'll be someone who:
  • Takes clear ownership of programme outcomes and commercial health, and doesn't wait to be asked
  • Moves between the portfolio view and delivery detail as the situation requires
  • Stays calm, decisive and credible under pressure, particularly in front of client executives
  • Manages scope and pushes back constructively when delivery is at risk
  • Raises the standard of delivery across the team without relying on formal authority
  • Uses AI tools day to day to work faster, and keeps learning as they change

Benefits

Who is Alliants and what do we do?
Alliants, established in 2009, is dedicated to producing customer engagement technologies and services that pave the way for a more human, sustainable, and promising future for hospitality.
At Alliants, we are all in for our people and our industry.

What's in it for you?
We know we all work better in an autonomous, collaborative, diverse and equitable space. To support you in becoming the best version of yourself, we offer:
  • Remote-first working: work remotely from anywhere in Canada on Eastern Time core hours, with flexibility for UK and US colleagues
  • Client-facing travel: regular time on site with clients in Washington DC and the Greater Toronto Area
  • High autonomy & trust: clear ownership of the programme, minimal micromanagement and direct impact on delivery
  • Inclusive team culture: we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work
  • A warm welcome: to celebrate you joining Alliants, we'll plant a Great Oak tree in your honour
Please note: this role is remote and requires you to be based in Canada, working Eastern Time hours, and able to travel to the United States.
Alliants celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees

Job brief

Join Elite Escapes and turn your passion for travel into your next career.

As a Remote Cruise Planner (Sales-Focused),

you'll help clients turn we should take a cruise someday into a confirmed sailing they cannot wait to board. What You'll Do

  • Connect with clients to understand their preferred destinations, travel style, budget, dates, group size, and cruise must-haves.
  • Recommend the right cruise line, ship, itinerary, stateroom, dining package, shore excursions, and add-ons based on each traveler's needs.
  • Turn inquiries into confirmed cruise vacations through email, chat, and phone with energy, accuracy, and a client-first approach.
  • Explain cruise options clearly, including cabin categories, deposits, payment plans, travel protection, onboard packages, and port requirements.
  • Handle booking details, special requests, changes, payments, upgrades, and pre-cruise questions with professionalism and care.
  • Resolve concerns quickly and confidently, helping clients feel supported from their first quote through embarkation and their return home.
  • Share valuable cruise insights—best sailings for families, romantic itineraries, hidden-gem ports, seasonal opportunities, and limited-time promotions.
  • Build post-booking relationships that encourage repeat sailings, referrals, reviews, and long-term client loyalty.

Nice to Have

  • Interest in cruises, ocean travel, river cruising, expedition voyages, or helping people explore the world by sea.
  • Travel-industry, sales, hospitality, customer-service, or booking experience is preferred—but not required. Zero experience is welcome.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to guide clients toward a decision.
  • Strong organization skills and comfort managing multiple quotes, reservations, follow-ups, and client details.
  • Comfort with technology, online booking platforms, CRM systems, and AI tools—we will train you on the rest.
  • A genuine passion for travel, memorable experiences, and helping clients find the cruise that feels made for them.

What You Get

  • Fully remote work with the flexibility to build your schedule around your life.
  • Comprehensive onboarding and training on cruise lines, ships, itineraries, supplier platforms, sales conversations, and travel planning.
  • A collaborative, supportive team atmosphere with colleagues who want to see you succeed.
  • The opportunity to grow into specialties such as luxury cruises, family cruising, group sailings, river cruises, expedition travel, or destination celebrations.
  • Clear paths toward leadership and higher earning potential.

Cruise planning has plenty of moving parts—but if you enjoy helping people choose between ocean views and balconies, island stops and bucket-list ports, relaxation and adventure, you will thrive here. Your work will transform questions into bookings and cruise dreams into unforgettable days at sea.

Who We Are

We curate journeys that turn travel dreams into reality. We believe travel and adventure should create transformative, lifelong memories — that's why we partner with advisors who share that passion.

Sound Like You?

Apply today—we look forward to welcoming you aboard.

jobs.description:
UPSTARS – продуктова IT-компанія, з якою злітають і люди, і бренди. Наш основний фокус – технологічні рішення та B2B-послуги для міжнародних клієнтів. Запускаємо зіркові проєкти у сфері iGaming, які отримують визнання та найвищі оцінки профільних рейтингів ✨

І так, підтримувати легальний та прозорий ринок України – це маст хев, тому третіми в країні отримали B2B-ліцензію на надання послуг у сфері азартних ігор.

У 2026 ми активно масштабуємо і проєкти, і дрім тім. Тому для підсилення Design Human-Centered департаменту шукаємо Product Designer.

✅ Твої майбутні задачі:

  • проєктування та покращення mobile-first веб-інтерфейсів з урахуванням потреб користувачів, бізнес-цілей і продуктових метрик;

  • робота над ключовими флоу: реєстрація, авторизація, профіль, бонуси, промо-активності, гейміфікація, навігація, пошук;

  • аналіз UX-проблем і збір контексту;

  • аналіз поведінки користувачів за даними аналітики;

  • формування гіпотез на основі даних, підготовка дизайн-рішень для їх перевірки; інтерпретація власних досліджень та досліджень інших команд;

  • оцінка роботи рішень після релізу; участь у UX-дослідженнях;

  • конкурентний аналіз: сильні й слабкі сторони конкурентів, можливості для покращення продукту;

  • створення user flows, wireframes та інтерактивних прототипів (зокрема з використанням ШІ), опрацювання станів і edge cases, підготовка специфікацій для розробників і супровід реалізації;

  • співпраця з Product Manager, розробниками, аналітиками, дослідниками, QA, copywriters, support;

  • підтримка консистентності в межах дизайн-системи;

  • презентація рішень стейкхолдерам з аргументацією на основі даних; надання та прийняття конструктивного фідбеку.

💪 Твої скіли:

  • 3+ роки досвіду в ролі Product Designer;

  • досвід проєктування складних mobile-first інтерфейсів; знання Apple HIG і Material Design;

  • впевнена робота у Figma: компоненти, auto layout, variants, variables, прототипування;

  • свідоме використання ШІ для досліджень, аналізу даних і прототипів;

  • досвід роботи з поведінковою аналітикою (FullStory, Hotjar, GA, Tableau тощо);

  • вміння формувати та аргументувати гіпотези на основі даних і досліджень;

  • розуміння продуктових метрик (conversion, engagement, retention, churn) та їхнього впливу на дизайн;

  • розуміння повного дизайн-процесу: від аналізу проблеми до аналізу після запуску;

  • досвід проєктування сценаріїв: user flows, форми, навігація, стани, edge cases;

  • досвід досліджень після запуску та участі в UX-дослідженнях (usability-тестування, JTBD, CJM);

  • вміння готувати специфікації для розробників; базове розуміння HTML/CSS;

  • уважність до деталей, робота в межах дизайн-системи.

🤞 Бажано, але не критично:

  • досвід роботи в B2C продуктах, entertainment, iGaming, fintech або продуктах зі складними користувацькими сценаріями;

  • досвід розвитку дизайн-системи, зокрема створення і підтримка компонентів

  • досвід підготовки документації, специфікацій, UX-анотацій або опису логіки складних станів інтерфейсу;

  • досвід менторингу або готовність поступово розвиватися в цьому напрямі.

🌟 Наші цінності та переваги:

  • командність – гуртом не лише працюємо, а ще й відпочиваємо, двіжуємо і робимо добрі справи;

  • позитив – з легкістю йдемо по життю і отримуємо драйв від круто зробленої роботи, цікавих задач і фідбеку тіммейтів;

  • можливості – пропонуємо чіткий кар’єрний план з Performance Review, тренінги, менторинг-програми та інші інструменти для реалізації як у карʼєрі, так і у житті;

  • сміливість – беремося за задачі із зірочкою, не боїмося викликів і амбітних планів;

  • відкритість – говоримо прямо і просто навіть про складне, чуємо ідеї та фідбеки і цінуємо проактивність;

  • маємо власні потужності для створення технологічних рішень з нуля;

  • автоматизуємо рутину, щоб використовувати час для розвитку та професійного зростання всередині компанії;

  • не любимо бюрократію та застарілі підходи – ми за свободу дій.

🍪Маст-хев:

  • працюй там, де комфортно та безпечно – в хабах у Києві та Варшаві або віддалено;

  • 20 робочих днів оплачуваних дей офів, державні вихідні і лікарняні – ми за ворк-лайф беленс;

  • медичне страхування у топових клініках і покриття витрат на психолога на платформі Pleso;

  • Benefit cafe – щомісячно витрачай кошти на уподобання, хобі, спорт тощо;

  • івенти – бери участь у майстер-класах, відвідуй тімбілдинги та корпоративи;

  • навчання під будь-який запит – індивідуальний бюджет на курси, корпоративна англійська, воркшопи та онлайн-бібліотека.

І ще про важливе:

❗️Не маємо клієнтів, які б використовували наші розробки та послуги на українському ринку.

❗️Не працюємо з клієнтами ринку країни-агресора чи будь-якого іншого російськомовного ринку.

Відчуваєш метч за цінностями і бажання професійно зростати? Давай знайомитися! 😉

P.S. Якщо після відгуку не бачиш нашого листа – зазирни у “Спам” або інші розділи. Іноді наші відповіді губляться там 👀

About CloudTalk

CloudTalk is an AI-powered business phone system and AI Voice Agent platform built for sales and support teams. It brings business calling, AI-powered call intelligence, and autonomous AI voice agents together in one platform, helping small and mid-sized businesses make more calls, handle more conversations, and deliver better customer experiences.

Serving customers in 160+ countries, CloudTalk is backed by $36M in funding from leading investors, including KPN Ventures, Point Nine, and HenQ. We’re investing in making AI a natural part of every business conversation and helping companies get more value from every call.

With a team of 200 people, CloudTalk values growth, innovation, teamwork, customer focus, and human connection. The company moves fast, builds for the future, and cares deeply about creating products and a culture that people genuinely love.

Why Join CloudTalk Now?

📍The setup: join an international team and work alongside an experienced GTM TA Partner. 100% remote, with our Prague and Bratislava offices there whenever you need them and team offsites in Portugal, Italy, Spain, etc. (last year: Tuscany 🇮🇹)

🎯 The scope: Full ownership of Engineering & Product hiring at CloudTalk

🤖 Innovation: Full access to Claude, space to try new AI tools and an AI Enablement team to help whenever a tool or workflow gets stuck

💰 Rewards: a bonus for each headhunted candidate who passes probation (minimum amount is €1,000)

The Challenge Ahead

At CloudTalk, Talent Acquisition is strategic, fast-paced and measured. We're looking for a Senior Tech Talent Acquisition Partner to fully own hiring for our Engineering and Product teams across Europe: someone who hires high-quality, mostly senior talent within ambitious time-to-fill benchmarks, and can show the numbers behind every hire.

This is a high-ownership, sourcing-heavy, full-cycle role: you'll be the one person who owns tech recruitment at CloudTalk, and your impact shows up in our product velocity and technical capability. You'll work directly with our C-level and Engineering and Product directors as their trusted Talent Partner, advising on market realities, hiring strategy and closing competitive tech talent. If you enjoy full ownership, fast decisions and building things without waiting for permission, this is the environment for you.

CloudTalk is AI fluent, and recruiting is no exception: we already run AI inbound screening, an AI sourcing agent and automated interview evaluations. We automate the manual work so you spend your time on the moments that decide whether someone joins. Those stay human, always. You'll get full Claude access, and we expect you to optimise our workflows with AI and trial new tools.

What You'll Be Hiring

  • Software Engineers
  • Engineering Managers
  • AI Researchers
  • Product Managers and Product Builders
  • Product Designers
  • Other technical profiles

Across:

  • CEE
  • Broader Europe

What You'll Own

  • Full-cycle recruitment for Engineering & Product roles
  • Proactive headhunting and targeted sourcing across European markets
  • Warm, long-term pipelines for senior and niche talent
  • Structured interview processes and high hiring standards
  • Your funnel numbers: you own, report monthly and improve time to fill, time to hire, stage conversion and offer acceptance rate, and you bring one proposed change each time
  • AI in your daily workflow: you automate manual tasks, trial new AI and sourcing tools, keep what works and share the results with the team
  • A human candidate experience at every moment that matters most
  • Strong ATS hygiene, so every number you present can be trusted

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 4+ years of full-cycle recruitment experience, with strong exposure to tech hiring
  • Proven success hiring engineers and product profiles in Europe
  • A strong sourcing mindset: you reach out to passive candidates daily
  • Comfort owning leadership and senior-level searches
  • Hiring insight backed by data: you can show your own funnel numbers and explain them in plain language to a CTO
  • Fluent English (C1+)

And importantly:

  • You use AI in your recruiting work every week and trial new tools, sourcing strategies and automation
  • You think about how to make hiring smarter, not just faster, and you know which moments should never be automated
  • You combine data-driven thinking with a strong human touch, and you care how a candidate feels after a rejection as much as after an offer

Why you’ll love being a CloudTalker

Unlimited PTO that people actually take. Fully remote with four European hubs. A coach you can book, a career path in writing, and equity when you deliver. Here's the full package.

Get better, faster

  • 💬 A coach you can actually book. Recurring 1-on-1 sessions with our resident coach. A real conversation about your career, on company time.
  • 🪜 Promotions without guesswork. Our job-leveling framework is transparent: every level and its expectations, in writing. You'll always know what the next step requires and where you stand.

  • Basic knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts.
  • Familiarity with Git commands and repository management, including branching, committing changes, creating merge requests, and resolving basic merge conflicts.

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About IT

The IT team enables Affirmers to work securely and efficiently. We manage internal devices, networks, and systems, ensuring employees can collaborate and perform at their best. Our team supports onboarding, troubleshooting, and scaling technology across locations. We focus on usability, reliability, and security to maintain a productive work environment. The IT team ensures that Affirmers have the tools and support they need—wherever they work.

About the role

As an IT Product Manager, you'll help Affirmers embrace new ways of working and get more value from the technology they use every day. Partnering with IT leadership and teams across Affirm, you'll translate employee needs into product priorities, shape technology roadmaps and lifecycle decisions, and drive adoption of collaboration, productivity, and emerging AI-powered capabilities.

What You'll Do

We are looking for a collaborative, adaptable IT Product Manager to help Affirmers work more effectively by shaping how we manage, use, and adopt collaboration, productivity, and AI-powered workplace technologies.

  • You will partner with IT leadership to define and manage priorities for Affirm's collaboration and productivity tools, including Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, and emerging AI-powered technologies.
  • You will turn employee needs, business priorities, and technical constraints into clear requirements, practical solutions, and actionable roadmaps that guide technology improvements.
  • You will help guide the technology lifecycle, from evaluating new solutions and developing business cases to optimizing existing investments, supporting vendor renewals, and recommending when to consolidate or retire tools.
  • You will lead the rollout and adoption of new tools, features, and AI-powered capabilities, partnering with Internal Communications, business leaders, and employee champions to help Affirmers navigate change with confidence.
  • You will connect Affirmers with practical guidance, self-service resources, and learning opportunities—leveraging vendor expertise, existing materials, and on-demand options—to help them build confidence and get more value from workplace technology.
  • You will define success measures, use employee feedback, adoption data, and support trends to evaluate outcomes, and recommend improvements that enhance the employee experience and inform technology priorities.
  • You will partner with IT Engineering, Security, Legal, Procurement, and vendors to deliver solutions that balance employee needs, business value, technical feasibility, cost, and risk.

What We Look For

You bring hands-on technology experience, a product mindset, and a people-first approach to solving problems, collaborating across teams, and helping others embrace change.

  • You have 5+ years of relevant experience in IT product or program management, workplace technology, technology-focussed organizational change management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
  • You have experience identifying and delivering improvements to employee workflows through enterprise collaboration and productivity platforms, such as Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, or similar technologies, and are eager to apply that same approach to emerging AI capabilities.
  • You have experience gathering stakeholder needs, defining requirements, prioritizing opportunities, and developing actionable plans or roadmaps for technology solutions.
  • You have experience leading technology rollouts, organizational change initiatives, or employee adoption programs that help people confidently embrace new tools and ways of working.
  • You communicate clearly with different audiences and have experience identifying, organizing, and sharing resources that help employees understand and adopt workplace technologies.
  • You use data, employee feedback, and support trends to evaluate technology adoption, measure outcomes, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • You build effective relationships across technical and business teams, using sound judgment to balance competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and influence decisions without direct authority.

Pay Grade - J

Equity Grade - 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, which includes the annual base pay and the sales incentive target.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base salary range per year: $101,000 - 151,000

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.description:
Nous recherchons un Analyste, conformité TI pour rejoindre IQVIA Laboratories en télétravail au Canada.

Nous recrutons des innovateurs passionnés qui font progresser les soins de santé grâce à une collaboration réfléchie et inclusive. Si vous souhaitez donner davantage de sens à votre carrière, joignez-vous à nous alors que nous transformons et accélérons la recherche et le développement.


À titre d’analyste en conformité TI, vous serez responsable de superviser les activités de conformité liées aux systèmes validés et de soutenir la préparation aux audits au sein d’IQVIA Laboratories. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes des technologies de l’information, de l’assurance qualité et les parties prenantes de l’entreprise afin d’assurer la conformité réglementaire, le maintien de l’état validé des systèmes et le succès des audits internes, des audits clients et des inspections réglementaires.


Ce que vous ferez :

  • Planifier, coordonner, exécuter, documenter et clôturer les revues périodiques des applications validées conformément aux procédures de qualité et de conformité.
  • Agir à titre de principal point de contact TI pour les audits internes, les audits clients, les inspections réglementaires et les évaluations de conformité.
  • Coordonner les activités d’audit et veiller à ce que les livrables, les réponses et la documentation justificative soient fournies avec exactitude et dans les délais requis.

Ce que nous recherchons :

  • Expérience dans le soutien d’audits internes, d’audits clients, d’inspections réglementaires ou de programmes de conformité dans un environnement réglementé.
  • Expérience liée au cycle de vie du développement logiciel (SDLC), au cycle de vie de validation des logiciels (SVLC), à la validation des systèmes informatisés (CSV) ou à des processus qualité similaires.
  • La certification CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) et/ou la certification ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) constituent un atout.
  • Une combinaison équivalente de formation, d’études et d’expérience pourra être considérée en remplacement du diplôme.

Les connaissances, compétences et aptitudes requises pour ce poste :

  • Excellente connaissance des exigences réglementaires et des bonnes pratiques de l’industrie, notamment FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, Annexe 11, ICH E6, ISO 15189 et des principes GxP appliqués aux systèmes informatisés réglementés.
  • Expérience dans l’interprétation et l’application des exigences réglementaires, la gestion de programmes de conformité, l’évaluation des risques et le soutien aux audits internes, aux audits clients et aux inspections réglementaires.
  • Connaissance de la validation des systèmes informatisés (CSV), de la documentation de validation, de la gestion des changements, des CAPA, des systèmes de gestion de la qualité (QMS), du contrôle documentaire, de la gouvernance TI et des méthodologies d’essais logiciels.
  • Connaissance des principes et pratiques d’audit; la certification CISA et/ou ISTQB constitue un atout.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en résolution de problèmes, en analyse, en communication, en gestion des parties prenantes et en coordination de projets, combinées à une grande rigueur et à un souci exceptionnel du détail.
  • Vous devrez travailler directement avec des départements, des équipes, des fonctions de soutien et des parties prenantes d’IQVIA situés partout au Canada et à travers le monde. Par conséquent, une connaissance fonctionnelle de l’anglais, tant à l’écrit qu’à l’oral, est nécessaire à l’exercice des fonctions de ce poste.

Ce que nous vous offrons :


Nous plaçons nos employés au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons et nous nous engageons à leur offrir, ainsi qu’à leur famille, des avantages sociaux qui répondent à leurs besoins diversifiés et évolutifs. Nous investissons dans des programmes intégrés d’avantages sociaux et dans des ressources favorisant le bien-être physique, mental, émotionnel, financier et social de nos employés afin qu’ils puissent s’épanouir à la maison comme au travail, à chaque étape de leur parcours de bien-être.


Pour en savoir plus sur nos avantages sociaux, visitez


Si vous souhaitez réaliser votre plein potentiel, joignez-vous à IQVIA Laboratories et contribuez à rendre l’extraordinaire possible!

As an IT Compliance Analyst, you will oversee compliance activities related to validated systems and support audit readiness across IQVIA Laboratories. What You'll Be Doing:

  • Analyze audit findings, track compliance metrics, identify trends and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Deliver compliance and quality training to IT teams and stakeholders based on audit outcomes, process gaps and regulatory requirements.

  • Support CAPA activities, SOP reviews, user access reviews, disaster recovery testing and other compliance-related initiatives to maintain the validated state.
