jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Technical GTM Operations Partner to help Bask Health improve how our commercial and technical teams work together throughout the merchant lifecycle.

You'll partner with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Customer Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, and Product to coordinate technical engagements and make sure the right teams are involved at the right time.

This role focuses on the operational processes connecting commercial opportunities with technical execution. You'll help manage technical engagement requests, improve handoffs, track commitments, and give stakeholders clear visibility into the progress of customer-facing technical work.

You'll also identify gaps in existing processes and help establish consistent ways for commercial teams to request technical support, communicate requirements, and follow through on customer commitments.

We're looking for someone who is organized, comfortable working with technical teams, and able to bring structure to cross-functional processes without slowing people down.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and technical teams to improve coordination across merchant engagements.
  • Develop and maintain operational processes for requesting customer-facing technical support.
  • Coordinate technical engagement requests involving Solutions Engineering, Customer Solutions Engineering, and Forward Deployed Engineering.
  • Help establish clear criteria for when technical teams should participate in commercial opportunities.
  • Support technical engagement planning for prospective merchants.
  • Coordinate technical support requirements for existing merchant accounts.
  • Improve handoffs between commercial teams and technical specialists.
  • Help ensure technical teams receive complete information before beginning an engagement.
  • Maintain visibility into incoming technical requests, assigned owners, and engagement status.
  • Work with technical leads to understand resource availability and assignment priorities.
  • Support consistent intake and prioritization processes for technical GTM requests.
  • Identify missing requirements, unclear ownership, and operational blockers.
  • Coordinate follow-up between commercial and technical stakeholders.
  • Track technical commitments made during sales and customer discussions.
  • Help ensure commitments are documented and communicated to the appropriate teams.
  • Develop standardized templates for technical engagement requests and handoffs.
  • Support the coordination of technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and integration-related engagements.
  • Work with Product and Engineering when merchant requirements involve platform capabilities or development dependencies.
  • Improve communication around technical feasibility, timelines, and outstanding requirements.
  • Help establish consistent processes for escalating complex technical requests.
  • Track technical engagement activity across merchant opportunities and accounts.
  • Develop reports on request volume, engagement status, and operational turnaround times.
  • Analyze recurring bottlenecks in commercial-to-technical workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce delays caused by incomplete requests or unclear ownership.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to improve CRM tracking of technical engagement activities.
  • Support consistent documentation of technical engagement outcomes.
  • Work with Customer Success to improve transitions from presales technical discussions to post-sale implementation.
  • Coordinate cross-functional reviews of outstanding technical GTM requests.
  • Support improvements to project management and engagement tracking tools.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive request intake and reporting tasks.
  • Help develop operational guidelines for technical GTM engagement processes.
  • Monitor adoption of new workflows and gather feedback from stakeholders.
  • Prepare recommendations for improving technical GTM coordination and execution.
  • Support operational planning for new commercial initiatives requiring technical involvement.
  • Help commercial and technical leaders understand recurring demand patterns and process challenges.
  • Support additional technical GTM operations projects as Bask grows.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in GTM Operations, Technical Operations, Solutions Engineering Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related field.
  • Experience coordinating work between commercial and technical teams in a B2B technology environment.
  • Strong understanding of technical customer engagement processes.
  • Experience improving intake, assignment, and handoff workflows.
  • Familiarity with technical presales or post-sales support processes.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional projects involving Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple technical engagement requests and changing priorities.
  • Experience developing operational processes and documentation.
  • Strong understanding of ownership, escalation, and stakeholder communication processes.
  • Experience using CRM and project management tools.
  • Ability to track operational performance and identify process bottlenecks.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with spreadsheets and operational reporting.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accurate tracking.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting workflow improvements or operational change initiatives.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of cross-functional processes.
  • Ability to work in a fast-moving environment with competing priorities.
  • Availability to collaborate during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting Solutions Engineering or Sales Engineering teams.
  • Experience working with Customer Solutions Engineers or Forward Deployed Engineers.
  • Familiarity with technical discovery and solution design processes.
  • Experience coordinating API integration or technical implementation requests.
  • Experience supporting B2B SaaS or platform businesses.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms and merchant technology.
  • Experience using Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM systems.
  • Experience using Jira, Linear, Asana, or similar project management tools.
  • Experience improving presales-to-post-sales technical handoffs.
  • Familiarity with technical resource planning and capacity management.
  • Experience developing technical engagement dashboards or operational reports.
  • Experience supporting enterprise or mid-market merchant accounts.
  • Familiarity with technical escalation processes.
  • Experience working with Product and Engineering on customer requirements.
  • Familiarity with telehealth or healthcare technology.
  • Experience supporting technical GTM operations in a growing SaaS company.

jobs.description:
Career Category

Information Systems

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Associate Director – Data and Visualization


What you will do


Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. Amgen is seeking an experienced and accomplished Associate Director to join our drug discovery efforts in the Computational Chemistry team. The Associate Director, Data & Visualization will play a key role in determining the strategy and implementing solutions for data pipelines and analysis to empower decision making on small molecule pipeline projects. This role demands a strong blend of business acumen, technical expertise, and strategic thinking to align data capabilities with the company's mission and growth. The Associate Director will also function as a representative for data initiatives across Research, influencing technology investment and enterprise direction. This position is a senior scientific role with significant leadership responsibilities and opportunities.

In this vital role, you will:


  • Own the continued development of software packages for the creation and maintenance of custom small molecule data pipelines.
  • Support data integration with platforms for analytics and visualization to empower decision making on drug discovery projects.
  • Collaborate with teams across Research to implement and adopt solutions for the management of scientific data.
  • Champion innovation and continuous evolution of Amgen’s data and analytics landscape through the adoption of new technologies and industry best practices.
  • Partner closely with Enterprise Architecture, Data Governance, Data Engineering, Analytics, AI/ML, and IT Security teams to operationalize data solutions.
  • Directly supervise and lead computational scientists and data engineers.
  • Communicate data strategy and team deliverables to executive leadership and other non-technical stakeholders.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The experienced professional we seek is a leader with these qualifications.


Basic Qualifications:


  • Doctorate degree and 3 years of experience in Data Science, Data Engineering, or related experience; OR
  • Master’s degree and 5 years of experience in Data Science, Data Engineering, or related experience; OR
  • Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of experience in Data Science, Data Engineering, or related experience; OR
  • Associate’s degree and 12 years of experience in Data Science, Data Engineering, or related experience, OR
  • High school diploma / GED and 14 years of experience in Data Science, Data Engineering, or related experience

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Academic or professional background in chemistry, biology, biochemistry, biophysics, computational biology, bioinformatics, or a related life-science discipline.
  • Expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), modern data technologies (data lakes, APIs, ETL/ELT frameworks), and programming languages (e.g., Python).
  • Experience with standard cheminformatics tools and software packages/ platforms to analyze molecular structures and SAR data (e.g., rdkit, Schrodinger’s LiveDesign, etc).
  • Experience building dashboards and visualizations for small molecule data (e.g., using Spotfire).
  • Experience designing and evaluating agentic AI architectures, including tool use, orchestration, planning, memory, guardrails, human oversight, and production monitoring.
  • Experience building and leading high-performing technical teams, developing professionals, and informing resource allocation.
  • Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • The preferred location for this position is at our Thousand Oaks (CA); but consideration will be given to remote candidates as well.

What you can expect of us


As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans
  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

careers.amgen.com

Application deadline

Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.

Sponsorship

Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
Clinical Trial Manager ll/ SrCTM, Multisponsor, based in Serbia

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Roles within the Clinical Trial Management job family are responsible for all aspects of the development, coordination, and implementation of Phase 1 clinical research studies at the organization's facilities. Collaborates with the principal investigator, liaisons between research subjects, client teams, investigators, and clinic operations teams, and plans logistics and resource usage. Tracks study progress in alignment with project milestones, client deliverables, and budget, and follows applicable regulations globally and by region.Impact and ContributionIncludes executives as well as managers, supervisors and team leads providing strategic vision and/or tactical direction across a discipline and/or broader organization. The majority of time is spent overseeing their area of responsibility, planning, prioritizing, and/or directing the responsibilities of employees. Goal are achieved through management of process, policy, and performance of direct and/or indirect reports. Supervises experienced support employees and/or entry individual contributors. Delivers operational results that have moderate impact on the immediate achievement of results for the team. Broad job knowledge in an operational, administrative and/or specialized field, adapts new procedures, techniques, tools, etc. Understands basic management approaches such as work scheduling, prioritizing, coaching and process execution.
  • Responsible for site management oversight, clinical monitoring and central monitoring deliverables with a focus on patient safety, protocol/GCP/regulatory compliance and data integrity.
  • Oversees site interactions post activation through site closeout. This may include patient recruitment, investigator payments or other related activities.
  • May be responsible for identification of critical data and process, protocol execution risks and risk mitigations related to completion of the Risk Assessment and Categorization Tool (RACT).
  • Reviews the study scope of work, budget and protocol content and ensures the clinical project team (CRAs/Central Monitors) is aware of the contractual obligations and parameters.
  • Uses prior clinical experience, operational data, metrics and reports to identify risks to clinical trial management deliverables.
  • Escalates to the project manager any risks to clinical trial management deliverables (timeline, quality and budget) and any activities and requests which are out of contracted scope.
  • Employs strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to propose and implement risk mitigations.
  • Participates and presents in key meetings such as Kick Off Meeting.
  • Serves as an escalation point for communications with investigator site staff and may be required to interact on the phone or in person with principal investigators or other site staff members. This may include accompanying CRA team members to sites for observation or conflict resolution.
  • Collaborates with other functional leaders such as Study Start Up, Patient Recruitment and Data Management to coordinate delivery handoffs and meet expected study milestones such as site activation targets, enrollment targets and database lock timelines. Reviews and provides feedback on other functional plans (e.g. Data Management Plan, Communication Plan) as they relate to the clinical trial management activities.
  • Responsible for development and ongoing maintenance of clinical study tools and templates, including the Clinical Monitoring Plan. Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.
  • Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.
  • Oversees resourcing allocations for CRAs and Central Monitors, site assignments and study team members' conduct, and identifies risks to delivery or quality.
  • Ensures quality of the clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management deliverables within a project and maintain proper visibility of its progress by the use of approved systems and / or tracking tools.
  • Reviews the project oversight dashboards and other clinical trial systems (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Data Capture (EDC), eDiary, Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes (ePROs),Trial Master File (TMF), IVRS/IWRS, Central Monitoring dashboards), to oversee site and patient activities, study team conduct and to ensure the data has been updated to reflect timely execution of all operational aspects (required visits/calls, duration, and frequency) according to plan.
  • Understands the monitoring strategy required for the study and, where required, participates in the development of the study risk assessment plan. Is accountable for their assigned clinical team members' understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP/SMP, and risk plans.
  • Reviews the content and quality of site and central monitoring documentation (site monitoring calls, site visit reports, site letters, central monitoring reports and pertinent correspondence), to ensure they represent site management activities and conduct and that they appropriately convey any risks to protocol/GCP compliance, trial conduct, patient safety or data integrity. Document requested revisions and approvals in CTMS. Ensures these deliverables are provided according to company and/or sponsor specifications, including delivery deadlines.
  • Interacts with the client and other functional departments related to clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management activities and deliverables. Provides status updates on the clinical deliverables and risks to clients, project management and leadership as per departmental or study agreements. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.
  • Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations. This may include data management, study start up, patient recruitment, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance and Quality Assurance (QA). Supports Inspection Readiness for clinical trial management scope.
  • Oversees CRAs and Central Monitors assigned to the study and routinely assesses study-specific process and training compliance, CMP compliance, and identifies emerging risks. May develop and support execution of corrective action plans at site and study level. Supports and completes activities to achieve data cut and lock deadlines.
  • Provides feedback to line managers on staff performance including strengths as well as areas for development. May be assigned to larger,more complex trials.

Qualifications:



  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align teams in the achievement of project milestones
  • Demonstrated capability of working in an international environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in site management and monitoring (clinical or central)
  • Preferred experience with risk-based monitoring
  • Demonstrates understanding of clinical trial management financial principles and budget management
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills
  • Good communication, presentation and interpersonal skills among project team and with sites
  • Strong conflict resolution skills
  • Demonstrated ability to apply problem solving techniques to resolve complex issues, and apply a risk management approach to identifying and mitigating potential threats to the successful conduct of a clinical research project.
  • Demonstrates critical thinking to determine the cause and appropriate solution in the identification of issues
  • Moderate travel may be required, approximately 20%

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. jobs.description:
Description et livrables de la prestation

Contexte de la mission :

Dans le cadre d’un programme de transformation des processus achats, contrats et paiements (Source-to-Contract-to-Pay), un groupe international recherche un consultant senior pour renforcer son dispositif sur le périmètre Ivalua–SAP.
La mission porte sur trois axes : la définition et la mise en œuvre de la supervision des flux, le pilotage des sujets cybersécurité et la finalisation de la documentation d’architecture.
Le consultant intervient en collaboration avec les équipes Architecture, Cybersécurité, Infrastructure, Intégration, Exploitation et les équipes métiers. Il assure le reporting de son périmètre auprès de la direction de projet.

Responsabilités :

1. Définir et piloter la mise en œuvre de la supervision des flux

  • Recueillir les besoins de supervision auprès des équipes techniques et d’exploitation.
  • Identifier les flux critiques du périmètre et définir les exigences de surveillance associées.
  • Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles et techniques de supervision.
  • Coordonner les travaux avec les équipes Splunk pour la mise en place des tableaux de bord, indicateurs, alertes et journaux.
  • Définir les procédures de supervision, de traitement des incidents et d’escalade.
  • Vérifier la couverture des flux critiques et la qualité du dispositif avant les mises en production.

2. Piloter les sujets cybersécurité :

  • Être l’interlocuteur privilégié des équipes Cybersécurité pour le programme.
  • Coordonner les travaux de sécurité applicative et d’architecture.
  • Organiser et préparer les revues de sécurité et audits portant sur les applications, les infrastructures et les flux.
  • Consolider les réponses aux questionnaires et demandes des équipes Cyber.
  • Suivre les recommandations d’audit et piloter les plans d’action avec les équipes concernées.
  • Formaliser les exigences, décisions et risques résiduels, et assurer leur traçabilité dans les documents d’architecture.

3. Finaliser la documentation d’architecture :

  • Animer les ateliers avec les interlocuteurs techniques et fonctionnels.
  • Consolider les contributions des différents domaines.
  • Finaliser le Dossier de Conception Générale (DCG) et le Dossier d’Architecture Générale (DAG).
  • Contribuer au Dossier d’Architecture Technique (DAT), notamment sur les volets sécurité et supervision.
  • Vérifier la cohérence des choix d’architecture avec les standards du groupe.
  • Assurer la traçabilité des décisions et préparer les dossiers destinés aux instances de validation.

Livrables attendus :

  • Dossier de spécifications de supervision des flux.
  • Matrice des exigences de supervision.
  • Procédures de supervision et d’exploitation.
  • DCG et DAG finalisés.
  • Contributions au DAT.
  • Comptes rendus des revues cybersécurité.
  • Suivi des recommandations d’audit et des plans d’action.
  • Tableau de bord d’avancement des sujets cybersécurité et supervision.

Expertise souhaitée

Profil recherché :

Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en architecture technique et intégration applicative, avec une pratique concrète de la supervision des échanges et de leur mise en exploitation.
Vous savez traduire les besoins des équipes en exigences techniques, coordonner leur réalisation et vérifier les résultats. Vous êtes à l’aise dans un rôle transverse nécessitant de dialoguer avec des experts techniques, des équipes cybersécurité et des interlocuteurs métiers.

Compétences indispensables :

  • Définition et mise en œuvre de dispositifs de supervision des flux.
  • Compréhension des architectures d’intégration : API REST, middleware / ESB et échanges HTTP(S), SFTP ou MQ.
  • Maîtrise des principes de journalisation, d’observabilité et de gestion des incidents.
  • Capacité à rédiger des spécifications et à coordonner plusieurs équipes techniques.

Compétences importantes :

  • Élaboration et finalisation de dossiers d’architecture.
  • Pilotage de sujets cybersécurité et suivi de recommandations d’audit.
  • Connaissance de Splunk pour la supervision et l’exploitation des journaux.
  • Compréhension des mécanismes IAM / SSO, TLS et de gestion des certificats.
  • Connaissance des processus et outils ITSM, tels que ServiceNow ou équivalent.

Atouts complémentaires :

  • Expérience de projets d’intégration Ivalua–SAP.
  • Connaissance des processus achats, contrats, facturation et paiement.
  • Expérience dans un environnement de groupe international.

Qualités attendues :

  • Leadership transverse et capacité à mobiliser des équipes sans lien hiérarchique.
  • Rigueur documentaire et esprit de synthèse.
  • Autonomie, organisation et suivi des engagements.
  • Capacité à identifier les risques et à faire remonter les arbitrages nécessaires.
  • Aisance relationnelle avec des interlocuteurs techniques et métiers.

Mobilité

Non renseigné

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Check out this video and find out why our team loves to work here!

Join Us! CDM Smith – where amazing career journeys unfold.

Imagine a place committed to offering an unmatched employee experience. Where you work on projects that are meaningful to you. Where you play an active part in shaping your career journey. Where your co-workers are invested in you and your success. Where you are encouraged and supported to do your very best and given the tools and resources to do so. Where it’s a priority that the company takes good care of you and your family.

Our employees are the heart of our company. As an employer of choice, our goal is to provide a challenging, progressive and inclusive work environment which fosters personal leadership, career growth and development for every employee. We value passionate individuals who challenge the norm, deliver world-class solutions and bring diverse perspectives. Join our team, and together we will make a difference and change the world.


Job Description

Seeking a highly qualified business development and capture professional to lead CDM Smith’s strategy and partnerships with national and regional General Contractors pursuing alternative delivery opportunities such as Progressive Design-Build (PDB), Design-Build to Budget (DB2B) and large-scale Design-Build (DB) for the U.S. Government, worldwide.

The Alternative Delivery Market Lead will focus on positioning CDM Smith as the exclusive or preferred lead design partner on prime contractor teams before the release of solicitations. This role will identify priority pursuits, assess General Contractor capability and qualifications, and build executive-level relationships that lead to early teaming commitments.

As the Federal Alternative Delivery Market Lead, you will work collaboratively with our Client Service Leaders (CSLs) and our technical, preconstruction, legal, and sales teams to develop and execute teaming strategies that improve CDM Smith’s probability of award. The role is accountable for the General Contractor relationship pipeline and supporting our CSLs from target identification through execution of teaming agreements and scopes of work.

As a member of our high-performing team, you will contribute to CDM Smith’s federal mission by:
• Targeting and establishing direct relationships with regional and national General Contractors actively pursuing federal alternative delivery contracts.
• Positioning CDM Smith as the preferred design subcontractor early in the procurement cycle and negotiating exclusivity, teaming terms, and scopes of work prior to solicitation.
• Working with the pursuit team to present engineering expertise, constructability, cost validation, design-phase management, risk mitigation, and phased delivery models directly to General Contractor teams.
• Leading teaming strategy for Department of War and other federal agency opportunities by translating procurement and solicitation criteria into competitive designer-led subcontract, joint-venture, or other teaming structures.
• Working with federal CSLs on maintaining a qualified pipeline of federal alternative delivery opportunities, prime contractor targets, relationship status, teaming decisions, and next actions.
• Tracking federal agency movement toward accelerated delivery methods and aligning pursuit resources with prime contractor interest, capacity, and probability of award.
• Identifying and resolving the operational friction points between the General Contractor and the architect-engineer team during design validation, constructability review, cost reconciliation, and development of the target price or Guaranteed Maximum Price.
• Serving as the senior relationship and capture lead through teaming agreement execution and transition to the pursuit and delivery teams.


Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree.

• 15 years of related experience.

  • Domestic and/or international travel may be required. The frequency of travel is contingent on specific duties, responsibilities, and the essential functions of the position, which may vary depending on workload and project demands.
  • Equivalent additional directly related experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in federal architecture, engineering, and construction business development, capture management, preconstruction, or an equivalent role.
  • Direct experience working for or closely alongside a General Contractor on alternative delivery projects, including Progressive Design-Build or traditional Design-Build.
  • Demonstrated understanding of federal procurement mechanics, including FAR Part 36, two-phase Design-Build selection, qualifications-based selection, and Progressive Design-Build commercial models such as target price or Guaranteed Maximum Price development.
  • Demonstrated success developing executive-level relationships and converting those relationships into teaming agreements, defined scopes of work, and pursuit commitments.
  • Practical knowledge of design risk, cost validation, constructability, schedule integration, and budget reconciliation during the progressive design and preconstruction phases.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, relationship management, business acumen, organization, and leadership skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Business, or a related technical discipline. Equivalent direct field, preconstruction, and commercial experience will be considered
  • Experience negotiating exclusive designer-of-record/engineering relationships, teaming agreements, and early-phase scopes for federal alternative delivery pursuits.
  • Experience supporting large, complex, or geographically dispersed military infrastructure programs.

Amount of Travel Required

20% - 40%

We attract the best people in the industry, supporting their efforts to learn and grow. We strive to create a challenging and progressive work environment. We provide career opportunities that span a variety of disciplines and geographic locations, with projects that our employees plan, design, build and operate as diverse as the needs of our clients. CDM Smith Inc. and its divisions and subsidiaries are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Career

The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks. As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer’s security transformation journey. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security operations services that establish PANW as your customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.

Your Impact


  • Curiosity is core to the Solutions Consultant role, and you see complex problems as opportunities to learn and deliver innovative solutions! You define your impact by:
  • Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross-platform solutions.
  • Understands Key customer business requirements and has the ability to position, demonstrate and create high level designs across the entire PANW portfolio solutions creating business value for customers.
  • Ability to drive customer adoption of Palo Alto Networks Platform. Building customer relationships by helping customers achieve increased productivity, operational efficiency, security efficacy, and greater flexibility to innovate.
  • Conducting discovery to understand and articulate the key technical, operational, and commercial imperatives of your prospects and customers
  • Working closely with Professional Services, Customer Success and Specialist teams to ensure overall customer implementation and adoption of solutions.
  • Demonstrating strong communication skills, influencing through effective presentations and customer-specific demos, and conducts technical engagements and workshops that are clear and impactful, simplifying complex ideas for various audiences
  • Leading successful technical validation efforts based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities.
  • Demonstrates Cross functional leadership driving collaboration and orchestrating supporting resources (Specialists, Channel Resources, Customer Support) to ensure a one-team approach that demonstrates a cohesive strategy.
  • Promoting end-to-end solutions that include PANW and/or partner professional services to ensure customers realize business value sooner
  • Understanding the competitive landscape and effectively differentiating PANW's leadership in the cybersecurity space
  • Continuously investing in yourself to develop technical and professional skills that drive your ever-increasing contributions to success of our customers while actively participating within the Solutions Consultant community and at industry events
  • Identifying technical stakeholders and cultivating relationships with key personas to build and drive a security architecture transformation roadmap

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • 3+ years experience in pre-sales/sales engineering
  • Skilled in at least one of the following Networking, Network Security, Cybersecurity, Private/Public Cloud Security, SOC/Endpoint or SASE.
  • Experience in delivering cybersecurity solutions that solve technical challenges and influence new business initiatives is preferred
  • Influencing and gaining buy-in from key stakeholders, either in a customer-facing or internal role; prior experience in a pre-sales role is ideal
  • Creating and delivering technical presentations, workshops, or technical validation engagements
  • Experience in selling, designing, implementing, or managing one or more of the following solutions: Network Security, SASE, SaaS, CNAPP and/or SOC Transformation Technologies
  • Partnering with Customer Support functions to ensure successful implementation and adoption of sold solutions
  • Experience in complex sales involving long sales processes with multiple buying centers and multi-product solutions are preferred
  • This is a field sales position where travel requirements may be required to support in person customer meetings, please discuss with the recruiter on the specifics for this position.
  • Proficient in English

¿Eres el estratega de Canales Digitales que transformará la experiencia y comunicación del cliente?

Ubicación / Modalidad: España | 100% Remoto

Horario: Lunes a Viernes de 09:00 a 18:00 (40 horas semanales / Jornada intensiva de 38 horas en agosto)

En Initium Software no somos una consultora tradicional; somos socios estratégicos que conectamos al mejor talento técnico con los proyectos más desafiantes e innovadores del mercado. Creemos en el impacto real a través de la tecnología. Por eso, no buscamos un gestor pasivo; buscamos a un profesional apasionado, capaz de adueñarse de la visión de producto y liderar la entrega técnica en un entorno de alto rendimiento.   • Adueñarte del Product Backlog: Crear, refinar y priorizar las user stories asegurando que cumplan estrictamente con los criterios de "Definition of Done" y "Definition of Ready".

Tu Arsenal (¿Qué buscamos en ti?)

Imprescindible (Requisitos Obligatorios):

jobs.excerpt: À propos de Workleap Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006.
jobs.description:
À propos de Workleap

Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006. Bâtisseurs dans l'âme, on crée des produits simples qui font une réelle différence pour ceux qui les utilisent. On a deux lignes de produits : Workleap, notre nouvelle solution conçue pour aider chaque gestionnaire à être plus efficace et ShareGate, la référence mondiale de migration et de gouvernance Microsoft 365. Plus de 15 000 entreprises dans le monde nous font confiance pour faire exactement ça. On est intentionnels dans notre choix des gens qu'on recrute : des personnes qui ont envie de retrousser leurs manches et de construire quelque chose de significatif dans une des périodes les plus excitantes de l'histoire de la tech.

Commence ici. Va loin.

Les belles carrières en ventes commencent quelque part. Les nôtres commencent dans l’équipe SDR.

On embauche des talents en ventes de niveau d’entrée régulièrement. L’équipe grandit et nos gens progressent. Si tu ne vois pas le bon poste aujourd’hui, postule quand même. On garde ton profil au dossier et on te contacte quand une place s’ouvre.

Là où tu commencerais : SDR chez ShareGate

Tu es la première voix que les acheteur.euse.s TI entendent. Tu démarres des conversations, tu poses les bonnes questions et tu transmets aux AE un lead avec du vrai contexte, pas juste un nom et un numéro.

Tu travailles avec ton propre agent IA, qui gère les lots de prospection sortante et les leads faciles. Toi, tu te concentres sur les appels, les comptes à forte valeur et le travail qui demande un humain. Tu apprends Protect et Migrate, et les pros TI qui s’en servent.

Là où tu pourrais aller

  • Account Executive (AE) : Tu fermes les deals que tu as aidé à lancer.
  • Account Manager (AM) : Tu prends en charge la relation après la vente et tu aides les clients à grandir avec nous.

On promeut de l’intérieur. Ce n’est pas un slogan, c’est comme ça que l’équipe grandit.

Ce que tu apportes

  • De l’expérience en ventes ou dans un rôle axé sur des cibles (SDR, BDR, ventes internes)
  • De l’aisance au téléphone et en vidéo, en anglais
  • De la résilience pour les appels à froid et les séquences multi-touch
  • De la curiosité pour l’IA. Tu utilises déjà Claude ou ChatGPT ? Parfait aussi.
  • De la rigueur dans ton pipeline : plusieurs conversations en parallèle, rien qui tombe entre les craques
  • Atout : expérience SaaS ou tech, Gong, Sales Navigator ou HubSpot, français

Ce que tu y gagnes

  • Un coaching de près : revues d’appels sur Gong, roleplay, outils IA sur mesure
  • LTIP, REER, assurances collectives familiales, télémédecine, budget bien-être annuel
  • Vacances flexibles
  • Télétravail, avec accès à nos bureaux de Montréal
  • Rassemblement en personne deux fois par an
  • Claude accessible à tous
  • Rémunération SDR : salaire de base de 55k$ - 60k$, OTE de 85k$ - 90k$ (échelle pancanadienne, ajustée selon la région)

Et ensuite ?

On examine les candidatures de façon continue. Si ton profil correspond à un poste à venir, une recruteuse ou un recruteur te contactera. Sinon, on garde tes informations au dossier.

Ce qui nous anime

Chez Workleap, on construit des logiciels au cœur de l'expérience de travail, au quotidien, à tous les niveaux.

On avance vite. Les priorités évoluent, les décisions se prennent avec l'information qu'on a, et on itère. Si tu carbures à l'intensité et que l'ambiguïté ne te fait pas peur, tu vas te sentir chez toi. On est des bâtisseurs. On fait ce qu'il faut pour avancer. L'IA fait partie de l'arsenal. On l'utilise pour aller plus vite et décider plus intelligemment, pas pour remplacer le jugement.

Si tu veux de l'impact réel et un endroit où tes décisions comptent, c'est ici.

Comment on recrute

La transparence, c'est notre façon de recruter — pour toi comme pour nous.

Voici comment ça se passe : un premier échange avec un.e recruteur.euse, puis un entretien virtuel avec le.la gestionnaire d'embauche. Tu complètes ensuite une étude de cas à faire chez toi, suivie d'une rencontre avec de futur.es collègues pour en discuter ensemble. Selon le poste, le parcours peut varier légèrement — ton.ta recruteur.euse t'en donnera tous les détails lors de votre premier appel.

On utilise l'IA pour soutenir certaines étapes du processus, mais chaque décision d'embauche reste humaine.

On a hâte de te rencontrer.

En postulant, tu confirmes avoir lu et accepté notre politique de confidentialité.

jobs.description:
At Luscii, we work on several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with your future colleagues, we build technology that takes the burden off patients and healthcare professionals, creating more space for care. As an iOS Developer, you will help make this happen by building and improving the mobile applications that connect people, devices and healthcare.

We create technology to make healthcare more accessible, as our digital health solutions help healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, so people can receive the right care in the right place. As an iOS Developer, you will help us build and improve the mobile applications that make this possible.

Your work goes beyond writing code. You will help shape technical direction, share your expertise with colleagues and explore new technologies that can improve our apps. At Luscii, our Holacratic way of working also gives you the autonomy to take initiative, pick up responsibilities and contribute beyond your core role.

The applications you build need to work reliably in a healthcare context, where stability and usability matter. You are going to make sure that our apps remain performant, scalable and easy to maintain, while exploring new ways to improve the experience for patients and healthcare professionals. By combining solid engineering with thoughtful technical choices, you will help us continue to develop its digital healthcare platform.

Your role

As iOS Developer at Luscii, you will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, working closely with colleagues across development, QA and support to build, improve and maintain our applications. You turn ideas into useful, intuitive digital health solutions. Whether you are exploring a new technology, building a proof of concept or solving a production issue, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and the opportunity to influence how we build our apps.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop and optimize our iOS applications using Swift, with a focus on performance, reliability and user experience.

  • Contribute to application architecture, technical design and the continued development of our modular codebase.

  • Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore ideas and validate technical solutions early.

  • Create intuitive user interfaces and experiences tailored to iOS devices.

  • Develop and maintain features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.

  • Troubleshoot production issues, review code and help colleagues make sound implementation decisions.

  • Explore relevant developments in mobile technology, including SwiftUI, and assess how they can improve our applications.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii).

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least 5 years of experience as an iOS or mobile developer.

  • You have a relevant bachelor’s degree in e.g. Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a comparable field, combined with experience working in an Agile environment.

  • You have experience writing unit tests and/or UI tests for mobile applications.

  • You understand object-oriented software design and architectural patterns such as MVVM.

  • You have experience with web services, cloud technologies and APIs, and are comfortable debugging issues involving memory management, multithreading and networking.

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via

What does the recruitment process look like?

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.

jobs.excerpt: Product EngineerHigh level stuff you might be filtering against 🔍 Location: Remote (CT/ET Timezone).
jobs.description:
Product Engineer

High level stuff you might be filtering against 🔍
Location: Remote (CT/ET Timezone). Collaborating with teams on the West Coast and in Europe, alongside building out a new hub in Chicago.
Type: Full-time
Salary: Location dependent. As a guide, our current range across all levels is $130k-$190k. We are open to negotiation as we recognise there are different situations, but these are our general guardrails.

What I am looking for

👋 Hi, I’m Martin, Chief Technology Officer at Zen Educate and I’m looking for engineers who can make an impact on the real world problem of education staffing, and do it through engineering excellence.
Every place has its own understanding of what engineering excellence looks like (sometimes written down, sometimes not). Here’s what it means to me and Zen:
• Valuing real world outcomes and shared learning over output
• Product thinking over pure tech - start with the problem, ship quickly and iterate.
• Team success and sustainability over individual heroics.
We are a small, but mighty team and so every engineer has the opportunity to make an outsized impact and put their stamp on what excellence looks like in practice. What do I mean by “small”? Today we have 25 Product Engineers working in small dynamic teams across the Zen product.
We recognise the world is not static - “what got us here, won’t get us there” - so we look for curiosity, adaptability and proactiveness as fundamental traits. The engineers I see be the most successful are those who focus on solving problems, look to help others and just happen to typically leverage technology to do so.
This role is particularly exciting because you’ll be one of Zen’s first Product Engineers in the US, where we’re enjoying rapid growth. You’ll thrive in this role if you’re someone who can build relationships quickly, take ownership of problems end-to-end and help grow a team around you 💪

What we are building and why

Getting the right teacher into the right school at the right time is a crucial problem to solve, both for education outcomes for children and for the sustainability of an industry that spends billions on this.
Today the platform we are building supports internal operations teams on filling roles, educators on finding roles via our mobile app and schools on getting educators in for both short-term and long-term roles. The more we develop the platform (and the ability to self-serve in the marketplace), the more efficient the whole process becomes, which means more money going back to educators and into classrooms (over $65 million globally since 2017).
We are well established in the UK and growing at a phenomenal rate in the US 🚀
What we need now is to reach the next level in how we build our platform to support this growth. That’s where you come in 😉

What the role looks like in practice

II’ve written a bunch of words above that I hope capture your interest and excitement ✨. But what really matters is what reality looks like and the best people to share that are the existing engineers on the team. So here are a few glimpses from your potential peers of some of what they have done in a week:
“I picked up an AI teacher qualification project that started out quite loosely defined, with no clear owner or scope. I spent time aligning with Product and Ops to clarify what problem we were solving, shaped an initial approach, and started delivering iterative improvements so we could test value quickly. Along the way I helped reset direction when momentum dipped.” - Arindam
"I spent the week working on a major overhaul of our permissions system — moving away from hardcoded roles towards something granular and scoped per school, network, and unit. I also wired up audit logging around sensitive actions so we have proper traceability in production, and built out an admin UI so non-engineers can manage roles and permissions without needing to come to us." - João
“I spent the week creating a foundational configuration for our monorepo to help us use AI more effectively when building product and writing code. I worked alongside the AI working group to support some of the bottlenecks we’ve been seeing in our development process, and made the setup clear and practical so other engineers could start using it straight away.” - Eimi
“I implemented backend and frontend MixPanel events for crucial workflows to better understand how users interact with our product and what we can improve on." - Georgi
“I spent the week upgrading our React Native app to the latest Expo SDK. This meant updating dependencies, fixing compatibility issues, and resolving build and runtime problems to keep everything stable. The upgrade puts us on a supported version, reduces future maintenance risk, and gives us access to new tools that will help us ship features faster.”- Ethan
“I spent time this week improving the anonymisation logic in Ditto - our internal tool for cloning production databases safely for development. I also put together the weekly DevEx metrics for the Product and Tech team, covering things like CI pass rates and deployment frequency. Then towards the end of the week I did some work addressing minor vulnerabilities that were found from our monthly red-teaming with CovertSwarm.” - Jai

What you might like or dislike

Every place makes tradeoffs based on what they value and where they are in their journey ⚖️. Here’s a list of things you might find useful in figuring out if this is the right role for you. If we end up chatting, feel free to dig deeper into any of them. Note that some of these are recent changes in our approach and may be “work in progress” when you join.
💻 How We Work
Boring tech for the obvious, experimentation for the rest. Our core is Ruby on Rails, React, React Native, running on Heroku + Cloudflare etc. But we have also evaluated Amazon Personalise as a candidate for our matching system and spiked out our own AI powered knowledge-base as well as investigating AI for bug triaging.
Process serves performance. We work in a Mission-based setup where teams form around outcomes not org charts, unnecessary process or following rules. That means you won't be stuck in a lane - you'll work across different parts of the business based on your strengths and interests. Greater performance gives greater freedom - think “Master your instrument, master the music, and then forget all that and just play.”
Engineers as problem shapers (not ticket takers). You’ll thrive here if you want to shape problems, not just deliver tickets. Our Product Managers and Designers are partners you pull on for leverage rather than task givers who hide the users away. And we’ll encourage you to propose (and lead) Missions that propel the business forward.
Daily shipping culture. We ship regularly and want to get even better at it. We are investing in this and welcome those who’ll help us start smaller and iterate faster.
🌱 Growth & Progression
Choose your own career path. We care more about impact and learning than rigid competency grids. This means greater flexibility in what progression looks like, but requires you to build an understanding of what we value from guiding principles and shared real-world examples.
Your manager is a partner, not a supervisor. You'll have a manager, but they won't be directing your every move. Expect them to help you think through hard problems, offer perspective, and provide nudges to help you grow - not to tell you what to do or check your work. That means you'll need to take ownership of your own progress and speak up when you need unblocking.
Few Titles, infinite Levels. We use Levels instead of Titles to show growth in a Role. You won’t see titles like Associate, Senior, or Staff here. Instead, you can grow continuously by getting better at your current role - e.g. working faster, safer, and more independently. Changing roles is possible too, but depends on business needs, since different roles aim for different business outcomes and typically use different skills.
Investment over reward as a mindset. Level changes are tightly coupled to compensation changes. Confidence in a Level change is based on sustainably doing great work at your current level. We think it is fairer to invest in what you do next, rather than reward you doing the next Level first for free!
💸 Compensation
Market reality. Compensation is based on your competitiveness in your local hiring market (note that’s not just where you live). We don’t believe anyone has found a great solution to global compensation, so we aim instead to be clear and equitable in how we do it.
Solid, but not flashy compensation. We pay decently, but we won’t beat out companies with deeper pockets (yet!).
Think long term investment. If you are in a place where you need to prioritise immediate financial gain then this probably isn’t the right time to join us.

Benefits.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance available for full time employees from day 1
  • 401(k) retirement plan with no match after 6 months
  • 20 Paid Vacation Days and 10 Paid Company Holidays
  • Sick leave provided at or above your location requirements
  • Equity compensation
  • Paid bi-weekly
🤝 Team Culture & Collaboration
Distributed engineering team. Solid communication skills and async habits are key to be effective. You’ll find strong connection here, but not through engineering getting together in-person. If you like the buzz of working near others you are welcome to work from one of our offices, but there won’t be many engineers there on any given day. There will be lots of frontline teams in-office though providing a fast way to build context on problems to solve by seeing them firsthand.
We believe in impact and measurable outcomes, alongside shared learning. If your work moves the needle or teaches us something meaningful then that’s a win. If not, then we’ll want to understand why.
Balanced, sustainable work. Long hours are not a badge of honour - they are an indication something isn’t working well. We value a sustainable pace and healthy teams.
Diversity is good in some ways and lacking in others. You might be the first of something here. That matters and we’ll support appropriately if you are.

How we hire

Hire fast, fix fast. Hiring today is...not great, with most companies being too cautious and taking too long to make a decision 😦. We move quicker - our ideal is: apply Monday, offer by Friday. Then we invest heavily in the most important part - your onboarding. We ensure you are setup for success, with clear direction, experience of different parts of the product and shipping to production within days.
Whilst fast doesn’t mean frivolous, it does slightly increase the risk that you or we made a mistake. So we include regular check-ins during onboarding to make sure expectations match reality. If either side feels something is off then we try to fix it fast. And sometimes that will mean saying “let’s not carry on” with respect.
Real talk. We believe in being direct and authentic. We’ll share the good, the messy and the challenges. We recognise we won’t have all the answers, still have much to learn, and that’s all part of the fun of this wild ride 🚀. We expect the same from you - after all we are just a bunch of humans trying to do great work together.
Mindset, not tools. We hire for how you think and create leverage, not what specific tools you’ve used before. To us, experience is just another tool - it is only valuable through how you leverage it. Curiosity, adaptability, product thinking - those are the durable qualities in a changing world. And we value different opinions, so ensure you share yours - have a point of view, maybe debate a little and we will respect that.\
Always open to great people We are always hiring and happy to chat even if the timing isn’t quite right. That’s why you might see this job post open for a long time. We are not collecting resumes or doing stealth market research, we just believe in the power of serendipity. To make that more transparent - right now we have a clear need for at least 4 more engineers in the team.
Okay, so what will the actual process look like? 👀
• Recruiter quick chat. Our recruiter will check you are human, can communicate effectively and cover some of the basics like compensation, benefits and availability.
• Technical expertise. We will do a paired session with a twist - we will be the ones sharing our screen and writing the code. So come prepared to ask questions, drive progress with another engineer and dig through an ambiguous past problem in our codebase.
• Product thinking. Chat to either our CPO, Dan, or a Product Manager about how you’ve demonstrated a product mindset in the past. Or if you haven’t had opportunity to do that, tell us why and what you’d do differently with us.
• Role chat. This will be with me and our Senior Engineering Manager, Sean. I’ll be wanting to understand how you think and approach the role and engineering excellence, and Sean will give you some insight about what it’s like to be a Product Engineer at Zen. I’ll start by asking you the question you include in your application. And I’ll want to dig into your answers so that this becomes more of a conversation and shared exploration than a Q&A session 😃.
The technical, product thinking and role chat sessions can happen in any order and as quickly as our schedules can align. You could do them all in a day if you want or spread them out a bit.
Once interviewers have shared their feedback from each session we do an internal debrief - that’s where we discuss what we are excited about you for in the role, any challenges we see and whether we think we can mitigate them at this time. From there we will make a decision and either proceed to offer or tell you that we not offering.
As part of the offer stage, we like to meet in person so you can connect with at least one member of the team before you start. It’s a chance to build a bit of human connection beyond the interviews and get a feel for what working together would actually be like.
We believe feedback is important, but also know not everyone wants it - so we don’t share it by default. If you’d like feedback after the process, just let us know. Note that we’ll frame the feedback from our perspective of why we did or did not have the confidence rather than as a commentary on you.

Interested? Let’s go!

If you read all of the above and are excited (maybe even a little nervous) about the opportunity and how we work then I recommend applying now! If you skipped or skimmed the above, feel free to apply anyway but you’re missing a bunch of useful information that could streamline the process for you 😉

jobs.excerpt: 📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkhedenDe organisatie gebruikt ESRI-technologie als basis voor de verdere uitbouw van haar geografische informatiesystemen.
jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

De organisatie gebruikt ESRI-technologie als basis voor de verdere uitbouw van haar geografische informatiesystemen. GIS speelt daarbij een centrale rol in het beheer van assets en netwerkinfrastructuur.

Binnen een multidisciplinair productteam van meer dan 40 IT- en businessspecialisten wordt gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling en implementatie van een GIS-centrisch assetmanagementlandschap. De belangrijkste technologieën zijn ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Pro, ESRI Utility Network en VertiGIS. De oplossingen worden niet alleen technisch gerealiseerd, maar ook geïntegreerd in de dagelijkse processen van verschillende gebruikersgroepen.

Als Functioneel Analist GIS werk je mee aan de analyse, uitwerking, implementatie en organisatiebrede uitrol van GIS-oplossingen. De focus ligt onder meer op de verdere introductie van GIS-viewers en Desktop GIS-oplossingen waarmee gebruikers geografische en assetinformatie kunnen raadplegen, analyseren en beheren.

Je vormt de schakel tussen de business, het productteam en technische specialisten. Je brengt behoeften en bedrijfsprocessen in kaart, vertaalt deze naar duidelijke functionele requirements en werkt samen met ontwikkelaars, GIS-specialisten, architecten en andere betrokkenen aan bruikbare en duurzame oplossingen.

Je neemt onder meer de volgende taken op:

  • Analyseren en structureren van functionele behoeften vanuit verschillende businessdomeinen.
  • Vertalen van bedrijfsprocessen en gebruikersbehoeften naar functionele requirements, user stories en acceptatiecriteria.
  • Meewerken aan oplossingen voor GIS-viewers, Desktop GIS en mobiel GIS-gebruik.
  • Functioneel bijdragen aan oplossingen op basis van ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Pro, ESRI Utility Network, VertiGIS Studio Web en VertiGIS Studio Mobile.
  • Onderzoeken hoe GIS-functionaliteiten optimaal kunnen worden geïntegreerd in bestaande assetmanagement- en bedrijfsprocessen.
  • Ondersteunen van de inrichting, configuratie, testing en validatie van nieuwe GIS-functionaliteiten.
  • Voorbereiden en begeleiden van functionele testen en acceptatietesten.
  • Ondersteunen van de uitrol van nieuwe toepassingen en functionaliteiten naar verschillende gebruikersgroepen.
  • Bewaken van de samenhang tussen processen, data, applicaties en gebruikerservaring.
  • Afstemmen met ontwikkelaars, GIS-experten, architecten, product owners, key users en andere stakeholders.
  • Documenteren van analyses, beslissingen, processen en oplossingen.
  • Actief deelnemen aan de Agile/Scrum-werking van het productteam en Jira en Confluence gebruiken voor backlogbeheer, opvolging en documentatie.

Je combineert een sterke achtergrond in functionele analyse met ervaring in GIS en assetmanagement. Je hoeft niet zelf te ontwikkelen, maar beschikt wel over voldoende technische affiniteit om mee te denken over GIS-architectuur, interfaces, API's, gegevensstromen en de mogelijkheden en beperkingen van het ESRI-platform.

Je kunt zelfstandig analyses opnemen en werkt tegelijk nauw samen met een multidisciplinair team. Ervaring met ESRI Utility Network en VertiGIS is belangrijk, omdat deze technologieën een centrale plaats innemen binnen de beoogde GIS-oplossingen.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Ervaring als functioneel analist.
  • Ervaring met assetmanagement.
  • Kennis van componenten van ArcGIS Enterprise, waaronder Server, Portal, Desktop, SDK's en API's, aangevuld met ervaring met ArcGIS Pro.
  • Ervaring met ESRI Utility Network.
  • Ervaring met VertiGIS Studio Web en VertiGIS Studio Mobile.
  • Ervaring met de Agile/Scrum-projectmethodiek en andere projectmethodieken.
  • Ervaring met Confluence en Jira.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring in de Belgische energiesector.
  • Voldoende technische affiniteit om mee te denken over GIS-architectuur, interfaces, API's en gegevensstromen.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig en communiceert vlot met businessgebruikers, technische specialisten en andere stakeholders.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Location: Remote | Canada

Reports to: Director - Data Insights

Employment Type: Full-time


This is a new vacancy

About the Role:

As part of the Analytics group of JD Power, you will work to understand what factors contribute to used values of vehicles and their residual values over time. This role is responsible for supporting the used vehicle value output of JD Power’s Used Car Guide products and the residual value output of JD Power/ALG residual value products. Responsibilities include analyzing vehicle data provided by OEMs and third-party sources to evaluate vehicle builds and audit used vehicle and residual values. Your expertise in deriving insights from data, formulating data-driven stories and using good judgement in selecting appropriate methods and techniques for analysis will greatly enhance our Valuation Insights team with perspectives about the industry, products, vehicle lifecycle, content developments, and trends. A background in the automotive space is desirable but not required.

The Valuation Insights team is responsible for the used & residual valuation of vehicles in the US and Canada markets. Banks, Dealers, Insurance and Fleet companies use our guidance to support the buying and selling of used vehicles.

In this role, you will:

  • Handling data preparation tasks under supervision.
  • Conducting basic statistical analysis and generating correlations.
  • Building visualizations using Tableau and Excel.
  • Assisting in interpreting data insights under guidance.
  • Learning and applying fundamental data-driven storytelling techniques.
  • Supporting basic data-driven problem-solving tasks.
  • Communicating data insights to stakeholders with guidance.
  • Documenting assumptions about RV and CMV setting, with oversight and best practice refinement from more experienced colleagues.
  • Actively participate in internal meetings related to data insights.
  • Responsible for completing work under a deadline.
  • Work cross-functionally with the Data Science team and other key functions to ensure latest analytics are incorporated in output and continuously improve production processes.

Required Qualifications:

  • At least two years of experience as a data analyst, automotive industry experience a plus, including knowledge of makes, models, segments, performance, lifecycle trends, automotive technology and content – and factors that impact resale values.
  • Previous experience in an organization which provides new and used vehicle estimations.
  • Proficiency in data preparation, basic statistics, correlation and regression concepts.
  • Familiarity of Tableau and Excel for visualization tasks.
  • Understanding of data-driven storytelling techniques and their application.
  • Working knowledge of AI tools for analysis tasks will be a definite plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, Finance, Computer Science or similar field.
  • Excellent critical thinking, data analysis and communication (written and verbal) skills necessary.
  • Must be a proactive problem solver and able to handle complex projects and tasks.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of products.

Compensation and Benefits

This position has a starting salary range of $60,000 - $70,000 CAD per year. The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

Why Join JD Power

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

· We power our customers’ success. Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

· We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data. We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.

deine position

Our stack: TypeScript, NestJS, Next.js, Flutter, GCP, Vercel, Cursor, Datadog.

What you will do:

  • Turn ambiguous problems into clear proposals, working with product and design on discovery

dein profil

  • Proven experience developing, shipping, and monitoring scalable backend software with TypeScript
  • NestJS in large applications is a clear plus. Experience with a similar framework is welcome
  • You communicate ideas clearly in writing and in conversation. Our working language is English
  • You seek input from your peers and create visibility where it is missing
  • Broad knowledge of architectural patterns, and experience implementing them with modern delivery practices
  • You have owned production systems through the full lifecycle, including monitoring and maintenance
