jobs.excerpt: WHO WE AREDrishti Astro is a decision-making brand.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Drishti Astro is a decision-making brand. People come to us stuck on the biggest decisions of their life — which career, whom and when to marry, where to put their money — and we use Vedic astrology as the tool to make that decision clear: what their own birth chart supports, when the timing is strongest, and what to do next. Led by an astrologer with 20 years of practice, we give the decision in writing first, in a personalised report, and then clear every doubt in a one-to-one consultation. Most of our customers are Hindi-speaking families aged 40+, and almost every conversation happens on WhatsApp.

Vision: To become India's most trusted name for taking life's important decisions through Vedic astrology.

Mission: Guide individuals — using Vedic astrology — in taking the important decisions of their life in career, relationships and finances.

The role in one line: make sure every customer leaves able to take their decision with confidence — own customer satisfaction and retention end to end: find out why customers are happy, unhappy or don't come back, then design, ship and measure the fixes yourself, using AI wherever it helps.

OUR CORE VALUES

  1. Customer First — Only Promise What Can Be Delivered
    “जो दे सकते हैं, वही कहेंगे।”
    The customer's need decides what we build, and we commit only to what we can actually deliver.
  2. Resilience / Adaptability
    “जो बदले, उसके साथ बदलो — बिना घबराए।”
    We adapt quickly without losing the core. A setback is information, not a verdict.
  3. Measurable Outcome
    “जो नापा नहीं गया, वो हुआ ही नहीं।”
    Every decision is judged on a number, not an opinion. If it can't be measured, it can't be claimed.

FOUR CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

01 Research

  • Talk to customers (calls, WhatsApp, surveys) — before and after they buy.
  • Read report ratings, feedback and support chats to find the real reasons behind low satisfaction.

02 Analyse

  • Map the journey: ad → website → checkout → report → rating → repeat purchase → consultation.
  • Find where satisfaction and repeat buying drop, with numbers (funnels, cohorts, session recordings).

03 Manage

  • Turn findings into a ranked backlog with a clear metric per item.
  • Write simple specs; work with the founder, marketing and engineering (in-house and AI tools) to deliver.

04 Execute

  • Ship the fix — report improvements, follow-up journeys, feedback loops, AI assistants.
  • Test it, measure the result against the target, keep or roll back.

Research → Analyse → Prioritise → Ship → Measure → Repeat

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 90 DAYS)

  • Day 30: A clear, data-backed list of the top reasons customers rate us low or don't return.
  • Day 60: Fixes for the top two reasons shipped and being measured.
  • Day 90: A measurable rise in report ratings and repeat-purchase rate, and a working feedback loop that keeps finding the next problem.

MUST-HAVE

  • 3+ years in product management, growth or customer experience at a consumer (B2C) product.
  • Proven work on retention, engagement or satisfaction — and the numbers to show for it.
  • Hands-on with user research and product analytics (e.g. Mixpanel, PostHog, Microsoft Clarity, GA, SQL / spreadsheets).
  • Uses AI/LLM tools in daily work and can design AI-powered product features.
  • Comfortable speaking and writing in Hindi — you will talk to our customers.
  • Individual contributor mindset: you do the work yourself, end to end.

GOOD TO HAVE

  • Experience with WhatsApp-first journeys, CRM (Zoho) or consumer apps for 40+ users.
  • Ran A/B tests and can read whether a result is real.
  • Can prototype with no-code / low-code tools (n8n, Make, simple front-end).
  • Interest in astrology, spirituality or wellness products.

NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF

  • You mainly manage teams or write documents without shipping.
  • Your experience is only B2B / enterprise, with no consumer customers.

ENGAGEMENT & COMPENSATION

  • Engagement: Part-time / Full-time, remote
  • Compensation: ₹6–12 LPA (₹6,00,000 – ₹12,00,000 per year), based on experience and engagement type
  • Reports to: Founder & CEO, working closely with the CMO
  • Start date: Immediate

jobs.description:
About PatientIQ

PatientIQ is a fast-growing health tech company on a mission to improve patient outcomes. We partner with healthcare providers, medical device companies, and researchers to collect, analyze, and act on patient-reported outcomes data at scale — powering smarter clinical decisions and accelerating the future of value-based care.

Headquartered in Chicago and backed by top-tier venture capital and major health system investors, PatientIQ is building the largest platform for healthcare providers, industry partners, and researchers to collaborate on what matters most: helping patients get better.

The opportunity

Health systems that adopt PatientIQ rarely stop at one service line. The value of outcomes data compounds as more sites, specialties, and teams use it, but that growth does not happen on its own. It takes someone who understands the customer’s clinical and financial priorities and turns them into a plan.

As a Strategic Account Manager, you will own the relationship, the account plan, and the growth outcome for a focused portfolio of PatientIQ’s most strategic customers, primarily large health systems. You are accountable for net revenue retention, gross revenue retention, and expansion in your accounts. You will be the executive-level partner customers call first.

This is a revenue-owning role, not a support role. Our new business team wins the account and hands it to you through a structured transition. From there, you protect the relationship, expand adoption, and build the case for long-term growth. You will work closely with Customer Success, Customer Operations, Renewals and Deal Desk, Provider Sales, Product, and Clinical.

This role reports to the VP, Customer Growth, and is one of the first Strategic Account Manager seats in a newly formed Customer Growth organization. You will help write the playbook.

What you'll do

STRATEGIC ACCOUNT OWNERSHIP

  • Portfolio ownership: Own the commercial outcome for your accounts, including net revenue retention, gross revenue retention, and expansion targets.
  • Account planning: Build and maintain a written strategic plan for each account covering stakeholders, adoption, risks, and expansion opportunities. Review each plan with the VP, Customer Growth every quarter.
  • Executive relationships: Build and sustain relationships from clinical champions to the C-suite across quality, service lines, operations, IT, and finance. Lead executive business reviews that tie PatientIQ outcomes to the customer’s priorities.

EXPANSION

  • Expansion pipeline: Identify, qualify, and close expansion across additional sites, specialties, service lines, and PatientIQ solutions. Keep a current weekly forecast in HubSpot.
  • Deal structure: Work with Deal Desk to structure multi-site and multi-year agreements and protect pricing integrity.
  • Adjacent offerings: Introduce additional PatientIQ and partner offerings where they serve the customer’s goals.

RETENTION AND RISK

  • Renewal outcomes: Partner with the Renewals team so every renewal in your portfolio is prepared well in advance, and own the executive conversation when a renewal is at risk.
  • Early warning: Use adoption, data collection rates, and stakeholder changes to spot risk early, and lead the response to escalations.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL EXECUTION

  • New business handoffs: Receive accounts from Provider Sales through a structured transition. Run joint introductions with the selling AE and honor commitments made during the sale.
  • Customer Success and Customer Operations: Align with the CSM and implementation teams on adoption and escalations. You own the commercial and executive relationship, and they own day-to-day success and delivery.
  • Voice of the customer: Bring workflow gaps, integration needs, and product requests to Product and Clinical teams, with the business case attached.
  • Operating discipline: Keep HubSpot accurate, follow the company’s account ownership and credit rules, and share what works so the playbook improves.

What success looks like

We believe clarity drives performance. Here's what the first 90 days look like in this role:

  • 30 days: Onboarding complete. You have reviewed the history and transition notes for every account in your portfolio, completed joint introductions with each customer, and drafted an initial account plan for each.
  • 60 days: Executive relationship map built for each account. First executive business reviews held or scheduled. Expansion opportunities logged in HubSpot with next steps. Renewal calendar reviewed with the Renewals team.
  • 90 days: Account plans reviewed and approved by the VP, Customer Growth. Weekly forecast accurate and current. First expansion opportunities at proposal stage. No unresolved escalations in your portfolio..

Requirements

What you bring

REQUIRED

  • Strategic account management: 7+ years in enterprise account management, revenue-owning customer success, or sales within health IT, digital health, or clinical technology.
  • Retention and expansion ownership: A track record of carrying and exceeding an expansion or retention target, and comfort being measured on net and gross revenue retention.
  • Executive credibility: Established relationships with, or the credibility to build them with, health system leaders in quality, service lines, operations, and IT. You can run an executive business review without a script.
  • Complex deal experience: Experience structuring multi-site, multi-year expansions through procurement, legal, and finance review.
  • Healthcare data literacy: Able to discuss patient-reported outcomes, EHR integration, and clinical quality measurement with physicians and quality leaders. Familiarity with Epic environments is a plus.
  • CRM discipline: HubSpot (preferred) or Salesforce proficiency, including accurate opportunity management and weekly forecasting.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Surgical and specialty service lines: Experience with orthopedics, spine, neurosurgery, or cardiology programs.
  • Registry and quality programs: Familiarity with specialty society registries or CMS quality payment programs.
  • Early-stage function building: Experience helping a company stand up its first strategic account program.

Benefits

Why PatientIQ

  • Mission-driven work. We're solving a hard problem that matters — improving patient outcomes through better data. Every person here is working on something real.
  • True idea meritocracy. Great ideas win, regardless of title. We encourage every team member to challenge the status quo.
  • World-class team. You'll work alongside people who are at the top of their fields in health tech, enterprise software, and clinical science.
  • Fast-growing. We're building the largest platform for healthcare providers and industry to collaborate — and we're just getting started.
  • Great benefits. Top-notch health, dental, and vision. 401(k). Flexible PTO — we trust you to take the time you need. Professional development stipends.
  • Real ownership. This is not a role where you maintain someone else's playbook. You'll build, shape strategy, and see your impact directly.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Chomps is America’s fastest-growing meat snack brand, redefining convenient snacking with a commitment to real ingredients and bold, satisfying flavors. Crafted from 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef and venison, along with antibiotic-free turkey and chicken, each Chomps meat stick delivers 10+ grams of high-quality protein without sugar, hormones, soy, dairy, artificial preservatives, artificial nitrates, or MSG. Seasoned with a blend of flavorful herbs and spices, Chomps provides a nutritious protein snack for the whole family. As a minority-owned, family-operated, and B Corporation-certified business, Chomps prioritizes thoughtful sourcing and recently earned the non–ultra-processed food certification through the non-GMO project. Discover a new standard in snacking at www.chomps.com.

Traits of a Chompian

If you’ve been called nimble, resourceful, and persistent, then you might just be a Chompian. You’re a team player who’s self-motivated and action-oriented. You’re committed to delivering efficiency and accuracy, and you happen to be great at proactive cross-functional communication. You’re a critical thinker and a natural problem solver who enjoys details, research, and data. You take initiative and complete ownership of everything you do, and you’ll go the extra mile for your team, consumers, and audience. You’re hungry to learn with a passion to grow and improve every day. You also take a keen interest in health, fitness, and nutrition. Sound like you? Then we want to meat you.

What You Will Do

The Senior Manager, Fulfillment is responsible for managing day-to-day fulfillment execution and the customer service function to ensure Chomps’ fulfillment network operates with accuracy, accountability, cost discipline, and scalability. This role translates established fulfillment priorities into clear operating routines and partner expectations across multiple distribution locations and 3PL partners. The ideal candidate brings strong fulfillment and 3PL management experience, understands order execution and customer service operations, and can turn complex operational priorities into practical processes, measurable results, and clear cross-functional communication.

Role Expectations: This role is expected to independently manage recurring fulfillment and customer service cadences, 3PL partner follow-up, KPI reporting, process controls, order exception management, and customer escalations. This role will also provide operational inputs, data analysis, customer and service insights, risk visibility, and execution support to leadership for network planning, budget development, partner governance, and material service, cost, compliance, or performance escalations.

Responsibilities

  • Fulfillment Network Operations & 3PL Management
    • Support daily fulfillment operations across a growing multi-node distribution network, ensuring accurate order execution, capacity readiness, inventory flow, cost discipline, and consistent partner follow-through.
    • Manage weekly and monthly 3PL operating cadences, including partner meetings, KPI reviews, action-item tracking, QBR content preparation, performance follow-up, corrective action tracking, SLA monitoring, root-cause analysis, and readiness checkpoints.
    • Create, maintain, and continuously improve scalable SOPs, process controls, compliance requirements, and partner playbooks covering receiving, inventory control, order release, allocation, pick/pack/ship execution, exception management, and partner escalation paths, ensuring consistent execution across distribution nodes and customer channels.
    • Support fulfillment budget management by preparing invoice audits, spend analysis, productivity tracking, cost-per-order or cost-per-case reporting, and cost-reduction recommendations across the partner network.
  • Order Management & Allocation
    • Manage order allocation across wholesale, retail, eCommerce, and other channels, balancing customer requirements, inventory availability, freight efficiency, production constraints, and service commitments.
    • Partner with Sales, Planning, Transportation, Finance, Customer Supply Chain, and Operations to execute customer requirements, manage order flow constraints, support inventory positioning decisions, and provide cost-to-serve inputs.
    • Drive proactive exception management for constrained inventory, customer allocation decisions, backorder risk, order holds, shipment readiness, and cross-functional communication.
  • Customer Service
    • Lead day-to-day customer service for wholesale, retail, distributor, and eCommerce accounts, serving as the operational link between Chomps’ fulfillment network and its customers. Oversee order status and shipment inquiries, the shared Customer Service inbox, and open-order review, catching PO issues (pricing errors, MOQ shortfalls, unapproved NetSuite POs, missed ship-by dates) before shipment.
    • Set the team’s structure and standards, including priorities, ownership boundaries, escalation paths, channel coverage, backup plans, a shared tracker, and an SOP library. Define and monitor KPIs such as inbox response time, on-time weekly PO updates, PO issue resolution time, OTIF, and fill rate.
    • Serve as the primary supply chain point of contact for key customers, supporting business reviews and new-customer onboarding. Partner with Sales, Account Management, Planning, and Quality to resolve customer issues and deliver weekly PO status updates, cut and delay notices, post-allocation ETAs, key-account update files, and customer portal PO approvals.
    • Own processes for PO revisions, cancellations, and expedites; UDRs, shortages, damages, and returns; and chargebacks, deductions, and disputes, with clear ownership from intake through resolution. Manage retailer compliance (routing guides, vendor manuals, labeling mandates, ASN accuracy, EDI readiness, and appointment scheduling) to protect OTIF and minimize penalties.
    • Turn customer feedback and performance trends into process improvements, driving root-cause analysis and corrective action with 3PLs, carriers, and internal teams to reduce chargebacks, shorten PO-to-delivery cycle time, and manage cost-to-serve. Partner with Planning on retailer demand signals, In-Stock %, Weeks of Supply, and CPFR with key accounts.
  • Technology, Reporting & KPIs
    • Support business-side execution of order management and fulfillment automation improvements, including reducing manual touches, improving order accuracy, strengthening exception workflows, supporting UAT, driving adoption, and increasing visibility across systems and 3PL partners.
    • Partner with Digital Transformation, Business Analytics, Sales Operations, and 3PL technology teams on NetSuite and partner-system improvements, including requirements, EDI/API integrations, order routing logic, reporting, issue tracking, and operational controls.
    • Own fulfillment scorecards and KPI reporting across service, cost, compliance, productivity, inventory flow, automation adoption, customer requirements, and partner performance, converting recurring issues into corrective action plans, partner follow-up, leadership-ready updates, and prioritized improvement recommendations.
    • Build ad hoc analyses that identify service risks, cost drivers, recurring partner issues, customer compliance exposure, inventory constraints, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Launch Readiness
    • Manage operational readiness for fulfillment, ensuring 3PL processes, documentation flows, lot traceability, shipment readiness, customer requirements, and exception management are defined and consistently executed.
    • Coordinate operational launch readiness for new customers, channels, facilities, lanes, and market launches by confirming people, processes, systems, inventory, documentation, partner capabilities, and escalation paths are aligned before go-live.
  • People & Cross-Functional Leadership
    • Guide, coach, and develop customer service and fulfillment team members as applicable, and influence cross-functional stakeholders, by reinforcing clear ownership, operating rhythms, priorities, and expectations and building a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and disciplined follow-through.
    • Partner with cross-functional teams and external partners to align on execution priorities, resolve constraints, and support fulfillment growth.
    • Translate business growth priorities into practical execution plans, partner requirements, system needs, process controls, and team readiness actions.
    • Provide operational insights, data-backed recommendations, implementation support, and disciplined follow-through to support leadership decisions related to network planning, transportation, contracts, budgets, partner performance, and risk response.

Who You Are

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in fulfillment, distribution planning, customer supply chain, logistics, or 3PL operations, including experience managing complex multi-node distribution networks and customer-facing operational process.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage 3PL partners, operational KPIs, QBRs, corrective actions, SLA follow-up, and fulfillment performance across multiple facilities or business channels.
  • Experience with ERP, WMS, TMS, EDI, API, and order management systems; NetSuite experience strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to identify, design, and implement automation or process improvement opportunities that improve order accuracy, reduce manual work, accelerate cycle times, and strengthen operational visibility.
  • Highly analytical and comfortable using data to make recommendations on allocation, cost-to-serve, service risk, inventory positioning, readiness gaps, and partner performance.
  • Strong understanding of fulfillment and supply chain metrics, including OTIF, fill rate, order cycle time, inventory accuracy, warehouse productivity, cost-per-order or cost-per-case, 3PL SLA performance, chargeback exposure, and capacity utilization.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence Sales, Planning, Finance, Operations, Quality, Digital Transformation, and external partners without always having direct authority.
  • Comfortable operating at both planning and execution levels, moving from operational readiness and issue resolution to SOP development, partner follow-up, and process improvement.
  • Excellent written and verbal communicator with the ability to translate operational complexity into clear recommendations, leadership-ready updates, and partner-facing expectations.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and process-oriented; energized by building scalable systems, improving ways of working, and creating structure in a high-growth environment.
  • Demonstrated p[eople leadership experience, including coaching, prioritization, ownership setting, and development of team members.
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% to distribution centers, partner sites, customer meetings, and cross-functional business reviews.

You will join a company that is genuinely rewiring how it works — not one bolting AI on at the edges.

  • You can structure prompts, iterate quickly, and refine outputs to a high standard.

  • You use AI to accelerate thinking and research, not just to produce content.

  • You help build AI-native ways of working that lift the whole team.

  • Own positioning, messaging, and end-to-end GTM strategy for the Medius Payments solution pillar.

  • Drive GTM initiatives that accelerate net-new enterprise acquisition and increase cross-sell velocity across our global AP customer base.

When you join the Latitude team, you’ll work alongside leading experts across machine learning and robotics, cloud platforms, mapping, sensors and compute systems, test operations, systems and safety engineering – all dedicated to redefining the relationship between people and their vehicles for millions of customers.

As a Ford Motor Company subsidiary, we operate independently to develop automated driving technology at the speed of a technology startup. Latitude is headquartered in Pittsburgh with engineering centers in Dearborn, Mich., and Palo Alto, Calif.

Meet the team:

The Embedded Software team develops foundational platform software critical to development across the company. The Hardware Safety & Power Systems group specializes in the real-time firmware that orchestrates safe system behavior during fault conditions, power transitions, and thermal events.

We develop FreeRTOS and SafeRTOS-based drivers, state machines, and diagnostic frameworks for power management, thermal monitoring, voltage supervision, and hardware watchdog systems on TDA4 (Jacinto 7) embedded targets. Projects often require deep collaboration with hardware teams (PMIC vendors, SoC architects), safety engineers (ISO 26262 compliance), and system integration teams across the company.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the end-to-end architecture of hardware safety and power management systems: design safe-state strategies, power sequencing across multiple cores and PMICs, thermal throttling, and watchdog orchestration. Your designs must meet ASIL-B/C safety goals
  • Implement low-level drivers and firmware for safety-critical integrated circuits (PMIC, voltage supervisor, thermal monitor) directly from datasheets and the TDA4 Functional Safety Manual. These drivers run on bare metal and FreeRTOS; they must be bug-free and testable
  • Lead the development of hardware-software safety diagnostic frameworks — integrate TI Safety Diagnostic Library (LBIST, PBIST, ECC, DCC, ESM) into the firmware; ensure diagnostic coverage maps to ISO 26262 hardware fault metrics; mentor engineers on coverage traceability
  • Consistently perform deep-dive code reviews across all hardware safety modules. Ensure PRs are simple, bug-free, and adhere to unified architectural vision (clean driver interfaces, consistent error handling, testable design patterns). Root out assumptions that could lead to latent ASIL-rated failures

jobs.excerpt: About UsAt Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: NYC, Boston, Atlanta, Miami OR Carolinas

About the Role

Cloudflare's North America Startups segment is growing its U.S. East go-to-market team. The goal is to win the fastest-growing AI-native and digital native companies early and grow with them as they scale. A new generation of companies is building AI models, agents, AI apps and developer tools, and many of them can go from seed funding to global scale in under two years. Cloudflare wants to be the platform they build, run and secure on from their first line of code through their IPO.

As the Senior Regional Sales Director, Startups – East, you will lead the managers and Account Executives (AEs) covering venture-backed AI and digital native companies across the eastern U.S., including New York, Boston, the DC area, Atlanta and Miami. You'll own revenue, hiring and Cloudflare's reputation in the East Coast startup and venture community, while keeping the Cloudflare culture. This role suits builders who like speed, technical buyers and the challenge of turning fast usage growth into lasting, multi-million-dollar customer relationships.

You'll set strategy for the region and lead a team that sells to founders, CTOs and heads of engineering and infrastructure. Your team will:

  • Move fast deals forward without losing sight of the long-term account
  • Turn companies already on Cloudflare's free and pay-as-you-go plans into committed contracts
  • Work with Product, Developer Speedboat, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success and the Cloudflare for Startups program to make Cloudflare the default choice for AI-native builders

Success means startups that love Cloudflare and recommend it, have grown alongside us from early stage to scale, and run their most important workloads on our Developer Platform, AI products, application security and network.

What You'll Do

  • Drive revenue growth across new customers, expansion and conversion of pay-as-you-go accounts to contracts. Build a sales motion where usage growth opens the door to the next use case.
  • Lead a team of Regional Sales Directors and their Startup Account Executives. Also lead indirectly, the Solutions Engineers, Business Development Reps, Customer Success and Field Marketing teams who support startup accounts.
  • Build the East Coast startup sales team. Work with your Ecosystem and Recruiting to hire people who are technical, sharp about the business and comfortable talking with founders and engineers.
  • Spot breakout companies early. Use funding rounds, usage data, hiring and developer adoption signals to find likely winners, then win them before they lock into AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel or other platforms.
  • Make venture investors a growth channel. Build relationships with VC firms, accelerators and startup programs across the East Coast, working with the Cloudflare for Startups and Workers Launchpad teams to bring in companies at the earliest stages.
  • Help shape the product roadmap. Bring what AI-native customers need back to Product and Engineering, and run design-partner relationships with leading startups that influence what Cloudflare builds next.
  • Adapt our sales process for startups. Use and influence Cloudflare's sales methodology for faster deals with technical buyers. Bring discipline to forecasting usage-based revenue, contracts sized for growth and expansion planning.
  • Balance short-term and long-term revenue. Close fast deals while also building multi-year relationships with companies expected to become tomorrow's large enterprise customers. Work with Enterprise leaders on clean handoffs when accounts move to that segment.
  • Represent Cloudflare in the East Coast startup scene at founder events, AI meetups, investor portfolio sessions and developer communities.

What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years of sales experience, including 3+ years managing managers (second-line leadership), with a track record of beating targets in a high-growth segment
  • Experience selling cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, application security or data and AI infrastructure to startups, digital natives or high-growth tech companies
  • Proven success in usage-based businesses, including converting product-led or pay-as-you-go customers to committed contracts and expanding from there
  • Credibility with technical buyers: comfortable at the whiteboard with CTOs and founders talking about how their AI systems are built, latency, how they scale and what it costs per request or token
  • Strong ties to the East Coast venture and startup community
  • A history of hiring and developing great AE managers and AEs, and building a team people want to join
  • Disciplined forecasting and pipeline management in fast-moving, high-volume deal environments
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the drive to build processes, programs and playbooks where none exist

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

  • For New York City and Boston based hires: Estimated annual salary of $418,000 - $575,000 OTE

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

  • Medical/Rx Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Commuter Spending Accounts
  • Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
  • On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
  • Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

  • Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

  • Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
  • Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

: We released to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

  • Den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen in enger Abstimmung mit relevanten Rollen und Funktionen und im Einklang mit der gemeinsam entwickelten Vertriebsstrategie.
  • Die proaktive Identifizierung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und deren Qualifizierung gemeinsam mit dem Key Account Manager und District Leader.
  • Die vollständige und korrekte Abbildung des Sales Funnels in unserem Customer-Relationship-Management-System (SFDC).

  • Die kontinuierliche Beobachtung des Wettbewerbs und relevanter Branchenentwicklungen sowie die Weitergabe von Markt- und Kundenfeedback an die Business Unit.

Darüber hinaus bist du in deinem Verantwortungsbereich zuständig für:

  • Order Intake (Auftragseingang) und Sales (Umsatz) für Equipment, Produkte, Software und Customer Service.
  • Order Intake und Sales für Lösungen.
  • Datenqualität in SFDC und Forecast Accuracy.
  • Kundenzufriedenheit (NPS), einschließlich Rücklaufquote und Ergebnis.
  • Share of Wallet (SoW).
  • Preisrealisierung für Equipment, Produkte und Customer Service.

Dafür bieten wir dir:

  • Eine attraktive Vergütung.
  • Einen Firmenwagen mit der Möglichkeit zur privaten Nutzung.
  • Purpose: Sinnvolle Arbeit, mit der wir gemeinsam als Team das Leben von Menschen verbessern.
  • Philips University: Ein breites Angebot an fachlichen Trainings sowie Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung.
  • Philips MyShop: Vergünstigte Philips Produkte.
  • Philips in Balance: Vielfältige Angebote rund um körperliche und mentale Gesundheit sowie Sportkurse.

Wer Verantwortung übernimmt, sollte fair und transparent vergütet werden. Das jährliche Grundentgelt für diese Position liegt bei vollständiger Erfüllung des Anforderungsprofils zwischen 80,000 CHF - 125,000 CHF ein Einstieg in ein niedrigeres Gehaltsband ist möglich, wenn noch nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllt sind. Die konkrete Höhe deines Gehalts innerhalb dieser Spanne legen wir anhand objektiver Faktoren fest, wie beispielsweise der für die Position erforderlichen Fähigkeiten, deiner einschlägigen Erfahrung sowie der Verantwortung, die Du in dieser Rolle übernehmen wirst. Dabei berücksichtigen wir außerdem die interne Gleichbehandlung und die lokalen Marktbedingungen.

Für diese Position besteht Anspruch auf eine variable Vergütung in Form eines Sales Incentive, dessen Höhe an das Erreichen festgelegter KPIs gekoppelt ist. Das gesamte Vergütungskonzept erläutern wir Dir gerne im Rahmen des Bewerbungsprozesses, damit Du eine klare und fundierte Entscheidung treffen kannst.


Warum du zu Philips kommen solltest

Arbeiten bei Philips ist mehr als nur ein Job. Wir fühlen uns berufen, durch sinnvolle Arbeit eine gesündere Gesellschaft zu schaffen, indem wir uns auf innovative, kundenorientierte Lösungen der Gesundheitstechnologie fokussieren. Hilf uns, die Gesundheit und das Wohlbefinden von Milliarden von Menschen zu verbessern.


Wir bei Philips fördern Chancengleichheit. Alle qualifizierten Kandidat:innen werden unabhängig von Hautfarbe, Religion, Alter, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, nationaler Herkunft, Glaube, Staatsbürgerschaft, Behinderung oder Familienstand gleichermaßen in unserem Auswahlprozess berücksichtigt.

jobs.excerpt: About Us Martin is a leading, tech-enabled insurance advisory firm celebrating over 30 years of excellence.
jobs.description:
About Us

Martin is a leading, tech-enabled insurance advisory firm celebrating over 30 years of excellence. We partner with national, regional, and local insurance carriers and Managing General Agents (MGAs) across the U.S. to solve their most critical challenges. Our expertise spans Product Development, Actuarial Services, Regulatory Compliance, State Filings, and Data Analytics. Our mission is simple: build lasting partnerships and deliver technology-driven outcomes that fuel business success.

We recently acquired Adaptify, bringing its engineering team in-house and accelerating our platform roadmap. We are now a fully remote team backed by private equity, with consulting expertise and technology under one roof.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Head of Sales to lead our sales team day to day and build the sales engine for Martin’s next stage of growth. In this newly created role, you will own team performance, pipeline, forecasting, and sales process. That frees our Chief Revenue Officer to focus on revenue strategy, strategic relationships and new markets.

With our recent acquisition of Adaptify, we have a bigger story to tell and a broader offering to sell. This role will shape how we take that combined offering to market.

Selling at Martin is consultative. Our clients increasingly buy expertise and software together, and our deals range from productized platform sales to complex, custom engagements. You will lead a team that sells both well, working alongside Sales Engineers and our Professional Services Group so that what we sell is what we deliver.

This is a builder's role. We are looking for a leader who coaches as well as they close, who brings structure without slowing the team down, and who is energized by taking a capable sales team to the next level.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop the sales team

  • Manage, coach and develop the sales team through regular one-on-ones, deal coaching and call reviews
  • Set clear expectations for activity, pipeline and results, and hold the team accountable to them
  • Hire, onboard and ramp new sellers as the team grows
  • Build the team's fluency in selling services and software together

Own pipeline, forecast and results

  • Own team quota attainment across new business and expansion
  • Run a disciplined pipeline and forecast cadence, and report results to the CRO and executive team
  • Stay close to the deals that matter: join key client conversations, shape strategy and help the team close
  • Use CRM data to spot what is working, what is stalling and where to focus

Build the sales engine

  • Define and document a repeatable sales process, from qualification through close, for both productized and custom deals
  • Establish the playbooks, messaging and tools the team needs to sell consistently
  • Partner with the CRO on territory and account planning, pricing approach and compensation design
  • Work with Marketing on pipeline generation and with Product on market feedback
  • Lead the team's shift to selling the combined services and technology offering, including positioning, messaging and cross-sell into existing clients

Partner across the business

  • Work with Sales Engineers on discovery, demonstrations and solution design
  • Bring the Professional Services Group into deals early so scope, pricing and timelines are right before signature
  • Represent Sales in deal review alongside Operations, Finance and Product
  • Stay engaged through the transition from sale to delivery, so clients experience one team
  • Coordinate with Account Management on renewals and growth within existing clients

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of B2B sales experience, including 3+ years leading and developing a sales team
  • A record of meeting or beating team targets in a consultative, multi-stakeholder sale
  • Experience selling professional services, software, or ideally both together
  • Insurance, insurtech or financial services experience strongly preferred; curiosity and the ability to learn a technical domain quickly are required
  • Experience building sales process and forecasting discipline in a growth-stage company, ideally PE- or VC-backed
  • A coaching mindset, with examples of sellers you have developed and promoted
  • Comfort working in the details: CRM data, deal strategy and live client conversations
  • The ability to build trust across Sales, Delivery, Product and Finance in a fully remote company

Why Join Us?

  • Real scope at the right moment. You will shape how Martin sells as we scale, with direct access to the CRO and executive team.
  • Expertise that scales. Our value comes from deep insurance expertise, delivered through people and a platform. You will sell something clients need and that few firms can offer.
  • Own the outcomes. We give leaders room to build and expect them to deliver. You will have the mandate to make the changes the team needs.
  • Do the right thing. We sell what we can deliver and stand behind it. Long-term client trust matters more to us than a quick close.
  • A remote team that stays connected. We are fully remote by design and invest in bringing people together.
  • Momentum you can sell. A recent acquisition, an expanded engineering team and private equity backing give us the product, the resources and the ambition to grow.

Salary and Benefits

  • Base salary: $185,000 – $210,000, based on experience.
  • Variable compensation: On-target earnings (OTE) of $290,000 – $330,000, with an approximately 65/35 base-to-variable mix. Variable pay is tied to team performance.
  • Benefits: Our salaries are complemented by an extensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance, including:

-Health, dental, and vision insurance

-401(k) retirement plan options

-Generous, flexible paid time off (PTO) policy

-Fully remote work environment

What You Get

Team Lead – CYP ADHD Titration Service

United Kingdom (Remote)

Ref: CYP001

Reporting to: Clinical Operations Manager – Children and Young Person Service

Remuneration: £74,000 FTE- plus £1000 working from home allowance

Contract Type:Permanent/Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Location:Home-based/various UK meeting locations as required

Closing Date for applications: Monday 30th November 2026*

Please note: While internal applications may be considered, no formal offer of employment will be made until the successful completion of any current probation period.

About Us:

Psychiatry UK is the UK’s leading provider of digital psychiatry services, working both privately and with the NHS to support children, teenagers and adults with expert, patient-centred care.

A career with Psychiatry UK allows you to expand your knowledge, enhance your skills, and gain valuable life experience—all while enjoying the flexibility of a remote full-time role. As part of a leading online mental health service, you'll collaborate with innovative, forward-thinking professionals in a dynamic, multidisciplinary team committed to making a real difference.

The Team Lead – CYP ADHD Titration Service plays a crucial role within Psychiatry UK, reporting directly to the Clinical Operations Director. This position is responsible for providing clinical leadership and operational oversight of the Children and Young People (CYP) ADHD Titration Service, ensuring the delivery of safe, effective and high-quality clinical care.

The service supports children and young people through the initiation, titration and stabilisation of ADHD medication, ensuring treatment is tailored to individual clinical needs, developmental considerations and relevant prescribing guidance. The Team Lead will oversee clinical practice, support prescribing clinicians and ensure appropriate engagement with children, young people, parents and carers throughout the treatment pathway.

The post holder will contribute to service development, operational excellence and clinical governance, allocating their time across team leadership, pathway ownership, clinical supervision and operational management to drive continuous improvement and maintain high standards of patient care.

This role is predominantly remote (applicants must reside in the UK) but requires attendance at various meeting locations within the UK as needed and operates in accordance with Psychiatry UK's flexitime principles.

As our Team Lead – CYP ADHD Titration Service, you will:

  • Lead and maintain clinical safety, prescribing governance and quality standards within the CYP ADHD Titration Service.

  • Develop, implement and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and clinical protocols to ensure evidence-based, safe and effective ADHD medication management.

  • Ensure clinical practices align with relevant NICE guidance, professional prescribing standards and regulatory requirements relating to ADHD treatment in children and young people.

  • Oversee appropriate monitoring of medication effectiveness, adverse effects, physical health parameters and clinical risk throughout the titration pathway.

  • Contribute to clinical governance, quality assurance, prescribing audits and service improvement activities, identifying and addressing areas of clinical risk.

  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement through the review of clinical incidents, patient feedback and treatment outcomes.

Clinical Leadership

  • Provide clinical supervision, guidance and professional support to prescribing clinicians within the CYP ADHD Titration Service, promoting best practice and professional development.

  • Support clinicians in the safe initiation, adjustment, monitoring and stabilisation of ADHD medication, ensuring treatment decisions are evidence-based and appropriate to the child's or young person's individual needs.

  • Provide clinical guidance on complex presentations, including co-occurring mental health conditions, neurodevelopmental needs, medication tolerability and safeguarding concerns.

  • Promote developmentally appropriate, patient-centred and family-inclusive approaches to treatment, supporting informed decision-making and effective engagement throughout the titration process.

  • Review applications and participate in interviewing and recruitment processes for new team members, working collaboratively with Talent Acquisition.

  • Maintain own Continuing Professional Development (CPD) and support compliance with relevant professional registration, prescribing competency and development requirements across the team.

Team Management

  • Manage the performance, workload and wellbeing of clinical staff within the CYP ADHD Titration Service.

  • Facilitate regular multidisciplinary team (MDT) meetings, clinical case discussions and reflective practice to promote effective clinical decision-making and team cohesion.

  • Provide coaching, mentoring and regular clinical supervision to build a resilient, motivated and skilled workforce.

  • Support clinicians in managing complex prescribing decisions, maintaining professional standards and practising within their individual scope of competence.

  • Identify training and development needs, ensuring clinicians are appropriately supported to deliver safe and effective ADHD treatment to children and young people.

  • Work collaboratively with operational and workforce colleagues to identify recruitment, capacity and resource requirements.

Operational Oversight

  • Oversee day-to-day operations of the CYP ADHD Titration Service, ensuring efficient patient flow, appropriate clinical allocation and effective resource management.

  • Monitor pathway performance, clinical capacity, prescribing activity and patient progression through medication initiation, titration and stabilisation.

  • Support timely clinical reviews, medication adjustments and follow-up arrangements, ensuring treatment is delivered in accordance with agreed clinical protocols.

  • Oversee appropriate arrangements for patients completing titration, including clinical handover and transfer to ongoing prescribing or shared care where clinically appropriate and agreed.

  • Collaborate with internal teams and external partners, including NHS services, GPs and other healthcare professionals, to support continuity of care.

  • Escalate clinical risks, prescribing concerns and safeguarding issues in accordance with Psychiatry UK policies and relevant statutory requirements.

  • Contribute to workforce planning and service development initiatives to support the safe and sustainable delivery of the CYP ADHD Titration Service.

Safeguarding and Patient-Centred Care

  • Promote a strong safeguarding culture, ensuring the safety, welfare and best interests of children and young people remain central to clinical decision-making.

  • Ensure clinicians understand and fulfil their safeguarding responsibilities, including recognising, documenting and escalating concerns appropriately.

  • Support effective communication with children, young people, parents and carers, ensuring medication information, treatment expectations and potential adverse effects are explained clearly and in a developmentally appropriate manner.

  • Promote good practice in relation to consent, Gillick competence, parental responsibility, confidentiality and information sharing, recognising the legal and ethical considerations associated with prescribing for children and young people.

  • Support clinicians in identifying and responding appropriately to concerns relating to medication adherence, treatment response, physical health, mental health and wider vulnerabilities.

  • Ensure the views and experiences of children and young people are considered throughout treatment, promoting their involvement in decisions about their care.

Engagement and Collaboration

  • Foster effective working relationships within Psychiatry UK, the NHS, primary care and other healthcare providers to support integrated and coordinated patient care.

  • Collaborate with clinical and operational leadership to identify opportunities for pathway improvement, service development and improved patient outcomes.

  • Communicate regularly with the Clinical Operations Director regarding service performance, clinical risks, workforce challenges and improvement initiatives.

  • Support effective communication and collaboration between prescribing clinicians, patients, families and external healthcare professionals throughout the titration pathway.

  • Promote Psychiatry UK's values, mission and vision through effective leadership and professional conduct.

Administration and Documentation

  • Ensure accurate, comprehensive and timely recording of clinical assessments, prescribing decisions, medication adjustments, monitoring outcomes and patient communications within electronic patient records.

  • Maintain oversight of clinical documentation standards, ensuring compliance with prescribing governance, information governance and data protection requirements.

  • Participate actively in clinical supervision and Psychiatry UK's Personal Development Review (PDR) process.

  • Attend relevant mandatory and professional development training.

  • Support clinical audits, service reporting and the monitoring of key clinical quality and performance indicators.

To succeed as our Team Lead – CYP ADHD Titration Service, you will be:

An experienced and confident clinical leader with exceptional organisational, communication and decision-making skills. You will have a strong understanding of ADHD medication management in children and young people, alongside comprehensive knowledge of prescribing practice, clinical governance, safeguarding and relevant regulatory requirements.

You will be experienced in supporting prescribing clinicians, managing complex clinical presentations and maintaining high standards of patient safety throughout medication initiation, titration and stabilisation. Your ability to balance clinical quality, operational priorities and team development will be essential to your success.

You will demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with children, young people, parents, carers and multidisciplinary colleagues. You will recognise the importance of developmentally appropriate communication, informed consent and collaborative decision-making when managing ADHD treatment.

You will also be confident in your administrative abilities, proficient in Microsoft 365 and competent in the use of electronic patient records, digital clinical systems and prescribing documentation.

Essential Qualifications and Experience

  • Experienced Registered Nurse with current, valid NMC registration, or another appropriately registered Allied Health Professional with relevant prescribing experience.

  • Independent and Supplementary Non-Medical Prescribing (V300) qualification, or an equivalent recognised independent prescribing qualification appropriate to professional registration.

  • Demonstrable clinical experience within specialist ADHD services, including the initiation, titration and ongoing monitoring of ADHD medication for children and young people.

  • Experience working with children and young people presenting with ADHD, co-occurring neurodevelopmental conditions and complex mental health needs.

  • Experience in clinical leadership or supervisory roles within CYP, mental health, ADHD or related healthcare services.

  • Strong knowledge of ADHD prescribing guidelines, medication management, physical health monitoring and the identification and management of adverse effects in children and young people.

  • Strong knowledge and practical experience of safeguarding children and young people, including risk assessment, escalation and relevant statutory responsibilities.

  • Proven track record in clinical pathway ownership, service development or quality improvement.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage, supervise and support multidisciplinary clinical teams.

  • Experience in clinical governance, prescribing audit, quality assurance or continuous improvement initiatives.

Desirable Qualifications and Experience

  • Additional clinical qualifications in child and adolescent mental health, ADHD, neurodevelopmental conditions or related specialties.

  • Further education relating to leadership, management or advanced clinical practice.

  • Experience working within specialist CAMHS, community paediatrics or CYP ADHD medication management services.

  • Experience working within or alongside NHS services, particularly NHS-commissioned CYP ADHD pathways.

  • Experience delivering or overseeing clinical prescribing services within a remote or digitally enabled healthcare environment.

  • Experience supporting shared care arrangements and transitions between specialist and primary care prescribing services.

Desirable Knowledge and Skills

  • Project management and change management experience.

  • Skills in data analysis to inform clinical pathway development, prescribing safety, service performance and quality improvement.

  • Familiarity with multidisciplinary working and integrated care models involving primary care, specialist healthcare, education and social care services.

  • Knowledge of relevant NICE guidance, prescribing standards and regulatory frameworks relating to ADHD medication management in children and young people.

  • Understanding of consent, Gillick competence, parental responsibility, confidentiality and information sharing when delivering treatment to children and young people.

  • Understanding of the challenges and considerations associated with delivering medication monitoring and clinical care through digital healthcare platforms.

Psychiatry UK: Supporting You

We want you to enjoy your work while feeling healthy, happy, and appreciated. That’s why we’ve created a benefits package designed with you in mind. You’ll have access to a range of wellbeing perks, including a Health Cash Plan, Well Hub Subscription, access to an Employee Assistance Programme, Annual Volunteering Day, Enhanced Sickness and Family Leave pay, Length of Service Bonus, Work from Home allowance and Pension options.

At Psychiatry UK, we care about what matters to you.

Recruitment Process

At Psychiatry UK, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Our process includes:

  • Application

  • Profile review

  • Screening conversation

  • Competency based interview(s)

If at any point you require any reasonable adjustments —such as additional time, assistive technology, or an alternative format for materials—please let us know. We are happy to accommodate your needs to ensure you have a fair and comfortable experience. Please feel free to reach out to us at to discuss any adjustments that would support you.

If this opportunity excites you, why not apply today?*We review applications as they come in and may close the advert early if we receive a high volume of interest. To ensure you don’t miss out, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

jobs.description:
日本市場におけるSwiftMRの事業拡大を統括する責任者の募集です。

■AIRS Medicalについて

AIRS Medicalは、ソウル大学の医学・工学のエキスパートたちによって設立されたグローバルスタートアップです。 私たちは「MRI × AI」という非常に難易度の高い領域に対し、世界で最も優れた解決策を提示できる集団であることを自負しています。 その技術力は、Facebook（現Meta社）とニューヨーク大学が共催した「fastMRI Challenge」での連続優勝といった実績に裏打ちされています。

私たちの使命は、放射線医学の領域を革新し続けることで、「予防医療」へのアクセシビリティを劇的に高めることです。 MRI検査をより身近なものへと進化させ、病気の早期発見と予防が中心となる新しい医療モデルを世界中で実現していきます。

■主力製品：SwiftMR

当社の主力製品である「SwiftMR」は、AIディープラーニングモデルを用いたベンダーニュートラルのMRI画像再構成ソリューションです。

  • 課題の解決: 従来のMRI検査の課題であった「長い検査時間」と「高コスト」を解消し、より効率的で費用対効果の高い検査を実現します。
  • 提供価値: MRIをより身近な診断ツールへと進化させ、医療従事者が潜在的な健康リスクを早期に発見できるようサポートします。

■グローバルな実績と評価

私たちの技術力は世界的に認められており、急速な成長を遂げています。

  • 導入実績: 世界40カ国以上、1,400以上の医療機関で導入されています。
  • 受賞歴:
    • 2023年 Frost & Sullivanにて「Technology Innovation Leadership Award」受賞
    • 2019年・2020年 fastMRI Challenge（Facebook AI ResearchおよびNYU Langone Health主催）にて連続優勝
  • グローバル展開: 韓国を拠点に、米国、欧州、日本に法人を設立し、グローバル市場で事業を拡大しています。

日本市場におけるSwiftMRの事業開発責任者として、大手企業との販売提携、新たな流通チャネルの開拓、医療データやエコシステムを活用した新規事業モデルの構築など、非連続な成長を生み出す事業開発をリードしていただきます。売上目標の達成に責任を持ち、日本法人代表の直属として、本社経営陣とも連携しながら日本事業の成長を牽引するポジションです。

1. 事業戦略・市場開拓

  • 日本市場の中長期事業計画・売上目標の策定と実行
  • 市場動向、競合、診療報酬などの制度動向を分析し、戦略に反映
  • 大学病院・基幹病院・画像診断センターなど重点顧客層の特定と開拓方針の策定

2. 戦略的パートナーシップの構築

  • MRIメーカー、PACSベンダー、医療機器商社・代理店との提携の開拓と交渉
  • 提携条件、価格、契約の交渉を主導し、収益性を最大化
  • 既存パートナーとの短・中・長期の目標を揃え、関係を深化

3. 営業推進・キーアカウント管理

  • パートナーとの共同営業を統括し、大型案件の商談やクロージングに参画
  • 放射線科医や病院経営層など、KOL・意思決定者との関係構築
  • リファレンスサイトの開拓と導入事例の創出

4. 組織の構築・マネジメント

  • 事業開発観点から営業チームの採用、育成、目標管理へ関与し、営業マネージャーに伴走
  • パートナー向けのトレーニング・オンボーディング体制の整備

5. 社内・グローバル連携

  • マーケティング、カスタマーサクセス、他の関連部門と連携したGo-to-Marketの推進
  • 韓国本社経営陣への業績報告と、日本市場のニーズの製品へのフィードバック

jobs.description:
Opportunity:

DeVry University focuses on developing long-term relationships with superior instructors who have high professional standards, excellent communication skills, enthusiasm and a commitment to providing the finest practitioner-focused education. We are seeking primarily industry professionals to teach and share their knowledge and experience with undergraduate and graduate students in a variety of fields.

Courses meet once or twice a week for eight weeks. Face-to-face interaction is blended with technology (such as online discussions and online assignments) for an enhanced learning environment. Faculty are responsible for facilitating student learning by teaching courses and programs in accordance with DeVry University requirements. Faculty develop course syllabi and lesson plans and apply teaching techniques to best achieve course and programmatic objectives. All DeVry instructors will participate in a comprehensive faculty training program and ongoing faculty development activities to ensure the highest quality instruction. DeVry University does not guarantee any specific number of work hours or assignments, which may vary based on the University’s needs and discretion. As you explore this opportunity, we invite you to view this brief video highlighting how our faculty engage in meaningful student support.

Responsibilities:

Develops and provides students with an approved DeVry University syllabus that follows a template established by the local campus, and which includes the terminal course objectives. Organizes, prepares, and regularly revises and updates all course materials. Uses appropriate technological options for online technologies and course-related software, including Websites, e-mail, and online discussions for preparing the course and making it accessible to students. Models effective oral and written communications that engage the students, provide clarity, and improve student learning. Sets clear expectations for the course by publishing course terminal objectives, assignment/examinations dates, and weight the distribution of various evaluation categories. Ensures that the content and level of material included on exams correspond to the course terminal objectives. Demonstrates consistency and fairness in the preparation and grading of exams and provides timely feedback to students. Embraces and integrates the responsible use of AI technologies in the classroom to enhance teaching and learning outcomes. Demonstrates the ability to recognize, evaluate, and address appropriate and inappropriate student use of AI tools in academic work. Completes other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

A doctorate in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a closely related field is required, with at least 18 graduate credit hours in cybersecurity, information assurance, network security, digital forensics, or related computing disciplines.

Applicants must upload unofficial graduate-level transcripts with their application. Degrees must be awarded by an institution accredited by an agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education or the Council for Higher Education Accreditation, or by an international institution determined to hold equivalent accreditation.

Three to five years of applied professional experience in cybersecurity, information security, security operations, threat analysis, or digital risk management. Demonstrated experience with cybersecurity technologies and practices, including network security, system hardening, vulnerability management, incident response, and security monitoring. Industry-recognized certifications or professional credentials relevant to cybersecurity, information assurance, or information security operations. Strong subject matter expertise in cybersecurity principles and defensive security practices, combined with effective communication skills and the ability to explain complex security concepts to diverse learners. Knowledge of cyber risk management, regulatory and compliance considerations, ethical security practices, and responsible use of security technologies. Faculty must have a commitment to ongoing professional development in instructional technology, digital literacy, and responsible AI practices. Additional requirements driven by state licensing, institutional policy, or accreditation standards may apply.

Preferred Qualifications:

Industry certifications related to cybersecurity operations, ethical hacking, incident response, or security management (e.g., certifications associated with security analysis, penetration testing, or security governance). Experience with security frameworks and operational models, such as risk management frameworks, security operations center practices, and threat intelligence processes. Experience with defensive and proactive cybersecurity techniques, including penetration testing methodologies, vulnerability assessment, digital forensics, and incident response. Experience implementing DevSecOps or secure development practices to support secure application and infrastructure environments. Experience with programmatic or regional accreditation processes, including outcomes assessment, curriculum alignment, and continuous improvement initiatives. Active membership or engagement in professional cybersecurity or information security organizations to maintain current industry awareness. Experience integrating cybersecurity laboratories, security simulation platforms, capture-the-flag environments, and real-world security scenarios into post-secondary instruction to support applied learning. Two to five years of teaching experience at the post-secondary level, preferably in cybersecurity, networking, digital forensics, information assurance, or related computing disciplines.

Pay:

Visiting Professor pay is based on level, credit hours taught per 8-week session, and location.

Pay may vary in most states from $1500-$2700 per 8-week session.

Pay in the states of AZ, CA, IN and PA is paid at an hourly rate of either $22.00/hour or $23.50/hour.

jobs.title: Lead Vulnerability Operations Associate
jobs.excerpt: As a Lead Vulnerability Operations Associate at QXO, you’ll lead the day-to-day execution and continuous improvement of vulnerability and exposure management across QXO’s systems.
jobs.description:
As a Lead Vulnerability Operations Associate at QXO, you’ll lead the day-to-day execution and continuous improvement of vulnerability and exposure management across QXO’s systems. You’ll serve as the technical escalation point, set remediation priorities, and drive accountable action across infrastructure, cloud, and application teams. You’ll remain hands-on with AI and automation, and measure success through risk reduced and validated remediation.

QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best-in-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second-largest distributor of roofing products, the second-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit QXO.com.

What you'll do:

  • Lead vulnerability operations end to end, from intake and triage through prioritization, remediation, and validated closure; set operating standards, coordinate daily priorities, and resolve complex escalations.
  • Own the correlation and deduplication of findings across vulnerability, CNAPP, EDR, and attack surface tools; use AI and automation to produce a reliable, prioritized view of exposure.
  • Define and apply risk-based prioritization and remediation timelines using the CISA BOD 26-04 decision model: asset exposure, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) status, exploit automation, and technical impact, informed by EPSS, threat intelligence, and asset criticality.
  • Design, implement, and improve AI-assisted remediation workflows covering fix guidance, ticket creation, owner routing, patch deployment, and automated validation, with testing and production change controls.
  • Lead remediation planning with infrastructure, cloud, and application owners; resolve ownership gaps, negotiate achievable action plans, and escalate overdue or high-risk exposures with clear business impact and recommended next steps.
  • Prioritize and deliver automation with engineering for repeatable fixes such as patching, configuration drift, image rebuilds, and dependency upgrades; measure improvements in remediation time and manual effort.
  • Establish review standards for AI agents and LLM tooling used to research vulnerabilities, assess impact, and draft remediation or compensating control guidance; require human review of production changes.
  • Set asset inventory and coverage requirements across internet-reachable assets and the internal attack surface, including acquired environments; drive resolution of ownership, tagging, and visibility gaps.
  • Lead the vulnerability response workstream for critical exposures through QXO’s incident response process, coordinating scoping, containment recommendations, remediation, validated closure, and after action reporting with Cybersecurity Operations.
  • Serve as the vulnerability escalation point for Cybersecurity Operations during active events; direct exposure scoping and forensic triage support, identify threat hunting leads, and coordinate detection coverage with incident responders.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation for critical cybersecurity response, including off-hours work, and provide lead-level escalation support for urgent exposures.
  • Lead technical evaluation of exceptions with GRC; recommend compensating controls and time-bound remediation plans, and route risk acceptance to authorized decision-makers with expiry and reassessment tracked.
  • Own vulnerability metrics and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), including mean time to remediate, SLA adherence, exposure aging, and automation coverage; explain trends, blockers, and recommended actions to leadership.
  • Define data quality checks and integration requirements across asset and findings tools; resolve systemic data issues so prioritization, reporting, and automated decisions can be trusted.
  • Use breach and attack simulation and penetration test results to validate controls and remediation effectiveness; translate recurring findings into prioritized engineering improvements.
  • Lead preparation of vulnerability operations evidence for internal and external audits and coordinate remediation of identified process or control gaps.
  • Set and maintain vulnerability operations procedures, runbooks, and automation playbooks; mentor analysts, review complex assessments, and reinforce consistent triage and closure standards.
  • Assess emerging vulnerabilities, attacker TTPs, and AI security tooling; recommend and deliver practical improvements to exposure coverage, prioritization, and remediation performance.

What you'll bring:

Skills and Experience

  • 7+ years in vulnerability management, security operations, systems administration, or infrastructure engineering, including substantial hands-on vulnerability operations experience and 2+ years leading technical workstreams or complex remediation initiatives.
  • A demonstrated track record of leading remediation at enterprise scale, setting priorities across competing business needs, and delivering measurable reductions in exposure and time to fix.
  • Experience leading critical vulnerability response workstreams alongside a SOC or incident response team, including exposure scoping, containment recommendations, and validation of remediation during active events.
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing AI, LLM, or agent-assisted security workflows for triage, prioritization, ticketing, or fix generation, with validation and human review controls.
  • Deep hands-on experience with risk-based vulnerability and exposure management platforms (e.g., Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Wiz), including API integrations, coverage validation, data normalization, and complex finding analysis.
  • Ability to build, test, and maintain automation and orchestration using SOAR, Python, PowerShell, or REST APIs and integrate remediation workflows with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or Jira.
  • Strong practical knowledge of patch and configuration management (e.g., Microsoft Intune, SCCM), infrastructure-as-code, and production change practices, with experience guiding teams through complex remediation.
  • Strong technical understanding of Windows, Linux, networking, and cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP), with the ability to assess exploitability, attack paths, and operational impact across environments.
  • Ability to apply CISA BOD 26-04 and BOD 22-01, CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK, and software development lifecycle knowledge to defensible prioritization and remediation decisions.
  • Experience mapping vulnerability operations practices and evidence to at least one compliance framework: NIST CSF, PCI DSS, SOX, ISO 27001, or CMMC.
  • Ability to communicate exposure, business impact, remediation tradeoffs, and performance trends to technical owners and leadership, with clear recommendations and accountable action plans.

Additional Qualifications

  • A track record of integrity, pride in your work, curiosity, and adaptability.
  • A builder mindset supported by delivered process improvements and automation that reduces manual work while improving reliability.
  • Sound technical judgment on when automation can run unattended, when human review is required, and when risk or production impact requires escalation.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence remediation owners without direct authority, resolve competing priorities, and secure follow-through on risk reduction commitments.
  • Ability to independently lead complex workstreams, mentor analysts, review technical assessments, and establish consistent operating practices with minimal supervision.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information assurance, MIS, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Certification Requirements

  • Preferred, not required: GIAC (GCED, GCIH, GPEN), CompTIA CySA+, CISSP, AI security or automation coursework, or equivalent.

What you'll earn

  • Base pay range: $101,300 - $172,000
  • Annual performance bonus
