NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Senior Data Scientist - Healthcare AI & Data Harmonization - Remote to join our team in Philadelphia, Plano, Pennsylvania (US-PA), United States (US).

Senior Data Scientist – Healthcare AI & Data Harmonization

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist to lead the architecture, development, and scaling of an enterprise data harmonization platform focused on transforming large volumes of complex healthcare and medical data into standardized, structured, and actionable information.

This individual will serve as a senior technical subject matter expert, designing and implementing intelligent AI-driven pipelines to ingest, interpret, normalize, and map heterogeneous structured and unstructured datasets, including clinical, genomic, pathology, and operational data.

The role will leverage advanced Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), semantic search, and biomedical ontologies to automate complex data mapping and schema alignment at enterprise scale.

The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in machine learning architecture, transformer models, distributed computing, and AI infrastructure, including optimization and deployment across specialized hardware accelerators such as NVIDIA GPUs and Google TPUs. They will work closely with Data Engineering, Bioinformatics, and Regulatory/Compliance teams to deliver scalable, production-ready AI and MLOps solutions.

Key Responsibilities

AI Architecture & Data Harmonization

  • Define the technical architecture and roadmap for an enterprise-scale data harmonization and intelligent mapping platform.
  • Design and develop AI-powered pipelines to ingest, process, normalize, and map heterogeneous clinical, genomic, biomedical, and operational datasets.
  • Automate complex schema alignment, semantic matching, and data transformation across structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Establish scalable approaches for processing multi-terabyte datasets while maintaining data quality, accuracy, and performance.

LLM, NLP & AI Model Development

  • Architect, fine-tune, and deploy domain-specific Large Language Models, transformer architectures, and embedding models for healthcare data interpretation and semantic alignment.
  • Develop advanced NLP capabilities, including Named Entity Recognition (NER), entity linking, relation extraction, and clinical information extraction.
  • Implement semantic search and retrieval-based approaches to improve medical terminology recognition, contextual understanding, and automated data mapping.
  • Evaluate and optimize model performance, accuracy, inference latency, and computational efficiency.

GPU/TPU Acceleration & Distributed AI Computing

  • Lead the optimization and deployment of complex AI/ML workloads using specialized hardware accelerators, including NVIDIA GPUs and Google TPUs.
  • Leverage acceleration and distributed computing technologies to support high-throughput model training, fine-tuning, and inference.
  • Optimize transformer and NLP workloads using technologies such as CUDA, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, DeepSpeed, and vLLM.
  • Establish scalable infrastructure and deployment patterns to support enterprise-level AI processing requirements.

Medical Ontology & Semantic Data Mapping

  • Lead the development of automated mapping solutions that align diverse healthcare data sources with established biomedical vocabularies and ontologies.
  • Establish standardized approaches for schema mapping, terminology normalization, semantic validation, and data quality assurance.
  • Work with healthcare data standards and models, including OMOP CDM, FHIR, UMLS, SNOMED CT, RxNorm, and LOINC.
  • Develop validation frameworks and quality controls to ensure consistency, traceability, and accuracy across mapped datasets.

MLOps, Platform Engineering & Technical Leadership

  • Partner with Data Engineers, Bioinformaticians, and Regulatory/Compliance teams to deliver production-ready AI and data processing solutions.
  • Design and implement scalable MLOps pipelines supporting model deployment, monitoring, versioning, evaluation, and continuous retraining.
  • Establish development standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices for enterprise AI model development.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to mid-level Data Scientists and ML Engineers.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to improve automation, scalability, and model performance.

Required Qualifications

  • 6–8+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning Engineering, or Applied AI, with demonstrated experience developing and deploying production-grade AI/ML solutions.
  • 3+ years of dedicated experience in Healthcare, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Informatics, or a related domain.
  • Strong practical understanding of healthcare data complexities, including clinical data, medical terminology, unstructured medical records, and applicable privacy requirements such as HIPAA and GDPR.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting and scaling AI-driven data processing, harmonization, or semantic mapping solutions.
  • Strong experience with advanced NLP, transformer architectures, LLMs, and embedding models.
  • Experience deploying and optimizing machine learning models in distributed, enterprise-scale environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and collaborate across multidisciplinary engineering and data science teams.

Technical Skills & Expertise

AI Infrastructure & Hardware Acceleration

  • Advanced experience with NVIDIA GPU architectures, including A100/H100 Tensor Core GPUs, and/or Google TPUs.
  • Hands-on experience with CUDA, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, DeepSpeed, and/or vLLM.
  • Experience optimizing distributed training, model fine-tuning, and high-throughput inference workloads.

Machine Learning & Generative AI

  • Expert-level Python programming and strong experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face.
  • Experience developing, fine-tuning, and deploying domain-specific LLMs, transformer models, and embedding models.
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and vector-based semantic search.
  • Strong understanding of NLP, information extraction, entity recognition, semantic similarity, and knowledge representation.

Healthcare Data Standards & Ontologies

  • Strong knowledge of healthcare data standards, biomedical vocabularies, and semantic data models, including:
    • OMOP Common Data Model (OMOP CDM)
    • HL7 FHIR
    • UMLS
    • SNOMED CT
    • RxNorm
    • LOINC
  • Experience with clinical terminology mapping, medical ontology alignment, and healthcare data normalization.

Big Data, Cloud & Distributed Computing

  • Experience designing and implementing large-scale distributed data processing solutions using PySpark, Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent platforms.
  • Familiarity with AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data and AI infrastructure.
  • Experience processing and harmonizing large volumes of structured and unstructured data.

MLOps & Deployment

  • Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, model monitoring, model versioning, and automated retraining.
  • Strong understanding of production ML architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance optimization.

Education

It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment’s notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.


What We Offer:At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.

The Mission: As a Senior Data Engineer, you are the engine room of our data strategy. You don't just "move data"; you build resilient, self-healing systems that transform raw, into high-fidelity data products. You will take the Architect’s blueprints and turn them into production-grade code, ensuring there is clean and reliable data.

Work mode : Remote

What the Senior Data Engineer will own:

  • Pipeline Engineering: Build and maintain high-throughput ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from various sources into our Lakehouse.

  • Code Quality & Tooling: Drive the adoption of dbt for transformation and PySpark for heavy lifting. You will be responsible for writing modular, reusable code that follows strict CI/CD practices.

  • Observability & Reliability: Implement "Data SLAs." You will build the monitoring and alerting systems that notify the team of data drift or pipeline failures before the business notices.

  • Data Productization: Work closely with the BI team and Data Scientists to prepare "feature-ready" datasets.

  • Performance Tuning: Deep-dive into SQL and Spark query plans to optimize slow-running jobs, reducing cost and latency.

  • Local Development Advocacy: Implementing a workflow where engineers can develop and test complex SQL transformations locally using DuckDB, drastically reducing "waiting-for-cluster" time and lowering development costs.

  • Cost-Efficient Micro-Pipelines: Building specialized pipelines for specific client reporting or data-quality checks that run on single-node containers (e.g., Lambda or small ECS tasks) using DuckDB, avoiding the minimum billing cycles of larger warehouses.

  • Embedded Analytics: Exploring ways to use DuckDB as an embedded engine for internal tools or "edge" processing within the BPO’s local site offices where bandwidth to the cloud might be a constraint.

Technical Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ Years in Data Engineering: You’ve lived through the "on-call" life and know how to build systems that don't break at 3 AM.

  • The Power Trio: Expert-level proficiency in Python, SQL, and PySpark.

  • Modern Lakehouse Stack: Hands-on experience with Databricks (Delta Lake) or Snowflake. You understand the nuances of the Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold).

  • Transformation & Modeling: Advanced experience with dbt (Data Build Tool). You treat data models like software, including version control, testing, and documentation.

  • Orchestration: Experience with Apache Airflow or Prefect, specifically building complex, idempotent DAGs.

  • Streaming Experience: Familiarity with Kafka, Kinesis, or Spark Streaming is a huge plus—our BPO operations move in real-time.

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Comfort with Terraform or CloudFormation to manage your own data infrastructure.

  • In-Process Analytics (DuckDB): Proven experience using DuckDB for high-speed local development, unit testing data transformations, or as a query engine for "small-to-medium" datasets (up to 100GB) without the overhead of a distributed cluster.

  • Hybrid Execution Patterns: Ability to identify when to use heavyweight compute (PySpark/Databricks) versus lightweight compute (DuckDB/Python) to minimize cloud costs and reduce job latency.

  • Parquet/Iceberg Interaction: Experience using DuckDB to directly query data stored in S3/Azure Blob (via Parquet or Iceberg files) for rapid ad-hoc analysis or local dashboarding.

  • Orchestration:Kubernetes (K8s). Deep understanding of Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and Secrets management.

As Canada’s leading applied research organization, we publish over 500 research outputs a year, helping to advance education on the critical issues facing our communities, our organizations and our country. Our Executive Councils bring leaders together to share real-world insights and support evidence-based decision-making. All in service of a stronger more prosperous Canada.

For more than 70 years, Signal49 Research is where Canada has turned for applied, independent research and meaningful connections. Leaders trust us because we stand apart: objective, credible, and connected. To learn more about Signal49 Research and our history, check out our website:

The ability to successfully work within a membership-based business model where fostering, managing and building relationships, delivering on the councils’ value-propositions, and driving thought-leadership are key.

A strong understanding of Canada’s Human Capital landscape and the evolving issues affecting workplaces and the workforce is highly desirable. This includes areas such as workplace inclusion, employee health and well-being, talent and workforce strategy, leadership, organizational culture, skills, productivity, and the changing nature of work. The successful candidate will demonstrate a natural curiosity and commitment to staying informed and ahead of trends in this dynamic space.

We are a virtual organization and as a remote worker you must be comfortable and able to work 100 per cent of the time from a home office in Canada, with the exception of the requirement to travel to attend regular council meetings and events hosted by Signal49 Research. To be successful as a remote worker you need to have a self-starter attitude, possess strong organizational and time management skills and be a proactive communicator. Having a home office environment that provides for a productive, professional, and safe work environment during regular working/business hours is a requirement of this role. About the Role

  • Demonstrate a commitment to producing high-quality work and upholding professional values in all aspects of work and interactions with colleagues, members, speakers, and partners.

About You

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Significant experience leading stakeholder-engagement activities and building partnerships.

Job Description:

CLUB CADDIE

Every course, one move ahead

Head of Enterprise Sales (MCO)

Sales & Marketing | Reports to: President/Chief Revenue Officer | Travel: ~50% | Full-Time


ABOUT CLUB CADDIE

Club Caddie is a fast-growing golf course management software (GMS) company and a member of the Jonas Software family, a division of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU). Our platform is the operating system for golf — unifying point of sale, tee sheet, member management, food and beverage, and payments into a single connected system for public, semi-private, and multi-course operators.

We are built by operators, for operators, and our brand is anchored in four commitments: Unified Operations, Intelligent Action, Revenue Momentum, and Hospitality Memory. As Club Caddie scales its footprint with the country's largest multi-course operators (MCOs), we're investing in the enterprise sales leadership to match that ambition.


THE ROLE

The Head of Enterprise Sales owns Club Caddie's go-to-market motion for Multi-Course Operators (MCO) — management companies and ownership groups operating multiple golf facilities across the country. This is a hunting, value-building, and relationship-building role for a seasoned enterprise sales leader who knows how to navigate long, complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and close large agreements.

You will report directly to the Chief Revenue Officer and work in close partnership with Marketing, Product, Implementation, and Customer Experience to build a durable pipeline of MCO logos, from first conversation through signed agreement and a clean handoff to post-sales. The base salary range for this role is between $110,000 - $120,000.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the MCO Sales Motion

  • Build and execute a strategic account plan targeting the top multi-course operators in the U.S. and Canada, prioritizing accounts by fit, size, and strategic value.
  • Manage a complex, multi-stakeholder sales pipeline in the CRM with rigor — accurate staging, next steps, forecasted close dates, and clear next steps on every opportunity.
  • Lead the full sales cycle: prospecting, discovery, solution design, ROI/business case development, procurement, contracting, and close through an enterprise level sales methodology.

Build Executive Relationships

  • Develop value-based relationships with C-suite and operations leaders (CEO, COO, VP of Golf Operations, CIO) at management companies and ownership groups.
  • Represent Club Caddie at industry events — NGCOA, the MCO Retreat (MCOR), and other regional and national golf industry gatherings — to build pipeline and deepen existing relationships.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, bringing a point of view on how technology can solve real operational and financial challenges across a multi-course portfolio.

Negotiate and Close Complex Deals

  • Lead commercial negotiations on multi-year, multi-property agreements, balancing win rate, margin, and long-term account health.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, and Implementation to structure deals that are commercially sound and operationally deliverable.
  • Manage competitive displacement deals against incumbent point-of-sale and tee sheet providers with a clear, defensible value narrative.

Drive Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Partner with Marketing and the Director of Digital on MCO-specific campaigns, collateral, and messaging that support the pipeline.
  • Work closely with the Executive, Product, Customer Experience, and Sales teams to translate enterprise buyer feedback into product improvements, market awareness, and competitor insights.
  • Ensure a clean, well-documented handoff from sales to implementation for every closed account, protecting the customer experience from contract to go-live.

Forecasting & Performance

  • Own MCO segment forecasting and pipeline reporting, contributing accurate inputs to company-wide revenue scorecards and QBRs.
  • Track and report on key metrics: pipeline coverage, deal velocity, win rate, average contract value, and sales cycle length.
  • Manage deals through a formal sales methodology e.g. MEDDIC, MEDDPIC, etc… to ensure internal and external alignment.
  • Continuously refine MCO sales playbooks, pricing strategy, and competitive positioning based on what's working in the field.
  • Achieve or exceed the annual targets for MCO sales including new logo and back-to-base revenue targets.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 7+ years of enterprise or complex B2B sales experience, with a track record of closing large, multi-stakeholder agreements; SaaS, hospitality, or golf/club industry experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success selling into complex organizations with long sales cycles and layered decision-making (procurement, ops, IT, finance, executive) leveraging enterprise sales methodologies.
  • Previous success creating value and desire across an entire organization including decision makers and deal champions.
  • Strong commercial negotiation skills, with experience structuring multi-year, enterprise-wide contracts.
  • Exceptional value-building instincts — comfortable and credible in a room with C-suite executives and front-line operators alike.
  • Highly organized and data-driven; disciplined about CRM hygiene, pipeline accuracy, and forecasting.
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% of the time for industry events, on-site customer meetings, and prospect visits.
  • Self-directed and resilient — comfortable building a territory and a pipeline largely from the ground up.
  • Genuine interest in or connection to the golf industry is a strong plus, but not required.

WHY JOIN CLUB CADDIE

  • Own a high-impact, high-visibility segment of the business, with a direct line to the CRO and executive team.
  • Sell a genuinely differentiated, unified platform into an industry that is actively consolidating around modern technology.
  • Competitive base plus uncapped commission, benefits, and the backing of Jonas Software and Constellation Software's scale and stability.
  • Be part of shaping the next chapter of Club Caddie's MCO strategy, not just executing an existing playbook.

Club Caddie is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

About AllShore Talent

AllShore Talent partners with growing organizations to build high-performing technology and consulting teams. We connect skilled professionals with meaningful, long-term engagements across web technologies, digital experience platforms, and enterprise software delivery — offering competitive compensation, flexible engagement models, and a collaborative, remote-friendly culture.

About The Role

The Data Architect provides hands-on data architecture and technical delivery expertise for Adobe Campaign Classic to Adobe Journey Optimizer modernisation. The role assesses the customer’s Campaign data model, workflows and integrations, defines the Adobe Experience Platform and AJO target data architecture, maps legacy data and processes to the new platform, and guides implementation, validation and transition.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery covering current data collection, data models, identities, integrations and platform configuration.

  • Document the current-state architecture and define a scalable target-state architecture based on Adobe Experience Platform.

  • Translate business and migration requirements into schemas, datasets, identity designs, data flows and integration specifications.

  • Map legacy implementation components and data structures to the target platform, identifying what should be migrated, redesigned or retired.

  • Work with technical consultants and customer engineering teams to implement the agreed architecture.

  • Define data quality, governance, privacy, security, retention, validation and reconciliation requirements.

  • Investigate source-to-target discrepancies and guide their resolution.

  • Produce clear architecture, design, mapping and implementation documentation, and identify dependencies, assumptions and risks early.

  • Support architecture governance and technical quality throughout implementation.

  • Understanding of AEP guardrails and licensing constraints, including recognising when a design is technically possible but not available under the customer’s licence.

  • lead workshops, present and recommend solutions, document designs and gain customer agreement.

Requirements

Experience and Skills

Essential

  • Strong technical experience with Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC).

  • Understanding of Campaign schemas, recipient and broad-log data, workflows, typologies, deliveries, integrations and custom extensions.

  • Strong Adobe Experience Platform experience, including XDM schema design, datasets, batch and streaming ingestion, identity namespaces, identity resolution, Real-Time Customer Profile, audience design, data governance and consent.

  • Practical experience with Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO).

  • Experience designing the data foundation required for AJO journeys, audiences, decisioning and message personalisation.

  • Ability to assess existing Campaign data and workflows and determine what should be migrated, redesigned or retired.

  • Experience mapping Campaign customer, interaction, campaign and delivery data into appropriate AEP schemas and datasets.

  • Experience integrating AEP and AJO with enterprise data sources and downstream activation or messaging services.

  • Experience facilitating customer-facing technical discovery and design workshops.

  • Ability to define validation and reconciliation approaches for migrated data and integrations.

Highly desirable

  • Previous delivery of an Adobe Campaign Classic-to-AJO migration or modernisation program.

  • Experience with Campaign custom schemas and complex workflow-based data processing.

  • Experience redesigning Campaign capabilities as AEP audiences, AJO journeys or platform integrations.

  • Understanding of AJO journeys, channel configuration, content, offers, decisioning and message execution.

  • Knowledge of consent, suppression, frequency-management and customer-preference patterns.

  • Experience supporting coexistence and transition between Campaign Classic and AJO.

  • Familiarity with APIs and event-driven integrations used to initiate journeys or update customer profiles.

  • Working knowledge of SQL, JSON, REST APIs and data-query or validation tools.

Expected deliverables

  • Current-state Campaign data model, workflow and integration assessment.

  • Target-state AEP and AJO data architecture.

  • Source-to-target mappings and XDM schema and dataset designs.

  • Identity, profile, audience, consent and governance design.

  • Batch, streaming, API and event-driven integration designs.

  • Migration and coexistence assumptions, dependencies and risks.

  • Validation, reconciliation and acceptance plan.

  • Technical implementation and operational handover documentation.

Engagement profile

This is a delivery-focused data architecture role. The successful contractor must be able to move between architecture and implementation-level detail, work effectively in a blended Adobe, customer and partner team, and provide clear evidence of personal ownership of relevant designs and delivery outcomes.

Engagement details section

  • Contract role.

  • Starts soon; a two-week notice period is acceptable.

  • Lasts 1–3 years.

  • Remote anywhere in EMEA, preferably Central Europe.

  • Occasional business travel, with expenses covered.

Program context: two migration paths built on AEP (AA → CJA and Campaign Classic → AJO). Customers are mostly B2C, across the UK, France, Spain, Germany, Norway and Italy.

Languages: strong professional English is required. German, French or Italian is highly valued.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Gen AI Video & Motion Designer to join our global Creative Capability team and lead the production of high-quality video content across multiple client accounts.

This is a hands-on creative role combining video editing, motion design, storytelling, and generative AI production. You will take projects from brief and storyboard through to final delivery, using traditional video craft alongside Gen AI tools to create high-quality, scalable content for paid media, social, and digital platforms.

A key part of the role is developing repeatable workflows and automation that allow the team to produce multiple platform, market, and audience-specific video variations efficiently, while maintaining a high creative and technical standard.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop storyboards and video concepts based on creative briefs, audience insights, and performance objectives.
  • Edit and produce video content across multiple formats, from hero assets to short-form paid social and 6-second cuts.
  • Create and integrate Gen AI video using text-to-video, image-to-video, generative extension, scene creation, object removal, outpainting, and other AI-assisted techniques.
  • Combine AI-generated content with traditional footage and professional post-production to ensure seamless, polished results.
  • Create motion graphics, kinetic typography, transitions, lower thirds, end frames, and other branded elements.
  • Adapt and version video content for different platforms, markets, languages, audiences, and aspect ratios.
  • Develop scalable video production workflows, templates, and automation processes to increase production efficiency.
  • Maintain prompt libraries, references, presets, and other systems that support consistent Gen AI output.
  • Ensure all final content meets creative, technical, brand, and platform standards, identifying and correcting AI artefacts and continuity issues.
  • Work closely with Creative Directors, Strategists, Designers, and other teams across the global Creative Capability.
  • Incorporate performance insights into creative decisions and future video concepts.
  • Share knowledge and help upskill other designers in Gen AI video tools and workflows.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in video editing and motion design.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience using Generative AI video tools in real production environments.
  • Mandatory: Portfolio/showreel demonstrating Gen AI video work.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.
  • Strong knowledge of Photoshop and Illustrator.
  • Experience with DaVinci Resolve or an equivalent editing/color-grading tool.
  • Strong storytelling and storyboarding skills.
  • Experience creating video for performance marketing, paid media, social, or digital advertising.
  • Experience producing high volumes of video variations and adapting content for different platforms and markets.
  • Strong understanding of video formats, aspect ratios, codecs, compression, and digital platform specifications.
  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when reviewing AI-generated content for artefacts, continuity, and brand consistency.
  • Ability to explain and defend creative decisions to both creative and non-creative stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ComfyUI, Figma Weave, or other node-based AI workflows.
  • Python, JavaScript, ExtendScript, or other scripting/automation experience.
  • Experience with LoRAs, ControlNet, fine-tuning, or other methods for maintaining consistency in AI-generated content.
  • Experience with creative automation and dynamic video templating.
  • Advanced Figma knowledge.
  • 3D or virtual production experience with tools such as Blender, Cinema 4D, or Unreal Engine.
  • Understanding of AI content provenance, licensing, synthetic likeness, and brand-safety considerations.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality video output that combines strong creative craft with effective use of Gen AI.
  • Scalable workflows that significantly increase video production capacity.
  • Consistent, brand-safe, and technically compliant video across platforms and markets.
  • Creative decisions informed by performance data and audience behaviour.
  • Reusable systems and workflows that can be adopted by other members of the creative team.
  • A higher standard of Gen AI video production across the Creative Capability.

Why Incubeta?

You will join a global, collaborative and entrepreneurial environment where you can have a direct impact on how media is delivered across the Americas.

This is an opportunity to shape the standards, processes and operating model behind a growing media execution function, while working alongside senior media leadership and a global media capability team.

Important: A portfolio or showreel containing demonstrable Gen AI video work is mandatory. Candidates without relevant Gen AI video examples will not be considered.

jobs.description:
Position:Seasonal Global Navigator Scholarship Evaluator- Temp

Reports to:Associate Manager, Sales Operations

Department:Global Navigator Programs, High School Summer Study Abroad

Location:US Remote

Who we are:

CIEE is a nonprofit study abroad and intercultural exchange organization that transforms lives and builds bridges between individuals and nations through study abroad and international exchange experiences that help people develop skills for living in a globally interdependent and multi-cultural world.

Why work with us:

  • You will change the world. CIEE builds bridges between people, countries, and cultures. We help young people participate in high-quality international exchange and study abroad programs that bring the world together. We change lives, our alumni change the world. Be part of the change!
  • You will be part of a fast-paced, international, and collaborative team of professionals. CIEE operates the largest nonprofit network of study abroad locations, with facilities and staff in over 30 countries. Additionally, we help international participants from over 140 countries come to the USA each year. Committed to excellence and solving whatever problem the world throws at them, CIEE professionals work on international teams, and are dedicated to advancing our almost 80-year-old mission to make the world a more peaceful place.

Who you are:

The Seasonal Global Navigator Scholarship Evaluator will support the review and evaluation of Global Navigator Scholarship applications during the scholarship review season. This role is responsible for objectively assessing applications, financial documentation, and supporting materials using established rubrics, eligibility criteria, and standard operating procedures. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable completing high-volume, repetitive work while maintaining accuracy, consistency, confidentiality, and established deadlines.

What you’ll do:

  • Review and score a high volume (approximately 1000-2000) of Global Navigator Scholarship applications using established rubrics, criteria, and standard operating procedures.
  • Evaluate application components, including written responses, student information, and financial documentation, and assign scores according to established guidelines.
  • Review and audit financial documentation to identify missing information, discrepancies, or items requiring additional review.
  • Accurately record scores, review outcomes, and required information in designated systems and tracking tools.
  • Maintain consistent, objective scoring across applications and meet established productivity, accuracy, and review deadlines.
  • Participate in required training and calibration activities and apply feedback to improve scoring consistency and accuracy.
  • Escalate questions, documentation concerns, and situations not addressed by established procedures to the appropriate team member.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality when handling student, family, academic, financial, and scholarship information.
  • Depending on workload, skills, and availability, assist with additional administrative or operational projects within the High School Study Abroad team.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What you’ll bring

  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong reading comprehension.
  • Ability to objectively apply established rubrics, criteria, and procedures without allowing personal opinions to influence evaluations.
  • Strong critical-thinking and analytical skills, including the ability to identify discrepancies, missing information, and documentation that does not meet established requirements.
  • Ability to maintain accuracy and focus while performing repetitive, high-volume work.
  • Strong organization and time-management skills, with the ability to independently manage workload and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to receive and apply feedback related to accuracy, quality, and scoring consistency.
  • Strong written communication skills and ability to clearly document questions or concerns.
  • Comfort working with written, numerical, and financial information.
  • Basic technical aptitude and ability to learn online application systems, databases, spreadsheets, and other technology-based tools.
  • Basic Microsoft Excel skills preferred.
  • Previous experience in application review, assessment, grading, auditing, quality assurance, education, administration, financial aid, or related work preferred but not required.
  • Experience reviewing scholarship, admissions, academic, grant, or similar applications is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a remote environment.
  • Professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Availability to work full or part-time during the designated scholarship review period.

Schedule & Hours:

This is a full-time, hourly position offering up to 40 hours per week. The standard schedule is Monday–Thursday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM, with flexibility on Fridays to choose either a 9:00 AM–5:00 PM or 12:00 PM–8:00 PM shift. All shifts are based on your local time zone. Each daily shift includes a 30-minute unpaid, uninterrupted break, resulting in a consistent 37.5 paid hours per week, with a hard cap of 40 hours. Employees will not be scheduled to work on CIEE-observed holidays.

CIEE believes that professionals with varied backgrounds bring unique approaches and ideas to solving problems and advancing our mission to bring the world together. Qualified candidates from underrepresented groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

Due to federal regulations and CIEE policies, a background check, and education and employment verification will be conducted as conditions of employment.

About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

CoLab is hiring a highly motivated VP of Enterprise Sales to scale our enterprise sales team and the process behind it during a critical phase of growth. You will report to our SVP of Sales and lead enterprise teams, whose Account Executives sell deals from $25K to $500K and upwards of $1M to Fortune 500 manufacturers in automotive, industrial, heavy machinery, medical device and consumer products.

CoLab sells into engineering and design teams, not just procurement or supply chain. These are complex, multi-stakeholder deals with long cycles and no pre-existing budget line, so this person needs to be a strong closer and a stronger coach.

What you'll bring

jobs.excerpt: About WRS HealthWRS Health builds an Electronic Health Records (EHR) system that medical practices rely on every day to care for patients.
jobs.description:
About WRS Health

WRS Health builds an Electronic Health Records (EHR) system that medical practices rely on every day to care for patients. Our platform runs on Linux servers in AWS with a PHP application stack, and it holds some of the most sensitive data there is: protected health information.
We are now investing heavily in AI agents that work alongside clinicians and staff. That shift opens new ground for our product and new attack surfaces for our security program. We are hiring a Security Engineer to help us protect both.

The role

As our Security Engineer, you will find and fix security risks before attackers do, across our AWS infrastructure, our PHP application, and our growing fleet of AI agents. You will look ahead to emerging threats, especially those unique to LLMs and autonomous agents, and build defenses before they are needed.
This is a hands-on, collaborative role. You will work directly with our development and AI teams, helping them understand issues, prioritize fixes, and ship secure code. We want someone who teaches and enables, not someone who only files tickets.

What you'll do

Application security
  • Review PHP code and architecture for vulnerabilities such as injection, broken authentication, insecure deserialization, and access-control flaws.
  • Run and tune SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning (e.g., Composer packages) in our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Lead threat modeling for new features and work with developers to fix findings, with clear guidance and secure code examples.
Cloud and infrastructure security
  • Harden our AWS environment: IAM least privilege, network segmentation, encryption at rest and in transit, and secrets management.
  • Monitor and respond to findings from tools such as GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, and AWS Config.
  • Secure and patch Linux servers, and define hardened baselines for new infrastructure.
AI and agent security
  • Assess AI agents for risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, excessive permissions, insecure tool use, and model supply-chain issues.
  • Define guardrails for what agents can access and do, especially where PHI is involved, including logging, human-in-the-loop controls, and output validation.
  • Partner with the AI team to build security into agent design from the start, using frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
Threat management and response
  • Track emerging threats to healthcare, cloud, and AI systems, and turn that intelligence into concrete defenses.
  • Coordinate penetration tests and vulnerability management, from discovery through verified fix.
  • Help build and run our incident response plan, including tabletop exercises.
Compliance and culture
  • Support HIPAA and HITECH compliance.
  • Run secure-coding training and build security awareness across engineering.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years in security engineering, application security, or a closely related role.
  • Hands-on experience securing AWS environments, including IAM, VPC design, KMS, and AWS security services.
  • Strong Linux administration and hardening skills.
  • Experience with vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and driving findings to resolution.
  • Working knowledge of LLM and AI agent risks, such as prompt injection, data exfiltration through tools, and over-permissioned agents.
  • Scripting or automation skills in Python, Bash, or similar.
  • Clear communication, and the ability to explain risk to developers and leadership in practical terms.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA or other regulated-data environments.

Nice to have

  • Experience in healthcare IT or with EHR systems and standards such as HL7 or FHIR.
  • Prior work securing AI agents, RAG pipelines, or LLM integrations in production.
  • Infrastructure-as-code security (Terraform or CloudFormation) and container security.

What success looks like in your first year

  1. First 90 days: You have assessed our AWS, Linux, and PHP environments and our AI agent designs, and you have a prioritized risk roadmap.
  2. By six months: Automated security scanning runs in every pipeline, and developers fix critical findings quickly with your guidance.
  3. By one year: Every new AI agent passes a security review before launch, our incident response plan has been tested, and security is part of how engineering works day to day.

Details and how to apply

  • Location: Remote
  • Employment type: Full-time - Independent Contractor
  • Reports to: CTO
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

The Office of Software Assurance (OSA) Lead is the senior individual contributor who establishes and leads the Office of Software Assurance, a new shift-left software quality function inside the Agile Office, through technical expertise and influence rather than line management. The OSA embeds right-sized, risk-based assurance into a 1,000+ person Engineering organization, so that compliance evidence is produced as a natural, tool-native output of how teams build, not assembled after the fact.

You will own day-to-day software quality execution across three lifecycle domains (SDLC, Computer Software Assurance, and Infrastructure Qualification). Natera’s Software Quality Assurance department keeps independent oversight, approval authority, and the front-line role in audits and inspections. Your focus is faster, simpler, and compliant delivery, and you do it in a way you can defend to an auditor. The ideal candidate is a software engineer first, someone who understands code, CI/CD, and engineering tooling, and who has worked close enough to regulated environments to apply quality and regulatory expectations without becoming a bottleneck.

What You Will Do

  • Stand up the OSA and execute its charter in phases: Launch (engineering-tool assurance), Extend (product-software assurance planning and evidence-readiness review), and Mature (largely automated, tool-native release-readiness evidence, with SQA operating by exception).
  • Own the OSA Charter and the OSA Responsibility & Governance Matrix, and keep them current with SQA concurrence. Review annually or sooner as responsibilities phase in.
  • Provide technical direction, coaching, and quality review for the OSA assurance resources, and contribute to their hiring and development plans in partnership with the Head of Agile Office. Coordinate, coach, and quality-check the engineers assigned the SQE capability within engineering teams.
  • Define baselines and targets with the Sponsor and report on OSA success metrics: assurance turnaround and cycle time versus the legacy CSV path, deliverables per release versus the 8–10-per-release baseline, intake quality, SQA relief, inspection readiness, and capability milestones.

Deliver right-sized assurance

  • Oversee AL1–AL2 assurance planning and participate in AL3–AL4 assurance under the CSA SOP. This covers the path from CSA Intake through Software Assurance Plan, execution, report and closeout, and Service Catalog registration.
  • Recommend the Assurance Level and assurance approach at CSA Intake. Select assurance activities and acceptance criteria from the Assurance Method Menu within an assigned level. Support SQA's level-confirmation walkthroughs.

Govern engineering tools and change

  • Provide fast-path change oversight and impact disposition on engineering tickets under the Software Change Work Instruction. Route device-software changes to SQA.

Partner with Software Quality Assurance (SQA) and the business

Build capability and automate

WORK OPTION: Remote

Position Summary
The Cybersecurity GRC Automation Lead is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing the technology solutions that enable the NBA’s cybersecurity governance, risk, compliance, and privacy programs to operate efficiently at scale. This role serves as the technical foundation for modern compliance operations by transforming manual processes into automated, data-driven workflows that provide continuous visibility into the organization’s security and control environment.

As a hands-on technology leader, the Cybersecurity GRC Automation Lead will evaluate, enhance, and integrate Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platforms across the enterprise, developing automated evidence collection, control monitoring, reporting, and workflow capabilities that support ongoing audit readiness. The role will partner closely with Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Privacy, Legal, and business stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements, industry frameworks, and internal control objectives into sustainable technical solutions.

This position plays a critical role in supporting the NBA’s compliance obligations, including industry-recognized security standards and privacy regulations, while advancing a continuous compliance operating model. The individual will establish scalable automation patterns that strengthen governance, improve risk visibility, reduce operational overhead, and enable leadership to make informed decisions based on timely, reliable security and compliance intelligence.

Operating within a dynamic global environment that includes digital fan engagement platforms, live events, media and broadcast operations, and emerging business initiatives, the Cybersecurity GRC Automation Lead will help ensure the organization’s governance and risk management capabilities evolve in step with the complexity and scale of the NBA’s technology ecosystem.


Major Responsibilities

  • Automate compliance workflows. Design, implement, and maintain automated risk and compliance workflows that reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency, and enable continuous control monitoring.
  • Develop the data foundation for risk visibility. Build data pipelines and analytics capabilities that consolidate risk, control, asset, and issue information from across the technology environment, providing timely insight into compliance posture through dashboards and executive-ready reporting.
  • Engineer automated evidence collection. Develop integrations between GRC platforms and cloud infrastructure, including AWS, Azure, and GCP; identity and access management and governance solutions, such as Ping or comparable technologies; human resources information systems; ticketing platforms; version control systems; and CI/CD pipelines to automate evidence collection and control validation.
  • Manage and enhance GRC platforms. Evaluate, configure, customize, and integrate GRC technologies to meet organizational requirements, and regularly assess the supporting technology landscape to ensure platforms remain effective as the program evolves and scales.
  • Support audit and certification programs. Establish automated evidence pipelines and control mappings that support continuous readiness for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and CCPA/CPRA requirements, and collaborate with external auditors and assessors throughout audit and certification cycles.
  • Strengthen issue lifecycle management. Develop and integrate tracking, escalation, and accountability mechanisms that enable findings to progress efficiently from identification through remediation and closure across cybersecurity functions and partner teams.
  • Translate requirements into measurable controls. Partner with Privacy, Legal, Information Technology, and Engineering stakeholders to translate regulatory obligations and framework requirements into technical controls, automated checks, and policy-as-code capabilities that can be consistently measured and monitored.
  • Drive business adoption and cross-functional alignment. Engage control owners and business stakeholders to build support for new and enhanced processes, clarify responsibilities, and promote consistent adoption across the organization.

Required Education/Professional Experience

  • A minimum of seven years of progressive experience in cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance (GRC), risk management, or compliance, including responsibility for program automation and cross-functional coordination.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple security domains and workflows concurrently while maintaining accuracy, transparency, and accountability.
  • Hands-on experience supporting ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 Type II compliance programs, including the automation of evidence collection through a commercial GRC platform.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more commercial GRC platforms, such as Drata or a comparable solution, is required.
  • Experience in sports, entertainment, media, or another high-profile, consumer-facing industry is preferred.
  • Professional certification, such as CISSP, CISM, or CRISC, is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information technology, computer science, risk management, or a related field.

Required Skills/Knowledge Attributes

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in systems engineering, data engineering, software development, or a closely related technical discipline, with a proven record of designing and implementing automated workflows and data pipelines.
  • Strong scripting capabilities and experience developing integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, or comparable technologies to connect disparate systems and enable reliable data exchange across platforms.
  • Experience with data warehousing or analytics platforms, including the development of scalable reporting and analytics infrastructure.
  • Ability to work independently, lead complex technical initiatives from design through implementation, and navigate ambiguity within a developing, rapidly scaling program.
  • Current working knowledge of relevant privacy and security frameworks, including CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001, and the ability to translate applicable requirements into effective controls.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, balanced with a practical approach to risk-based prioritization and the judgment to determine when precision or speed is most critical.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present effectively to senior cybersecurity leadership and collaborate closely with technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence leaders at the Director level and above, foster cross-functional alignment, and drive accountability without direct authority.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity and operational risk considerations associated with broadcast or live event environments is preferred.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.

US or Canada - Remote

U.S. LOCATIONSMAY INCLUDE

Indianapolis, IN; Arizona; Colorado; Michigan; North Carolina; Ohio; Texas; Virginia

Role Overview

The AI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is the technical owner for strategic customer AI engagements, responsible for turning high-value business problems into working, production-ready AI solutions. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, AI engineering, solution architecture, and hands-on delivery. The FDE works directly with customer business and technical teams to identify the right problem, rapidly build and validate a solution, deploy it into real operating environments, and continuously optimize it against measurable business outcomes.

This is a builder role. Success requires equal comfort with executive discovery, architecture whiteboarding, writing and debugging code, integrating enterprise systems and data, evaluating agent behavior, and resolving blockers with Product and Engineering. The FDE maintains end-to-end accountability from discovery through production and converts lessons from each engagement into reusable assets that accelerate the next customer.

Key Responsibilities

· Own customer outcomes end to end. Partner with customer business and technical leaders to identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases, define measurable success criteria, and own the technical outcome from discovery through prototype, live test, production, and optimization.

· Build hands-on. Rapidly prototype, code, configure, integrate, test, and deploy AI solutions using customer systems, APIs, data, workflows, and cloud services.

· Engineer agentic AI systems. Design and optimize agent behavior, prompts, context, tool invocation, orchestration, grounding, retrieval, memory, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns.

· Connect AI to the enterprise. Develop secure integrations across APIs, webhooks, enterprise applications, data platforms, identity systems, and legacy environments so AI agents can act reliably within real business workflows.

· Validate with engineering rigor. Build evaluation and observability approaches that test accuracy, safety, latency, reliability, and business outcomes; diagnose failures and edge cases and iterate rapidly.

· Move prototypes into production. Apply sound software engineering, security, governance, CI/CD, version control, monitoring, and operational practices to deliver maintainable production solutions.

· Remove production blockers. Work directly with Genesys Product, Engineering, Support, and cross-functional teams to identify platform gaps, resolve technical issues, and unblock customer deployment.

· Co-build with customers. Work alongside customer engineers and architects, transfer knowledge, and leave customer teams more capable of operating and extending the solution after the engagement.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Data Manager (South Africa)
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionSUMMARY ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​The Senior Clinical Data Manager will lead and manage multiple clinical studies, ensuring that data are collected, managed and reported clearly, accurately and securely.
jobs.description:
Description

SUMMARY

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​The Senior Clinical Data Manager will lead and manage multiple clinical studies, ensuring that data are collected, managed and reported clearly, accurately and securely. In addition, this position is required to conduct all these activities in conformance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry guidelines, and Innovaderm standard operating procedures (SOPs) while respecting Indero’s commitment to sponsor’s requirements and timelines

.

RESPONSIBILITIES

More specifically, the Senior Clinical Data Manager must:

· Adhere and promote company organizational values and related expected behaviors, follow company SOPs and processes for all deliverables, and ensure all trainings assigned to oneself are completed on time.

  • Be the data management liaison to the project team, sponsor and external vendors, as needed.
  • Be able to manage three to four concurrent studies independently, with minimal supervision.
  • Be able to take decision with minimal support from manager.
  • Attend meeting with sponsor and answers Data Management related question.
  • Provides input for timelines and monitor scope of work to ensure timely and within budget completion of assigned tasks.
  • Be responsible for the development of electronic case report form (eCRF) specifications (including data capture screens and edit check specifications) needed to build a study-specific clinical database/electronic data capture (EDC) system.
  • Be responsible for or assist in the programming and ongoing maintenance of the clinical database.
  • Be responsible for the validation and testing of the clinical database (e.g. User Acceptance Testing).
  • Be responsible for the development of eCRF completion guidelines and other training material required to train site users and monitors.
  • Conduct training for site users/monitors on the clinical database.

· Develop data transfer agreements and specifications with vendors providing external data (e.g. laboratory results).

  • Conduct reconciliation between external data and data in the EDC system to ensure consistency, including reconciliation with sponsor safety databases for adverse events/serious adverse events data (if needed).
  • Provide support to study team in the development of external systems capturing clinical data, e.g. ePRO or IWRS, and ensuring that any data transfer requirements between these systems and EDC are documented and tested appropriately.
  • Be responsible for the development of the data management plan (DMP), and other clinical data management related documentation.
  • Be responsible for ongoing data review/cleaning during study conduct and also during preparation for database lock/close.
  • Code medical terms in the clinical database, as required.
  • Generates data listings and reports needed for data review by the project manager (or other study team members) in preparation for database close/lock.
  • Monitor study status (e.g. enrollment, CRFs monitored/approved, etc.) on an ongoing basis and provides data status reports to the project team, as needed.
  • Ensure that data management documentation is complete and up-to-date in the trial master file (TMF).
  • Respond to users requiring assistance with the EDC system.
  • Be responsible for archiving of the clinical database and related documents.
  • Participate in the definition, writing and updating of data management Work Instructions
  • Mentor and train Clinical Data Coordinators, as needed.
  • Provide basic support to less experienced Clinical Data Managers, as needed.

· For any studies where any of the above activities have been outsourced to an external service provider:

    • Oversee/manage the vendor to ensure that timelines and deliverables meet with sponsor and protocol requirements;
    • Ensure that their work is done in accordance with effective work orders and Innovaderm SOPs (if applicable).

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

· B.Sc. or in a related field of study.

· M. Sc. or in a related field of study is an asset;

· 5 to 8 years of clinical data management experience in clinical research in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or contractual research organization (CRO) industry.

· Understanding of the drug development process and of applicable regulations, including Good Clinical Practices, ICH Guidelines.

· Extensive experience working with EDC systems, and/or database structures.

· Demonstrated skills in database programming an asset.

· Good understanding of CDISC SDTM/CDASH standards;

· Highly organized and detail-oriented with effective project planning and time management skills.

· Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, French an asset.

· Good knowledge of MS Excel.

· Knowledge of SAS or similar, an asset;

· Excellent problem solving abilities;

· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated agility to organize and prioritize multiple competing demands.

· Knowledge of MedDRA and WHODrug dictionaries.

· Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability, and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Flexible schedule
  • Vacation
  • Home-based position
  • Ongoing learning and development

About Indero

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Position Overview

Providing quality training since 1996, Rhodes Wellness College is recognized as a leader in counselling, wellness, and coaching education.

We offer a warm and vibrant environment with a team committed to their own growth and wellness, as well as that of our students. Our students are diverse, curious, and engaged with their learning.

This is not your typical educational institution. We use an experiential learning model that emphasizes active participation. Through practice, reflection, demonstration, discussion, and real-world application, students develop new skills, attitudes, and approaches to working with clients.

If you are an experienced counsellor and passionate educator looking for a dynamic and meaningful teaching environment, you could be a great fit for our faculty.

The Opportunity

We are seeking experienced, qualified counsellors who are strong facilitators and educators to join our faculty as Clinical Supervisors for students entering the final two semesters of our Counselling Diploma Program.

Clinical Supervision plays an important role in helping students transition from classroom learning into professional counselling practice. As a Clinical Supervisor, you will support students in developing their clinical skills, applying counselling theory to practice, engaging in reflective learning, and developing their professional identity and competencies.

We are looking for counsellors who enjoy teaching, facilitating groups, and creating an engaging and supportive learning environment for adult learners.

Position Details

Clinical Supervision is delivered over a 12-week semester, with approximately 48 instructional hours per semester.

  • Schedule: Fridays, 9:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m. Pacific Time (Vancouver time)
  • Duration: 12 weeks per semester
  • Teaching format: Synchronous online instruction via Zoom
  • Blended opportunity: We are also seeking faculty members who are available to teach both online and in person from our Vancouver campus.
  • Course materials: All course materials and instructional resources are provided. No curriculum development is required.

Rhodes Wellness College operates four semesters per year, with teaching opportunities depending on program scheduling and faculty availability.

What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate is an experienced counsellor who is also an engaging educator and facilitator. You bring warmth, professionalism, curiosity, and a collaborative approach to teaching, and you enjoy supporting emerging counsellors as they develop their clinical skills and professional identity.

Ideal Candidate Qualifications & Experience:

  • A Master’s degree in Counselling Psychology or equivalent education.
  • Six years of professional counselling experience following graduation.
  • Current registration or membership with a recognized Canadian counselling organization, such as CPCA, ACCT, BCACC, CRPO, or another recognized professional counselling association.
  • Designated as a clinical supervisor: have completed a recognized qualified supervisor training program or be registered with a recognized professional counselling association as a qualified supervisor.
  • Experience supervising other counsellors
  • Familiar with the Code of Ethics and Standards of Practice of either ACCT or CPCA, or a willingness to become knowledgeable in the applicable standards.
  • Strong clinical experience and a demonstrated commitment to professional counselling practice.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience or familiarity with experiential learning and facilitation.
  • Experience teaching or facilitating online education with adult learners.
  • Post-secondary teaching experience is preferred.
  • A reliable internet connection suitable for synchronous teaching via Zoom.

Specific Duties and Responsibilities

The Clinical Supervisor will:

  • Facilitate clinical supervision sessions that support students in developing their counselling skills, clinical judgment, and professional competence.
  • Support students with their client work through case discussion, clinical guidance, and feedback.
  • Provide direct observation and constructive feedback on students’ counselling practice, where applicable.
  • Review students’ clinical documentation and case conceptualizations, providing feedback to support effective and professional clinical practice.
  • Support students in identifying and addressing clinical, ethical, and professional issues that arise in their counselling practice.
  • Facilitate reflection and discussion that helps students integrate counselling theory, clinical experience, and professional development.
  • Assess and provide feedback on student clinical work and required course assignments, as applicable.
  • Maintain appropriate records of student progress and submit evaluations, marks, and required documentation within established timelines.
  • Comply with Rhodes Wellness College policies, procedures, and guidelines.

Why Teach at Rhodes Wellness College?

At Rhodes, you will be joining a community that values growth, wellness, experiential learning, and meaningful connection. Our faculty bring their professional expertise into a learning environment where students are encouraged to participate actively, explore new perspectives, practice their skills, and develop their confidence as future counsellors.

If you are an experienced counsellor who is passionate about education and enjoys facilitating experiential learning, we invite you to consider joining our faculty.

jobs.excerpt: Crisis Analyst, Real-Time Coverage (Remote, Canada) When a crisis breaks, our analysts are often among the first people in the world to know about it.
jobs.description:
Crisis Analyst, Real-Time Coverage (Remote, Canada)

When a crisis breaks, our analysts are often among the first people in the world to know about it.

samdesk uses AI to detect emergencies around the world as they happen, from shootings and bomb threats to severe weather and conflict, and alerts organizations that need to act fast. As a Crisis Analyst on our Real-Time Coverage (RTC) team, you will be the human in the loop behind our AI-first alerts. You will gather, corroborate and curate social media and open-source information as events unfold.

The alert you send about an active shooter at a shopping mall may prompt a user to tell customers and employees to seek shelter, lock down stores and reroute deliveries. On a busy shift you may assess hundreds of incidents, sometimes with only 10 seconds to decide: do our users need to react to this?

This is a full-time, fully remote role open to candidates anywhere in Canada. Shifts are 8 hours, typically between 10am and 7pm Eastern Time, with one weekend shift a week for roughly one month in every three.

Who We Are

samdesk is a real-time risk detection and situational awareness platform that delivers real-time crisis alerts 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, powered by AI. We make sense of the world’s most valuable real-time data sources with the purpose of creating a safer world. samdesk is proudly headquartered in Alberta, Canada, with team members located all over the world. Check us out: www.samdesk.io

What You’ll Do

Reporting to a Lead Analyst, you will:

  • Assess incoming incidents quickly and decide which ones our users need to know about, using your judgement and our playbooks
  • Gather and corroborate information from social media and open sources in real time, and build out our coverage as a crisis unfolds
  • Make sure every alert we send is accurate, timely and relevant
  • Work alongside analysts around the world on a shared audio call throughout your shift
  • Join a working group on geopolitics, forward planning or climate, and contribute to the resources the team relies on

What You’ll Need

  • A relevant degree (political science, international relations, journalism, etc.) or equivalent experience. This could include work as a security operations centre (SOC) analyst, intelligence analyst, or emergency dispatcher, or as a reporter in breaking news or open-source intelligence (OSINT)
  • A close interest in breaking news and current affairs, and an understanding of how social media is used for newsgathering and fact-finding
  • The ability to track several developing incidents at once and work quickly without losing attention to detail
  • Calm, sound judgement under pressure
  • Confidence working independently and remotely as part of a globally distributed team
  • The right to work full time in Canada

Early in your career? We provide full training, so if you have the interest and instincts, we’d like to hear from you.

Bonus Points if You Have

  • Worked in corporate security, intelligence, a newsroom or an OSINT environment
  • Done your own OSINT or verification work, such as geolocation, student journalism or open-source investigations
  • Proficiency in other languages

Working Hours

This isn’t a typical remote role and may not be for everybody! We ensure continuous coverage of urgent emergencies, so you need to be plugged in and working on our dashboard during your shift. This can mean organized break schedules and set shift times. In exchange, you don’t need to take your work home with you and will rarely be asked to work additional hours.

You will also be part of our weekend rotation. For roughly one month in every three, your working week includes a Saturday or a Sunday (for example, in January and then again in April). You still work a five-day week during those months, such as Sunday to Thursday. Any public holidays worked are given back as time off in lieu.

Support on Shift

It can be high pressure, and some of what you monitor will be distressing. To help you succeed, we provide a friendly, supportive team alongside the tools and training you need. samdesk takes a trauma-informed approach, with wellbeing tools and debriefs on shift, and access to professional support through our company-funded health benefits.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote, from anywhere in Canada
  • A rare way into OSINT and crisis intelligence, with full training and no prior industry experience required
  • Work that matters: your alerts help some of the world’s most notable brands keep their people safe
  • A supportive team you are connected to throughout every shift
  • Predictable hours: your roster is planned a month in advance, with no on-call and no work to take home
  • Company-funded health benefits
  • A salary of 60,000 to 65,000 CAD per annum (commensurate with experience)

A note on using AI to apply

This role will involve working with AI-generated data, but please don’t use AI to apply. The application and interview process is intended to let us learn more about you as an individual and how you make decisions.

Diversity and Inclusion

samdesk is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a safe, diverse and inclusive environment. We encourage qualified applicants of all backgrounds including ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation, family status, age, nationality, and education levels to apply. If you are contacted for an interview and require accommodation during the interviewing process, please let us know.

Salary: CAD 60-65k per annum, (commensurate with experience)
