The Kraft Heinz Company manufactures and markets food and beverage products in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, Australia and throughout Asia-Pacific. Our products include condiments and sauces, cheese and dairy, meals, meats, refreshment beverages, coffee, and other grocery products, as well as infant and nutrition products.
As one of the world’s largest food and beverage companies, we are proud to spark joy around mealtimes with a global portfolio of more than 200 brands. Our iconic brands include Kraft, Oscar Mayer, Heinz, Philadelphia, Lunchables, Velveeta, Maxwell House, Capri Sun, Kool-Aid, Jell-O, and Classico, among others. We sell products through our own sales organizations and through independent brokers, agents, and distributors to convenience stores, drug stores, value stores, bakeries, pharmacies, mass merchants, club stores, foodservice distributors, and institutions (e.g., hotels, restaurants, hospitals, health care facilities, and certain government agencies) as well as to chain, wholesale, cooperative, and independent grocery accounts.
No matter the brand, we are united under one vision: To Be the Best Food Company, Growing a Better World. Bringing this vision to life are our 39,000+ teammates around the world, making food people love. Together, we help provide meals to those in need through our global partnership and commitment with Rise Against Hunger. And we also stand committed to sustainability, and the health of our planet and its people. Every day, we are transforming the food industry with bold thinking and unprecedented results. If you share our passion -- and are ready to create the future, build on storied legacy, and participate as a conscientious global citizen -- there’s one thing to do: join us.
Our culture of Ownership, Meritocracy and Collaboration
We’re not afraid to think differently. Embrace new ideas. Dream big. We empower our people at every level – from entry intern to senior leader -- to own their work. We believe that we share a responsibility to think like Owners – to be mindful of the collective and sustained success of Kraft Heinz – and we apply this to every situation, every day. As part of Kraft Heinz, you’re supported to grow and achieve. You’re recognized and rewarded for outstanding performance at every level. You’re given opportunity to leave a mark and build a legacy. But you won’t do it alone. You’ll be supported by a thriving group of teammates in over 40 countries around the world, and our collective, collaborative spirit fuels our incredible progress every day.

Position Summary

This role/position ensures effective implementation and execution of the Kraft Heinz Supplier Quality Management System across an assigned ingredient or packaging category. The position provides visible quality leadership ensuring that KHC supplier quality standards are understood and met through on-site assessments as well as desk top audit as determined by the Kraft Heinz supplier management policy. This position also ensures that best practices are replicated across the category. This position requires travel between 50 – 70%.

Role / Title : Supplier Quality Sr. Analyst

  • This role/position ensures effective implementation and execution of the Kraft Heinz Supplier Quality Management System across an assigned ingredient or packaging category. The position provides visible quality leadership ensuring that KHC supplier quality standards are understood and met through on-site assessments as well as desk top audit as determined by the Kraft Heinz supplier management policy. This position also ensures that best practices are replicated across the category. This position requires travel between 50 – 70%.
  • This role is responsible for providing program support and data analysis for the US and Canada supplier quality program. This position requires some quality technical depth and applicant should be comfortable with learning and working with internal systems, technology and reporting. As there is a significant amount of supplier compliance and performance data for ~ 3,000 KHC, the position requires exceptional organizational skills. It is important that the person is detailed oriented to make sure data is accurate in the system. Organization and communication skills are also needed to support the KHC audit strategy and working with external partners.
  • In this role, the individual will evaluate the 2nd party audit reports for the KHC NA suppliers as well as support global compliance reporting, which is a very important KPI to support strategic growth. The individual will work with outside audit companies (examples NSF and DNV) weekly to 2nd party audits are complete and include supplier corrective and preventive actions. In addition, the person will track and trend data for reporting purposes.
  • This person will support plants in achieving Quality KPIs through participation in root cause activities, corrective and preventive action, and customer complaint related to suppliers. This position works closely with cross functional partners (Examples include but not limited to Procurement, specification management, FSM, R&D, Category Quality, Material management, Plant Quality) .
  • Candidate should be comfortable with working with virtual tools to conduct audits if needed.
  • Travel required 50-70%.

Key Components of the role

  • Support KHC business teams and factories to address supplier performance concerns or complaints; perform follow-up visits (“tech assessments”), as needed
  • Provide FSQ input into Procurement sourcing strategy and supplier business review meetings

  • Review 2nd party audit program for NA

Proficiency:

  • Auditing
  • Communication
  • Relationship building

  • Organization skills
  • Ability to work autonomously
  • Results driven
Communication:

Energy Solutions Associate

About the Role

We are looking for a Energy Solutions Associate to join our Technical Solutions team, working at the intersection of Commercial, Product and Technology.

This is a client-facing role combining technical implementation, analytical thinking and problem-solving. You will work directly with clients to understand their business needs, design tailored solutions and manage the technical implementation and integration of our SaaS platform.

You will ideally have 3–5 years of relevant professional experience and may have previously worked in finance, energy consulting or a similar industry, where you developed strong analytical, technical and problem-solving skills.

You will collaborate closely with commercial, product and engineering teams, playing an important role in delivering successful client solutions and improving our products and services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work directly with clients to understand their business activities, technical requirements and operational needs.
  • Design, document and implement tailored solutions and data integrations between client systems and our SaaS platform.
  • Manage technical onboarding and ensure successful implementation and adoption.
  • Act as a technical point of contact for clients, providing guidance, troubleshooting and ongoing support.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible language for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Monitor integrations, processes and automations to ensure smooth platform operations.
  • Identify challenges, develop solutions and communicate project progress and key insights to internal stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Commercial, Product and Engineering teams to support business development and product improvements.

What We're Looking For

Essential Experience & Skills

  • 3–5 years of relevant professional experience, ideally as an energy consultant, business analyst or in a similar analytical, technical or client-facing role.
  • Previous relevant jobs could be Analyst, Energy Analyst, Energy Originator or previous experience from an energy graduate programme.
  • Degree in a STEM-related discipline or equivalent relevant technical experience.
  • Degree in Energy Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Finance or similar would also be highly relevant to the role.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complex challenges and develop practical solutions.
  • Excellent analytical skills and confidence working with data and complex processes.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to engage with a range of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Interest in the energy industry, ideally with some existing sector knowledge such as PPAs, energy trading solutions or similar
  • Knowledge of a scripting language, preferably Python (VBA or R also beneficial).
  • Familiarity with AI-powered coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex or equivalent.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
  • Fluency in English.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in the energy industry.
  • Experience with SaaS platforms, APIs, data integrations or enterprise software implementations.
  • Experience in consulting or client project management.

Location & Working Arrangements

This is a fully remote position, and you can be based near London, Paris, Brussels or Amsterdam. No sponsorship is available for this position, you must have the right to work.

Why Join?

You'll have the opportunity to work directly with clients, solve complex technical and business challenges, and collaborate across commercial, product and engineering teams. This role offers significant exposure to different areas of a growing business and the opportunity to make a tangible impact on its products and customers.

jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Lead SAP CRM-analist neem je binnen een multidisciplinair agile productteam een inhoudelijke trekkersrol op. Je helpt het team om complexe businessbehoeften te vertalen naar samenhangende, haalbare en toekomstbestendige CRM-oplossingen.

Je bewaakt de end-to-end samenhang tussen processen, functionele analyses, data, integraties en architectuur. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met de Product Owner, functioneel analisten, developers, architecten en collega's uit andere productteams. Je brengt expertises samen, bewaakt de oplossingsrichting en maakt keuzes, risico's en afhankelijkheden tijdig zichtbaar.

End-to-end oplossingsrichting bewaken

Je doorgrondt complexe businessbehoeften, stelt kritische vragen en helpt het team om die te vertalen naar passende CRM-oplossingen.

  • Je bewaakt de samenhang tussen processen, data, integraties en CRM-functionaliteit.
  • Je kijkt verder dan één requirement, user story, functionaliteit of applicatie.
  • Je bevraagt behoeften en aannames wanneer dit tot een betere oplossing kan leiden.
  • Je onderzoekt samen met het team verschillende oplossingsrichtingen.
  • Je maakt voor- en nadelen, risico's en afhankelijkheden inzichtelijk.
  • Je bewaakt dat oplossingen aansluiten bij de productvisie en voldoende toekomstbestendig zijn.

Complexe refinements inhoudelijk trekken

Bij complexe roadmapinitiatieven help je het team om voldoende duidelijkheid te creëren voordat de ontwikkeling start.

  • Je structureert complexe onderwerpen voorafgaand aan de refinement.
  • Je brengt functionele en technische onzekerheden in kaart.
  • Je detecteert afhankelijkheden met andere systemen en productteams.
  • Je helpt alternatieve oplossingsrichtingen onderzoeken en vergelijkt ze op haalbaarheid, impact, risico's en toekomstbestendigheid.
  • Je maakt openstaande beslissingen expliciet.
  • Je betrekt tijdig de juiste analisten, developers, architecten en andere experten.
  • Je helpt oplossingsvragen en afhankelijkheden samen met het team uitklaren.

Samenhang met architectuur bewaken

Je herkent wanneer oplossingskeuzes een bredere architecturale impact hebben en zorgt ervoor dat die tijdig met de juiste architecten en experten worden afgestemd.

  • Je brengt architecturaal relevante vraagstukken tijdig naar voren.
  • Je stemt oplossingsrichtingen af met architecten.
  • Je vertaalt architectuurprincipes en beslissingen naar concrete gevolgen voor CRM.
  • Je bewaakt samen met het team dat oplossingen aansluiten bij geldende richtlijnen, standaarden en best practices.
  • Je helpt beslissingen en hun impact helder vastleggen.
  • Je vertegenwoordigt het productteam waar nodig in relevante inhoudelijke overlegfora.

Over productteams en systemen heen werken

CRM-oplossingen staan zelden op zichzelf. Daarom kijk je actief naar processen, systemen en productteams buiten het eigen team.

  • Je identificeert cross-teamafhankelijkheden vroegtijdig.
  • Je werkt samen met analisten, lead analisten en architecten van andere productteams.
  • Je organiseert waar nodig inhoudelijke afstemming over teamgrenzen heen.
  • Je bewaakt de end-to-end samenhang wanneer een oplossing verschillende systemen of teams raakt.
  • Je voorkomt dat lokaal optimale oplossingen verderop in de keten problemen veroorzaken.

Product Owner en team ondersteunen bij de roadmap

Vanuit je inhoudelijke expertise ondersteun je de Product Owner bij het realiseren van de productroadmap.

  • Je maakt technische en functionele afhankelijkheden zichtbaar.
  • Je adviseert over haalbaarheid en oplossingscomplexiteit.
  • Je helpt risico's vroegtijdig identificeren.
  • Je adviseert over een logische fasering van grotere roadmapinitiatieven.
  • Je helpt bepalen welke analyses of architecturale beslissingen vooraf nodig zijn.
  • Je geeft input over de benodigde analyse- en ontwikkelcapaciteit.

Functioneel analisten coachen en ondersteunen

Je helpt functioneel analisten bij complexe analyses en bewaakt de samenhang tussen verschillende oplossingsonderdelen.

  • Je fungeert als inhoudelijk klankbord.
  • Je helpt complexe functionele vraagstukken uitklaren.
  • Je reviewt analyses en oplossingsvoorstellen.
  • Je detecteert inconsistenties en hiaten tussen verschillende analyses.
  • Je stimuleert hergebruik en consistente oplossingen.
  • Je bevordert kennisdeling binnen het team.
  • Je coacht en ondersteunt minder ervaren collega's en helpt hen groeien in hun rol.

Betrokken blijven tijdens de realisatie

Ook nadat de development is gestart, blijf je actief betrokken bij de oplossing.

  • Je bent beschikbaar voor complexe functionele of solutiongerelateerde vragen.
  • Je helpt onduidelijkheden voor analisten, developers en testers uitklaren.
  • Je bewaakt samen met het team dat de gerealiseerde oplossing aansluit bij de afgesproken oplossingsrichting.

  • Je helpt het team oplossingskeuzes opnieuw te bekijken wanneer nieuwe inzichten ontstaan.

Hoe werk je samen?

Als CRM Lead Analist toon je leiderschap vanuit expertise, overzicht, initiatief en overtuigingskracht.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt ervaring met SAP CRM of gelijkaardige technologie.

  • Je beschikt over sterke vaardigheden in functionele analyse: je doorgrondt complexe businessbehoeften, stelt ze kritisch in vraag en vertaalt ze naar functionele oplossingen.
  • Je hebt voldoende ervaring om analyses van andere analisten inhoudelijk te beoordelen.
  • Je hebt ervaring met complexe CRM-oplossingen en solution design.
  • Je kan verschillende oplossingsalternatieven uitwerken en vergelijken op haalbaarheid, impact, risico's en toekomstbestendigheid.
  • Je hebt kennis van de Belgische energiesector.
  • Je kan complexe refinements inhoudelijk leiden.
  • Je kan oplossingen en afhankelijkheden over productteam- en systeemgrenzen heen bekijken en neemt initiatief om afstemming met andere teams en stakeholders te organiseren.
  • Je kent de werking van een agile productteam, waaronder backlog refinement, user stories, sprintwerking en de samenwerking tussen Product Owner, analisten en developers.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. jobs.description:
Position: Chief Revenue Officer

Company: Solen Software Group

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: US, Canada, UK

About Solen Software Group

Solen Software Group is an evergreen holding company that acquires and operates proven software businesses that have significant growth potential in a variety of vertical markets, enabling them to be market leaders in their niche industry. Solen owns several software companies in various market spaces: Human Resource Technology, Fleet Telematics, Asset Management, E-Health, Document Management, and other innovative software solutions in a variety of industries. Solen is backed by a group of advisors and investors that have built software businesses of material scale (10-100M in ARR) and advised many.

About The Role

The Chief Revenue Officer will own revenue growth across Solen's Hyper Growth Portfolio, starting hands-on at our anchor portfolio company, the fastest-growing business in the portfolio, and then scaling a proven go-to-market playbook across additional Portfolio Companies.

This role is responsible for building an engineered, predictable sales machine on a common RevOps stack, accelerating organic ARR growth, launching new sources of revenue, and making AI the default across every revenue function. The CRO will recruit and lead GTM leadership across sales, marketing, and customer success, and partner closely with portfolio company CEOs and founders.

This is a highly strategic, hands-on leadership role for a vertical-agnostic operator who builds systems, not heroics.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Growth

  • Accelerate organic ARR growth above target at the anchor portfolio company, then roll the same playbook out to other Portfolio Companies in scope.
  • Own pipeline coverage, net revenue retention (NRR), gross revenue retention (GRR), and CAC payback across the Portfolio Companies in scope.
  • Balance growth with efficiency, using Rule of 40 as a portfolio guardrail.
  • Lead Monthly Business Reviews on revenue performance with portfolio leadership.

Growth Opportunities

  • Identify, size, and launch new sources of revenue, each backed by an approved ROI case.
  • Drive internal growth through cross-sell and referral motions between Solen Portfolio Companies, upsell and expansion, and pricing and packaging improvements.
  • Drive external growth through new customer segments, channels, partnerships, and markets.
  • Track each new motion as a separate revenue source in the CRM from launch.

Engineered Sales Machine & RevOps

  • Build a vertical-agnostic Solen go-to-market playbook covering ICP and segmentation, sales stages, pricing guardrails, compensation plans, and forecasting cadence.
  • Stand up a common RevOps stack so every Portfolio Company in scope runs the same stages, metrics, and forecast cadence in one system.
  • Prove the playbook at the anchor portfolio company, then roll it out to additional Portfolio Companies, shortening rollout time with each one.
  • Deliver accurate forecasts and keep sales and marketing spend within plan.

AI-Driven Go-to-Market

  • Make AI the default across prospecting, lead scoring, deal coaching, forecasting, renewals, and customer success.
  • Raise revenue per GTM employee at each Portfolio Company while ARR grows at or above target.
  • Build a shared AI GTM toolkit on the Solen RevOps stack that is reused across Portfolio Companies rather than rebuilt in each one.

Talent Density

  • Own recruitment and development of GTM leadership (sales, marketing, and customer success leaders) across the Portfolio Companies in scope, with a reporting line to the CRO.
  • Place A-Players in Key Seats and apply the Unlock, Replace, Redeploy, Expand, and Duplicate framework.
  • Improve quota attainment and reduce new-rep ramp time through coaching, enablement, and process.
  • Lead portfolio company CEOs and founders through influence as well as authority.

What We're Looking For

  • Builds sales machines, not heroics: You work hands-on first, then design the process, compensation, metrics, and tooling that make revenue predictable and repeatable across companies. You have proven this in more than one company.
  • Efficient growth operator: You have a track record of hitting ARR growth targets while improving NRR, GRR, and CAC payback in B2B SaaS.
  • Growth hunter: You find and size new growth opportunities, inside and outside a portfolio, and back each with an ROI case.
  • Vertical-agnostic operator: You learn a new market fast and run one playbook across different businesses, adapting only where it matters.
  • Data- and AI-native: You run the business from the numbers and are an early, practical adopter of AI and RevOps tooling that makes revenue teams measurably more productive.
  • Talent magnet and multi-company leader: You recruit, coach, and retain A-player GTM leaders, hold a high bar across several companies at once, and win the support of CEOs and founders.
  • Lives the Solen-isms: You operate by the Solen-isms and the Solen Principles of Transformation.

What Success Looks Like

  • Organic ARR growth at the anchor portfolio company accelerates above target within 12–18 months.

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on:

We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers.

What’s unique about management at Miaplaza:

Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice:

  1. You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important.

  2. We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer.

  3. We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you.

  4. One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports' work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output.

  5. Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader, of which:

    • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering, of which:

  • 3+ years running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE preferred)

  • 3+ years of experience with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code. GCP is our primary cloud and we expect senior-level knowledge of IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, CloudSQL and Secret Manager

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operations

  • Experience with GitOps (FluxCD or ArgoCD)

  • Experience working directly with engineering teams and other managers as your customers on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience leading incident response, including running postmortems

What makes you stand out:

Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

Experience with consumer platforms at scale

Experience building in regulated environments

Experience operating self-hosted observability stacks (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry)

Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling

Experience supporting .NET/C# application deployments

Experience with database operations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ)

Experience with Istio or other service meshes

Responsibilities

  • Work with your team to design, build, and operate the infrastructure the rest of engineering depends on: clusters, pipelines, databases, edge, and observability

  • Your customers are the other engineering teams. Work with the other Engineering Managers and product development leadership to scope and prioritize platform work

  • Set the quality bar for your team. Lead by example.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean infrastructure-as-code, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

  • Application and CV Review - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update.

  • Initial Technical Screen (20 minutes) - A quick screening call to answer some administrative questions and confirm your basic technical knowledge. You'll be asked some administrative questions and 7 short technical questions related to the role.

  • Behavioral Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of our HR team to discuss your experience and share your approach throughout your career so far.

  • 1st Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team to answer focused technical questions tailored to our work.

  • Scenario-based Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team and the team's engineering manager to work through two hypothetical DevOps scenarios and how you would tackle them.

  • Leadership Interview (1 hour) - With our head of engineering and executive leadership.

  • Reference check - We'll reach out to the 3 references you provided, at least one being a former or current manager and any former or current direct reports.

  • Offer & background check - Once you sign your offer, we'll run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation and setup

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. jobs.excerpt: Top 3 Reasons To Join Us• 100% remote, with a global, diverse team • Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader • Lead and shape how an AI-native security function finds and prevents vulnerabilities at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world’s leading insurers About UsAt CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.
jobs.description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us

  • 100% remote, with a global, diverse team
  • Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader
  • Lead and shape how an AI-native security function finds and prevents vulnerabilities at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world’s leading insurers

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
  • We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
  • We're an international, diverse team of over 200 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
  • We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
  • We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
  • We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
  • We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

About The Role

CoverGo is hiring an Application Security Engineer to use AI to find and prevent vulnerabilities before they reach production, and to give engineering teams the tools and guardrails that stop vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place. The Security team is small and growing, and works AI-first: everyone uses AI to automate their own work and to scale security across a large engineering organisation.

What You Will Do

  • Use AI tools such as Claude and OpenAI models to find and triage vulnerabilities in code, dependencies and designs before changes are merged.
  • Embed security checks into developer workflows and CI/CD pipelines so issues surface as code is written.
  • Select, configure and tune code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk and Checkmarx, keeping the signal high enough that engineers act on the findings.
  • Build self-service tools, guardrails and guidance that help engineering teams prevent common vulnerability classes.
  • Partner with engineering leads and security champions across product teams to prioritise and fix findings.
  • Review security-relevant designs and changes, ranking risk by what an attacker could realistically reach.
  • Track and report on application-security risk and remediation progress.

What We Need

  • 3+ years in application security or a closely related security role.
  • An AI-native approach to securing software: you already use LLMs to find, detect and explain vulnerabilities.
  • Enough fluency in at least one modern programming language to read, understand and fix vulnerable code. A software-engineering background is not required.
  • Hands-on experience with code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk or Checkmarx.
  • A solid grasp of common vulnerability classes, such as the OWASP Top 10, and how to prevent them.
  • A practical, enabling style of working with engineers.

Nice to have

  • Experience building custom security tooling or automations on LLM APIs.
  • Experience securing applications on AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated SaaS environment.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Paid Annual Leaves
  • Annual Performance Bonus
  • Health Insurance
  • Remote Work Allowance
  • Anniversary Bonus
  • Company activities and events
  • Learning and development plan

Arine is redefining what excellent healthcare looks like by solving these issues through our software platform (SaaS). We combine cutting edge data science, machine learning, AI, and deep clinical expertise to introduce a patient-centric view to medication management, and develop and deliver personalized care plans on a massive scale for patients and their care teams.

Arine is committed to improving the lives and health of complex patients that have an outsized impact on healthcare costs and have traditionally been difficult to identify and address. These patients face numerous challenges including complicated prescribing issues across multiple medications and providers, medication challenges with many chronic diseases, and patient issues with access to care. Backed by leading healthcare investors and collaborating with top healthcare organizations and providers, we deliver recommendations and facilitate clinical interventions that lead to significant, measurable health improvements for patients and cost savings for customers.

jobs.title: Principal Quality Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Let’s Tango!  Where Innovation Meets Impact. At Tango Analytics, we're all about helping businesses make smarter decisions through powerful technology, insightful data, and a whole lot of collaboration.
jobs.description:
Let’s Tango! Where Innovation Meets Impact.

At Tango Analytics, we're all about helping businesses make smarter decisions through powerful technology, insightful data, and a whole lot of collaboration. Whether you're a creative thinker, a strategic planner, a tech wizard, or a customer champion, there's a place for you on our team. We believe work should be meaningful and fun — so if you're ready to make a difference while enjoying the journey, come join us and let's Tango!

About the role

Tango is looking for a Principal Quality Engineer (E6) to define and drive our company-wide Quality Engineering strategy, architecture, and technical standards. As the most senior individual contributor in Quality Engineering, you will operate across products and engineering teams to shape how quality is designed, measured, and delivered throughout the software development lifecycle.

You'll translate Tango's long-term business and technology strategy into a multi-year Quality Engineering roadmap spanning test architecture, automation platforms, continuous integration and delivery, test environments, production quality signals, and AI-powered testing. You'll partner with engineering and product leadership to ensure our systems are testable, observable, secure, performant, and reliable by design. You'll establish technical standards, guide critical architectural decisions, and help senior engineers and technical leads raise the quality bar across the organization.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll remain deeply engaged in engineering through architectural design, code reviews, prototypes, technical investigations, and the development of reference implementations that demonstrate how quality engineering should work at scale. You'll also play a pivotal role in shaping Tango's approach to AI in Quality Engineering and establishing the evaluation frameworks needed to deliver trustworthy AI-powered products.

What You'll Do

Technical Strategy and Execution

  • Define the Quality Engineering roadmap. Translate Tango's business objectives and technology strategy into a multi-year roadmap for test architecture, automation, environments, test data, release confidence, and production quality.
  • Architect scalable quality solutions. Design and evolve the frameworks, platforms, and engineering practices that enable teams to validate complex, multi-tenant SaaS applications efficiently and consistently.
  • Make quality a design principle. Influence system architecture and technical decisions to improve testability, observability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability from the outset.
  • Accelerate the software delivery lifecycle. Drive initiatives that improve feedback loops, enable shift-left testing, strengthen continuous quality validation, and support faster, safer releases.
  • Establish engineering standards. Define pragmatic, organization-wide standards for test automation, test design, coverage, test data, environments, CI/CD quality gates, and release readiness.
  • Solve the hardest technical problems. Lead investigations into systemic quality issues, complex failures, flaky tests, environment instability, performance bottlenecks, and production defects.
  • Stay hands-on. Build prototypes, develop reference implementations, review critical code and designs, and demonstrate engineering practices that teams can adopt and scale.
  • Measure and improve quality outcomes. Establish meaningful quality metrics and feedback mechanisms that help engineering teams identify risk, prioritize improvements, and make data-driven decisions.

Technical Leadership and Organizational Influence

  • Influence engineering strategy. Partner with engineering, product, architecture, to prioritize quality investments and align technical initiatives with business outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional programs. Drive complex, multi-team initiatives that require technical alignment, coordinated execution, and sustained organizational change.
  • Build a strong QE technical community. Coach members of the quality team through architecture reviews, technical mentoring, and shared quality engineering practices.
  • Enable distributed quality ownership. Help development teams take responsibility for quality throughout the SDLC by providing the frameworks, tools, standards, and guidance needed to succeed.
  • Raise the technical bar. Establish reusable patterns and engineering principles that improve consistency without creating unnecessary process overhead.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies. Assess industry developments, testing approaches, and engineering tools, identifying opportunities to improve Tango's engineering capabilities and long-term competitiveness.

AI Strategy and Quality Engineering Innovation

  • Define the AI strategy for Quality Engineering. Establish a multi-year vision for incorporating AI into test engineering, automation, defect analysis, and quality decision-making.
  • Scale AI-assisted engineering. Identify and implement opportunities for AI-assisted test generation, test maintenance, failure triage, root-cause analysis, and other activities that improve engineering productivity.
  • Establish AI evaluation frameworks. Define repeatable approaches for validating AI-powered features, including agentic workflows, non-deterministic behavior, multi-step reasoning, and tool interactions.
  • Define AI quality standards. Establish evaluation criteria, test methodologies, and measurable acceptance thresholds for accuracy, reliability, consistency, robustness, and task completion.
  • Address AI-specific risks. Ensure appropriate testing for hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe behavior, data leakage, privacy, security, and other risks relevant to Tango's AI capabilities.
  • Enable continuous AI quality monitoring. Develop approaches for regression evaluation, production feedback, model or prompt changes, and ongoing monitoring of AI quality.
  • Connect innovation to business value. Measure the impact of AI-enabled quality practices on engineering productivity, defect prevention, feedback speed, and release confidence.

What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering, Quality Engineering, test architecture, or a related technical discipline, including several years operating at Staff, Principal, or equivalent quality engineering leadership scope.
  • Demonstrated success designing and scaling test architectures, automation frameworks, or quality engineering platforms adopted across multiple engineering teams.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one general-purpose language, with the ability to build prototypes, review implementation details, and solve complex technical problems.
  • Deep understanding of modern software delivery practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, test environments, test data management, and continuous quality validation.
  • Experience with multiple dimensions of software quality, including functional correctness, integration, performance, reliability, security, and production behavior.
  • Ability to design quality solutions for distributed cloud-based, multi-tenant SaaS applications.
  • Experience defining technical roadmaps and driving engineering initiatives that span multiple teams, products, or organizational boundaries.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards, reference architectures, and reusable practices that improve quality and consistency across teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor junior and senior quality engineers, facilitate technical discussions, and influence engineering leadership.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical challenges into clear recommendations, investment priorities, and business outcomes.
  • Practical experience applying AI/ML techniques to software products or using AI to improve software engineering and Quality Engineering practices.
  • Understanding of how to validate AI-powered systems whose outputs may be probabilistic, context-dependent, or non-deterministic.
  • Ability to design evaluation strategies that combine automated metrics, scenario-based testing, human judgment where appropriate, and production feedback.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks for LLM-powered applications, AI agents, or multi-step agentic workflows.
  • Experience with AI red-teaming, adversarial testing, model evaluation, or production quality monitoring.
  • Background in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), chaos engineering, distributed systems, or production observability.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms serving multiple customers, with complex configurations, integrations, and data boundaries.
  • Experience working in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments.
  • Experience leading quality strategy through a major platform migration, architectural transformation, or modernization initiative.
  • Experience evaluating and adopting emerging AI-powered development and testing tools.

jobs.description:
What is Accenture & Avanade Microsoft Solutions Marketing?

Microsoft Solutions Marketing is on a mission to help our clients do what matters and use the power of the Microsoft platform to fuel frontier transformation powered by agentic AI. Solutions Marketing plays a pivotal role in our success, serving as the bridge between Accenture Microsoft Business Group (AMBG) and Avanade services and our clients. We are the driving force bringing our solutions to life through compelling messages that harness a collective of knowledge about market conditions, client challenges and behavior, competitive knowledge and subject matter expertise and fuels the rest of our go-to-market initiatives. If you thrive at the intersection of marketing innovative technology solutions, insights, and the creative application of technology to solve real business problems to drive material client demand, look no further.

Job Summary: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Solutions Marketing Manager to join our team. This role involves acting as a Marketing Subject Matter Expert (SME) and ensuring the effective implementation and optimization of go-to-market (GTM) initiatives and marketing programs. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading and coordinating marketing efforts across various functions and channels. They will be adept at navigating complexity, managing multiple initiatives simultaneously, and balancing strategic prioritization across multiple programs and campaigns.

Key Responsibilities:

  • GTM Perspective: Align with relevant business SME’s, Microsoft stakeholders, and senior executives across Avanade and Accenture where and when needed to create a holistic perspective married with product knowledge, services, compete, pricing, analyst, perspectives and align with relevant marketing teams to drive execution of the Solution Area agenda.

  • GTM Capability Readiness & Launch: Ideate, create and refine specific go-to-market messages for our Solution areas. Conduct market landscape analysis, competitive analysis and message testing to support GTM initiatives. Collaborate with campaigns and thought leadership teams to optimize launch activities. Oversee quality assurance across sales enablement materials and field-owned content, ensuring consistency in messaging.

  • Content Creation: Own the creation of multi-format content (digital, print, social, videos, long-form, short-form, etc.) aligned to Solution Area priorities and GTM offerings to drive demand generation across the top, middle and bottom of the marketing funnel. Identify and develop Leverage AI tools (primarily M365 Copilot) to scale content development.

  • Integrated Campaign Planning and Activation: Work collaboratively across various marketing functions, ensuring deep alignment with campaigns, field marketing, communications (media and social), analyst relations, events and other teams for seamless program execution. Involves coordinating efforts to develop and implement comprehensive go-to-market strategies that resonate with target audiences and drive demand. By fostering strong relationships and maintaining open communication channels with these teams, the Solutions Marketing Manager ensures that all marketing initiatives are cohesive, strategically aligned, and effectively executed to achieve the company's business objectives.

  • Optimize Discoverability of GTM Solutions: Map solutions to the GTM placemat. Create externally facing content for .com and Showcase, making sure that all solutions are accurately discoverable. Plus maintain relevant mapping between the Accenture Reinvention Console, where Microsoft is a "differentiating technology" and the most relevant AMBG/Avanade Solution landing pages in the Microsoft Showcase.

  • Annual Solution Marketing Plan: Develop and maintain GTM plans for solutions practices, aligning with global and regional marketing functions. Ensure the creation and maintenance of Bill of Materials (BOM) content and client stories across primary market-facing platforms. Support content development including joint research with Microsoft, GitHub or other third parties, relevant to your solution area. Manage the sunsetting and retirement processes for market-facing collateral.

  • Annual Market Development Plan: Interlock with business stakeholders to ensure GTM and demand generation planning are represented in the annual partner marketing plan for Microsoft. When applicable, support the creation of solution-centric Partner Investment Request plans and content to support GTM investments. Some management of solution-specific investment funds including alignment with Microsoft, development and execution of marketing plans, and Proof of Execution collection may be required.

  • Event Activation: Own the end-to-end development of event strategy, content build, audience acquisition, demand generation, and internal/external communications for solution-specific events such as Fabric Community Conference, M365, and Power Platform Community Conference. Align with Solutions leads and other teams to support new capability development and announcements at events to maximize market impact. Optimize expert speakers and partner opportunities in our events plan. Support creation of ‘event in a box’ content that can scale across regions for your category where and when possible.

  • For non-solution specific events, work with field business stakeholders, marketing team, and event leads to curate content and demos for use in event programs.

  • Area and Regional Marketing Activation: Work directly with areas and regions to support local market GTM plans and activation. Build and align GTM funding tactics and initiatives with regional teams. Support the creation of content BOMs needed for local market execution.

  • Analyst Engagement and Featured Report Support: Execute briefing cadences with key analysts, influence whitepapers, and share lighthouse wins. Write and commission content for analyst wave, quadrant, and other featured reports.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • GTM Initiative Success: Measure the effectiveness of GTM initiatives through metrics such as campaign performance, lead generation, and conversion rates.

  • Event Impact: Coordinate with field and industry marketing to evaluate the success of events based on attendance, engagement, and feedback from participants. Regional Activation: Coordinate with field marketing to assess the impact of regional marketing activation efforts through metrics such as regional campaign performance and local market engagement.

  • Analyst Relations: Monitor the success of analyst engagement activities through the number of briefings, whitepapers influenced, and featured reports.

  • Content Performance: Measure the effectiveness of BOM content through metrics such as content engagement, downloads, and usage.

  • Funding Usage: Providing POE proof and performance metrics to support of aligned funding for activation jointly with partners.

Job requirement: Ability to accommodate West Coast hours.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum of 5 years of marketing

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Degree with a focus in marketing or business
  • Solutions marketing in B2B environment
  • Experience with CRM systems and marketing automation tools.
  • Experience in creating and managing marketing content, including BOMs and sales enablement materials.
  • Experience working in a global marketing environment and collaborating with regional teams.
  • Experience in planning and executing events, including funding submissions and event promotion.
  • Familiarity with content creation and creative production processes.
  • Familiarity with the technology industry ideally around the topics of cybersecurity and cloud

Professional Skills Requirements:

  • Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Proven track record of successfully launching and managing marketing campaigns, preference for multi-channel demand generation.
  • Knowledge of market research and competitive analysis.
  • Ability to conduct market landscape analysis and message testing.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data to drive marketing decisions.
  • Experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders, including analysts and partners.

jobs.description:
About RentSpree

Renting should be faster, fairer, and less stressful than it is. We're the infrastructure that makes that happen. Five million users. 300+ real estate company and MLS partnerships. Ten years of consistent growth. From applications and screening to payments and lease management, the full rental journey runs on RentSpree. Recognized by Forbes as a Best Startup Employer and by BuiltIn Seattle as a Best Place to Work.

Customer Support Specialist - Remote PST

This is a full-time, contract position with the opportunity to evolve into a permanent position. The contract will be for a minimum of six months.

RentSpree is currently seeking a Customer Support Specialist to join our team and deliver world-class customer support. In this role, you will provide vital assistance and guidance to agents, landlords, and renters, ensuring their rental journey is smooth and successful. We are seeking a candidate with strong communication skills, particularly in phone support, who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while driving growth through OKRs and project-based initiatives.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide Tier 2 support to users via phone by troubleshooting and resolving complex system-related issues, guiding users through challenges with proactive solutions, and exceptional customer service
  • Work on projects aligned with OKRs (Objectives and Key Results), focusing on continuous improvement and growth initiatives for both the company and your role
  • Participate in quality testing scenarios, consistently offering feedback to improve the user experience
  • Lead efforts to improve support processes, providing insights and recommendations to the team while maintaining exceptional communication with customers and stakeholders
  • Apply data-driven problem-solving and deep technical expertise in RentSpree’s platform to troubleshoot independently, optimize system functionality, and drive cross-team initiatives aligned with business objectives

Skills You Bring (Required)

  • 2+ years of experience in tier 2 customer support (emphasis in phone support)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience triaging issues with users and providing solutions; Remain professional in high-pressure situations
  • Familiar with PC and Mac operating systems and mobile devices
  • Ability to set priorities, problem-solve, multitask, and work independently
  • M-F business hours, weekend availability when needed

Skills You Bring (Desired)

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Experience using CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zendesk) to track support tickets and user interactions
  • Familiarity with OKRs and experience contributing to growth-oriented projects or initiatives
  • Experience in product testing and providing feedback on software updates & releases
  • Knowledge of Jira for project management
  • Fluency in Spanish

AI Compounds the Work

AI is a core skill. The people who thrive here are curious, take ownership, and use AI to compound their thinking, not replace it.

We are fueled by our Guiding Principles

How we work and who we are comes down to six guiding principles. These are the principles we hire for and hold ourselves to:

  • Customer obsession: Our customers' needs come first. Not eventually, not when it's convenient. Every decision runs through one question: does this make things better for the people who depend on us?
  • Take action, forge solutions: When there's a problem, we don't wait for permission to solve it. We move with urgency, think past the obvious fix, and build something that holds.
  • Be candid, yet respectful: Say what you think. Name the problem. Challenge the idea. We don't do polite silence, but we also don't do cheap shots. Honest, direct, respectful.
  • Disagree, then commit: The best decisions come from real debate. Say what you think, even if it's uncomfortable. Once we decide, we move together.

jobs.excerpt: About us:Branch is on a mission to empower workers with financial freedom.
jobs.description:
About us:

Branch is on a mission to empower workers with financial freedom. We do this by helping companies accelerate payments and providing working Americans with accessible, free financial services. We’re committed to building and delivering more inclusive, transparent, and frictionless financial products.

Our goal of empowerment extends to our own employees, too. Have a great idea? Share it today and it might just get implemented tomorrow. As a member of our team, your voice and creativity matter—and they can directly impact our products, company, and culture.

We not only focus on attracting great talent from across the country, but also on building teams that help that talent thrive. That means valuing a diversity of opinions and working styles, while creating a shared belief in innovation, initiative, and winning together.

Come join our team as we develop new ways to improve the lives of working Americans.

About the role:

Every risk control at Branch, whether for fraud, financial crime, disputes or collections, answers two questions. The first is detection: should this user, login or transaction be flagged? The second is treatment: once it is flagged, what happens to the user, how quickly, and how does a legitimate user get back to normal? Our rules team owns the first question. This role owns the second.

As Risk Controls Manager, you own the control paths users move through once a control fires: step-up verification, holds, locks, review queues, unlock and recovery, and the handoff to offboarding. You decide who goes down each path, when, and on what exit criteria, across onboarding, login and account takeover, money movement and card activity, for fraud, financial crime, disputes and collections alike, including how Branch treats scams and first-party fraud. You also build and run Branch's User Risk Score, the user-level view that decides which treatment each user gets. Then you make the changes happen.

The role exists to close the gap between a strategy decision and the frontline. You will take ideas from the Enablement Director and carry them through Product, Engineering, Operations and our BPO partner until they are live, measured and understood by the people working the queues.

This is an individual contributor role with program ownership. You will not have direct reports.

Responsibilities:Own the Control Paths and User Risk Score

  • Map and document every control path Branch uses today: the trigger, the treatment, the owner, the service level and the exit criteria for each
  • Set the standard for which treatment applies to which risk, so similar risks get similar treatment across products and channels
  • Keep the map current as rules, products and vendors change, and make it the reference Operations, Support and Product work from
  • Document each control path, with its rationale, approvals and change history, to a standard our partner banks, internal audit and examiners can follow, and support partner bank reviews, audits and exams of the control environment, working with Compliance
  • Build and run Branch's User Risk Score: a lifetime view of each user that starts at enrollment and moves with behavior, money movement, payouts and account changes. You own the factors, weights, risk bands and the treatment each band receives; the Enablement Director owns the score's results and approves material changes
  • Combine existing signals (device and login intelligence, transaction monitoring, disbursement and payout models, organization risk classification, dispute and collections outcomes) into a single user-level view, working with the Manager of Risk Rules and Monitoring and Data
  • Measure and tune the score on capture rate, false positive rate and approval-rate cost, and feed confirmed fraud back into it, so every user removed changes how the next one is scored
  • Set the identity verification and step-up standards for phone and chat contacts, including unlocks and ATO recovery, and close the social engineering gaps the Manager of Risk and Recovery Contact Operations surfaces from live contacts

Change Management & Operationalization

  • Use loss, friction and operational data to find the paths that cost the most in loss, user friction or manual work, and redesign them
  • Write the requirements for each change, sequence it with Product and Engineering, and run it from design through testing to live
  • Before a change goes live, map its upstream and downstream impacts on disputes, collections, Support and other control paths, so a fix in one place does not create loss, friction or volume in another
  • Measure each change after launch and report whether it did what it was meant to do
  • For every control change, update the operational side before it goes live: queue design, SOPs, BPO procedures and agent guidance, working with the Managers of Risk and Recovery Program Operations and the BPO partner
  • Write procedures that meet audit and partner bank requirements and that an agent can still follow in the middle of a live queue
  • Brief Operations on what changed and why, so the frontline understands the controls it works with
  • Consult on improvements that start inside Operations; those remain with the Managers of Risk and Recovery Program Operations

Protect Good Users

  • Own the friction legitimate users absorb from fraud controls: step-up pass and drop-off rates, time to unlock or resolve, and the volume of escalations controls create
  • Design recovery paths for account takeover victims and good users caught by a control, in partnership with Support
  • Track loss on users released from controls, so friction reductions are not paid for in fraud

Scams and First-Party Fraud

  • Design the treatment paths for scams: warnings and added friction on high-risk outbound payments (P2P, Branch Direct, instant transfer), protective holds when a user appears to be acting under a scammer's direction, and recovery paths for scam victims, in partnership with Support
  • Build first-party fraud factors into the User Risk Score, such as repeat or unsupported disputes, bust-out patterns, negative-balance abuse and payback failures. Set the treatment each band receives, from limits to dispute scrutiny to offboarding
  • Apply Branch's scam and first-party fraud definitions consistently across control paths. Set the standard, with Disputes Operations and Compliance, for separating authorized scam payments from unauthorized transfers at the handoff to disputes

Onboarding Guardrails

  • Bring Risk & Recovery's control requirements to the cross-functional onboarding review led by the User Onboarding Product Manager, who owns the onboarding experience end to end
  • Model the risk and conversion tradeoff of proposed step-up and verification changes; Product makes the final call, and agreed tradeoffs are documented

What We're Looking For:

Required

  • 4 to 6+ years in fraud strategy, fraud operations, account takeover or customer risk at a financial institution, fintech or payments company
  • Experience designing or changing fraud control flows: step-up authentication, holds, locks, review and recovery
  • Experience designing or owning a customer-level risk score or risk rating model: factor selection, weighting, banding and treatment design
  • A record of taking process and product changes from design to adoption across Product, Engineering and Operations
  • Able to size exposure and measure friction, false positives and loss from data; SQL and BI fluency
  • Working knowledge of Regulation E as it applies to unauthorized transfers, account takeover and scam claims, including the authorized versus unauthorized distinction
  • Clear writing; able to turn a control design into requirements an engineer can build and an SOP an agent can follow
  • Comfort operating with program accountability and no direct reports

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SEON, Persona, device intelligence or real-time card decisioning platforms
  • Experience in a BPO-supported operating model
  • Working knowledge of NACHA rules and Mastercard dispute and chargeback rules as they apply to ACH, debit card and push-to-card activity
  • Experience supporting partner bank oversight, internal audit or regulatory examinations of fraud controls
  • Exposure to earned wage access, gig or staffing platforms, or employer-verified onboarding
  • Experience designing protective treatment for scam and account takeover victims, or first-party fraud controls such as dispute abuse and bust-out
  • CFE or comparable industry certification

Compensation:

The base salary range for this role is $95-110k. The salary range displayed reflects an average base salary range for the position across all the U.S. The base salary offered to an applicant could be higher or lower based on each applicant's specific skill set, depth of experience, relevant education or training, etc.

Location:

This position is classified as REMOTEwithin the United States of America.

We are unable to hire candidates located outside of the domestic U.S.

Benefits:

  • Market-leading medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Stock options
  • Free Premium-Tier Origin Financial Wellness subscription
  • Monthly home-office stipend
  • 401k (TransAmerica)
  • 12-weeks paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents
  • Flexible time off + sick and safe time
  • 11 paid company holidays
  • Branch@Branch Same Day Pay Option

Identity VerificationAs part of our application process, you'll receive a separate email from Greenhouse shortly containing a unique identity verification link. This step, powered by Persona, helps us confirm applicant identities and keep our hiring process secure for everyone.

Upon identity verification, all biometric data is deleted. If you need support completing this application, please reach out to

Working at Branch

A remote-first company with employees located throughout the U.S., Branch emphasizes transparency, accountability, and trust to create a collaborative environment where our product, engineering, marketing, customer support, customer success, and sales teams can all thrive together. Learn more about what we do in this video!

Our collaborative spirit has helped us become an award-winning FinTech company, with Branch’s innovation and workplace recognized across industries. Branch has been honored by Inc., the Webby Awards, Benzinga FinTech Awards, FinTech Breakthrough Awards, Top Workplaces USA, Great Places to Work, and EY Entrepreneur of the Year, Heartland, among others.

The network services will include the management, on-island communications, off-island communications, and an integration facility to be used to ensure consistent interfaces and end-to-end service delivery.


The successful candidate will work closely with the chief engineer, system design team, system modelers and other technical disciplines to develop and maintain authoritative system models, establish and maintain requirements traceability, validate model integrity, and support the adoption of MBSE practices across engineering teams. Develop MBSE output from Cameo to include ICD, IDD, SDD, RVTM, and other engineering artifacts to support design reviews and testing processes using Cameo Report Wizard.

  • Experience with systems integration, modeling and simulation, or digital engineering environments.

Are you passionate about building scalable data systems and solving complex technical challenges? We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our dynamic, global team. This is a remote-first role for someone who enjoys ownership, thrives on problem-solving, and wants to work on high-impact, real-world technology.

This role is best suited to an experienced engineer. You’ll be expected to work independently on complex problems and, at times, liaise directly with clients.

At IntelliSense.io, we’re pioneering Objective AI (ODAI), combining fundamental physics with AI to understand and characterise the physical world. Our platform delivers high-value decision recommendations, acting as role-specific co-pilots that augment human intelligence or enable autonomous systems. In short, we’re building the brains behind smarter, more efficient operations.

What you’ll be working on

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll design and implement robust data solutions that meet both internal and client needs. You’ll also play a key role in shaping how we build software—supporting junior engineers, setting standards, and helping teams deliver high-quality work.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing and implementing reusable data-processing features across multiple sites and product teams

  • Leading feature breakdown and planning at a service level

  • Maintaining and improving technical documentation

  • Setting and upholding code review standards, including testing and code coverage practices
    Contributing to technology reviews and architectural discussions

  • Supporting and overseeing implementation work across individual sites

  • Identifying and addressing technical debt

  • Investigating, breaking down, and resolving bugs

  • Mentoring and supporting junior developers

What we’re looking for

  • Solid experience in software engineering, with a strong focus on data systems

  • Proficiency in Java and Node.js

  • Strong SQL skills and experience with both relational and NoSQL databases

  • Hands-on experience with message queues (e.g. NATS, Pub/Sub)

  • Experience building web services using REST and SOAP

  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and Docker

  • Excellent communication skills and confidence working in distributed teams

  • A degree in Computer Science (or a related field), or equivalent practical experience

Bonus points for

  • Familiarity with Python

Why join us?

  • Remote-first role with flexible working hours

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology and meaningful data challenges

  • A collaborative, global team of talented engineers and domain experts

  • A continuous learning environment with real opportunities to grow and lead

Location

This role is fully remote but must be based in the UK or Ireland.

Apply today

We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.
You belong here. Let’s build something extraordinary together.

jobs.excerpt: Kopius is seeking a hands-on, quota-carrying Sales Director with a proven ability to personally source, pursue, and close new logos across the Central U.
jobs.description:
Kopius is seeking a hands-on, quota-carrying Sales Director with a proven ability to personally source, pursue, and close new logos across the Central U.S. region.

You will own and scale a new-business engine—generating your own pipeline, opening doors through outbound effort and relationships, and closing profitable deals across end-to-end technology solutions—including data & AI, application management, managed services, staff augmentation, and embedded teams—leveraging nearshore (LATAM) delivery. Success in this role means consistently exceeding new-business revenue targets and building a repeatable path to growth, not managing inbound demand.

Key Responsibilities

  • Revenue & Pipeline Generation: Own and achieve company-wide and team new-business revenue targets, including direct accountability for team quota and overall sales performance. Personally source, develop, and close new business opportunities, leading by example in deal execution.
  • Go-to-Market Strategy: Build and scale a repeatable, predictable new-business engine, including processes, playbooks, and performance metrics. Identify, open, and expand into new markets and customer segments, developing outbound sales strategies beyond inbound and brand-driven opportunities.
  • Consultative Selling: Take a business-outcome approach: identify industry trends and implications for clients, uncover business pain points, and map Kopius solutions—such as data & AI, application management, and managed services—to solve them.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and manage a high-performing team of Account Executives as a player-coach (~60% sales leadership and coaching, 40% individual contribution), setting clear expectations around quota attainment and execution.
  • Deal Execution: Lead complex deal cycles, including negotiation and closing of enterprise-level agreements. Position LATAM-based delivery models effectively to U.S. buyers, articulating value beyond cost arbitrage.
  • Relationship & Ecosystem Building: Establish strong relationships with key prospects, clients, strategic partners, and internal cross-functional teams (marketing, recruiting, delivery). Represent the company at industry events and key networking opportunities.
  • Sales Operations & Analytics: Analyze pipeline health, sales performance, and market dynamics to continuously refine strategy, maintaining accurate forecasting in Salesforce.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years of sales experience, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role. Proven history of personally sourcing and closing new logos in competitive, commoditized markets where differentiation must be actively created.
  • Domain Expertise: Proven end-to-end technology solutions sales experience within IT services, systems integration, or consulting firms, including selling nearshore/offshore delivery models.
  • Track Record: Demonstrated success consistently meeting and exceeding an individual sales quota in addition to leading teams. Experience building and scaling sales teams and processes in growth-stage environments.
  • Prospecting & Network: Proven ability to generate pipeline via outbound efforts and relationships rather than relying on inbound demand. Established network of decision-makers to support pipeline generation.
  • Business Acumen & Skills: Depth in 2–3 industry verticals with the ability to translate business challenges into technology solutions. Excellent negotiation, communication, executive presence, and analytical mindset with CRM proficiency (Salesforce).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industry experience in Retail/CPG, Manufacturing, Energy & Utilities, Financial Services, or Healthcare.
  • Experience within enterprise technology ecosystems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft, AWS). ERP fluency is a plus.
  • Experience selling LATAM nearshore staff augmentation or embedded services.
  • Public sector experience (local municipalities, city, and state government).

Position Details & Compensation

  • Location & Territory: Full-time role covering the Central U.S. region. Candidates based in the Central region are preferred; candidates elsewhere in the U.S. who can effectively cover the territory will be considered.
  • Work Authorization: Must be eligible to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
  • Base Salary: $150,000 – $180,000 (determined by experience, skills, and background).
  • Compensation Structure: 50/50 OTE split (Base Salary / Variable Compensation). Salary plus OTE expected to be in the $300,00 - $360,000 range.
  • Travel Expectation: Approximately 50% travel.
