jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Junior Billing & Reconciliation Analyst to support accurate merchant billing and financial recordkeeping at Bask Health.

You'll work closely with Finance, Revenue Operations, Pricing, and Customer Success to review invoices, compare billing information against approved commercial agreements, maintain reconciliation spreadsheets, and help investigate discrepancies.

This is an opportunity for someone early in their career to develop experience in billing operations, financial analysis, and commercial reconciliation.

You'll learn how merchant contracts, pricing arrangements, transaction activity, and billing systems connect. You'll also help ensure important billing details, including rates, discounts, credits, and effective dates, are accurately documented and reviewed.

We're looking for someone who is organized, comfortable working with numbers, and willing to take ownership of detailed work.

What You'll Do

  • Support daily and recurring merchant billing review activities.
  • Assist with reconciling invoices against approved commercial agreements.
  • Compare billed amounts with expected charges using established procedures.
  • Help verify that merchant rates and fees match documented pricing terms.
  • Review billing records for missing information or inconsistent values.
  • Assist with checking that discounts are applied correctly.
  • Help verify the effective dates of approved pricing changes.
  • Support the review of credits and billing adjustments.
  • Maintain spreadsheets used to track billing reconciliation results.
  • Assist with identifying duplicate, missing, or incorrect charges.
  • Help compare transaction activity with relevant billing information.
  • Review merchant billing records for completeness and accuracy.
  • Support the preparation of recurring billing reconciliation reports.
  • Help organize commercial agreements and supporting billing documentation.
  • Assist with investigating straightforward billing discrepancies.
  • Escalate complex or unusual billing issues to senior team members.
  • Track outstanding billing questions and their resolution status.
  • Support Finance with gathering information for billing investigations.
  • Collaborate with Revenue Operations to validate merchant account information.
  • Assist with reviewing approved pricing changes against billing records.
  • Help maintain accurate records of merchant rates, discounts, and billing periods.
  • Support basic reconciliation of transaction counts and applicable fees.
  • Assist with preparing documentation for billing corrections.
  • Help verify that authorized billing adjustments are accurately recorded.
  • Maintain organized records of completed reconciliation work.
  • Support monthly billing reviews and reporting deadlines.
  • Assist with checking the accuracy of data entered into billing systems.
  • Help identify recurring patterns in billing discrepancies.
  • Support the development and maintenance of reconciliation checklists.
  • Assist with improving spreadsheet templates and reporting procedures.
  • Help document billing review steps and reconciliation methods.
  • Coordinate with Customer Success when additional merchant information is needed.
  • Support the preparation of summaries for internal billing discussions.
  • Help validate information used in billing and revenue reports.
  • Assist with testing billing changes under the guidance of senior team members.
  • Learn how commercial contracts and billing configuration relate.
  • Communicate findings clearly and raise potential issues promptly.
  • Support additional billing operations and reconciliation projects as assigned.

Billing corrections, credits, and changes to commercial terms will follow Bask's established approval procedures.

Requirements

  • 0–2 years of experience in Billing Operations, Finance Administration, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or a related area; relevant coursework and internship experience are welcome.
  • No previous full-time billing experience required.
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Ability to perform basic calculations involving amounts, percentages, rates, and discounts.
  • Strong attention to detail when reviewing numerical information.
  • Ability to organize and maintain accurate financial or operational records.
  • Comfortable comparing information across spreadsheets and documents.
  • Ability to identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent information.
  • Interest in learning billing reconciliation and financial operations processes.
  • Basic understanding of invoices and financial transactions.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to follow established procedures and document completed work.
  • Willingness to learn how commercial agreements affect billing.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate discrepancies and questions clearly.
  • Comfortable handling confidential financial and commercial information.
  • Willingness to ask questions and escalate issues when necessary.
  • Ability to manage recurring assignments and meet deadlines.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability to collaborate during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Degree or coursework in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, Analytics, or a related field.
  • Internship experience involving invoicing, billing, bookkeeping, or financial records.
  • Experience using spreadsheet formulas, lookups, or pivot tables.
  • Familiarity with billing or accounting software.
  • Experience reviewing invoices or payment records.
  • Understanding of basic financial reconciliation concepts.
  • Familiarity with subscription-based or transaction-based billing.
  • Experience using Stripe or similar payment platforms.
  • Experience maintaining financial tracking spreadsheets.
  • Familiarity with commercial contracts or pricing terms.
  • Experience identifying errors in numerical datasets.
  • Interest in SaaS or B2B technology businesses.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce or online merchant businesses.
  • Basic SQL knowledge.
  • Experience preparing financial or operational reports.
  • Interest in billing automation and process improvement.
  • Familiarity with telehealth or healthcare technology.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Care Manager, Telephonic Nurse 2 , in a telephonic environment, assesses and evaluates members' needs and requirements to achieve and/or maintain optimal wellness state by guiding members/families toward and facilitate interaction with resources appropriate for the care and wellbeing of members. The Care Manager, Telephonic Nurse 2 work assignments are varied and frequently require interpretation and independent determination of the appropriate courses of action.

Our nurses are titled Care Managers, because our case management services are centered on the person rather than the condition. We contact members with multiple chronic conditions as well as financial and functional barriers in order to assist them in achieving and maintaining optimum health. We provide telephonic outreach to assess and support their health, offering education, identifying resources, and helping remove barriers to achieving health and independence, while using a multidisciplinary team.


This position will be part of our Special Needs Program (SNP) team. All of our SNP RN Care Managers are work at home associates, working from a dedicated home office space. Work at home care managers are responsible for meeting quality and productivity measures daily and maintaining working home internet at all time with demonstrated advanced communication and interpersonal skills.


This is a very compliance driven and highly visible program at Humana. The nature of the work requires telephonic interaction with members during the majority of the business day, primarily through an auto dialer system. Environment is fast paced and requires ability to engage quickly with member while concurrently navigating multiple computer applications. Due to the auto dialer process and compliance needs of the business there is limited day to day flexibility in care manager's schedule.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Telephonically assess Medicare, Medicaid, and/or and Group Account members and create actionable and measurable care plans to help guide and track the members' progress toward goals
  • Use nursing judgment to assess and coordinate care for acute situations (APS, EMS)
  • Discuss transitions of care to assist with safe discharge to the home and coordinate care for DME, home health, provider appointments, etc.
  • Guide members and their families toward and facilitate interaction with resources appropriate for the care and wellbeing of members
  • Assess member's physical, environmental and psycho-social health issues and work in collaboration with a multi-disciplinary team, such as social workers, dietitians, pharmacists, etc., employing a variety of strategies/techniques to manage appropriately and provide timely intervention


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Active Registered Nurse (RN) Multi-State/Compact State license with no disciplinary action
  • 3 or more years of clinical nursing experience
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Word, Excel, Outlook with the ability to quickly learn and navigate new applications
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in nursing (BSN)
  • Previous experience with adult chronic conditions or care management
  • Case Management certification (CCM)
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish

Additional Information

  • Training: The first 4 weeks of training are Monday-Friday 8:30am to 5:00pm EST., (No time off is permitted during the first month of training)
  • Schedule: Core hours for this position after training are Monday-Friday 9:00am to 5:30pm EST
  • Work Style: Remote
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$71,100 - $97,800 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 11-18-2026

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Finance, Revenue Operations, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Billing Operations & Revenue Integrity Analyst to help ensure Bask Health's merchant billing is accurate, consistent, and aligned with our commercial agreements.

You'll review merchant contracts, pricing schedules, discounts, and billing records to identify discrepancies, investigate issues, and improve how commercial terms are translated into billing.

This role combines financial analysis, billing operations, reconciliation, and process improvement. You'll work closely with Finance, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and technical teams to resolve billing issues and help prevent revenue leakage.

You'll also take ownership of complex billing investigations, develop better controls, and improve the processes used to activate and maintain merchant pricing.

We're looking for someone who is highly detail-oriented, comfortable investigating financial discrepancies, and able to take a complicated billing problem from initial discovery through resolution.

What You'll Do

  • Review merchant contracts and commercial agreements to understand agreed-upon billing terms.
  • Validate that contracted pricing, discounts, fees, and effective dates are accurately reflected in billing configurations.
  • Reconcile merchant invoices and billing records against applicable commercial agreements.
  • Identify and investigate billing discrepancies, including incorrect rates, missing charges, duplicate charges, and misapplied discounts.
  • Analyze potential revenue leakage and recommend corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with Finance and Revenue Operations to resolve billing inconsistencies.
  • Review pricing changes and confirm that approved updates are implemented accurately.
  • Support the activation of new merchant pricing arrangements and commercial amendments.
  • Verify billing start dates, renewal dates, promotional periods, and other time-sensitive commercial terms.
  • Investigate invoice adjustments, credits, and billing corrections.
  • Maintain accurate records of billing investigations, discrepancies, resolutions, and outstanding issues.
  • Develop recurring reconciliation processes to identify billing errors before they affect merchants.
  • Build reports and dashboards that monitor billing accuracy, exceptions, and revenue integrity.
  • Analyze recurring billing issues to identify root causes and opportunities for improvement.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success to investigate merchant billing questions and escalations.
  • Work with Sales and Deal Desk stakeholders to clarify nonstandard commercial terms.
  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering when billing issues require technical investigation or configuration changes.
  • Help establish controls for pricing activation, billing updates, and contract-to-billing validation.
  • Review billing processes for gaps that may create financial or operational risks.
  • Support month-end billing reviews and reconciliation activities.
  • Analyze the financial impact of identified billing discrepancies.
  • Prepare summaries of revenue leakage, billing corrections, and process improvement opportunities.
  • Develop clear documentation for billing workflows, exception handling, and reconciliation procedures.
  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring billing checks and reporting.
  • Support internal reviews of billing accuracy and commercial compliance.
  • Partner with Finance to ensure billing adjustments are appropriately documented and approved.
  • Track the implementation of corrective actions and verify that issues are fully resolved.
  • Help improve consistency between commercial documentation, billing systems, and financial reporting.
  • Provide guidance to teammates on complex billing investigations and reconciliation practices.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in billing operations, revenue operations, financial operations, revenue assurance, or a related field.
  • Strong experience reconciling billing records, invoices, and commercial agreements.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate complex billing discrepancies and identify root causes.
  • Experience reviewing pricing schedules, discounts, contract terms, and effective dates.
  • Strong understanding of billing accuracy, revenue leakage, and financial controls.
  • Advanced spreadsheet skills, including complex formulas, reconciliation models, and data analysis.
  • Experience working with billing systems, financial records, or revenue management tools.
  • Ability to analyze large datasets and identify inconsistencies or exceptions.
  • Experience coordinating billing corrections, invoice adjustments, or credits.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to financial accuracy.
  • Experience developing reports, reconciliation processes, or operational controls.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain billing issues clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating with Finance, Sales, Customer Success, or technical teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple investigations and deadlines.
  • Experience maintaining accurate documentation of billing issues and resolutions.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex operational problems.
  • Availability to collaborate during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.
  • Ability to handle confidential financial and commercial information responsibly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SaaS billing, subscription billing, or usage-based pricing models.
  • Experience supporting merchant billing for a technology platform.
  • Familiarity with contract-to-billing processes and pricing activation.
  • Experience working with Stripe Billing or similar billing platforms.
  • Experience identifying and resolving revenue leakage.
  • Familiarity with commercial deal desk or pricing operations.
  • Experience in telehealth, healthcare technology, or e-commerce.
  • Understanding of cash-pay business models.
  • Experience using SQL to investigate billing discrepancies.
  • Experience with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Experience automating reconciliation or billing exception reporting.
  • Familiarity with billing system integrations and pricing configuration.
  • Experience supporting internal financial audits or billing control reviews.
  • Experience working in a growing SaaS or technology company.

Req ID:398012

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Data Engineer Tester - Healthcare Data & AI Validation - Remote to join our team in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania (US-PA), United States (US).

Data Engineer Tester (2 Positions) – Healthcare Data & AI Validation

Industry: Healthcare / Life Sciences / Biotechnology

Position Overview

We are seeking two experienced Data Engineer Testers to support the quality assurance, data integrity, and regulatory validation of an enterprise-scale medical data ingestion and automation platform.

These individuals will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive testing strategies across complex ETL pipelines, large-scale data processing environments, and AI-driven data mapping solutions. The platform processes substantial volumes of structured and unstructured healthcare data, including clinical records, pathology reports, and other medical datasets.

The successful candidates will validate data ingestion, transformation, mapping accuracy, semantic alignment, and overall pipeline performance. A key component of the role will involve testing and validating outputs generated by Machine Learning models, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Natural Language Processing (NLP) technologies to ensure data accuracy and alignment with established healthcare standards and medical ontologies.

Candidates should bring a combination of hands-on data engineering, automated testing, big data quality assurance, and healthcare or life sciences domain experience.

Key Responsibilities

Data Pipeline & ETL Testing

  • Design, develop, and execute automated testing frameworks to validate complex ETL pipelines and large-scale data transformations.
  • Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across ingestion, processing, transformation, and output stages.
  • Develop SQL and Python-based scripts to perform data reconciliation, validation, and automated quality checks.
  • Test data processing workflows across distributed environments and large-scale platforms.
  • Identify, document, and troubleshoot data discrepancies, transformation defects, and pipeline failures.

AI-Driven Data Mapping & Model Validation

  • Develop testing strategies to validate automated data mapping and semantic alignment generated by Machine Learning models and LLMs.
  • Verify AI-generated mapping outputs against established healthcare data standards, medical terminologies, and biomedical ontologies.
  • Evaluate mapping accuracy, precision, consistency, and completeness across diverse clinical and medical datasets.
  • Develop test datasets and validation benchmarks to assess model performance and identify mapping errors or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers to investigate defects and improve model validation processes.

Performance, Load & Scalability Testing

  • Conduct performance, stress, and load testing across high-volume data ingestion and processing pipelines.
  • Benchmark data throughput, processing speed, resource utilization, and system responsiveness under varying workloads.
  • Validate distributed data processing performance across technologies such as PySpark, Databricks, Snowflake, and AWS EMR.
  • Assess pipeline performance in environments utilizing specialized AI hardware, including NVIDIA GPUs and Google TPUs.
  • Identify performance bottlenecks and collaborate with engineering teams to improve processing efficiency and scalability.

Unstructured Data & NLP Validation

  • Develop and execute test cases for NLP and Named Entity Recognition (NER) models processing unstructured clinical information.
  • Validate the accuracy of extracted medical entities, terminology, relationships, and clinical information from medical records and pathology reports.
  • Test entity recognition, classification, normalization, and semantic extraction outputs.
  • Verify that extracted information is correctly mapped to standardized medical terminologies and data structures.

Regulatory Compliance & Data Quality Assurance

  • Validate data lineage, traceability, audit logging, and security controls throughout the data processing lifecycle.
  • Ensure testing practices support applicable healthcare and life sciences regulatory and privacy requirements, including HIPAA, GDPR, and relevant GxP requirements.
  • Verify data handling, access controls, and documentation requirements within regulated healthcare data environments.
  • Maintain test documentation, execution evidence, defect records, and validation results to support auditability and compliance.

Test Management & Defect Resolution

  • Develop and maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, and automated regression suites.
  • Track testing progress, defects, and resolution activities using Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and Business Analysts to resolve technical issues.
  • Participate in Agile development activities, including sprint planning, testing reviews, defect triage, and release readiness assessments.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in Data Testing, Data Engineering, Big Data Quality Assurance, or Software Testing focused on data-intensive applications.
  • 1–2+ years of experience within Healthcare, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical, or related regulated data environments.
  • Hands-on experience testing complex ETL pipelines, data transformations, and large-scale data processing workflows.
  • Strong SQL and Python programming skills for data validation, reconciliation, and test automation.
  • Experience validating structured and unstructured datasets and identifying data quality issues.
  • Understanding of automated data testing, regression testing, performance testing, and defect management.
  • Familiarity with healthcare data standards, clinical data models, and medical terminology.
  • Experience working with technical teams in Agile or enterprise software delivery environments.

Technical Skills & Qualifications

Data Engineering & Big Data Platforms

  • Strong SQL and Python programming capabilities.
  • Experience with PySpark, Databricks, Snowflake, and/or AWS EMR.
  • Understanding of distributed data processing, ETL architecture, data ingestion, and transformation workflows.
  • Experience testing large datasets across cloud-based data platforms.

Automated Testing & Data Validation

  • Hands-on experience with data quality and testing frameworks such as:
    • Great Expectations
    • dbt Testing
    • PyTest
    • Automated SQL-based validation frameworks

jobs.excerpt: You’ve discovered something special.  A company that cares.
jobs.description:
You’ve discovered something special. A company that cares. Cares about leading the way in construction, engineering, manufacturing and renewable energy. Cares about redefining how energy is designed, applied and consumed. Cares about thoughtfully growing to meet market demands. And ─ as “one of the Healthiest 100 Workplaces in America” ─ is focused on the mind/body/soul of team members through our Culture of Care.

The Modular Product Developer works within the Product Development organization to execute development activities for ETO Modular Product Platforms under the direction of Product Architects. This individual transforms conceptual requirements, sketches, technical direction, and evolving design decisions into accurate virtual prototypes, models, drawings, submittals, and supporting technical documentation.

The primary focus of this role is early concept development using Revit and other digital design tools to rapidly visualize, evaluate, and refine product solutions before design intent is established. The Product Developer maintains sufficient technical understanding of the complete product to accurately represent dimensions, clearances, interfaces, equipment arrangements, constructability, manufacturability, and site integration within concept-level models and documentation. As concepts mature, the Product Developer supports development and maintenance of master Revit models, reusable BIM content, product configuration content, Product Requirements Document (PRD) supporting information, Component Definition Documents (CDDs), specifications, scope documents and matrices, Illustrated Basis of Design (iBODs), client submittals, vendor- and site-specific submittals, permit submittals, ETO submittal packages, and early Long Lead Equipment (LLE) Bills of Material (BOMs).

The Modular Product Developer collaborates with Product Architects, peer Product Developers, Program Design Managers, Preconstruction, engineering disciplines, subject matter experts (SMEs), Virtual Design and Construction (VDC), Detailed Design, Construction Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Construction, Operations, vendors, manufacturers, and other cross-functional stakeholders to incorporate requirements, constraints, design changes, and lessons learned into product development deliverables.

Success in this role requires strong technical modeling capability, product thinking, creativity, curiosity, attention to detail, and active participation in a collaborative product development environment. The Modular Product Developer is expected to understand how concept decisions affect downstream engineering, procurement, fabrication, manufacturing, construction integration, and overall product lifecycle performance.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Education: Vocational or Technical Certificate, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's Degree in engineering drafting or design, engineering technology, industrial technology, manufacturing design, mechanical design, electrical design, architecture, construction, or a related technical field. Equivalent relevant experience may include electrical or mechanical trades, modular construction, manufacturing, field engineering, VDC/BIM, or project management within an engineering or specialty-contractor environment.

Experience:5+ years of experience in product development, engineering design, BIM/VDC, modular construction, manufacturing, electrical or mechanical construction, or a related technical environment.

Travel: 10-50%

Work Schedule:This position works between the hours of 6 am and 6 pm, Monday through Friday. Schedule may vary and can include, but is not limited to nights, weekends, and holidays. Overtime may be required. Ability to work a flexible schedule is necessary.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Execute and be directly accountable for assigned product development activities and deliverables under the technical direction of Product Architects, ensuring work is complete, accurate, on schedule, and aligned with established product requirements, architecture, standards, and design intent.
  • Develop virtual prototypes, product concepts, component designs, and technical solutions that support early concept development, client solutioning, technical evaluation, and rapid design iteration.
  • Translate conceptual requirements, sketches, engineering direction, and evolving technical decisions into accurate, constructable digital models.
  • Develop and maintain master Revit models, reusable BIM content, families, templates, standardized details, and product configuration content under Product Architect direction.
  • Produce accurate 2D concept drawings, layouts, design-intent documentation, submittal packages, and presentation-ready technical documentation.
  • Support development of client, programmatic, vendor-specific, site-specific, permit, and ETO product submittal packages through approval.
  • Support development and maintenance of CDDs, iBODs, design narratives, and other product-definition deliverables; perform scope leveling through specifications, scope documents and matrices, and Comply, Deviate and/or Exclude (CDE) documentation.
  • Support development, validation, and maintenance of early Long Lead Equipment (LLE) Bills of Material (BOMs) and other product data required to support strategic procurement.
  • Review and mark up specifications, vendor and equipment submittals, and technical documentation to identify requirements, gaps, deviations, and information requiring incorporation into product models and documentation.
  • Coordinate with Product Architects, peer Product Developers, SMEs, engineering disciplines, and cross-functional stakeholders to incorporate requirements, interfaces, constraints, and design changes into product deliverables.
  • Maintain model and drawing accuracy for dimensions, clearances, interfaces, equipment layouts, accessibility, constructability, and manufacturability appropriate to the maturity of the design.
  • Ensure product models and documentation clearly communicate approved design intent and are suitable for transition to downstream Detailed Design.
  • Support establishment of the engineering baseline from which Detailed Design develops production-level models, Engineering Bills of Material (EBOMs), fabrication documentation, manufacturing documentation, and engineering releases.
  • Read, understand, and incorporate relevant information from construction design documents to ensure modular products integrate successfully with the overall facility and site design.
  • Coordinate with vendors and manufacturers to obtain and validate product data, equipment information, materials, and technical documentation required to support development activities.
  • Conduct research on products, components, materials, manufacturers, processes, and technologies to support technical decisions and product improvement.
  • Actively participate in product development meetings, design reviews, and technical workshops by presenting concepts, solution ideas, research, technical findings, and recommendations.
  • Support development and maintenance of schedules for assigned product development activities and deliverables using applicable planning tools.
  • Organize and manage models, drawings, supporting documentation, file structures, revisions, and version control in accordance with company standards and product-development workflows.
  • Identify innovative opportunities to reduce cost and improve standardization, manufacturability, constructability, quality, reusable content, and execution efficiency.
  • Capture and incorporate lessons learned from Detailed Design, Procurement, Fabrication, Manufacturing, Construction, site deployment, and Operations into updated product models and development deliverables.
  • Collaborate with peer Product Developers to develop and continuously improve product design, modeling, documentation, and development best practices.
  • Complete assigned development activities accurately, completely, and on schedule while maintaining strong attention to technical quality and product integrity.

Technical Capabilities

  • Develop ETO and complex engineered products, including modular, prefabricated, and construction-integrated systems.
  • Translate concepts, sketches, specifications, and technical requirements into accurate digital models, designs, and documentation.
  • Develop 2D drawings, layouts, submittal packages, and presentation-ready technical documentation.
  • Apply virtual prototyping, concept development, and rapid design iteration to support product development.
  • Interpret multidisciplinary technical documentation, including electrical, mechanical, structural, architectural, and construction drawings.
  • Read and interpret single-line diagrams, control diagrams, equipment layouts, process piping diagrams, and related technical documents.
  • Review and implement equipment and product submittals, specifications, scope documents, matrices, and CDE (Comply, Deviate, Exclude) requirements.
  • Conduct independent research to evaluate equipment, materials, manufacturers, components, processes, and technical solutions.
  • Support workflows spanning design, procurement, fabrication, manufacturing, construction integration, and site deployment.
  • Develop and maintain standardized, reusable design content and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Apply applicable codes, standards, and safety requirements, including NEC, NFPA 70E, OSHA, and relevant industry standards.

Software Proficiency

  • Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Revit, including BIM, model development, families, schedules, documentation, and reusable content.
  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in Bluebeam Revu and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
  • Demonstrate working proficiency in Autodesk Inventor and Vault (PDM).
  • Demonstrate familiarity with Autodesk Forma, Fusion Manage (PLM), Acumatica (ERP), Navisworks, Microsoft Office 365, Excel, and MS Project.
  • Adapt to and maintain proficiency with evolving digital engineering, product development, and company-standard technologies.
  • Performs other related duties as required and assigned.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Clinical Documentation Specialist (CDS) will provide clinically based concurrent and retrospective review of inpatient medical records to evaluate the utilization and documentation of acute care services. The goal of concurrent review includes facilitation of appropriate physician documentation of care delivery to accurately reflect patient severity of illness and risk of mortality. Specific reviews are both determined internally and by requirements/requests of external payers or regulatory agencies and play a significant role in reporting quality of care outcomes and in obtaining accurate and compliant reimbursement for acute care services.

Position: Clinical Documentation Specialist

Department: Clinical Documentation

Schedule: Part Time, 1199SEIU Union Per Diem

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Nursing or Health Information Management is required; however, an equivalent combination of education and experience, which provides proficiency in the areas of responsibility, may be substituted for the stated education and experience requirements.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS REQUIRED:

  • RN or CCS, required. CCDS, CDIP preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum 6 years related experience (i.e. 6 years clinical experience including 3 years inpatient case management experience or 6 years of experience inpatient coding with DRG Validation required).

  • Previous CDS experience preferred.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

  • Knowledge of care delivery documentation systems and related medical record documents.

  • Knowledge of age-specific needs and the elements of disease processes and related procedures.

  • Strong broad-based clinical knowledge and understanding of pathology/physiology of disease processes.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Excellent critical thinking skills.

  • Demonstrated employee and medical staff relationships in the past and has the ability to maintain those going forward.

  • Working knowledge of inpatient admission criteria.

In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

Role Overview

The Treasury team is part of Circana’s global Finance and Strategy organization and manages a broad range of operational and strategic activities, including cash management, banking, liquidity planning, capital structure, and financial risk management. The team supports approximately 25 countries and partners closely with Controllership, Tax, Legal, and Financial Planning & Analysis.

As the US Treasury Operations Manager, you will lead daily US cash management and liquidity activities, including cash positioning, forecasting, banking administration, intercompany funding, and operational controls. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for ensuring reliable daily execution while strengthening processes, controls, visibility, and scalability.

In partnership with the Assistant Treasurer and OUS Treasury Operations Manager, you will support coordinated global liquidity management, recommend operational improvements, and help advance Circana’s broader Treasury capabilities.

This role reports to the Assistant Treasurer and manages one Treasury Analyst.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own daily US cash positioning and liquidity management, ensuring adequate funding for payroll, payments, and other business obligations.
  • Coordinate with the OUS Treasury Operations Manager to support global cash visibility, coverage, and funding needs.
  • Lead daily, weekly, and monthly cash forecasting, improving accuracy and decision-making through clear assumptions and variance analysis.
  • Manage cash deployment and short-term investment activity to optimize the use of available cash.
  • Oversee Treasury payment execution and partner with Controllership to resolve bank reconciliation items, ensuring accurate cash visibility and a strong control environment.
  • Manage US bank account structures, including account openings and closures, authorized signers, user access, entitlements, and security controls.
  • Support intercompany funding, loan administration, and cash repatriation activities in partnership with Tax, Legal, and Controllership.
  • Maintain accurate tracking of intercompany loans, interest calculations, and supporting documentation in accordance with internal policies.
  • Deliver clear reporting and actionable insights on liquidity, cash trends, forecast variances, and potential risks.
  • Evaluate Treasury-related risks and recommend practical mitigation strategies to Treasury leadership.
  • Lead process, control, and system improvements that strengthen automation, visibility, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Maintain Treasury procedures and operational control frameworks.
  • Lead and develop the Treasury Analyst by setting priorities, overseeing execution, and supporting professional growth.
  • Partner across Treasury, Controllership, Tax, Legal, FP&A, and other Finance teams to resolve issues and advance cross-functional initiatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on Treasury Operations experience, including cash positioning, liquidity management, cash forecasting, and banking administration.
  • Strong understanding of corporate cash management, banking structures, cash deployment, intercompany funding, and Treasury controls.
  • Experience managing bank accounts, authorized signers, user access, entitlements, and online banking security.
  • Experience with treasury management systems and ERP platforms. Kyriba and NetSuite experience are preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to strengthen processes and controls while improving efficiency, visibility, and scalability.
  • Experience analyzing cash forecasts, variances, liquidity trends, and financial risks.
  • Strong judgment and ability to distinguish routine operational activity from issues requiring escalation.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Controllership, Tax, Legal, FP&A, and global Finance teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and develop others through direct management, mentoring, or significant team leadership.
  • Experience leading cross-functional projects, Treasury improvements, or systems initiatives.
  • Multinational Treasury or global operations exposure is preferred.

Circana Behaviors

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:

  • Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.
  • Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action.
  • Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices.
  • Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers.
  • Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement.
  • Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.
  • Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

Location:This is a Remote US position. Candidates must be available to support Treasury activities during US banking hours. Eastern or Central time zones are preferred

jobs.excerpt: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm's engineering team is building a large-scale, highly available, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products. Ensuring that our infrastructure is accessible to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of engaging in thorough technical design review, operational excellence, and capable incident response and analysis.

Affirm runs its workloads on more than 85 Amazon EKS clusters, and the number is growing. The Workload Safety team creates one set of standards for how workloads are configured and run, so Affirm can grow globally and still meet its availability and latency SLOs. The team identifies the industry best practices Affirm needs, drives their adoption across every engineering team on EKS, and enforces them through policy and automation so new workloads comply by default.

As a senior engineer on the team, you will help set its roadmap, decide which standards matter most, and build a repeatable way to take each standard from research to enforcement across the fleet.

What you’ll do

  • Define and evolve workload safety standards for Affirm's EKS fleet, such as CPU and memory settings, workload isolation and placement, tolerance for disruption, graceful termination to name a few

  • Own each standard end to end: research and prototyping, white-glove onboarding for early adopters, self-service guidance for everyone else, and automation and policy guardrails that keep every workload compliant from day one

  • Lead cross-team initiatives from design through fleet-wide rollout, mentor other engineers, and set a high bar for design, code review, and operational readiness

  • Isolate workloads by criticality and resource profile so one misbehaving workload cannot degrade critical paths such as checkout

  • Fix stuck workloads and node lifecycle problems, such as pods that ignore termination signals, pod disruption budgets that block node cycling, and Karpenter timeouts that prevent bin packing and the removal of excess capacity

  • Determine the safe operating limits of each cluster (pod count, node count, API server request volume), keep clusters within them, and develop control plane scaling patterns for bursty workloads such as scheduled batch jobs and large deployments

  • Analyze workload resource profiles across the fleet (CPU, memory, disk, network) to guide EC2 instance type strategy, and automate that analysis as workloads change

  • Measure each standard's impact on availability, latency, risk, and cost, and use the results to prioritize the roadmap

  • Participate in on-call for Kubernetes runtime issues across the fleet, and turn recurring failure patterns into roadmap items

  • Work closely with the teams that run services, batch jobs, and ML workloads on EKS, and with the deployment, capacity, and SRE teams

  • Keep up with new best practices from the Kubernetes community and adapt them to Affirm's needs

What we look for

  • 5+ years of experience running Kubernetes in production at scale, ideally Amazon EKS across many clusters

  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes resource management and scheduling: requests and limits, OOM and CPU throttling behavior, affinity and anti-affinity, taints and tolerations, and topology spread constraints

  • Solid grasp of the pod lifecycle and disruption management, including graceful termination, pod disruption budgets, and node draining

  • Experience enforcing configuration standards through admission control and policy-as-code (for example, OPA Gatekeeper or Kyverno)

  • Proficiency in Go or Python, including building production infrastructure software such as Kubernetes controllers, operators, or admission webhooks

  • Strong production debugging skills and a demonstrated ability to turn recurring incidents into systemic fixes

  • Track record of leading technical initiatives across multiple teams, driving adoption of shared standards, and mentoring other engineers

  • Experience quantifying the impact of infrastructure changes on availability, latency, and cost

  • Strong written communication, including standards and guidance that teams can adopt on their own

  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Pay Grade - N

Equity Grade - 9

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $195000 - $255000
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $173000 - $233000

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

Donorbox is a leading fundraising platform and donor management system for nonprofit organizations. Our mission is to accelerate positive impact worldwide by helping nonprofits become highly effective at raising funds and managing their supporter base. Our fast-growing company is profitable and bootstrapped with a healthy run rate. We have a fully distributed and diverse 150-person team based in 16+ states and 23+ countries. In 2026, Donorbox was named by Built In as one of the Best Places to Work in Washington, DC.

The Role

The CSM is responsible for engaging Donorbox’s mid-tier customers and new CRM signups who have yet to interact with a company representative. This role bridges Customer Success, Community Engagement, and Growth—helping customers adopt key features, recognize value, and stay connected to Donorbox through education and proactive outreach. Working closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Support, you will guide customers through onboarding and adoption, create and share helpful educational resources, and identify opportunities for expansion or deeper engagement to hand off to the Sales team. You’ll also support knowledge initiatives that strengthen the self-serve experience and community learning for all Donorbox users.   • Manage relationships with mid-tier customers to ensure continued success and feature adoption.
  • Act as the first point of human contact for users who have not yet interacted with a representative.
  • Conduct onboarding check-ins, webinars, and product walkthroughs to help users achieve first value.
  • Identify upsell or cross-sell opportunities through customer usage analysis and pass qualified leads to Sales.
  • Partner with the Product and Customer Operations teams to surface insights, feedback, and improvement opportunities.
  • Foster community engagement through online events, user groups, newsletters, and in-app communications.
  • Maintain an understanding of new features and updates to share proactively with customers.

Full time, Atlanta, Chicago

As a member of the Enterprise Development organization, you will work on a range of complex and high-impact cloud platform challenges and be responsible for designing, building, and evolving scalable AWS-based platform capabilities that enable product engineering teams.

You will contribute to the development of an internal cloud platform that simplifies and standardizes how applications are built, deployed, and operated across the enterprise. Working within a cross-functional team including Engineering, Architecture, Security, Operations, and Product - you will help drive platform adoption and improve developer experience across the organization.

You will collaborate closely with platform engineers, application teams, and enterprise stakeholders to deliver foundational capabilities in a complex, data-intensive, and distributed cloud environment. In this role, you will contribute not only to execution but also to shaping platform standards, improving automation, and enabling long-term scalability, reliability, and operational excellence across AWS environments.

We are looking for individuals who enjoy solving complex infrastructure and platform challenges, are comfortable working hands-on with cloud-native technologies, and are passionate about building reusable, self-service capabilities. You should be eager to dive deep into technical details, improve system internals, and enable teams to deliver faster with greater consistency and quality.

As a Senior AWS Cloud Platform Engineer, Enterprise Development, you will

  • Own the platform engineering strategy, roadmap, and delivery outcomes, enabling scalable, self-service infrastructure and developer productivity across the organization
  • Drive adoption of platform capabilities including CI/CD templates, reusable modules, golden paths, and standardized environments across engineering teams
  • Establish Infrastructure as Code (IaC) frameworks (Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation) with reusable, versioned modules to ensure consistency, compliance, and scalability
  • Architect and manage multi-account AWS environments with strong governance, security guardrails, and automated onboarding for application teams
  • Enable self-service provisioning of infrastructure, pipelines, and services through developer portals and APIs (e.g., Backstage or similar platforms)
  • Implement centralized observability (logs, metrics, traces) with integrated tooling (CloudWatch, Datadog, Open Telemetry) to support operational excellence
  • Define and enforce platform standards for security, compliance, cost optimization, and reliability
  • Partner with application engineering teams to onboard them onto the platform, ensuring seamless adoption and high developer experience
  • Act as the primary SME for cloud-native patterns including microservices, event-driven architectures, serverless, and container platforms (EKS/ECS)
  • Lead platform reliability initiatives including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, and resilience engineering practices
  • Proactively manage system-wide risks, platform dependencies, and trade-offs between flexibility and standardization
  • Collaborate with architects to define scalable data and integration patterns aligned with enterprise architecture
  • Mentor platform engineers and DevOps teams, building strong expertise in automation, cloud architecture, and platform design
  • Establish KPIs for platform adoption, developer productivity, deployment efficiency, and operational maturity
  • Serve as the strategic bridge between infrastructure, security, and application teams to drive platform-first engineering culture

About you

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or Business/Technology Management, or relevant experience
  • Extensive experience in platform engineering, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure roles, with strong focus on building internal platforms at scale
  • Deep expertise in AWS services including compute (EC2, Lambda), containers (EKS/ECS), storage (S3), networking (VPC), Events(SQS, SNS, Event Bridge)
  • Ability to design a medium to large scale system in AWS
  • Familiarity with building APIs in AWS and authentication
  • Basic understanding of general programming languages such as Python, JavaScript and C#

  • Experience with developer portals and self-service tooling (Backstage or equivalent)
  • Advanced knowledge of CI/CD design and standardization using tools like GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or AWS-native services
  • You have a strong understanding of cloud security best practices (IAM, KMS, secrets management, network isolation, compliance enforcement)
  • Experience managing multi-account AWS environments with centralized governance, logging, and monitoring
  • Hands-on experience with observability tools (Datadog, ELK, CloudWatch) and defining SLO-driven monitoring practices
  • Expertise in containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes/EKS)
  • You have an understanding of developer experience principles, including reducing cognitive load and enabling faster delivery cycles
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation (Python, Bash, etc.) for platform tooling and integration
  • Proven ability to influence engineering teams to adopt platform standards and best practices
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to design scalable abstractions for complex infrastructure challenges
  • Excellent communication skills, with ability to articulate platform vision and value to both technical and business stakeholders
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt platform strategy to evolving enterprise needs

    • Support month-end and year-end financial close by generating balancing files, reconciling clearing accounts, and delivering variance analyses to management.

JOB TITLE:Senior Business Applications Specialist

REPORTS TO: IT Director

STATUS: Full time, exempt

BENEFITS: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, optional FSA/HSA, 401k with 6% employer match, life and AD&D insurance, Employee Assistance Program, short & long term disability, tuition reimbursement, 21.67 days of paid time off + 10 holidays

About Tidal Vision:

We believe that sustainability should not require customers to compromise on price, convenience, or performance. Our mission is to create positive and systemic environmental impact by making our biopolymer solutions cost competitive, more convenient, and better performing than the synthetic chemicals we displace. We value innovation and take pride in challenging the status-quo; we choose to view obstacles as opportunities. We value new ideas and encourage the team to apply creativity and invent new solutions to meet challenging demands. We foster open, direct communication, and a collaborative working environment through our unique approach to work culture. We value our employees and demonstrate that through our compensation and benefits programs and opportunities for growth and development.

About Our Unique Work Culture:

Tidal Vision and Clear Water Services strive to build and invest in the highest performing and most innovative team. We put our people and customers above process, avoid company-wide rules as much as possible, and have the courage to take unusual approaches to advance our mission. With this approach, we believe we can create a more flexible, fun, stimulating, creative, collaborative, and innovative organization.

Our commitment to developing, practicing and promoting direct and open communication, responsibility and freedom, and leading with and seeking context is a responsibility for every role at Tidal Vision.

Position Summary

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Business Applications Specialist to guide the design, governance, reliability, and continuous improvement of its enterprise business applications. The initial priority is ownership of NetSuite ERP, with responsibility expanding over time to other core business systems and the integrations connecting them. Reporting to the IT Director, this role combines business process analysis, functional solution architecture, and application leadership. The successful candidate thinks across systems and departments, uncovers the root cause behind business requests, and recommends the simplest sustainable solution—often improving a business process or using native application functionality rather than adding customization.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Must operate and work within our Mission-Driven Culture Core Values and Principles and encourage others to do the same.
  • Business Process & Solution Leadership:
    • Partner with business process owners to understand workflows, underlying needs, pain points, and downstream impacts before proposing solutions.
    • Assess whether a request is best addressed through process improvement, training, standard NetSuite functionality, or a justified system enhancement.
    • Design practical, cross-functional solutions that minimize customization, complexity, cost, and long-term technical debt.
    • Advise stakeholders on tradeoffs, challenge assumptions constructively, and support consistent processes across the organization.
  • Business Applications Ownership & Administration:
    • Initially lead NetSuite platform standards, roadmap, configuration governance, and enhancement prioritization; progressively extend consistent practices across other enterprise business applications.
    • Configure and support NetSuite workflows, forms, roles, permissions, saved searches, reports, and dashboards; guide configuration and functional improvements in other assigned applications as the scope expands.
    • Maintain application reliability through troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, release testing, change control, documentation, and prevention of recurring issues.
    • Partner with IT and business leaders to establish appropriate access controls, segregation of duties, security, data integrity, and audit readiness across assigned applications.
  • Cross-System Integration, Vendors & Continuous Improvement:
    • Evaluate end-to-end workflows and data flows across ERP, CRM, HR/payroll, and other operational systems; recommend clear system ownership, integration patterns, and solutions that avoid duplicate functionality and unnecessary complexity.
    • Oversee integrations, third-party applications, scripts, and specialized development; coordinate external partners while retaining internal ownership of solution design, standards, and application knowledge.
    • Build scalable application support practices, documentation, automation, and business super-user capabilities so routine process questions remain with business teams.
    • Prioritize application improvements by measurable business value, maintainability, and cross-functional impact rather than simply implementing requested configurations.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5-7+ years of experience in the IT/Systems Architecture sector with at least 3 years of experience in NetSuite specifically
  • Strong hands-on NetSuite ERP administration and functional configuration experience, with the ability and interest to lead a broader business applications portfolio.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end business processes and dependencies across finance, operations, sales, and related enterprise functions.
  • Demonstrated systems thinking: ability to investigate requests, identify underlying business needs and root causes, and recommend process changes or native functionality before custom development.
  • Experience with enterprise application configuration, reporting, roles and permissions, integrations, testing, and change management.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to work across business and technical teams, lead solution decisions, and coordinate partners without direct people-management authority.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with CRM, HR/payroll, manufacturing, project management, or other enterprise business applications and their integrations.
  • Familiarity with SuiteScript and SuiteCloud sufficient to evaluate, troubleshoot, or make limited enhancements.
  • Experience supporting multi-subsidiary, manufacturing, service, or project-based ERP environments.
  • Experience supporting multi-subsidiary environments and managing implementation or managed-services partners.

Licensing & Special Requirements:

  • Subject to a criminal background check.

Working Conditions:

Work is performed in an office or remote office environment. Must be able to sit or stand for long periods of time.

会社概要

BoostDraftは、契約書をはじめとする法的文書の作成・レビューを効率化するプロダクトを開発・提供するリーガルテック企業です。
2021年にMITとStanford大学院の卒業生が創業し、現在6年目を迎えています。プロダクトへの圧倒的な信頼を武器に、口コミを中心に急拡大。創業2年目には純利益1億円を達成するなど、着実に成長してきました。現在は日本の5大法律事務所すべてを含む、国内外800社以上にご利用いただいており、韓国・シンガポール・米国・英国にも展開しています。
詳細はこちら: BoostDraft Company Deck

採用背景

BoostDraftはいま、APAC事業の成長に伴い、チームがこの1年で約1.5倍に拡大しています。プロダクトには確かな手応えがある一方、組織はまだ小さく、一人ひとりの仕事が会社全体に影響するフェーズです。
累計導入社数は1,000社を超え、利用のされ方も業種や部門ごとに多様化しています。さらに近年は生成AIの普及によって、お客様の業務のあり方そのものも変わりつつあります。これらの動きに伴い、既存のお客様企業内における複数部門への展開や新たな活用方法のご提案など、今まで以上に深くBoostDraftの活用方法をご提案できる機会が増えてきました。
一方で、お客様ごとに最適な活用方法を提案し、取引を広げていく体制はこれから強化していく段階にあります。そこで今回、既存のお客様を担当し、活用の定着から追加のご提案、契約までを一貫して担うメンバーを募集する運びとなりました。

想定業務

担当する既存のお客様について、導入後の活用定着から追加のご提案、契約の更新までを一貫して担っていただきます。担当アカウントの継続率と、アカウントあたりの取引額の拡大に責任を負うポジションです。担当するお客様が成果を出し、その結果として取引が広がっている状態をつくることを、このポジションのゴールとしています。

上記を実現するために、具体的には以下を担当いただきます。

  • 顧客理解と関係構築：利用状況・業務課題の把握、現場のキーパーソンから決裁者までのリレーション構築

  • 商談推進とクロージング：提案資料の作成、商談、条件交渉、契約更新の実施
  • アカウントプランの設計：重点顧客の見極めと、成長シナリオの立案・実行
  • 案件管理：CRMを活用したパイプラインおよび売上進捗の管理
  • 社内連携：プロダクト・マーケティング・セールス各部門との連携、およびお客様の声のプロダクトへの還元

  • 法人営業、カスタマーサクセス、またはアカウントマネジメントの実務経験3年以上

歓迎 -

求める人物像
