jobs.excerpt: BioAge Labs (BIOA) is finding new ways to treat disease by targeting the mechanisms of aging, with the ultimate goal of increasing healthy human lifespan.
jobs.description:
BioAge Labs (BIOA) is finding new ways to treat disease by targeting the mechanisms of aging, with the ultimate goal of increasing healthy human lifespan.

(Senior) Manager, Contracts, Budgets & Outsourcing

BioAge is seeking to hire a (Senior) Manager, Contracts, Budgets & Outsourcing to run day-to-day vendor contracting and R&D budget operations across our clinical development programs. Reporting to the Vice President, R&D Operations, this individual contributor will own the contract lifecycle with CROs, CDMOs and other R&D service providers, from RFP through close-out. The role also oversees CRO-managed site contracting and keeps program budgets, forecasts and monthly accruals accurate. It partners daily with Clinical Operations, CMC, Non-Clinical, Legal, Finance and Quality Assurance. This is a fully remote position open to candidates across the continental US, and a chance to help build scalable outsourcing processes as BioAge’s pipeline grows.

Essential Job Duties

  • Run the end-to-end outsourcing process for clinical, CMC and non-clinical vendors: RFP preparation, bid grids, proposal review, bid defenses and vendor selection recommendations.
  • Maintain RFP, budget and contract templates, and contribute to the preferred vendor list in partnership with Quality Assurance.
  • Serve as the day-to-day commercial point of contact for CROs, CDMOs and specialty vendors (central labs, IRT, imaging, eCOA).
  • Track vendor performance against contracted scope, timelines and budget, and escalate issues to the VP, R&D Operations and functional leads.
  • Draft, negotiate and execute MSAs, work orders, SOWs, CDAs, change orders and amendments, working with Legal on terms.
  • Negotiate scopes of work, pricing and payment schedules with input from functional stakeholders.
  • Oversee CRO-managed site contracting:
    • approve site budget templates and negotiation parameters
    • review investigator grant budgets against fair-market-value benchmarks
    • track CTA execution and site payments
  • Own the contract, change order and change notification trackers so every agreement, amendment and PO has a current status.
  • Build cost estimates for new studies and study scenarios, and maintain program- and study-level budgets and forecasts.
  • Prepare monthly clinical and CMC accruals with function heads and Finance, and reconcile vendor invoices and pass-through costs against contracts and work performed.
  • Assess the cost and timeline impact of proposed scope changes before they are approved.
  • Raise purchase order requests with correct coding, and review and approve vendor invoices.
  • Report budget-vs-actual variances and prepare materials for program reviews and quarterly forecasts.
  • Help build and document outsourcing, contracting and accrual processes (SOPs, work instructions, approval workflows) for a growing company.
  • Keep contract files inspection- and audit-ready, and support QA, audit and SOX-related requests.
  • Participate in special projects and initiatives as assigned by the VP, R&D Operations.

Required Skills & Abilities

  • Working knowledge of clinical trial execution (start-up, maintenance, close-out) and how those activities drive vendor and site costs.
  • Hands-on experience negotiating budgets and contracts with CROs, CDMOs and other R&D service providers.
  • Solid understanding of clinical trial costing: budget creation, forecasting, accruals and reconciliation.
  • Experience overseeing CRO-managed site budgets, CTAs and investigator grants, including fair-market-value benchmarking.
  • Demonstrated expertise in advanced Excel (including lookup functions, pivot tables, and scenario modeling) is required. Familiarity with contract lifecycle management tools, or ERP/PO systems is preferred.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including summaries for senior leaders.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage many agreements and deadlines at once.
  • Comfortable working independently in a lean, fast-paced team and handling both strategy and administration.

Education & Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, life sciences or a related field.
  • 6+ years of biotech, pharma or CRO experience, including 3+ years in clinical outsourcing, contracts, or clinical budgets and accruals.
  • Direct experience negotiating vendor SOWs, change orders and budgets.
  • Direct experience working with POs
  • Experience working closely with R&D functions and Finance.

Preferred

  • Experience at a small or mid-size biotech where the role covered outsourcing, contracting and budgeting together.
  • Exposure to CMC/CDMO and non-clinical contracts in addition to clinical.
  • Experience supporting Phase 1–3 studies through start-up and enrollment.
  • Proven ability to work independently and communicate effectively in a fully remote team.
  • Experience supporting audits, SOX controls or public-company accrual processes.
  • Advanced degree or contract management certification.

Our company

BioAge is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company harnessing the biology of human aging to develop new therapies for metabolic diseases. The Company’s human-first discovery platform analyzes proprietary multi-omics data captured over decades to identify molecular pathways that drive metabolic aging and disease. BioAge’s lead program, BGE-102, is a potent, orally available, brain-penetrant NLRP3 inhibitor being developed for diseases driven by inflammation. The Company is also advancing oral and injectable APJ agonists—exercise mimetics with the potential to enhance incretin-driven weight loss and restore healthy body composition in obesity. BioAge’s discovery platform is validated by ongoing research collaborations with Novartis and Lilly. BioAge has been listed on Nasdaq (BIOA) since 2024. For additional information about BioAge, visit the company’s website at

Our workplace

BioAge offers competitive salary, a comprehensive compensation package, and generous paid time off in addition to company-observed holidays. We provide comprehensive health and wellness benefits (medical, dental, and vision insurance) and a 401(k) retirement savings plan with matching employer contributions, and we support families through childcare and fertility benefits. We also pride ourselves in giving employees many opportunities for career development, including a generous annual budget for continued learning and a dedication to training and skill development. Many positions (including this one) are remote, allowing our team members to work from anywhere. The salary for this role is expected to be approximately $150,000 - $175,000, depending on experience. We are open to the concept that different experience levels add value to the team in different ways, and therefore will consider a variety of experience and offer commensurate pay.

At BioAge, we embrace diversity and differences while we learn from each other, and we believe that every team member has an important role to play. We are an equal opportunity employer. BioAge prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. BioAge conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Sales, Finance, Customer Success, Pharmacy Operations, Product, and Engineering to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Commercial Strategy & Pricing Analyst to help Bask Health evaluate pricing opportunities, develop commercial recommendations, and make informed decisions about merchant agreements.

You'll work with Sales, Finance, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to analyze proposed pricing structures, evaluate deal economics, and understand how commercial decisions affect revenue and profitability.

This role focuses on the analytical side of commercial strategy. You'll build financial models, compare pricing scenarios, assess proposed discounts and contract terms, and help teams understand the financial trade-offs involved in different commercial arrangements.

You'll also analyze existing merchant relationships to identify opportunities for improved pricing, stronger margins, and more sustainable commercial agreements.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving business problems, working with financial data, and turning analysis into clear recommendations that help teams make decisions.

What You'll Do

  • Analyze proposed merchant pricing arrangements and commercial agreements.
  • Build financial models to evaluate deal economics, revenue potential, costs, and margins.
  • Compare different pricing structures and identify their financial implications.
  • Evaluate proposed discounts, fees, and commercial terms.
  • Prepare pricing recommendations for new merchant opportunities and existing accounts.
  • Partner with Sales to support pricing discussions and commercial proposals.
  • Work with Finance to validate financial assumptions and profitability estimates.
  • Analyze merchant spending patterns and identify opportunities for commercial improvements.
  • Evaluate the potential impact of contract changes on revenue and margins.
  • Develop pricing scenarios that balance merchant value with Bask's commercial objectives.
  • Review existing commercial arrangements and identify opportunities for renegotiation or restructuring.
  • Support the development of consistent pricing evaluation frameworks.
  • Analyze product-level and merchant-level economics to inform commercial decisions.
  • Compare proposed pricing against relevant internal benchmarks and cost assumptions.
  • Identify commercial risks related to pricing, discounts, or contract structures.
  • Prepare financial summaries and recommendations for internal stakeholders.
  • Support Customer Success with pricing analysis for merchant renewals and expansion opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Revenue Operations to improve commercial approval and pricing review processes.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of pricing assumptions, commercial proposals, and analysis results.
  • Track the outcomes of pricing decisions and evaluate their financial performance.
  • Identify patterns in commercial agreements that may affect profitability.
  • Analyze how changes in supplier costs or merchant activity affect deal economics.
  • Work with Pharmacy Operations to understand cost considerations affecting commercial proposals.
  • Support pricing-related reporting and recurring commercial performance reviews.
  • Identify opportunities to improve pricing consistency across merchant segments.
  • Help develop templates and tools that make commercial analysis more efficient.
  • Collaborate with Billing Operations to ensure approved pricing terms are clearly documented for implementation.
  • Communicate analytical findings to Sales, Finance, and other stakeholders.
  • Support cross-functional commercial strategy projects as business needs evolve.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in commercial strategy, pricing analysis, financial analysis, deal strategy, or a related field.
  • Experience evaluating pricing proposals, commercial agreements, or deal profitability.
  • Strong financial modeling skills, including the ability to compare multiple pricing scenarios.
  • Experience analyzing revenue, costs, margins, and profitability.
  • Advanced spreadsheet skills, including formulas, scenario modeling, and financial analysis.
  • Strong understanding of commercial pricing decisions and their financial implications.
  • Ability to evaluate discounts, pricing structures, and contract economics.
  • Experience translating financial analysis into clear business recommendations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Experience working with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, or commercial teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain financial trade-offs to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience preparing pricing analyses, commercial summaries, or business cases.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned analyses.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.
  • Availability to collaborate during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.
  • Ability to handle confidential financial and commercial information responsibly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting commercial pricing decisions for a SaaS or technology company.
  • Experience working with B2B merchant or e-commerce platforms.
  • Familiarity with subscription, transaction-based, or usage-based pricing.
  • Experience supporting Deal Desk or commercial approval processes.
  • Experience evaluating nonstandard pricing arrangements or customer discounts.
  • Familiarity with telehealth or healthcare technology.
  • Understanding of cash-pay healthcare business models.
  • Experience analyzing pharmacy, fulfillment, or service delivery costs.
  • Experience supporting merchant contract renewals or expansion opportunities.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM platforms.
  • Experience using SQL for commercial or financial analysis.
  • Experience with Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar reporting tools.
  • Experience developing pricing templates or financial approval frameworks.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams on commercial negotiations.
  • Experience working in a growing SaaS or technology company.

About GoCharting

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading platform. Traders use professional orderflow tools — footprint charts, volume and market profile, cumulative delta, DOM trading — to read the market and place orders through their broker, all in the browser. Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world.

The Role

You will run GoCharting's partnership operations. Every inbound request lands with you first: SDK and library integrations, brokers and data providers, media and advertising, creators and communities, affiliates and resellers. You read it, qualify it, answer it, and either close it, run it yourself or pass it upward. You also own the CRM that tracks every partner, creator and lead, so that nothing goes quiet and every campaign and integration starts from a warm, verified list.

The role is full-time and remote from Europe, reports to the Senior Integrated Marketing Manager, and works with colleagues in Europe, US and India. This is an immediate need. You work hands-on: you personally process the inbound queue, run the follow-ups and keep the CRM current. Large and strategic partnerships are handled by the partnerships lead, and the community channels GoCharting already runs belong to the community lead.

What you'll do

  • Process every inbound — read each request, sort it by type (SDK or library integration, broker or data provider, media or advertising, creator or community, affiliate or reseller, other), qualify it against our criteria, and reply, move it forward or decline it politely
  • Run the smaller partners end to end — onboard them, agree terms within an approved budget or framework, send briefs and assets, set up tracked and referral links, and make sure deliverables land on time

  • Own the relationship CRM — keep partners, creators, communities and inbound leads in one system with clean stages, owners and next steps
  • Report on results — show inbound volume, response time, conversion by type, pipeline health and spend against results every week
  • Hand off upward — pass large, strategic and legally heavy partnerships to the partnerships lead with full context, and coordinate with product, engineering, marketing and finance on the rest

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • 3+ years in partnerships operations, business development or sales operations, or account and relationship management, owning the follow-through yourself

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.
Join one of the Philippines' fastest-growing tech companies! Open to Philippine-based candidates only.
About the Role
As a QA Analyst, you will support our client's Microsoft Fabric implementation by ensuring that data pipelines, transformations, notebooks, lakehouses, warehouses, and reporting models work as expected and meet business and technical requirements.
This is a hands-on role focused on data quality, SQL and PySpark validation, ETL/ELT testing, and test automation. You will develop and execute test plans, validate data across different systems, identify defects, and work closely with developers, data analysts, QA teams, and project stakeholders to ensure the reliability and accuracy of the data platform.
We're looking for someone with strong experience in data warehouse testing and advanced SQL, along with practical experience using Python or PySpark. Experience with Microsoft Fabric is important, particularly in testing and validating data pipelines and related components.
Key Responsibilities
  • Test Planning and Strategy: Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on business and technical requirements. Ensure testing activities cover key requirements, business rules, and implementation risks.
  • Data Validation: Use SQL and PySpark to validate source-to-target mappings, data transformations, data types, aggregations, business rules, duplicates, null values, and reconciliation results.
  • ETL/ELT Testing: Test data pipelines and integration processes to ensure data is properly extracted, transformed, and loaded into the target environment.
  • Microsoft Fabric Testing: Perform functional, integration, and regression testing across Fabric pipelines, notebooks, lakehouses, warehouses, SQL analytics endpoints, and semantic models.
  • Data Quality Assurance: Verify data completeness, accuracy, consistency, referential integrity, and incremental-load behavior across source and target systems.
  • Performance and Reliability Testing: Validate pipeline performance, processing times, scalability, error handling, logging, monitoring, and recovery processes.
  • Defect Management: Identify, document, and track defects using Azure DevOps or other approved QA tools. Work with developers to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and perform retesting.
  • Test Automation: Develop reusable SQL scripts, PySpark notebooks, reconciliation utilities, and automated regression tests to improve testing efficiency and coverage.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Maintain test plans, test cases, traceability matrices, test evidence, defect reports, and testing summaries.
  • Team Collaboration: Work closely with QA, data engineering, development, data analytics, and project management teams to clarify requirements, communicate testing progress, and address data quality issues.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in software quality assurance, particularly in data warehouse, ETL/ELT, data integration, or analytics testing.
  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience testing or validating Microsoft Fabric solutions.
  • Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, common table expressions (CTEs), aggregations, reconciliation queries, and query troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience with Python or PySpark for data validation, transformations, dataset comparisons, and automated testing.
  • Experience developing and executing test strategies, test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test reports.
  • Strong understanding of ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing concepts, data lake/lakehouse architecture, and dimensional modeling.
  • Experience validating source-to-target mappings, data transformations, and business rules.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric components such as Data Factory pipelines, notebooks, lakehouses, warehouses, and SQL analytics endpoints.
  • Experience identifying, documenting, tracking, and retesting defects using Azure DevOps or similar tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate data discrepancies and communicate findings clearly.
Nice to Have:
  • Experience testing Delta Lake tables and medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers).
  • Experience with Azure services such as Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Key Vault, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience working with different data sources and formats, including Oracle, SQL Server, APIs, CSV, XML, JSON, and Parquet.
  • Experience building automated SQL/PySpark validation or reconciliation frameworks.
  • Familiarity with performance testing, data pipeline monitoring, and production readiness validation.

Benefits

About Us
Full Scale is a fully remote-first company that helps businesses build dedicated teams of skilled software engineers. We make it easier for growing companies to find, onboard, and retain high-performing software talent.
Why work for us:
  • 100% remote work setup.
  • Work from anywhere in the Philippines.
  • Opportunity to work on a Microsoft Fabric implementation project.
  • Hands-on experience with modern data engineering and cloud data technologies.
  • Collaboration with experienced QA, data engineering, and development teams.
  • Opportunity to contribute to improving enterprise data quality, reliability, and automation.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

HOW WE WORK

You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Revenue Operations to develop reporting, analyze commercial performance, and connect information across our merchant accounts, sales pipeline, contracts, and revenue systems.

This role focuses on making commercial data more reliable and useful. You'll build dashboards, investigate trends, identify data quality issues, and help teams understand how sales activity and merchant relationships contribute to business performance.

You'll also support the development of consistent metrics and reporting processes that help leadership make informed decisions about acquisition, retention, expansion, and commercial priorities.

  • Technical leadership: Build working knowledge of the systems, APIs, and data flows within your program scope; partner with Principal Engineers and architects to shape technical approach; ramp up quickly across domains like monetization, identity and access, enterprise integrations, and real estate SaaS/lead delivery.

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.excerpt: You: The voice behind PLF's daily presence on social media.
jobs.description:
You: The voice behind PLF's daily presence on social media. Every day, government officials trample someone's rights, and every day PLF's freedom fighters push back in court. Your job is to make sure people see it. You'll take a dense case filing or a new legislative initiative and turn it into a post that stops the scroll. You know an exciting story when you hear one and you’re able to maximize its impact online. When you're nailing it, more Americans know PLF is a best-in-class public interest law firm, and donors, legislators, and journalists respond.

Them: Bureaucrats, city councils, mayors, governors, and federal agencies stripping Americans of their rights every day. There's a lot of government overreach out there, and it's backed by seemingly endless resources. But fortunately, like all lumbering giants, abusive government is most vulnerable when countered by individuals who act strategically and nimbly, take calculated risks, have each other's backs, and are confident in and passionate about the cause—the very sort of swashbucklers we employ in spades here at PLF. And a giant's overreach only stays hidden if nobody tells the story.

Us: We fight back. Pacific Legal Foundation is the nation's first and most successful public interest law firm dedicated to vindicating individual liberty. PLF has an unmatched record in the United States Supreme Court, with 18 victories out of 21 litigated at the Court. We also have more than two hundred active cases across the nation.

We are a next-generation public interest law firm. That means we aren't interested in doing the same thing as everyone else. We aspire to be the best player in a constantly changing game.

Here's what you get to do in this role

You'll report to our Social Media Manager who is responsible for increasing output while maintaining quality on PLF’s social media channels. You'll write, design, and schedule content every day. You'll turn case updates, legislative wins, and event news into posts, graphics, carousels, and short videos. The social media team works within our Case Publicity team to tell client stories, shape the narrative around our issues, and highlight the work of our attorneys. You’ll also collaborate with our Content Marketing, Media Relations, and Digital Marketing teams. That way, what we post lines up with what's happening in our cases.

Here's the twist: we know great social media people don't all have the same strengths. Some are wordsmiths who can make a property rights case sing in 280 characters. Others are storytellers behind a camera who can cut a 90-second video that people actually finish. We want you to bring your strongest skill and grow the others.

We’re building a best-in-class social media presence and want you to bring your unique set of skills to help us continually level up. Stick with it, and you'll learn the platforms, our audience, and our cases inside and out.

Here's where you'll spend your time:

  • Writing, designing, and publishing daily posts in Sprout Social and Canva, and scheduling them ahead for the Social Media Manager's approval
  • Boosting the volume and consistency of our case update and legislative posts, including carousel copy and graphics that promote our cases
  • Owning event promotion on social, with graphics and copy for LinkedIn
  • Filming and editing short-form video (potentially on location, with our clients and staff), and writing scripts for on-camera talent to deliver
  • Replying to comments, growing our followers, and handling routine upkeep on each platform
  • Building tracking links (UTMs) to measure how social drives traffic to our website, and sharing what's working with the team
  • Checking facts with our attorneys and massaging messaging so every post gets the story right

This role is ideal for someone with 2-4 years of experience professionally, in environments like a think tank, NGO, newsroom, agency, or political campaign. We're looking for:

  • A clear strength in either social copywriting or short-form video.
  • A strong sense of storytelling and the ability to put the most interesting facts at the front to grab audience attention.
  • A portfolio that showcases your strengths as a communicator. We want to see your work, so this one is required (see below).
  • Comfort reading case summaries and asking attorneys questions until you're sure the details are right. In our line of work, accuracy isn't optional.
  • The ability to run a daily publishing calendar without dropping deadlines, even when news breaks and plans change.
  • Working knowledge of Canva and a scheduling tool like Sprout Social. If you haven't used them, we'll teach you. Just be ready to learn fast.
  • A genuine passion for individual liberty, constitutional law, and helping real people fight back against government overreach.

The right person is relentless about getting the story right, confident enough to pitch a bold idea, and quick to elevate the teammates around them.

General Information

Pacific Legal Foundation identifies and litigates important legal issues to set landmark precedents that will benefit Americans nationwide. Using strategic and principled litigation, communications, and research, we battle for freedom in the nation's courts and the court of public opinion.

As a national nonprofit organization, PLF has brick-and-mortar offices in Sacramento, California and Arlington, Virginia, although approximately half of the staff work from home offices across the country. You can work physically in any of our offices or work virtually.

Salary range and benefits

This is a full-time, permanent position with a starting salary range of $60,000–$70,000. Exceptions may be considered for candidates with exceptional experience, education, professional background, or proven results in previous roles. PLF is committed to recruiting and retaining the highest-quality talent nationwide and offers a total compensation package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a generous 403(b) company contribution, life and disability insurance, paid leave and wellness leave, and 3 weeks of paid time off. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

How to apply

jobs.title: YouTube Growth & Strategy Manager
jobs.excerpt: Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years.
jobs.description:
Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years. Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia.

YouTube Growth & Strategy Manager

About the Role

Newsweek is seeking a data-driven, creative, and commercially minded YouTube Growth & Strategy Manager to accelerate audience growth, improve video performance, and drive revenue across our YouTube channels.

As a member of Newsweek’s Video Department, this role will help shape the growth and monetization strategy for our primary YouTube channel and portfolio of show-specific channels, working across both YouTube Shorts and long-form video content.

The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of YouTube’s discovery and monetization ecosystem with hands-on content creation or production experience, strong analytical capabilities, and a proven ability to translate audience insights into measurable business results.

This is more than a channel optimization role. We are looking for someone who can identify what makes video content successful on YouTube, recommend changes to programming and production, develop strategies that increase viewership and revenue, and collaborate with producers and cross-functional teams to execute those strategies.

The successful candidate will be equally comfortable analyzing revenue and audience performance, developing video concepts, optimizing content packaging, and identifying new opportunities to grow the commercial value of Newsweek’s YouTube business.

Key Responsibilities

YouTube Strategy, Growth & Monetization

  • Develop and execute YouTube growth strategies designed to increase audience reach, engagement, subscribers, and revenue across Newsweek’s main and show-specific channels.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities to increase YouTube advertising revenue through improved programming, stronger audience retention, increased monetized viewership, and content optimization.
  • Analyze revenue performance and monetization metrics, including RPM, CPM, estimated revenue, monetized playbacks, and revenue by content format, to inform strategic decisions.
  • Recommend content formats, programming strategies, and channel improvements that balance audience growth with revenue potential.
  • Identify opportunities to expand monetization through long-form videos, Shorts, live programming, and other YouTube revenue features.
  • Evaluate channel performance, audience behavior, competitive trends, and platform developments to identify new opportunities for growth.
  • Develop channel-specific recommendations tailored to different audiences, editorial topics, and content formats.

Video Optimization & YouTube SEO

  • Lead hands-on optimization of YouTube titles, descriptions, thumbnails, keywords, metadata, playlists, and discovery features.
  • Develop SEO strategies to improve visibility across YouTube search, recommendations, and other discovery surfaces.
  • Analyze click-through rates, audience retention, traffic sources, and viewing behavior to identify opportunities to improve video performance.
  • Develop and evaluate tests involving thumbnails, titles, video packaging, publishing strategies, and content formats.
  • Identify opportunities to refresh existing content, extend video lifecycles, and generate additional viewership and revenue from Newsweek’s video library.
  • Establish scalable optimization standards and best practices across Newsweek’s YouTube portfolio.

Video Ideation & Content Development

  • Partner with video producers, editors, and editorial teams to develop new video concepts, formats, and programming opportunities informed by audience data and revenue potential.
  • Provide actionable creative feedback on video structure, hooks, pacing, storytelling, length, and presentation to improve viewer engagement and retention.
  • Use performance data, competitive research, and monetization insights to identify high-potential topics, recurring franchises, and commercially attractive programming opportunities.
  • Participate in content planning before production to help incorporate YouTube audience insights into creative decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to adapt existing Newsweek journalism and editorial coverage into compelling YouTube-native formats.
  • Balance audience and commercial objectives with Newsweek’s editorial standards, brand voice, and journalistic mission.

YouTube Marketing & Audience Development

  • Develop organic and paid YouTube marketing strategies to expand content reach, attract new viewers, grow subscribers, and support revenue objectives.
  • Collaborate with marketing and audience development teams on cross-platform promotion and audience acquisition initiatives.
  • Identify influencer, creator, and channel collaboration opportunities that can expand reach and contribute to audience and business growth.
  • Recommend paid promotional campaigns where appropriate, including audience targeting, budget allocation, performance measurement, and return-on-investment analysis.
  • Develop strategies to improve audience engagement, returning viewership, and community participation.
  • Explore opportunities to convert YouTube viewers into deeper engagement with Newsweek content and programming.

Analytics, Revenue Reporting & Performance

  • Own ongoing analysis and reporting of YouTube audience and revenue performance across assigned channels.
  • Track and interpret key metrics including advertising revenue, RPM, CPM, monetized playbacks, views, watch time, click-through rates, audience retention, engaged views, subscriber growth, and returning viewers.
  • Build reporting frameworks and dashboards that connect audience performance with monetization and business outcomes.
  • Identify the content categories, programming formats, and distribution strategies that generate the strongest audience and revenue results.
  • Evaluate the financial and audience impact of optimization, programming, and marketing initiatives.
  • Provide regular recommendations to Video leadership on opportunities to improve performance, grow revenue, and allocate resources toward high-performing content.
  • Partner with relevant commercial teams to provide audience insights that can support sponsorship opportunities and the broader video revenue strategy.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Newsweek’s video producers, editors, editorial leadership, marketing, audience development, and commercial teams.
  • Serve as the Video Department’s subject-matter expert on YouTube growth, optimization, and monetization best practices.
  • Influence content development and production decisions through data, performance insights, and collaborative relationships.
  • Communicate business and audience performance clearly to producers and senior leadership, translating analytics into actionable recommendations.
  • Support consistent workflows, performance benchmarks, and optimization practices across Newsweek’s channels.

Qualifications

Required

  • Demonstrated success growing YouTube channels, improving video performance, or developing successful YouTube growth strategies.
  • Deep understanding of YouTube’s recommendation and discovery systems, SEO, content packaging, audience engagement, and monetization fundamentals.
  • Strong working knowledge of YouTube Studio, YouTube Analytics, and relevant optimization tools.
  • Hands-on experience optimizing video titles, thumbnails, descriptions, metadata, and distribution strategies.
  • Strong analytical skills and demonstrated ability to turn performance data into actionable creative and business recommendations.
  • Understanding of content creation and video production workflows, including the elements that drive performance for both Shorts and long-form videos.
  • Experience developing or supporting digital video marketing and audience growth initiatives.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence creative, editorial, and business stakeholders without direct management authority.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple departments and manage competing priorities.
  • A proactive, experimental mindset focused on testing ideas, measuring outcomes, and improving results.

Preferred

  • Previous experience within a news organization, digital publisher, media company, or established YouTube-first content business.
  • Direct experience creating, producing, editing, or developing successful YouTube videos.
  • Experience managing or optimizing multiple YouTube channels or distinct content franchises.
  • Experience managing paid YouTube promotion, creator partnerships, influencer collaborations, or digital audience acquisition campaigns.
  • Familiarity with vidIQ, TubeBuddy, Google Trends, Google Ads, or comparable tools.
  • Experience working toward defined audience growth, advertising revenue, or other commercial KPIs.
  • Experience using RPM, CPM, monetization data, and content profitability insights to inform programming and distribution decisions.
  • Experience collaborating with producers and editorial teams to shape content strategy using performance insights.

What Success Looks Like

The primary objective of this role is to drive sustainable YouTube revenue growth through smarter content strategy, stronger audience performance, and improved monetization.

Success will be measured by the ability to translate audience insights and YouTube expertise into meaningful financial results for Newsweek’s Video Department.

Key outcomes include:

  • Revenue Growth: Measurable growth in YouTube advertising revenue across Newsweek’s main and show-specific channels, with clear strategies and initiatives contributing to that growth.
  • Monetization Performance: Improved revenue efficiency through stronger monetized viewership, effective content strategies, and optimization of RPM and other revenue drivers.
  • Revenue-Driven Content Strategy: Identification and development of video formats, topics, and programming opportunities that attract audiences while generating sustainable revenue.
  • Audience Growth: Consistent increases in views, watch time, returning viewers, and subscribers, with particular emphasis on audience growth that contributes to long-term monetization.
  • Video Performance: Improved click-through rates, audience retention, and discovery performance through better video packaging, creative recommendations, and optimization.
  • Commercial Opportunities: Identification of content and audience opportunities that support sponsorships, partnerships, and new revenue-generating video initiatives.
  • Data-Informed Decision-Making: Demonstrated ability to use audience and financial performance data to influence programming, production, marketing investment, and channel strategy.
  • Cross-Functional Impact: Strong adoption of YouTube best practices across production and editorial teams, resulting in measurable improvements to both content performance and business outcomes.

Compensation

The expected annual base salary for this full-time, remote, U.S.-based position is $85,000–$105,000, depending on qualifications, experience, and relevant expertise.

Newsweek is an equal opportunity employer. We seek employees of diverse backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, equitable and respectful workplace.

Pre-Contract & Estimating

  • Review and log incoming bid requests in the project management/CRM system.
  • Review construction plans, drawings, specifications, and project manuals.
  • Research and document project requirements, including construction type, square footage, stories, taxes, warranties, maintenance agreements, insurance, bonds, and other requirements.
  • Research local AHJ requirements, fire codes, ERRCS policies, radio systems, frequencies, and permit requirements.
  • Coordinate with AHJs to confirm enforcement, testing, plan review, permitting, and inspection requirements.

  • Support budgetary pricing and prepare project quotes.

  • Coordinate pricing for equipment, electrical, fire alarm, roofing, and other project requirements.
  • Track sales tax, shipping, warranties, maintenance agreements, and other project costs.
  • Maintain executed contracts and project records.

Pre-Installation Documentation

  • Prepare, format, organize, and distribute project submittals to customers, installers, and AHJs.
  • Coordinate building plans, certifications, permits, equipment documentation, system designs, reports, and trade coordination documents.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a polished, proactive, and detail-oriented Virtual Back Office Patient Care Coordinator / Concierge to manage clinical scheduling, patient membership coordination, and behind-the-scenes administrative operations for a U.S. healthcare practice. In this full-time remote role, you will ensure providers' calendars run at peak efficiency, coordinate seamless patient follow-ups, verify insurance details, and deliver high-touch concierge support that elevates the patient experience.

Because this role requires direct communication with patients, clinical providers, and insurance representatives, exceptional, accent-neutral English communication and strong organizational instincts are non-negotiable requirements. You must be comfortable managing multi-provider schedules independently, maintaining accurate patient records, and operating in full compliance with HIPAA privacy standards.

Working Environment & Core Schedule

  • Role Title: Virtual Back Office Patient Care Coordinator / Concierge
  • Status: Full-Time (40 Hours / Week)
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST
  • Core Systems: Electronic Health Record (EHR) / Practice Management System, VoIP Phone & SMS Platform, Insurance Payer Portals, Membership/CRM Tracking Tools
  • Primary Scope: Provider Calendar Optimization, Concierge Patient & Membership Follow-Ups, Insurance Verification, and Daily Provider Administrative Support

Top 3 Daily Tasks

  1. Provider Schedule Optimization: Actively manage, audit, and optimize daily provider calendars—filling schedule gaps, balancing appointment types, and preventing bottlenecks.
  2. Patient & Membership Care Coordination: Conduct proactive outbound follow-ups for upcoming visits, missed appointments, care plans, and patient membership renewals or inquiries.
  3. Insurance Verification & Back-Office Support: Verify patient insurance eligibility, update demographic and coverage records in the EHR, and execute daily administrative tasks requested by providers.

Core Responsibilities

  • Provider Calendar Management: Build, monitor, and optimize provider schedules in the EHR, adjusting for provider availability, appointment durations, and clinic workflow rules.
  • Patient Appointment & Follow-Up Coordination: Coordinate initial consultations, recurring visits, and post-visit follow-ups, ensuring patients receive timely reminders, intake forms, and care instructions.
  • Concierge & Membership Follow-Ups: Serve as a dedicated point of contact for practice members and patients—tracking membership renewals, answering program questions, and ensuring high retention and satisfaction.
  • Insurance Verification & Chart Accuracy: Perform routine insurance eligibility checks, collect and update patient demographics and policy details, and flag coverage issues prior to appointments.
  • Provider Administrative Support: Assist clinicians with daily non-clinical workflows, including routing clinical messages, organizing medical records/referrals, and preparing daily schedule huddles.
  • General Back-Office Operations: Handle digital faxes, inbox triage, task queues, and ad-hoc administrative projects while maintaining strict HIPAA confidentiality.

Requirements

  • U.S. Healthcare Coordination Experience: 2+ years of experience in medical scheduling, patient coordination, healthcare concierge services, or back-office medical administration.
  • Accent-Neutral English & Concierge Communication: Clear, natural, and accent-neutral spoken and written English with a warm, polished, and service-driven demeanor.
  • Schedule & Calendar Management Mastery: Proven ability to manage complex, multi-provider schedules and proactively resolve cancellations or scheduling conflicts.
  • Insurance & EHR Proficiency: Solid familiarity with U.S. health insurance eligibility verification, medical terminology, and navigating EHR/practice management platforms.
  • Exclusive Full-Time Commitment: Full availability to work 40 hours per week (Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM) with no outside clients or competing employment.
  • HIPAA-Compliant Remote Workspace: Private, quiet home office with a lockable door, high-performance PC/Mac, high-speed primary internet, backup internet/power solutions, and a noise-canceling headset.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You bring hospitality-level care to healthcare administration. You anticipate provider scheduling needs before bottlenecks happen, follow up with patients and members so no one slips through the cracks, keep insurance records spotless, and operate as a reliable, self-directed right hand to the clinical team.

  • Establish scalable messaging frameworks and source-of-truth resources that enable consistent execution across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, including through AI-assisted workflows.

Market Intelligence & Strategic Insights

  • Lead the competitive and market intelligence strategy, identifying emerging threats, opportunities, and implications for ServiceTrade's commercial positioning.
  • Establish a disciplined approach to customer research, win/loss analysis, competitive assessment, and market feedback.
  • Engage directly with customers, prospects, and sales teams to understand buying decisions, competitive dynamics, and unmet market needs.
  • Translate market insights into actionable recommendations for Product, Sales, and Marketing leadership.
  • Develop and maintain practical competitive resources that improve seller confidence and influence win rates.

Go-to-Market & Commercialization Strategy

  • Lead go-to-market strategy for new products, major capabilities, and strategic portfolio initiatives.
  • Define target markets, commercial objectives, positioning, launch strategies, success metrics, and cross-functional requirements.
  • Establish launch prioritization, readiness criteria, and operating frameworks that ensure investments align with business impact.
  • Drive cross-functional launch readiness, identifying risks, resolving gaps, and influencing go/no-go recommendations.
  • Partner with Revenue Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to connect product strategy to demand generation, pipeline, adoption, and expansion.
  • Evaluate GTM performance and recommend adjustments to improve commercial outcomes.

Sales Effectiveness & Commercial Readiness

  • Define product-specific sales narratives and competitive selling strategies that strengthen differentiation and support revenue growth.
  • Establish scalable enablement resources, including pitch frameworks, objection handling, competitive guidance, and product value narratives.
  • Partner with Sales Enablement and commercial leadership to ensure customer-facing teams are prepared to position and sell new capabilities.
  • Use win/loss insights, seller feedback, and performance trends to identify gaps in commercial effectiveness.
  • Equip teams with clear, reusable materials that enable independent execution rather than reliance on Product Marketing as an intermediary.

Customer Value, Adoption & Growth

  • Partner with Product and Customer Success to identify adoption barriers, expansion opportunities, and customer value drivers.
  • Develop value propositions and use-case strategies that support acquisition, cross-sell, upsell, and retention.
  • Identify compelling customer proof points, differentiated outcomes, and opportunities to strengthen market credibility.
  • Bring a market-informed perspective to product investment and commercialization decisions.

Product Marketing Leadership & Operations

  • Establish and continuously improve the product marketing operating model, including priorities, workflows, decision frameworks, and cross-functional accountability.
  • Act as a strategic partner to Product, Sales, and Marketing leadership, bringing informed recommendations and challenging assumptions when appropriate.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on commercial impact, market opportunity, and organizational capacity.
  • Build scalable systems, frameworks, and AI-enabled resources that allow other teams to execute effectively and independently.
  • Define meaningful product marketing performance measures and communicate strategic insights, progress, and recommendations to leadership.

What Success Looks Like:

  • ServiceTrade has a clear, differentiated product narrative that connects its capabilities to customer value and competitive advantage.
  • Market and competitive insights meaningfully influence product, positioning, and commercialization decisions.
  • Product launches are strategically prioritized, commercially ready, and measured against defined business outcomes.
  • Sales teams confidently articulate ServiceTrade's value, address competitive objections, and execute product-specific selling strategies.
  • Product adoption and expansion opportunities are supported by clear segmentation, use cases, and value propositions.
  • Cross-functional teams independently leverage product marketing frameworks, insights, and resources.
  • Product Marketing operates as a proactive strategic partner to the business, not simply a producer of launch materials and sales content.

Cross-Functional Ownership:

Product Marketing sits within Marketing and owns product positioning and messaging, market and competitive intelligence, product GTM strategy, commercialization readiness, and product-specific sales enablement strategy and content.

The role partners closely with:

  • Product Management: Owns product roadmap, development, and feature prioritization. Product Marketing influences decisions through market insights, customer research, and commercial recommendations.
  • Revenue Marketing: Owns demand generation, campaign strategy and execution, and pipeline programs. Product Marketing informs audience strategy, product narratives, and GTM priorities.
  • Brand & Communications: Owns corporate positioning, brand strategy, content, PR, and external communications. Product Marketing owns product-level narratives and differentiation.
  • Sales Enablement: Owns training delivery, seller development, and enablement programs. Product Marketing owns product-specific narratives, competitive guidance, and readiness content.
  • Customer Success: Owns customer relationships, adoption programs, retention, and expansion execution. Product Marketing provides segmentation, value propositions, and customer insights to support those efforts.

A few things you’ll want to know:

What does ServiceTrade do?

ServiceTrade is a best-in-class field service management platform that helps commercial fire protection and mechanical service contractors build efficient and growing businesses. With more than a decade of innovation and 1500 customers, ServiceTrade streamlines operations from the field to the office, boosts technician productivity, and enhances the end-customer experience.

Ok, so why should I care about that?

Our customers do essential work — often behind the scenes — and our software helps them do it better. They’re smart, hardworking people, and we take pride in helping them grow their businesses, earn more revenue, employ more skilled workers, and deliver greater value to their own customers. When you work at ServiceTrade, your impact extends beyond our walls, supporting communities and markets you might never have thought about — and making work that truly matters every day.

What kind of working environment do you have?

We’re a growing business focused on building with intention and operating with purpose. You’ll have meaningful responsibility and the trust to do your best work from the start. We encourage calculated risks and bold experimentation, while providing opportunities to learn, grow, and turn today’s lessons into tomorrow’s breakthroughs—all in service of big ambitions and real customer impact.

Learn more about our culture and values on our About Us page.

What kind of benefits do you offer?

  • Flexible Spending Account and Dependant Care Account

Want to know more?

jobs.excerpt: We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity.
jobs.description:
We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this link directly.

Who we are

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

About Campana Systems

Campana Systems, a Gemini Group company within Aquila, develops specialized software solutions for AAA and CAA auto clubs across North America. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Waterloo, Ontario, Campana has built long-standing relationships with organizations that rely on its technology to manage their operations and deliver services to their members.

Our AXIS platform brings together membership management, customer relationship management, emergency roadside assistance, travel services, and business intelligence in an integrated suite of solutions. Looking ahead, we are focused on evolving our technology, strengthening our platform capabilities, and finding new ways to help our customers work more efficiently and deliver better member experiences.

Who we need

Reporting to the General Manager, we are hiring a Director, Technology to lead the evolution of Campana Systems’ technology strategy, architecture, infrastructure, and AXIS platform. In this newly created role, you will own the technology roadmap from strategy through execution, with accountability for modernization priorities, investment decisions, platform reliability, and measurable business outcomes. You will lead the Architecture and Infrastructure & Security teams, partner with the Director, Development, and establish the technical direction and capabilities needed to deliver on our product vision while supporting the customers who depend on our technology.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates across Canada, with working hours of 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Eastern Time.

What’s in it for you

Shape a meaningful transformation. You will have the autonomy to challenge established approaches, make consequential technology decisions, and guide the evolution of a business-critical software platform. You will see the impact of your work in stronger platform capabilities, improved delivery, and better customer experiences.

Build what comes next. You will lead experienced teams while shaping the standards, capabilities, and ways of working needed for the future. From strengthening engineering practices to developing technical leaders, you will have the opportunity to build a more effective technology organization and see the results of your leadership.

Grow your executive influence. You will work directly with the General Manager and contribute to decisions that connect technology investments with customer needs and business growth. Backed by Aquila and the broader Constellation Software network, you will have opportunities to expand your leadership experience and pursue broader responsibilities over time.

As our new Director, Technology, you will

  • Own the technology roadmap. You will turn the product vision into a multi-year strategy with clear priorities, investments, milestones, and measurable outcomes. You will balance modernization, technical debt, customer commitments, and platform stability, taking accountability for delivery and results. You will establish architectural standards, technology governance, and engineering priorities. Partnering with the Director, Development, you will strengthen technical decision-making, CI/CD, automation, and delivery practices across Canadian and offshore teams.

  • Lead platform modernization. You will define a phased approach to evolving AXIS, including its legacy Rocket UniVerse architecture. You will determine what to retain, integrate, replace, or modernize, guiding decisions on APIs, application architecture, CRM, data capabilities, and cloud or hybrid environments while protecting the reliability customers depend on.

  • Turn innovation into impact. You will identify opportunities to improve CRM capabilities, business intelligence, reporting, and operational efficiency through AI, automation, and better use of data. You will evaluate feasibility and business value, establish priorities, and work with technical teams to turn promising initiatives into measurable results.

  • Strengthen security and reliability. You will oversee infrastructure, hosting, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and platform resilience. You will reduce technology risk, strengthen operational controls, and advance security and compliance readiness, including SOC 2-related requirements.

  • Build and grow technical capabilities. You will lead the Architecture and Infrastructure & Security teams, develop talent, strengthen accountability, and identify capability gaps. You will improve collaboration with Development and Product to ensure teams have the direction and support needed to execute the roadmap.

  • Connect technology to business priorities. You will partner with the General Manager on technology investments, budgets, resources, and strategic decisions. You will communicate risks and trade-offs, measure progress, and contribute technical leadership to customer conversations when needed.

You bring

  • The senior technology leadership. You have led technology strategy, architecture, and technical teams within an enterprise software business, with accountability for investment decisions, organizational performance, and business outcomes. You bring the judgment to set direction, establish priorities, and deliver results through technical leaders and cross-functional teams.

  • The platform modernization expertise. You have led the evolution of complex, business-critical software, navigating legacy architecture, technical debt, and customer dependencies. You know how to assess what to retain, replace, or integrate, develop a phased modernization roadmap, and introduce new capabilities without compromising reliability.

  • The technical depth. You bring strong expertise in enterprise architecture, APIs, integrations, data platforms, and cloud or hybrid environments, along with an understanding of infrastructure, cybersecurity, and disaster recovery. You can establish technical standards, evaluate emerging technologies, and guide decisions that strengthen platform performance, security, and scalability.

  • The experience driving innovation. You have improved engineering practices and delivery performance across distributed teams, including those outside your direct reporting structure. You understand CI/CD, automation, and modern development practices, and can identify practical opportunities for AI, analytics, and business intelligence that deliver measurable value.

  • The business acumen. You connect technology decisions to customer needs, financial priorities, and long-term business growth. You can evaluate investments, communicate complex trade-offs, and align senior leaders while staying close enough to the technology to challenge assumptions and guide execution.

  • The influence. You develop strong technical leaders, establish accountability, and build cross-functional, cross-location collaboration. You are comfortable making difficult decisions, navigating competing priorities, and owning outcomes in an environment where you have the autonomy to shape what comes next.

Why join?

Axis Campana and Aquila are part of Constellation Software Inc., one of Canada's largest and most successful software companies and its most successful technology stock over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fibre, you will thrive at Aquila.

Compensation

At Campana and Aquila, we believe compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of both experience and impact. The salary range for this role is CAD $150,000 to $200,000 plus bonus.

Compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the scope and complexity of the role. We value open conversations about compensation and are happy to discuss our approach at any stage of the hiring process.

Apply now.

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.

  • An interview with the General Manager to discuss your technology leadership experience, approach to platform modernization, architectural decision-making, and ability to connect technology strategy to business outcomes.

  • A final virtual interview with the Portfolio Manager and members of the technology leadership team to explore your approach to leading transformation, collaborating across teams, and building the capabilities needed to execute the technology roadmap.

Aquila and Campana Systems promote equal employment opportunities for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, marital status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and accommodations are available on request.

This role exists to make that delivery happen: owning the plan, driving the workstreams, and keeping senior stakeholders informed and unblocked.

  • Prior PMO experience inside a legal function
  • Comfort with ambiguity: able to create structure and process where none yet exists.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex status for executive audiences.
  • High discretion and sound judgement on confidential, sensitive matters.

  • Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
  • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

About the Role

We're looking for a Pricing Analyst, New Grad to support Bask Health's commercial pricing analysis and revenue optimization efforts.

You'll work with Revenue Operations, Finance, Sales, and Pricing to research commercial pricing structures, analyze merchant spending, prepare financial models, and help evaluate different pricing arrangements.

This is an opportunity for someone beginning their career to gain hands-on experience in pricing strategy, financial analysis, and merchant economics.

You'll learn how pricing decisions affect merchant relationships, business profitability, and long-term revenue performance. You'll also help maintain pricing models, research market information, and prepare analyses that support decisions made by senior team members.

We're looking for someone who enjoys working with numbers, is curious about how businesses make money, and can turn detailed information into clear, useful findings.

What You'll Do

  • Support pricing analysis for new and existing merchant relationships.

  • Build and maintain spreadsheets used for commercial pricing analysis.

  • Support the preparation of pricing comparisons and financial models.
  • Research publicly available pricing structures used by relevant technology platforms.
  • Assist with comparing different commercial pricing arrangements.
  • Help analyze the financial impact of rates, fees, and discounts.

  • Help organize information about approved merchant pricing agreements.

  • Assist with comparing existing pricing terms against proposed alternatives.
  • Help identify inconsistencies in pricing data or supporting documentation.
  • Support the preparation of reports on pricing performance.
  • Assist with evaluating merchant revenue and profitability trends.
  • Help compare commercial arrangements across merchant segments.
  • Prepare charts and tables summarizing pricing analysis results.
  • Support research into transaction-based, subscription-based, and usage-based pricing models.
  • Assist with documenting pricing methodologies and analytical assumptions.
  • Work with Finance to validate basic revenue and cost information.
  • Collaborate with Revenue Operations to obtain accurate merchant activity data.
  • Support Sales and Customer Success with pricing information prepared for internal review.
  • Help prepare supporting analysis for commercial proposals.
  • Assist with comparing approved commercial terms against relevant billing information.
  • Flag potential pricing or billing discrepancies for review by senior team members.
  • Support the development of standardized pricing analysis templates.
  • Help maintain organized pricing research and commercial reference materials.
  • Assist with reviewing historical pricing data to identify trends.
  • Support improvements to pricing spreadsheets and reporting workflows.
  • Learn how Bask evaluates merchant economics and commercial profitability.
  • Participate in discussions about pricing research and analytical findings.
  • Help prepare presentations summarizing pricing comparisons and recommendations.

jobs.description:
At RCX Sports, we proudly serve as the premier youth sport operating partner for the NFL, NHL, MLS, MLB, NBA, and WNBA. We provide officially licensed uniforms, comprehensive resources, and dedicated support, empowering league operators to run the very best youth sports leagues and events in their communities. Our mission is grounded in the transformative power of sports. We’re dedicated to ensuring every child has the opportunity to play the game they love. By empowering league operators to effectively run and maintain their programming season after season, we’re committed to making youth sports accessible and inclusive for all.

We are seeking a Data Architect to connect our core business processes, operational systems, and data in a trusted enterprise architecture. This hands-on, build-first leadership role will map key business processes, define systems of record and shared data definitions, and determine how information flows across the company. The successful candidate will lead and contribute directly to rebuilding RCX’s BigQuery platform and developing the pipelines, integrations, data models, quality standards, and governance that support it.

The work spans Salesforce, BigQuery, Tableau, League Central and SMA application databases, Heroku Connect, SKU Vault, and a commerce platform being replaced. RCX’s Analytics team owns reporting, visualization, and analysis; this role owns the underlying architecture and data foundation that enable that work.

Initially a player/coach role, this position calls for someone equally comfortable building a pipeline or troubleshooting an integration and working with executives to shape business processes.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Business Process & Systems Architecture

    • Map RCX's highest-priority business processes from beginning to end.

    • Understand the people, activities, decisions, systems, handoffs, and data involved in each process.

    • Identify manual work, disconnected systems, duplicated data, inconsistent definitions, and opportunities for simplification or automation.

    • Define which applications should support key processes and which systems should serve as systems of record.

    • Translate business requirements into clear systems, integration, and data architecture.

    • Ensure new technology decisions fit within a coherent architecture rather than creating additional silos.

  • Enterprise Data Architecture

    • Define RCX's core business entities and the relationships between them.

    • Establish common definitions for critical data and business metrics across systems and departments.

    • Reconcile conflicting representations of customers, organizations, leagues, participants, registrations, transactions, partners, products, locations, and other core entities.

    • Establish authoritative sources and ownership for important data domains.

    • Design conceptual, logical, and physical data models that support operations, analytics, forecasting, automation, AI, and future data products.

    • Partner with Engineering on application structures that shape enterprise data, such as account hierarchies and the market, program, and catalog model. Own enterprise entity definitions, systems of record, and data flows; Engineering owns application design and keeps Data Architecture informed of changes that affect downstream data.

  • BigQuery Data Platform

    • Assess and redesign RCX's existing BigQuery implementation into a scalable, governed enterprise data platform.

    • Personally contribute to the architecture and implementation of the new environment.

    • Design appropriate source/raw, transformation, core model, and analytics-ready layers.

    • Build sophisticated SQL transformations and data models.

    • Establish appropriate partitioning, clustering, incremental processing, security, and access-control patterns.

    • Optimize the environment for reliability, performance, scalability, and cost.

    • Establish development, testing, deployment, and monitoring practices for the data platform.

  • Data Pipelines & Integrations

    • Architect and build pipelines connecting Salesforce and other operational systems to BigQuery.

    • Develop integrations using APIs, databases, files, and other appropriate mechanisms.

    • Build batch, incremental, and change-data-capture processes where appropriate.

    • Use Python or similar technologies for custom ingestion, transformation, validation, and automation.

    • Implement orchestration, testing, monitoring, alerting, and failure recovery.

    • Define where data should flow back into Salesforce or other operational systems when business processes require synchronization or write-back.

    • Resolve discrepancies when multiple systems contain different versions of the same business information.

    • Architect ingestion of operator and participant data from third-party registration platforms, including matching participants across platforms RCX does not control.

    • Own the architecture for data shared with league and licensing partners: what is shared, in what format, and under what consent.

  • Data Quality & Governance

    • Establish practical standards for data ownership, quality, access, lineage, documentation, security, and change management.

    • Implement automated testing and validation for critical data.

    • Create monitoring for failed pipelines, schema changes, freshness issues, and anomalies.

    • Establish clear documentation and metadata practices.

    • Own the technical controls for participant PII, much of it belonging to minors: access, consent, retention, and keeping production data out of non-production environments. Work within policy set by Security.

  • Analytics Enablement

    • Partner closely with the Analytics team to provide reliable, well-structured, analysis-ready data with Data Architecture owning the underlying data platform and Analytics focused on reporting, analysis, visualization, and business insight.

    • Create curated data models and marts that support Tableau and other downstream analytical uses.

    • Establish consistent dimensions, metrics, and business definitions.

    • Reduce the manual work required to find, clean, combine, and reconcile data.

  • AI & Automation Enablement

    • Design the data platform so AI applications and agents can securely access trusted, governed data.

    • Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to reduce manual work and improve business processes.

    • Explore AI-assisted approaches to data mapping, documentation, testing, quality monitoring, anomaly detection, and development productivity.

    • Partner with Engineering on the architecture required for AI applications to safely interact with RCX systems and data. AI should build on the data foundation rather than operate as a separate architecture.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data architecture, or closely related roles.
  • Experience operating at a lead, principal, architect, or technical leadership level.
  • Demonstrated experience personally designing and implementing production cloud data platforms.
  • Hands-on BigQuery experience.
  • Expert SQL skills.
  • Strong working proficiency with Python for data engineering and integrations.
  • Deep knowledge of enterprise and dimensional data modeling.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT, APIs, incremental ingestion, CDC, synchronization, orchestration, testing, and observability.
  • Experience with dbt, Dataform, or similar transformation approaches.
  • Experience with Airflow, Composer, Dagster, Prefect, or similar orchestration technologies.
  • Strong understanding of GCP architecture, IAM, service accounts, storage, and related services.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise data platforms.
  • Understanding of Salesforce objects, APIs, synchronization, CDC, and write-back patterns.
  • Experience supporting Tableau or comparable BI environments.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, lineage, governance, metadata, privacy, and security.
  • Experience handling regulated personal data, ideally including data about minors.
  • Demonstrated ability to map business processes and translate them into systems and data architecture.

Additional Position Details:

This job is responsible for investigating BPM (Bicycle, Pedestrian, Motorcycle) or severe/complex, unrepresented bodily injury claims.
