jobs.excerpt: About Reserv Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims.
jobs.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

As the Vice President, Casualty Claims at Reserv, you will ensure our talented Commercial Casualty Liability Claims team realizes its full potential as we continue to grow as the leading TPA by providing strategic leadership and direction. We want your background and experience to deliver operational effectiveness, particularly in leveraging technology and analytics to drive better efficiencies and performance. You will serve a critical role with the team, the customers, and the client. You will maintain high quality standards, and compliance with regulatory, internal, and external contractual SLAs. This role reports directly to our SVP, and requires exceptional leadership skills, and foundational understanding of claims ideally with experience handling and/or managing multi lines of business.

You will be responsible for driving strategy, establishing an effective structure, and developing and enforcing compliant internal policies and procedures. Commercial Casualty Liability Injury claims are high-volume, fast-moving, and heavily scrutinized, with layered coverage structures, evolving state regulations, and demanding program-level reporting. Your expertise in claims management, along with your ability to drive operational efficiencies and foster innovation, will be critical. With a focus on talent acquisition and continuous improvement, you will ensure exceptional service delivery, customer satisfaction, and the identification of opportunities for improvement. The ideal candidate is excited about designing processes that support the quickest claim resolution with optimal outcomes. You will also collaborate closely with our Product and Engineering teams to give feedback and identify technology and process improvements. Join our exceptional team and help shape the future of Reserv.

What you'll do

  • Provide strategic leadership, vision, and direction for the Commercial Casualty Liability Claims organization.
  • Collaborate closely with the Account Management team to ensure the organization consistently exceeds client expectations and builds strong, trusted relationships with carriers, program managers, and platform partners.
  • Foster a customer-centric approach to claims handling, focusing on exceptional service and timely resolution, and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
  • Establish and maintain an effective structure and staffing model that aligns with current and future organizational needs, including capacity planning against volume swings.
  • Monitor and analyze claims data and key performance indicators (severity, frequency, cycle time, litigation rates, reserve accuracy, and leakage) to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Own program-level performance, including audit readiness, bordereaux and reporting accuracy, and corrective action plans when programs fall short of carrier expectations.
  • Drive operational efficiencies and process improvements through proprietary claim systems and automation.
  • Develop an enhanced operating model for commercial casualty claims focused on strategic priorities and performance.
  • Advance and enforce clear, consistent, and compliant policies, procedures, and processes for claims handling across multiple programs and coverage structures.
  • Lead and motivate a high-performing claims team focused on industry-leading service, providing guidance, mentorship, and technical expertise to claims staff and managers.
  • Consult and advise on high-exposure, complex litigation, and coverage matters, including bodily injury, uninsured/underinsured motorist, and PIP exposures.
  • Oversee related functions such as subrogation, total loss, and special investigations to maximize recovery and control loss costs.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, including state transportation network and delivery-platform insurance statutes, and maintain best practices.
  • Collaborate with global claims departments and other stakeholders to align strategies and initiatives.
  • Support and communicate claim philosophies while building strong customer relationships.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies relevant to claims management and recommend their integration where appropriate.
  • Set standards and practices to ensure prudent claims management and control expenses.
  • Promote a culture of innovation and encourage the exploration and implementation of new ideas and technologies within the claims organization.

Who you are

  • Customer Centric. You prioritize the needs of our customers, ensuring exceptional service delivery and consistently striving to exceed their expectations.
  • Data Obsessed. Data excites you, and you consistently leverage it to inform and support decision making.
  • Strategic Thinker. You think critically, analyze complex situations, and develop innovative strategies to drive the success of our claims organization.
  • Collaborative. You thrive in a collaborative environment, fostering strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to achieve common goals.
  • Resilient. You remain composed and adaptable in the face of challenges, demonstrating the ability to navigate ambiguity.
  • Results-Driven. You have a track record of achieving measurable results, setting ambitious goals, and driving performance to meet and exceed expectations.
  • Empowering Leader. You empower and inspire your team, providing mentorship, guidance, and support to help them reach their full potential.
  • Analytical. You have strong analytical skills, using data-driven insights to make informed decisions and drive continuous improvement.
  • Ethical. You demonstrate high ethical standards and integrity in all aspects of your work, maintaining trust and transparency in your interactions.
  • And did we mention, a sense of humor. Claims are hard enough as it is.

Qualifications

  • 15 years of on-point technical experience managing teams of 75 or more employees.
  • 20 years minimum in P&C claims, with significant experience with interstate transportation claims management experience, ideally overseeing bodily injury and physical damages claims.
  • Experience building and iterating on process and technology in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong command of bodily injury, UM/UIM, PIP, and physical damage claims, along with subrogation and total loss handling.
  • Strong litigation management leadership skills; Juris Doctor is a plus.
  • Deep understanding of coverage and contracts, with emphasis on risk transfer and the relationship between platforms, carriers, and independent drivers.
  • Experience managing carrier programs, including audits, performance guarantees, and program-level reporting. TPA experiences a significant differentiator.

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, and dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized
  • 100% remote (home-based) role designed to support your work-life balance
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

Position Title: Solution Architect, HPE Storage Position Location: Remote - Canada

Main Purpose of the Role:

The experienced Solutions Architect will support client engagements through the design, development, and presentation of enterprise storage and data infrastructure solutions, with a primary focus on HPE Storage technologies. This role serves as a technical leader throughout the sales and delivery lifecycle, working closely with account teams, engineering resources, HPE, and clients to develop scalable, resilient, and high-performing storage architectures. The Solutions Architect demonstrates strong consulting and technical expertise across enterprise storage, data availability, business continuity, and hybrid cloud infrastructure, with experience in HPE storage platforms including HPE Alletra, Alletra Storage MP, Primera, Nimble Storage, and related technologies. Experience with complementary infrastructure technologies, including virtualization, compute, and data protection, is beneficial, but this role will be primarily aligned to HPE-led storage opportunities and solutions. This position requires the ability to translate business requirements into technical architectures, develop solution designs, support customer presentations, and collaborate with delivery teams to ensure successful implementation.

Essential Functions:

The Company is committed to the success of its employees. If you require accommodation because of a ground protected under the applicable human rights legislation, please contact People Operations at your earliest convenience. Solution Development & Architecture

Design and develop enterprise storage and data infrastructure solutions for new and existing clients, with a primary focus on HPE Storage technologies. Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable, resilient, and operationally sound storage architectures. Develop high-level designs (HLDs), low-level designs (LLDs), reference architectures, and technical recommendations. Conduct technical workshops, discovery sessions, storage assessments, and architecture reviews. Perform storage sizing, capacity planning, performance analysis, and solution configuration. Validate solution designs against performance, availability, resiliency, security, and operational requirements. Provide technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle, from initial discovery through implementation and transition.

Pre-Sales & Customer Engagement

Partner with account managers and business development teams to support customer opportunities. Deliver technical presentations, demonstrations, workshops, and solution reviews. Participate in customer meetings to understand business objectives and technical requirements. Support RFP, RFI, and proposal development activities. Assist with solution sizing, configuration, pricing support, scope development, effort estimation, and Statement of Work (SOW) creation. Support the technical positioning of professional services and managed services offerings. Collaborate with HPE technical and sales teams to develop competitive and technically sound solutions.

Architecture & Advisory

Lead the development of architectures across core storage and infrastructure domains:

Enterprise Block Storage File and Object Storage Storage Area Networks (SAN) Data Availability and Business Continuity Hybrid Cloud Storage and Data Mobility Storage for Virtualized and Enterprise Application Environments

Provide design guidance and technical oversight to engineering and delivery teams. Develop standards and best practices for enterprise storage and infrastructure solutions. Advise customers on storage modernization, consolidation, migrations, and lifecycle management. Ensure proposed solutions align with industry best practices for scalability, resiliency, security, performance, and operational efficiency.

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

Work closely with engineering, delivery, and managed services teams to ensure successful implementation of proposed solutions. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and consultants. Participate in internal knowledge sharing and technical enablement activities. Contribute to the development of standardized architectures, methodologies, and service offerings. Maintain awareness of emerging technologies, industry trends, and vendor solutions. Collaborate with adjacent technology practices, including compute, virtualization, networking, data protection, and cloud infrastructure.

Required Skills/Abilities/Competencies:

Experience in consulting, professional services, systems integration, or solution architecture roles. Proven ability to design and present complex technical solutions to customers. Experience gathering requirements and translating business needs into technical architectures. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, project stakeholders, and executive leadership. Strong consultative and problem-solving mindset. Ability to quickly understand customer business and technical requirements. Strong presentation skills and ability to lead technical discussions and workshops. Excellent organizational and documentation skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. Strong collaboration skills and ability to work across sales, engineering, and delivery organizations. Ability to balance technical depth with business value when communicating solutions. Ability to independently develop storage solution configurations, sizing recommendations, and technical proposals.

Technical Expertise:

Enterprise Storage

Strong experience designing, implementing, or supporting enterprise storage solutions, including HPE technologies such as:

HPE Alletra Storage MP B10000 HPE Alletra 5000/6000/9000 HPE Primera and 3PAR HPE Nimble Storage HPE GreenLake for Block Storage HPE Storage management and monitoring platforms

Experience with enterprise block storage architectures, including Fibre Channel, iSCSI, and NVMe-based storage connectivity. Knowledge of SAN design, zoning, multipathing, and storage connectivity best practices. Experience with storage sizing, performance analysis, capacity planning, and data reduction technologies. Understanding of storage replication, snapshots, high availability, and disaster recovery architectures. Experience designing storage solutions for virtualized environments, databases, and mission-critical enterprise applications.

Data Protection & Business Continuity

Working knowledge of enterprise data protection concepts, including:

Backup and recovery architectures Storage-based replication and snapshots Disaster recovery and business continuity RPO/RTO requirements Ransomware resilience and immutable backup concepts

Familiarity with HPE StoreOnce, HPE Zerto, Veeam, or other enterprise data protection technologies. Ability to collaborate with data protection specialists when opportunities require deeper backup, recovery, or cybersecurity expertise.

Hybrid Cloud & Infrastructure Integration

Experience designing storage solutions that integrate with:

VMware vSphere and enterprise virtualization platforms HPE ProLiant and other enterprise compute platforms Fibre Channel and Ethernet networking infrastructure Microsoft Windows Server and Linux environments Hybrid cloud and private cloud architectures

Working knowledge of HPE GreenLake and consumption-based infrastructure offerings. Understanding of storage provisioning, automation, monitoring, and lifecycle management. Familiarity with storage migration methodologies and infrastructure modernization initiatives.

Vendor Experience

Primary Focus:

HPE Storage HPE Alletra and Alletra Storage MP HPE Primera, 3PAR, and Nimble Storage HPE GreenLake Storage solutions

Additional Experience Beneficial:

Dell Technologies, Pure Storage, NetApp, IBM Storage, or other enterprise storage platforms HPE StoreOnce and HPE Zerto HPE Morpheus VM Essentials (VME) HPE Morpheus Software for virtualization and hybrid cloud management HPE SimpliVity and hyperconverged infrastructure

Education and Experience:

8+ years of experience in enterprise storage, infrastructure engineering, architecture, or related technical roles. Hands-on experience with HPE enterprise storage technologies, particularly HPE Alletra, Alletra Storage MP, Primera, 3PAR, or Nimble Storage. HPE Storage certifications or equivalent hands-on experience. Experience working for a VAR, systems integrator, managed services provider, or consulting organization. Experience in technical presales, solution configuration, storage sizing, and customer-facing architecture engagements. Experience with storage migration, infrastructure modernization, and hybrid cloud solutions is beneficial.

Preferred Qualifications (Not Required):

Experience with HPE Morpheus VM Essentials (VME) and/or broader HPE Morpheus virtualization and hybrid cloud management solutions. Experience with HPE GreenLake cloud and infrastructure services. Familiarity with HPE data protection technologies, including StoreOnce and Zerto. Experience with automation, scripting, or infrastructure-as-code technologies. Bilingual proficiency in English and French is considered an asset, particularly for supporting French-speaking customers in Canada.

Travel Requirements:

Ability to travel up to 20% as required to support customer engagements, workshops, assessments, and project activities.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pricing governance and quote approvals

  • Serve as the approval authority for quote escalations and non-standard deals, balancing win rate against margin protection.
  • Own pricing policy, guardrails, and exception governance, and keep approvals timely, consistent, and well documented.
  • Provide pricing guidance to sales on complex or strategic opportunities and act as the escalation point for pricing questions.

Analytics, dashboards, and KPIs

  • Own the pricing KPI framework and dashboards; define the metrics that matter and hold the commercial organization accountable to them.
  • Partner with the pricing data analyst to ensure reliable pricing data, waterfalls, and reporting.

  • Strong command of pricing governance and deal or quote approval processes.
  • Advanced analytical skills, including Excel modeling and comfort building and interpreting BI dashboards; SQL or a similar query language is a plus.
  • Experience with CPQ and CRM (Salesforce) pricing configuration and how strategy is enforced in tooling.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders without formal authority, with excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience pricing both products and services, including service contracts, parts, and training.
  • Exposure to global, multi-region, and multi-currency pricing.
  • Familiarity with elasticity and leakage analysis and basic statistical methods.
  • A track record of change management and stakeholder management on pricing or commercial initiatives.

jobs.title: PPC Marketing Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.excerpt: At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

About the role

CI&T is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to embed with a global enterprise client and ship AI-powered features into its React and .NET operator portal. You will own outcomes end to end: from the first workshop with the client's architects to the code running in production.

A Forward Deployed Engineer is a software engineer first and a consultant second. You work directly with client stakeholders to understand a messy, ambiguous problem, shape the solution, write the production code, and stay until it is adopted. This is not a pre-sales or project management role: you build.

The first mission is to integrate an existing AI assistant into the client's operator portal as a micro frontend, so it runs both inside the portal and as a standalone app. The portal serves frontline and site management teams at large scale.

What you will do

  • Discover with the client. Run working sessions with the client's architects, product owners and frontline users to map workflows, constraints and the highest-value problems.

  • Build and ship production code. Design and deliver micro frontends in React and TypeScript, and the .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core) services and APIs behind them.

  • Own the integration contract. Define how the AI assistant plugs into the host portal: module loading, shared state, routing, user and site context, and versioning, so both sides can deploy independently.

  • Handle identity and security. Implement single sign-on across identity providers (for example Entra ID and OneLogin), with role-based access and secure token handling.

  • Make it production-ready. Set up telemetry, accessibility, responsive UX, CI/CD and automated tests, and take part in production deployment and hypercare.

  • Prototype fast. Turn open questions into working prototypes in days, so the client decides on evidence rather than slides.

  • Close the loop. Feed what you learn in the field back into the solution and into CI&T's reusable assets, and help shape the next phases of scope.

Required qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering, with code you shipped to production and supported.

  • Strong React and TypeScript, including state management, performance and component architecture in large applications.

  • Hands-on micro frontend experience in production (for example Module Federation or single-spa), or a clear account of how you split and integrated a large front end.

  • Solid .NET backend experience: C#, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs and integration with enterprise systems.

  • Working knowledge of SSO and identity standards (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML) in enterprise environments.

  • CI/CD, automated testing and cloud deployment, preferably on Azure.

  • Advanced English, spoken and written. You will lead workshops, present trade-offs and negotiate scope directly with international stakeholders.

  • Proven client-facing experience: you have worked directly with business or technical stakeholders outside your own team.

Nice to have

  • Python, especially for AI work: calling LLM APIs, building agents or RAG pipelines.

  • Experience building user interfaces for AI assistants or chatbots (streaming responses, conversation history, feedback capture).

  • Familiarity with agent platforms and protocols such as MCP, Copilot Studio or Agentforce.

  • Exposure to Databricks or other enterprise data platforms.

  • Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor.

  • Experience with apps used by frontline or mobile workforces, including accessibility requirements.

  • Spanish or French.

Who thrives in this role

You are comfortable starting without a complete spec. You ask the questions that turn an ambiguous request into a clear plan, then you build it.

  • You explain a technical trade-off to an architect and to a business user, and both leave with the same decision.

  • You prefer showing a working prototype over writing a long document.

  • You own the result, not just the ticket: if the feature is not adopted, you find out why.

  • You care about cost and scale, because the solution serves hundreds of thousands of users.

In the first 90 days, success means the client has a working micro frontend integration in a test environment, an agreed integration contract between both teams, and a clear plan for production rollout.

Logistics

  • Location: remote from Brazil, with occasional on-site sessions when the project calls for them.

  • Schedule: regular overlap with European business hours (CET), since key client stakeholders are based in Europe.

  • Working language: English with the client; Portuguese within the CI&T team.

  • Start: as soon as possible.

jobs.description:
Postpartum Support International (PSI) works to promote awareness, prevention, and treatment of mental health issues related to childbearing. PSI supports families, provides expert training to providers, and creates a bridge between families and informed resources. PSI disseminates information and resources through its volunteers, website, training, chapters, and annual conference. PSI board and staff are dedicated and passionate individuals committed to alleviating distress and improving outcomes for pregnant and postpartum families. PSI headquarters is in Portland, Oregon, but the position is entirely remote. PSI additionally operates the National Maternal Mental Health Hotline, a 24/7 hotline federally funded by the Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA).

The Hotline Counselor facilitates daily engagement with help-seekers of the National Maternal Mental Health Hotline (Hotline), delivering psychosocial support, referrals, and resources to pregnant and postpartum individuals, as well as their families and support systems. In coordination with the Services/Operations and Clinical teams, the Counselor serves as the primary point of contact, managing incoming telephonic, text, and chat inquiries.

This is a fully remote position. The pay for this position is $64,714.90.

The schedule totals 40 hours per week. Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday - 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM Eastern.

PLEASE NOTE: Our training schedule for this role requires that you can attend 2 weeks (80 hours) of training, Monday – Friday, 6:00 am – 2:00 pm or 4:00 pm – 12:00 am, before you start your agreed-upon shift.

How You Will Contribute

As the Hotline Counselor, you will perform the following key responsibilities:

  • Answer incoming telephonic, text, and chat inquiries, conducting assessments to determine the nature of the contact and provide immediate psychosocial support, evidence-based information, and brief interventions.
  • Educate help-seekers about perinatal mental health resources and services. Referring help-seekers to appropriate services and resources within approved directories.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, detailed, and timely documentation of cases in the Salesforce system in real-time. Ensure documentation is in adherence with established policies and procedures.
  • Ensure professionalism in the virtual workspace and when using any of the provided communication platforms. Fully interact and engage with your remote team, including communicating while on shift via Slack and other mediums as assigned.
  • Ensure the privacy and confidentiality of each help-seeker and their information.
  • Attend and participate in routinely scheduled meetings, trainings, and development exercises as requested or required for the Hotline project.

Education and/or Work Experience Requirements

  • A bachelor's degree in a related ﬁeld (psychology, social work, counseling, etc.) is preferred.
  • Candidates must be one of the following:
    • Licensed Mental Health Clinician, such as a Professional Counselor, Social Worker, Psychotherapist, Psychologist, or Marriage and Family Therapist,
    • Licensed Healthcare Professional who has experience in maternal and child health, such as a Nurse, Nurse Midwife, Nurse Practitioner, Physician Assistant, or Psychiatrist,
    • National or State-Certified Doula, Lactation Consultant, Childbirth Educator, or Peer Specialist.
  • Two (2) years’ work experience in your profession, working with the maternal and child health population.
  • Professional liability insurance coverage of at least $1,000,000 per occurrence, $3,000,000 aggregate.
  • Demonstrated proﬁciency in using software applications, such as Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, internet browsers, and search directories.
  • Ability to manage conﬂict and tolerate distress while assisting help-seekers.
  • Must be able to multitask and handle potentially unpredictable and high-acuity contacts within the mental health environment.
  • Ability to work independently and to carry out assignments to completion within the parameters of instructions given, prescribed routines, and standard accepted practices.
  • Ability to adapt to immediate changes and requirements outlined in policies, procedures, processes, and guidances.

Additional Eligibility Qualifications

  • Must complete and clear a Non–Sensitive Tier II - Moderate Check and Clearance background check (administered by HHS).
  • Must complete all training as required by Postpartum Support International training policies and procedures.
  • Must be able to commit to the Postpartum Support International vision and be passionate about its mission.
  • Must possess optimal (high) internet speeds and be able to maintain optimal speeds for the utility of operating systems and platforms.
  • Must utilize a quiet and secure office space for privacy and confidentiality.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA, and other federal, state, and local standards, including meeting qualitative and/or quantitative productivity standards;
  • Required to sit, stand, walk, speak, and hear while performing the duties of this job regularly. The position requires extensive computer use, so the employee must have sufficient hand dexterity to use a computer keyboard and be capable of reading a computer screen.

What We Offer

  • A deep commitment to fostering a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and supported.
  • A fully remote, asynchronous work environment that empowers you to work where and when you’re most effective while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
  • Ongoing professional development opportunities to help you grow your skills and expand your network.
  • A comprehensive benefits package focused on your well-being, including medical, dental, and vision coverage.
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation (two weeks), holidays, sick leave, and personal days (three).
  • Inclusive parental leave (twelve weeks) supporting all paths to parenthood, along with resources to help balance family responsibilities
  • Comprehensive retirement plan option with an organization-provided match to support your long-term financial goals.

Equal employment opportunity and having a diverse staff are fundamental principles at Postpartum Support International, where employment and promotional opportunities are based upon individual capabilities and qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation/affectional preference, age, national origin, marital status, citizenship, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as established under law. Postpartum Support International does not discriminate against formerly incarcerated individuals.

About LOVB (League One Volleyball):
League One Volleyball (LOVB) is reimagining women's sports. Launched in 2019, our company is a mission-led sports performance, training and media enterprise that will change the game of volleyball in the USA and empower new generations of female athletes.

It is a groundbreaking time for volleyball in the US with our historic triple Olympic Gold medals in Women's Indoor, Beach and Sitting Volleyball. Volleyball is already the #1 most played girls' youth sport. There are 38M current and former players today. Of major sports, it's the only one that is women-first (~90% of players are female). But the volleyball market has been almost entirely missed by traditional sports investors, brands, and media.

LOVB is capturing this opportunity by creating a strong club business, and from that built-in audience and fandom, is creating the best Pro League in the world and a digital ecosystem that will connect all aspects of LOVB. This community-up approach will drive participation and fandom, while enabling greater empowerment for girls and young women living this amazing sport. In this role, you will join a mission-driven, roll-up-your-sleeves team of innovators and builders who have come together to change the paradigm of professional volleyball and women’s sports.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Title: Regional Coach Development Lead – West Coast

Title: Regional Coach Development Lead – West Coast

Department Code & Name: 202 – Club Support

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: West Coast Region – travel to clubs and tournaments within assigned area

Reports to: National Director of Coach Development

Job Summary:

The Regional Coach Development Lead equips and supports coaches across assigned LOVB clubs to deliver consistent, high-quality athlete development experiences. Embedded within the regional POD support model, this role translates LOVB sport strategy and Regional Sport Leader (RSL) priorities into practical coaching resources, curriculum, training, observation, and in-season guidance. The role reports to the National Director of Coach Development for consistent coaching standards and works closely with the RSL, Regional Operations Leader (ROL), Regional Vice President (RVP), Club Directors, and coaches on regional priorities. POD alignment does not change the formal reporting relationship. This job description is not an exhaustive list of duties and may evolve with business needs.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Coaching Curriculum & Resources

• Develop coach-facing playbooks, practice plans, drill libraries, and technique progressions that translate LOVB sport strategy into actionable session-level guidance.

• Maintain and update curriculum and training resources to support consistent coaching practices across assigned clubs.

Coach Training & In-Season Support

• Plan and deliver in-person and virtual coaching clinics, video review sessions, and practice-based instruction.

• Provide ongoing guidance to coaches on practice design, team dynamics, and individual athlete development needs.

• Conduct structured practice and game observations and provide timely, actionable feedback to coaches.

Regional Club & Tournament Engagement

• Coordinate sister-club visits and peer learning opportunities that strengthen collaboration and consistent execution across clubs.

• Attend selected regional tournaments to provide coach-facing feedback, competition debriefs, and developmental support.

• Coordinate tournament presence with the Regional Recruiting Lead to distinguish coach development activities from athlete recruiting efforts.

Coach Onboarding, Evaluation & Development

• Implement a standardized coach onboarding pathway covering LOVB coaching philosophy, relevant safety and compliance expectations, and internal systems.

• Monitor coach certification and background-check status in coordination with the appropriate club and People Success partners.

• Conduct periodic coach evaluations and provide development feedback informed by athlete development outcomes.

• Identify high-potential coaches and support career pathways, mentorship, and advancement opportunities.

• Monitor coach engagement and retention risks and communicate concerns to appropriate leaders.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

• Build and facilitate a regional coaching community of practice for mentorship, shared resources, and collaborative problem-solving.

• Partner with the RSL on coaching capability while respecting the RSL’s ownership of sport strategy and program design.

• Track coach retention, satisfaction, training completion, and playbook adoption, and contribute to shared athlete development measures.

Required & Preferred Skills/Abilities:

  • Strong volleyball knowledge and ability to translate technical strategy into practical coaching instruction.
  • Effective written, verbal, and virtual presentation skills, including the ability to facilitate coach learning across varied experience levels.
  • Strong relationship-building, mentorship, feedback, and collaboration skills across multiple clubs and functional partners.
  • Ability to develop curriculum, organize competing priorities, and work independently within a regional support model.
  • Proficiency with technology tools used for presentations, virtual training, film review, and coaching resources.
  • Ability and willingness to travel regularly within the assigned region, including tournament and occasional evening or weekend commitments.

Education and Experience:

  • Experience coaching volleyball or developing coaches in club, school, or collegiate settings.
  • Experience creating training content, curriculum, or coach development programs preferred.
  • Experience supporting multiple clubs, programs, or stakeholders preferred.

Personal Attributes

  • Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with shifting priorities.
  • Solutions-oriented and able to identify when to escalate issues or challenges.
  • Strong collaborator with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Capable of working independently while effectively partnering with a distributed, remote team.
  • Positive, proactive, organized, and creative - brings fresh ideas to problem-solving.
  • Highly adaptable and eager to learn in a rapidly evolving environment.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements (Remote):

  • Regional role involving work from a computer and frequent virtual meetings, with regular travel to club gyms and tournaments.
  • Ability to communicate effectively by video, phone, and written channels and to observe coaching activities in active volleyball facilities.
  • Work schedule may include evenings and weekends based on club training and tournament schedules.

ABOUT KION

Kion offers FinOps+, an approach that unifies automated guardrails, AI-driven FinOps, and beyond public cloud cost management in a policy-driven platform. With FinOps+, teams can proactively govern and eliminate waste before it happens, extend visibility and optimization beyond public cloud (AI, SaaS, and private cloud), and leverage AI for smarter forecasting and faster decision-making. FinOps+ moves beyond simply tracking costs, it accelerates value, serving as the bridge between cost control and operational excellence to do more with less while ensuring long-term efficiency. Kion serves leading regulated enterprises and agencies including Verizon, NASA, Indeed, Insulet and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS). Learn more at: .

ABOUT THE ROLE

Kion is hiring a Product Manager to own defined areas of the Kion FinOps+ platform end to end and bring rigor to how we decide what to build. This role reports to Chief Product Officer. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success to turn customer evidence and business impact into clear priorities, crisp requirements, and a steady flow of ready work, delivering features that streamline and automate infrastructure operations across cloud and AI environments.

This role suits someone who is equally comfortable shaping strategy and doing the work: building the business case, writing the requirements, and signing off on the release. You will contribute to Kion’s product vision and translate it into a clear roadmap for your area. Over time, you will become a trusted voice for Kion with strategic customers, partners, and the broader cloud and FinOps community.

YOUR DAY-TO-DAY:

Prioritization and Business Cases

  • Build lightweight business cases for proposed features that estimate impact on revenue, adoption, retention, and customer satisfaction.
  • Apply a consistent, transparent prioritization framework (for example RICE or opportunity scoring) to rank work in your area, and explain the trade-offs behind each call.
  • Maintain a prioritized backlog that stays at least two sprints ahead, so Engineering always has well-defined work ready to build.
  • Know when a decision needs more analysis and when it needs a fast, reversible call. Bias toward action and validate through what ships.

Contributing to Product Vision and Strategy

  • Contribute to the Kion product vision and strategy, bringing customer, market, and usage insight from your area.
  • Translate company and product priorities into a clear roadmap for your area that rolls up to the overall Kion roadmap.

Customer and Market Collaboration

  • Engage directly with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders (Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success) to gather feedback, present roadmaps, and refine product direction.
  • Engage with key strategic customers to validate feature requirements and improve release quality.

Product Execution and Delivery

  • Partner with Design to help visually document key feature requirements and user experiences to ensure they meet intended customer needs.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering managers, feature owners and software engineers to refine requirements, remove ambiguity, and ensure timely delivery of high-impact features.
  • Sign off on completed features to maintain quality standards as part of the release process.
  • Analyze platform usage trends to inform feature enhancements, technical debt management, and product feature deprecation.

Go-to-Market Enablement

  • Work with Marketing, Sales and Customer Success to clearly communicate and demonstrate the value and impact of new features in your area.
  • Represent the voice of the customer in product planning and help translate feedback into actionable features and positioning.

Thought Leadership & Industry Engagement

  • Represent Kion through speaking engagements, certifications, and participation in industry groups.
  • Contribute to building a stronger internal and external understanding of cloud and AI best practices.

Metrics and Process

  • Define success with measurable KPIs for each roadmap feature that focus on customer value and business outcomes.
  • Adopt and improve repeatable product management processes that scale with growth.

WHAT WE ARE EXPECTING FROM YOU (I.E., THE QUALIFICATIONS YOU MUST HAVE):

  • 3+ years of B2B product management, ideally on infrastructure software products sold to engineering, IT, DevOps or FinOps buyers.
  • Experience in a product organization with established modern practices, where you used prioritization frameworks, business cases, and outcome metrics day to day. You can describe what good looks like and how you adapted it to a smaller team.
  • Strong requirements analysis and communication. You excel at probing disparate customer voices for feedback, distilling them into business cases for prioritization and product requirements documents for humans and agents.
  • Comfort balancing rigor with speed. You know when analysis is "good enough" and keep engineering teams unblocked.
  • Experience working with leading public cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google, Oracle) ideally in a role to fill feature gaps in individual cloud providers or unify the experience for customers using multiple cloud providers
  • Experience supporting a software product that must support both customer hosted and SaaS deployment options
  • AI fluency. Kion has fully embraced AI across all business functions and you use AI chat and/or coding platforms from vendors like Anthropic and OpenAI daily to speed delivery and build prototypes.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience in FinOps, AIOps, cloud operations, IT financial management, cloud governance, and/or multi-cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience using agentic software development lifecycle (ADLC) approaches to accelerate software delivery and handoffs between product and engineering
  • Experience building capabilities that integrate and enhance analytics within AI providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, xAI, etc.) via APIs and MCP capabilities
  • Experience designing integrations with established 3rd party commercial and open source software solutions including but not limited to AI proxy / gateways (LiteLLM, OpenRouter, etc.), ITSM (ServiceNow, JIRA, etc.), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.) to unlock access to critical data across the enterprise, deliver unique insights and power automated actions
  • Experience expanding product capabilities to support international growth and expansion
  • Experience with packaging and pricing analysis of product capabilities to optimize revenue
  • Experience at a startup or growth-stage company, including a period of scale or M&A.

If you meet most of these qualifications but not all, we still encourage you to apply. We hire for capability and impact, not a specific career path.

WHAT WE WILL PROVIDE IN RETURN:

  • Kion is a remote-first company. We offer a 100% remote work schedule (US only)!
  • Excellent compensation and outstanding benefits, including medical, dental and vision!
  • 3% of direct compensation contribution to your 401(k) (no match required).
  • Unlimited PTO to allow staff to spend time with friends and family.
  • Regular virtual engagements to better connect with co-workers and talk about life outside of work.
  • A small-team collaborative environment that fosters communication and innovation.

Compensation: The base salary range for this role is $140,000 to $170,000, plus equity. Final pay depends on experience and skills.

ISSA is looking for a contractor to serve as our IT Systems Administrator – RingCentral!

This is a fixed-term contract position: 8-12 weeks

Compensation: $40-45/hr

Hours per week: Up to 40 hours per week

Location: Remote (United States only). Candidates must reside and perform the work within the U.S.

About ISSA: ISSA is an education and certification company for fitness trainers, personal trainers, strength and conditioning coaches, nutritionists, nutrition coaches, yoga instructors, health coaches, medical professionals, and more! For over 35 years, ISSA has developed a personal fitness training program that combines gym experience with practical and applied sciences. With over 300 employees, we have certified nearly 500,000 trainers in 174 countries. We were recently recognized as a Best Place to Work and Healthiest Employer by The Phoenix Business Journal, Fastest Growing Private Company by Inc. Southwest Regionals, and Top Workplace by USA Today!

We are adding a contractor to serve as our IT Systems Administrator – RingCentral to our team of relationship-builders who are laser-focused on providing exceptional service to our students. We are tenacious and resilient in pursuing personal and professional success while incorporating fun into everyday life!

So What's the Job?

As the IT Systems Administrator – RingCentral, you will own our cloud communications platform end-to-end. In this role, you will be the subject-matter expert for RingCentral MVP (Messaging, Video, Phone), responsible for call routing, queues, IVR design, number and device provisioning, E911 compliance, call quality, and integrations with our business systems. You will also provide supporting administration of Microsoft Entra ID / Azure, Intune, and Google Workspace, primarily as they connect to identity, provisioning, and the communications experience.

Approximately 60–70% of this role is dedicated to RingCentral; the remainder covers adjacent platform administration and general IT operations.

Core Responsibilities:

RingCentral Administration & Telephony (Primary Focus)

  • Platform Ownership: Serve as the lead administrator for company-wide RingCentral MVP, including the Admin Portal, account structure, sites, extensions, user roles and permissions, and service plan/license management.
  • User & Number Lifecycle: Manage onboarding, role changes, and offboarding: extension and DID assignment, number porting and ordering, hot desking, shared lines, and license reclamation.
  • Call Queues & Routing: Design, build, and tune call queues, ring groups, business-hours and after-hours rules, holiday schedules, overflow, voicemail, and call-handling and forwarding rules.
  • IVR & Auto-Attendants: Create and maintain multi-level IVR menus and auto-attendants, prompts and greetings, and department directories, in collaboration with business stakeholders.
  • Devices & Softphones: Deploy and troubleshoot desk phones, conference phones, paging, and the RingCentral desktop and mobile apps, including auto-provisioning, firmware, and headset support.
  • E911 & Compliance: Maintain E911 addresses and emergency notifications, Kari’s Law and RAY BAUM’S Act requirements, call recording and retention settings, and number/caller ID compliance (e.g., STIR/SHAKEN registration).

Call Quality, Monitoring & Reporting

  • Call Quality Management: Monitor MOS, jitter, latency, and packet loss using RingCentral analytics and diagnostics; troubleshoot one-way audio, dropped calls, and registration issues.
  • Network Readiness: Work with networking to validate QoS, SIP ALG settings, firewall and VPN rules, bandwidth, and DHCP/DNS configuration required for reliable voice and video.
  • Analytics & Reporting: Build recurring reports on call volume, queue performance, abandoned calls, license utilization, and cost; present findings and recommendations to IT and business leaders.

Integrations, Identity & Automation

  • SSO & Provisioning: Configure and maintain SSO (SAML) and SCIM user provisioning between Microsoft Entra ID and RingCentral to automate account creation, updates, and deprovisioning.
  • App Integrations: Administer RingCentral integrations with Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace, CRM and helpdesk platforms, and other business applications.
  • API & Scripting: Use the RingCentral REST API, webhooks, PowerShell, Python, or similar tools to automate bulk changes, reporting, and onboarding/offboarding workflows.
  • Vendor & Carrier Management: Serve as the primary technical contact for RingCentral support, account managers, and carriers on escalations, number porting, contract renewals, and roadmap planning.

Supporting Platforms (Secondary Focus)

  • Identity & Azure: Support Microsoft Entra ID user lifecycle, MFA, and Conditional Access, plus basic Azure administration, as they relate to communications access and security.
  • Endpoint Management: Assist with Microsoft Intune device provisioning and app deployment (including the RingCentral app) across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android.
  • Google Workspace: Perform day-to-day Google Admin tasks, including user and group management, Gmail routing, organizational units, and domain policies.

Support, Security & Documentation

  • Tier 2/3 Escalation: Serve as the escalation point for complex telephony, collaboration, and related identity or endpoint issues; train and guide the help desk on RingCentral troubleshooting.
  • Security & Auditing: Review RingCentral audit logs, admin and user activity, and security settings (MFA, role-based permissions, toll-fraud and international-calling controls).
  • Documentation & Training: Maintain call-flow diagrams, SOPs, runbooks, and asset inventories; create end-user guides and deliver training on RingCentral features and best practices.

What is ISSA looking for (Requirements)

  • RingCentral Experience: 3+ years of hands-on administration of RingCentral MVP (or a comparable cloud UCaaS platform), including queues, IVR, number management, devices, and the Admin Portal.
  • Telephony Knowledge: Strong understanding of VoIP and SIP, codecs, call flows, DIDs, number porting, E911, and PSTN concepts.
  • Network Fundamentals: Solid foundation in TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, QoS, firewalls, and VPNs, with the ability to diagnose voice and video quality issues.
  • Identity & SSO: Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, and MFA.
  • Supporting Platforms: Practical experience with Microsoft Intune / Azure and Google Workspace administration (a strong foundation is sufficient; deep expertise is a plus).
  • Automation: Proficiency in PowerShell, Python, or Bash; experience with REST APIs is highly desirable.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate business call-handling needs into technical configurations.

Preferred Qualifications and Certifications:

  • RingCentral: RingCentral Certified Administrator (RCCA) or equivalent RingCentral certification
  • Contact Center: Experience with RingCentral contact center products or integrations (e.g., RingCX), workforce engagement, or CRM-integrated telephony
  • Microsoft: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)
  • Google: Google Workspace Administrator Certification
  • Networking / ITIL: CompTIA Network+, CCNA, or ITIL Foundation

Success in this role looks like:

  • RingCentral Uptime & Call Quality: Meeting availability SLAs and maintaining target MOS and packet-loss thresholds across sites.
  • Provisioning Turnaround: Time to complete new-hire extensions, number orders, device setups, and offboarding requests.
  • Resolution Time: Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) for telephony and collaboration tickets escalated to Tier 2/3.
  • Automation Ratio: Share of onboarding/offboarding handled automatically via SCIM, API, and scripted workflows.
  • Compliance & License Health: E911 accuracy, audit readiness, and license utilization/cost optimization.
  • User Satisfaction: End-user and stakeholder satisfaction with call handling, training, and support.

jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Senior Data Engineer, Enterprise Core Datasets, Tech Foundations

The Community You Will Join

At Airbnb, trustworthy data powers business decisions, product innovation, and operational efficiency. The Enterprise Core Datasets team builds the technical data foundations that help Airbnb understand how the business operates, where resources are invested, and how new technologies create value.

Our scope spans high-impact datasets across the organization: measuring AI adoption, usage, and cost; understanding revenue, costs, and profitability through Unit Economics; integrating non-platform data from Jira and other enterprise applications; and powering critical company metrics such as Gross Booking Value and Revenue.

You will join a team that values thoughtful architecture, engineering rigor, and operational ownership. We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains.

The Difference You Will Make

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. Your work will help the organization measure AI adoption and spending, understand the economics of its products, and connect enterprise application data to meaningful business and operational insights.

You will own complex data engineering projects from requirements gathering and technical design through implementation, validation, and production operations. Working closely with stakeholders and engineering partners, you will build maintainable data models and pipelines that accommodate new AI tools, products, cost categories, and enterprise systems while preserving clear definitions, traceability, and reliable historical data.

Operating in an ecosystem that includes petabyte-scale datasets, you will improve correctness, freshness, performance, and cost efficiency. You will build reusable components that simplify source onboarding and reduce duplicated logic. Through design reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship, you will help strengthen the team’s engineering practices and contribute to Airbnb’s broader data community.

A Typical Day

  • Design, build, and operate high-impact data pipelines across AI usage and cost, Unit Economics, enterprise applications, and critical financial metrics.
  • Partner with stakeholders to clarify how AI adoption, consumption, and spending are measured, and implement consistent data models that support those definitions.
  • Evolve Unit Economics datasets to connect revenue and diverse cost drivers, enabling teams to understand product profitability and resource efficiency.
  • Build reliable ingestion and transformation pipelines for non-platform systems such as Jira and other BizTech enterprise applications.
  • Translate complex requirements into clear source contracts, reusable fact and dimension models, and practical technical designs.
  • Develop configurable pipelines and shared components that simplify onboarding new data sources, products, and business requirements.
  • Implement automated testing, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and monitoring to protect data accuracy, completeness, and availability.
  • Plan and execute safe migrations and historical backfills through dependency analysis, validation, controlled cutovers, and recovery planning.
  • Optimize distributed processing, storage, and query performance to improve freshness and reduce compute costs.
  • Own production reliability for your datasets and pipelines through on-call participation, incident response, and improvements to systems and runbooks.
  • Contribute to technical planning and design reviews, mentor fellow engineers, and improve Airbnb’s Data Engineering Paved Path.

Your Expertise

  • 5+ years of relevant industry experience, with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • A track record of independently delivering complex data engineering projects, from requirements and technical design through implementation and sustained production ownership.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and programming skills in Python or Scala, with experience building maintainable, well-tested data systems.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed processing technologies such as Apache Spark and large-scale analytical storage systems.
  • Strong data modeling skills, including fact and dimension design, slowly changing dimensions, incremental processing, and historical data management.
  • Experience integrating heterogeneous sources, including APIs, enterprise applications, event data, and transactional systems, while managing schema changes and source reliability.
  • Proven ability to build reliable pipelines and execute migrations and backfills while preserving correctness and downstream compatibility.
  • Experience implementing data quality controls, observability, lineage, and governance practices, and troubleshooting production data issues.
  • The ability to diagnose performance bottlenecks and optimize distributed computation, storage, and query execution.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to clarify requirements with business partners, explain technical tradeoffs, and coordinate delivery across teams.
  • Experience contributing to design and code reviews, sharing knowledge, and supporting the development of other engineers.
  • Curiosity and sound judgment when learning new domains and balancing delivery needs with long-term system health.

Experience with AI usage or cost measurement, cloud cost attribution, Unit Economics, enterprise application data, or financial and payments datasets is a plus. Familiarity with workflow orchestration, SQL transformation frameworks, and modern table formats such as Apache Iceberg is also valuable.

Your Location

jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Sales Capacity & Strategy Lead to help Bask Health plan the sales resources, productivity expectations, and commercial investments needed to support our growth.

You'll partner with Sales leadership, Finance, and Revenue Operations to develop capacity models, evaluate hiring and ramp assumptions, and determine how different resource plans could affect merchant acquisition and revenue performance.

This role combines strategic planning with hands-on financial and operational analysis. You'll study historical sales performance, model future capacity, evaluate productivity trends, and help leadership understand the trade-offs behind staffing and investment decisions.

You'll also help establish consistent methods for measuring sales capacity and comparing planned performance against actual results.

We're looking for someone who is analytical, comfortable building detailed planning models, and able to translate commercial data into clear recommendations.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and maintain sales capacity planning models that support Bask's commercial growth objectives.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to understand current staffing, productivity, and future resource needs.
  • Analyze historical sales performance to establish realistic capacity assumptions.
  • Model expected sales output based on headcount, ramp periods, and productivity.
  • Support the development of quarterly and annual sales capacity plans.
  • Evaluate the impact of different hiring scenarios on expected merchant acquisition and revenue.
  • Develop models that connect sales capacity with pipeline requirements and conversion assumptions.
  • Analyze sales productivity across roles, experience levels, and relevant merchant segments.
  • Evaluate the time required for new sales team members to reach expected productivity.
  • Develop and maintain ramp assumptions for commercial planning.
  • Support the evaluation of quota-setting assumptions and overall sales capacity.
  • Identify gaps between revenue objectives and modeled sales capacity.
  • Recommend adjustments to resource plans based on capacity constraints or changing business priorities.
  • Partner with Finance to evaluate the cost and expected return of commercial hiring plans.
  • Develop scenario models comparing alternative staffing and productivity assumptions.
  • Analyze how sales cycle length and conversion rates affect capacity requirements.
  • Evaluate the operational implications of changes in merchant acquisition targets.
  • Support strategic planning for sales team expansion or changes in coverage.
  • Analyze account and merchant segmentation to inform sales resource allocation.
  • Evaluate potential differences in productivity across commercial motions and customer segments.
  • Work with Revenue Operations to ensure planning models use consistent pipeline and performance data.
  • Collaborate with Sales Operations to understand execution trends without taking ownership of weekly pipeline management.
  • Develop dashboards and reports comparing modeled capacity against actual sales performance.
  • Identify significant differences between planned productivity and actual results.
  • Investigate the assumptions contributing to capacity or performance variances.
  • Recommend improvements to planning methodologies based on observed results.
  • Develop frameworks for evaluating sales productivity and resource efficiency.
  • Support leadership discussions about commercial hiring priorities and investment timing.
  • Prepare capacity planning analyses and strategic recommendations for leadership.
  • Document capacity model assumptions, calculation methods, and scenario inputs.
  • Coordinate with Finance and other stakeholders to validate planning assumptions.
  • Support recurring commercial planning and performance review discussions.
  • Evaluate how changes in pricing, merchant demand, or commercial processes may affect capacity assumptions.
  • Develop reusable templates for sales capacity, productivity, and ramp analysis.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the reliability and efficiency of capacity planning processes.
  • Monitor sales performance trends that may affect future staffing requirements.
  • Support additional sales strategy and resource planning initiatives as Bask grows.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Strategy, GTM Strategy, Revenue Operations, Strategic Finance, Sales Planning, or a related field.
  • Experience developing sales capacity models for B2B commercial organizations.
  • Strong understanding of sales productivity, ramp periods, pipeline coverage, and quota planning.
  • Experience building financial or operational models involving staffing and revenue assumptions.
  • Advanced spreadsheet skills, including complex formulas, scenario analysis, and sensitivity analysis.
  • Experience analyzing sales performance and identifying productivity trends.
  • Ability to evaluate commercial hiring plans and resource requirements.
  • Strong understanding of B2B sales processes and commercial performance metrics.
  • Experience partnering with Sales, Finance, or Revenue Operations leadership.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to translate commercial objectives into measurable capacity assumptions.
  • Experience comparing planned sales performance with actual results.
  • Ability to identify and explain risks in staffing or productivity assumptions.
  • Experience preparing strategic planning analyses and recommendations for leadership.
  • Strong project management and cross-functional coordination skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to model accuracy.
  • Ability to work with large commercial or financial datasets.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain complex planning models and business trade-offs clearly.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of strategic initiatives.
  • Ability to manage multiple planning projects and competing priorities.
  • Availability to collaborate during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in sales capacity planning at a SaaS or technology company.
  • Experience supporting a growing B2B sales organization.
  • Experience developing annual sales hiring and capacity plans.
  • Familiarity with quota capacity, attainment, and sales productivity analysis.
  • Experience modeling sales ramp curves and time to productivity.
  • Experience evaluating territory coverage and account segmentation.
  • Familiarity with subscription, transaction-based, or usage-based revenue models.
  • Experience supporting commercial headcount and investment planning.
  • Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM platforms.
  • Experience using SQL for sales performance analysis.
  • Experience with Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar reporting tools.
  • Experience partnering with FP&A or Strategic Finance teams.
  • Familiarity with merchant acquisition and e-commerce platform business models.
  • Experience developing pipeline coverage and conversion models.
  • Familiarity with telehealth or healthcare technology.
  • Experience building commercial planning processes in a growing SaaS company.
