jobs.excerpt: Req ID:398008 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us.
jobs.description:
Req ID:398008

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Intermediate Data Scientist - Healthcare AI & Data Harmonization - Remote to join our team in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania (US-PA), United States (US).

Intermediate Data Scientist – Healthcare AI & Data Harmonization

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Intermediate Data Scientist to support the development and implementation of enterprise-scale data harmonization and automation solutions within the Healthcare and Life Sciences domain.

This individual will design, develop, and optimize intelligent data processing pipelines that ingest, transform, normalize, and map large volumes of heterogeneous medical data, including structured clinical, genomic, and operational datasets, as well as unstructured information such as clinical notes and pathology reports.

The role will leverage advanced Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), semantic search, and automated data mapping techniques to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and scalability of medical data harmonization.

The successful candidate will have hands-on experience with Python, machine learning frameworks, big data processing technologies, and healthcare data standards. Exposure to specialized AI computing infrastructure, including NVIDIA GPUs and Google TPUs, will be particularly valuable.

Key Responsibilities

Data Mapping & Harmonization

  • Design and implement automated data mapping pipelines to ingest, normalize, and transform diverse healthcare and life sciences datasets.
  • Develop solutions to map structured clinical data, including CDISC, EHR, and SDTM datasets, as well as unstructured medical information such as clinical notes and pathology reports.
  • Implement automated semantic mapping techniques to align source data with established medical terminologies and standardized vocabularies, including SNOMED CT, RxNorm, LOINC, and ICD-10.
  • Develop reusable mapping frameworks to support data standardization, interoperability, and integration across multiple data repositories.
  • Identify opportunities to improve mapping accuracy, reduce manual intervention, and increase processing efficiency through AI-driven automation.

AI, Machine Learning & Accelerator Optimization

  • Develop, fine-tune, and deploy machine learning and deep learning models to support automated data mapping, semantic alignment, and information extraction.
  • Leverage LLMs, transformer architectures, embedding models, and semantic search techniques to improve contextual understanding of complex medical data.
  • Optimize AI/ML workloads using specialized hardware accelerators, including NVIDIA GPUs, AMD Instinct, and Google TPUs.
  • Improve the performance of embedding generation, tokenization, model inference, and semantic matching processes.
  • Evaluate model accuracy, processing performance, and computational efficiency across different datasets and use cases.

Data Engineering & Pipeline Development

  • Build and maintain scalable data ingestion, transformation, and processing pipelines capable of handling large, potentially terabyte-scale healthcare datasets.
  • Develop distributed data processing workflows using PySpark and other big data technologies.
  • Integrate structured and unstructured data sources into standardized data processing environments.
  • Implement efficient data transformation, validation, and orchestration processes.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers and Architects to ensure pipelines are reliable, scalable, and production-ready.

NLP & Unstructured Medical Data Extraction

  • Develop and implement NLP and Named Entity Recognition (NER) models to extract relevant clinical information from unstructured medical documents.
  • Identify and extract medical entities, terminology, relationships, and contextual information from clinical notes, pathology reports, and other healthcare documentation.
  • Apply entity recognition, classification, normalization, and semantic matching techniques to convert unstructured information into structured datasets.
  • Evaluate and improve extraction accuracy through model testing, validation, and iterative refinement.

Data Quality, Governance & Compliance

  • Develop automated data quality and validation frameworks to ensure the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of harmonized datasets.
  • Establish validation processes for AI-generated mapping outputs and standardized medical terminology.
  • Support data lineage, reproducibility, traceability, and documentation across data processing workflows.
  • Ensure solutions align with applicable healthcare data privacy and regulatory requirements, including HIPAA and GDPR.
  • Collaborate with Data Governance and Compliance teams to support secure and responsible handling of sensitive healthcare information.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning Engineering, Data Engineering, or Applied AI.
  • 1–2+ years of experience working within Healthcare, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or Pharmaceutical environments.
  • Practical experience developing and deploying machine learning models, AI-driven data processing solutions, or automated data transformation pipelines.
  • Strong Python programming skills and experience working with structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Experience with NLP, semantic search, embeddings, transformer models, or LLM-based applications.
  • Understanding of healthcare data structures, medical terminology, and clinical data standards.
  • Experience working with large datasets and distributed data processing environments.
  • Familiarity with data quality, validation, and governance requirements in regulated or privacy-sensitive environments.

Technical Skills & Qualifications

AI, Machine Learning & Hardware Acceleration

  • Strong experience with Python-based machine learning and deep learning frameworks, including:
    • PyTorch
    • TensorFlow
    • Hugging Face Transformers
    • Pandas and NumPy
  • Experience developing or deploying LLMs, transformer-based models, embedding models, and NLP solutions.
  • Exposure to AI hardware acceleration using NVIDIA Tensor Core GPUs, AMD Instinct, or Google TPUs.
  • Familiarity with CUDA, TensorRT, and/or Triton Inference Server.
  • Understanding of model optimization, inference performance, and distributed AI computing.

Healthcare Data Standards & Medical Ontologies

  • Working knowledge of healthcare data models, standards, and biomedical vocabularies, including:
    • OMOP Common Data Model
    • HL7 FHIR
    • HL7
    • UMLS
    • SNOMED CT
    • RxNorm
    • LOINC
    • ICD-10
  • Familiarity with clinical data structures, EHR systems, and pharmaceutical or clinical research datasets, including CDISC and SDTM.

Data Engineering & Big Data Technologies

  • Strong SQL and Python programming capabilities.
  • Experience with PySpark and distributed data processing frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Databricks, AWS EMR, and/or Google Cloud Dataproc.
  • Understanding of data ingestion, transformation, harmonization, and large-scale processing architectures.

Automation & MLOps

  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or Prefect.
  • Familiarity with Git, Docker, and CI/CD development practices.
  • Understanding of model deployment, version control, automated testing, and production ML workflows.

Education

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Biomedical Informatics, Computational Biology, Machine Learning, or another related quantitative discipline.

Pay Transparency

Where required by law, NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for specific roles. The starting pay range for this remote role is $104,194-$142,500. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications.

This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits.

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

jobs.description:
Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years. Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia.

Commercial Counsel

About Adprime

Adprime Media is a vertically integrated advertising technology company headquartered in New York. Our platform spans a demand-side platform, a programmatic ad exchange, audience, data, and ad products, and campaign intelligence. We work with agencies, brands, and publishers across performance and healthcare verticals, and we are building an AI-first engineering and operations culture.

Role Summary

Adprime Media is seeking a practical, commercially minded full-time Commercial Counsel to support its digital advertising business. This attorney will lead day-to-day contract work across the company, including ad tech agreements, NDAs, vendor contracts, data protection agreements, and other commercial arrangements.

The role is suited for an experienced commercial attorney, or a product/privacy-adjacent attorney with strong ad tech contract experience, who can negotiate efficiently, identify legal and business risks, and provide concise, actionable guidance. The attorney will work closely with commercial, product, operations, and leadership teams in a fast-moving environment. Success requires balancing legal risk with commercial priorities rather than taking purely academic positions.

The position will report into General Counsel of NW Media Holding Corp., the parent company of Adprime Media LLC.

Key Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, revise, and negotiate contracts across the business, including:
    • DSP and SSP agreements;
    • Advertiser, agency, publisher, and platform agreements;
    • Identity resolution, measurement, attribution, and data partner agreements;
    • NDAs and confidentiality agreements;
    • Vendor, technology, software, and professional services agreements;
    • DPAs and other privacy and data-related terms; and
    • Other customer, partner, and general commercial agreements.
  • Develop and maintain contract templates, standard provisions, negotiation positions, and practical contracting processes.
  • Identify and advise on legal and business risks involving data use rights, service descriptions, platform obligations, performance commitments, liability allocation, indemnities, audit rights, confidentiality, regulatory compliance, and termination.
  • Provide practical contract interpretation, issue spotting, and guidance on commercial, advertising, privacy, and data governance matters.
  • Advise on advertising compliance topics, including truth-in-advertising, claim substantiation, disclosures, political advertising, platform-specific restrictions, and applicable sector-specific advertising rules.
  • Address privacy and data governance issues relevant to programmatic advertising, including consent frameworks, lawful basis concepts, controller and processor roles, data-sharing restrictions, cross-border data considerations, and contractual privacy obligations.
  • Conduct focused legal research concerning U.S. and European advertising and privacy requirements and translate findings into concise, business-oriented recommendations.
  • Partner with commercial, product, operations, and leadership stakeholders to resolve legal questions and advance transactions under tight timelines.
  • Identify matters requiring specialized or jurisdiction-specific advice and coordinate with outside counsel as appropriate.

Required Qualifications

  • J.D. or equivalent legal qualification, with active bar membership or authorization to practice in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  • Meaningful experience drafting and negotiating ad tech and other commercial agreements.
  • Strong familiarity with the programmatic advertising ecosystem and the contractual provisions commonly found in DSP, SSP, identity, measurement, data partner, NDA, DPA, and vendor agreements.
  • General understanding of advertising regulations in the United States and Europe, with the ability to independently research specialized requirements, including political advertising rules.
  • Functional understanding of privacy law in the context of programmatic advertising sufficient to support contract negotiation, issue spotting, and business guidance.
  • Working knowledge of GDPR and ePrivacy concepts, U.S. state privacy laws like CCPA, data-sharing restrictions, cross-border data considerations, and advertising compliance issues arising in digital media transactions.
  • Strong judgment, responsiveness, and the ability to work effectively with demanding stakeholders under time pressure.
  • Excellent drafting, negotiation, prioritization, and concise communication skills.
  • Ability to advise non-legal stakeholders in practical terms and independently manage multiple matters.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demand-side experience, including familiarity with advertiser, agency, DSP, measurement, attribution, and identity-related commercial arrangements.
  • Experience advising digital advertising, media, martech, or data-driven technology businesses.
  • Experience building scalable contracting processes and managing a broad commercial contract portfolio.
  • Ability to assess legal issues across multiple jurisdictions while avoiding unnecessary complexity or delay.
  • An existing network of trusted, cost-effective outside counsel in European jurisdictions for country-specific legal questions.

Compensation

Base salary: Up to $130,000 annually with annual performance bonus eligibility.

Working Style and Stakeholder Environment

This is a hands-on, business-facing role for an attorney who can serve as a practical legal partner across the company. The successful candidate will manage routine and complex commercial contracts, keep pace with a high-demand stakeholder environment, and provide advice that is clear, risk-aware, and commercially workable. The role does not require specialist expertise in every jurisdiction, but it does require the ability to identify material issues, conduct targeted research, and recognize when country-specific or specialized outside advice is appropriate.

About Hint Health

Hint Health is the leading digital health company dedicated to supporting the growth and success of the Direct Primary Care (DPC) movement. With a mission to power direct care and make it the new standard, the Hint Core platform supports thousands of clinics and networks across the nation, providing care for over a million members. Hint also produces Hint Summit, the leading DPC innovation conference and supports Hint Connect, a curated national network of independent DPC clinics. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco, CA. To learn more visit.

The Opportunity

As an Account Executive, you’ll help expand Hint’s customer base by working assigned opportunities through established sales processes, with coaching from your manager and teammates. You’ll partner with independent clinicians and healthcare leaders to understand their goals, simplify operations, and help them succeed with the Direct Care model. You’ll learn the full sales cycle by following established practices for qualifying leads, running standard demos, managing next steps, and moving high-volume deals through early stages.

You’ll work across assigned inbound, outbound, and partner opportunities, partnering with your manager and cross-functional teammates to support a clear, consistent buyer experience. It’s an opportunity to build your craft, make a measurable impact, and contribute to meaningful change in how healthcare operates.

If you’re curious, organized, energized by customer conversations, and eager to grow through feedback and coaching, you’ll thrive here.

Team Culture & The Hint Vibe

At Hint, we believe Culture is a foundational element to our ongoing success. We are a tight-knit, collaborative sales team that believes in balancing hustle with heart. We show up for each other, share wins, and stay curious. You’ll find teammates who genuinely care - about our customers, our mission, and each other. We’re competitive in the right ways, and we believe success is best when it’s shared.

You’ll thrive here if you:

  • Value transparency and integrity in how you sell

  • Bring positivity and energy to your work and your team

  • Enjoy solving problems collaboratively and learning from others

  • Appreciate constructive feedback and use it to get better every day

  • Celebrate others’ wins as much as your own

  • Care deeply about transforming healthcare and empowering independent practices

If you’re looking for a place where you can grow your craft, make a meaningful impact, and be part of a team that genuinely has your back - you’ll fit right in at Hint.

What You’ll Do

  • Work opportunities through established sales stages, using provided outreach, discovery, demo, and follow-up practices; take increasing ownership of standard opportunities with coaching

  • Follow up promptly with inbound leads and carry out assigned outreach using established target lists, messaging, and activity expectations

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with independent practices and healthcare leaders

  • Deliver standard product demos that explain key features in the context of a practice’s day-to-day workflow, adapting the presentation to the prospect with guidance

  • Keep HubSpot records current, update deal stages weekly using defined forecast categories, and document clear next steps; ask for guidance when a deal or process is unclear

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Product, Network, and Customer Success to create a seamless buyer journey

  • Apply coaching and feedback to improve your individual workflows, and use available tools - including basic AI prompts where useful - to increase administrative efficiency.

  • Meet or exceed quarterly and annual goals with consistency and integrity

About You

Must have:

  • 2 - 3 years of B2B SaaS experience with a proven track record. Healthcare experience is a plus.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to listen actively and ask questions to understand customer needs.

  • Ability to learn and sell a comprehensive, evolving product suite

  • High emotional intelligence and customer empathy

  • Openness to learning new sales tools, including AI tools that can improve day-to-day administrative efficiency.

  • Willingness to learn Hint’s sales process, apply feedback, and contribute collaboratively to team goals.

  • Embrace Hint’s Core Values - Be Transparent, Learn Continuously, Care Deeply

  • Based in and authorized to work in the U.S.

  • Required to travel for conferences and company events

Highly desired:

  • Familiarity with the U.S. healthcare system, Direct Primary Care (DPC), and Direct Care models

  • Experience managing a high volume of customer interactions is helpful.

  • Strong organizational skills and a self-starter mindset

  • Experience with HubSpot or similar CRMs

  • Collaborative by nature - you lift others and welcome feedback

Life at Hint
Our team is inquisitive, kind, open, and smart. We share glimpses of our lives—introducing our kids and pets—and host virtual hangouts to stay connected. Our employee Slack channels include spaces for women, caregivers, and our Diversity & Inclusion Committee. We also have regular cadences for company all-hands updates and team learning sessions so all Hinters can stay connected to how their work is changing the landscape of healthcare.
Hint has taken the Parity Pledge and is committed to racial and gender parity. Furthermore, those historically underrepresented in tech—including people of color, immigrants, members of the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities and veterans—are encouraged to apply. We look for the best candidate for the job based on demonstrable skills, and do not screen for educational background, age, or markers of socioeconomic status.
Benefits
At Hint we support our teams to be their best by taking care of them and providing attractive benefits.
* Competitive compensation of base salary & stock options
* Progressive paid parental leave for both parents
* Remote-first workplace, home office stipend & optional in-person meet-ups
* Flexible working hours, flexible vacation, & paid national holidays

Additional benefits by location

United States

* 401(k) plan
* Comprehensive medical, dental, & vision + DPC membership or HSA stipend

Canada

* Extended healthcare & dental coverage + HCSA stipend

Principal Product Designer

US Remote | Full-Time

Who We Are:

NuvemRx helps community health providers deliver on their mission by simplifying the complexity of pharmacy operations —with a suite of scalable solutions that integrate software, intelligence and expert support that can illuminate savings, expand access, and elevate patient care.

What We Are Looking For:

At NuvemRx, we know high standards must be maintained to deliver impact at scale, and we want to work with people that embody our core values:

  • Mission Always: Every choice is a chance to service our customer. Every choice is a chance to serve -and make healthcare better for all. We don’t just check boxes- we make choices that serve people and move the mission forward.
  • Be A Pioneer: Find the problem. Invent the Solution. We don’t wait for direction—we take initiative, stay resourceful, and create what’s needed - not just what’s expected. Pioneers chart new territory with vision, courage, and grit. We learn quickly and turn challenges into momentum.
  • Do the Right Thing the Right Way: We lead with care, respect, and compliance—and we don’t cut corners. We solve the right problems the right way, always balancing speed with thoughtfulness, and outcomes with ethics.
  • Stronger Together: Own Your Role. Play for the Team. We bring diverse voices together to solve hard problems with humility and shared ownership. We challenge each other with respect, hold each other accountable, and strive to be the best for the team—not just on the team.

Because we are a fast-growing company with a bold mission and a lot of work to do, every employee of NuvemRx must also have growth company DNA, which requires either success working in a fast-paced VC/PE-backed early-stage company with high expectations or the underlying qualities that create that success including: high-motor, comfort with ambiguity, resilience in all of its forms, and a growth mindset. No matter your job level, you will own your work from beginning to end, take feedback well, prioritize what matters, never rest on your laurels, stay positive and resilient, and make data-driven decisions.

As a Principal Product Designer, you lead through craft, systems, and influence. This role owns two company-wide programs: Nuvem’s unified design system, and our center of excellence for customer, user, and patient journeys. Through both, you set the standard for how Nuvem products look, behave, and fit together. You also create forward-looking visions for our 340B products, partner with product and engineering to make them real, and confidently influence stakeholders. You also champion the use of AI across design, helping Nuvem’s product and engineering teams adopt AI tools and use them to move faster from idea to validated, shipped product.

What You'll Do:

Platform Design System

  • Own Nuvem’s unified design system end to end, including its vision, roadmap, governance, and adoption across all Nuvem products.
  • Define and maintain design foundations (color, typography, spacing, iconography, accessibility standards) and a library of reusable components and patterns with clear usage guidance.
  • Partner with engineering to keep design and code components in sync, including design tokens, versioning, and release notes.
  • Run the contribution and review process so product teams can propose, build, and adopt new patterns without fragmenting the experience.
  • Ensure the system meets accessibility standards (such as WCAG) and supports both desktop and mobile experiences.
  • Track adoption and consistency across products, and drive the retirement of legacy and one-off UI.
  • Structure the design system so AI design and coding tools can use it well (for example, clearly documented components and tokens), so teams can generate on-system designs and code faster.

User and Customer Journey Center of Excellence

  • Own and drive Nuvem’s research and journey work across three lenses: customer journeys (how Covered Entities evaluate, implement, run, and renew with Nuvem), user journeys (the day-to-day workflows of 340B program managers, pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, finance and compliance staff, and internal Nuvem teams), and patient journeys (how patients move from care encounter to prescription to affordable access at the pharmacy).
  • Partner with product and business leaders to use journeys to surface pain points, prioritize roadmap opportunities, and measure experience outcomes.
  • Keep journeys current through research, customer feedback, and operational data.
  • Use AI tools to speed up research synthesis and journey mapping, such as summarizing interview notes and customer feedback, with human review and no PHI entered into unapproved tools.
  • Handle all patient-journey research and artifacts in line with HIPAA and Nuvem’s confidentiality policies.

AI-Enabled Product Design Leadership

  • Operate as a senior design leader and champion for product design at Nuvem.
  • Raise the bar for design craft across the team through design critique, shared standards, and example.
  • Champion the adoption of AI tools across design and product, sharing practices and workflows that help teams work faster without sacrificing quality.
  • Use AI to accelerate prototyping and development, such as building working prototypes quickly and partnering with engineering on AI-assisted design-to-code handoff.

jobs.excerpt: Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.
jobs.description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We’re looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer, Financial Performance, to join our UK SMB sales team, which serves everything from small firms all the way up to mid-market firms. This role is open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or Ireland.


You recognise that financial and accounting systems are the foundation of successful law firms. If you have experience managing billing, client account and office operations as a Legal Cashier, Bookkeeper, Practice Manager, or COFA, or if you’ve sold SaaS solutions like Xero, Sage, QuickBooks, LEAP or Unity (formerly Quill), you understand the complexities UK firms face when scaling their business. This is an opportunity for you to guide law firms across the UK on how to work smarter, faster and more securely using Clio’s legal intelligence platform.

As the first Financial Performance Solutions Engineer in EMEA, you’ll be the go-to expert on legal finance in UK sales cycles, predominantly in England and Wales. You’ll help shape how Clio positions its financial suite in the UK, from discovery through to the handoff to Customer Success.


Your Team

You’ll join our Solutions Engineering team, which serves as the Swiss Army knife for our entire sales organisation. Using your hybrid skill set, you’ll explain how our platform and partner ecosystem solve specific problems while clearly articulating value to customers. You’ll partner closely with our generalist Solutions Engineers in UKI and work closely with EMEA Account Executives to help close new business by navigating the complex technical, financial and regulatory challenges facing UK SMB firms, from small practices to the mid-market. You’ll also be paired with our Financial Performance SEs in North America to learn best practices and share knowledge.


What You Will Do


  • Lead Technical Strategy: Own the technical deal cycle for UK SMB opportunities, enabling firms to scale by solving complex hurdles in financial reporting and automated billing, and showing how Clio supports firms in meeting their obligations under the SRA Accounts Rules and the equivalent rules in Scotland and Northern Ireland.
  • Articulate Value: Collaborate with Sales to clearly explain Clio’s core capabilities and third-party integrations, including the UK accounting and payments tools firms already rely on.
  • Build Proof of Concepts: Create technical demonstrations that connect product features back to tangible business value and ROI, such as faster billing cycles, improved lock-up and cleaner month-end reconciliations.
  • Drive Revenue Goals: Partner with Sales to create urgency and contribute to the team’s revenue targets.
  • Manage the Sales Lifecycle: Support the full sales cycle, from initial technical scoping and migration planning (Xero, QuickBooks Online, Sage or legal-specific accounting software) to a smooth handoff to Onboarding and Customer Success.
  • Partner with Clio Certified Consultants: Bring in CCCs (the accounting and bookkeeping firms that serve Clio customers) when a deal needs specialist accounting support, and relay their feedback to Product.
  • Influence the Product: Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to share UK market feedback and influence the future product roadmap.
  • Enable the Sales Team: Train AEs and SEs to run confident financial discovery and handle common accounting and client money questions without escalation.
  • Maintain Expertise: Stay current on UK legal industry news, regulatory changes and technology products to ensure you remain an expert in the legal and financial ecosystem.

What You Bring


  • Relevant Experience: You have significant experience working in or with UK law firms. That could be managing finance and operations as a Legal Cashier, Bookkeeper, Accounts Assistant, Practice Manager or COFA within an SRA-regulated firm, or selling and supporting legal or accounting software to UK firms, such as LEAP, Unity (formerly Quill), Osprey, Peppermint, Xero, Sage, QuickBooks, Aderant, Elite 3E or other relevant SaaS solutions.
  • UK Legal Finance Knowledge: A working understanding of the SRA Accounts Rules and how law firms manage client and office accounts, including reconciliations, client ledgers and the correction of breaches, with awareness of the equivalent rules in Scotland and Northern Ireland. You also understand UK VAT as it applies to law firms, including the treatment of disbursements and Making Tax Digital.
  • Communication Skills: The ability to explain complex technical or financial solutions in plain English to various stakeholders, from Managing Partners and Finance Directors to Legal Cashiers, and to navigate objections with empathy.
  • Technical Proficiency: A solid understanding of cloud technologies, including APIs, data migrations and security infrastructure.
  • UK GDPR Knowledge: A working knowledge of UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018, and how data protection, security and data residency shape law firm buying decisions.
  • Problem Solving: A creative and curious mindset used to find solutions for difficult technical or operational problems.
  • Relationship Building: The ability to build strong, trust-based relationships with both internal teams and external customers.
  • Location and Travel: Based anywhere in the UK or Ireland with the right to work there. This is a remote role, with access to Clio’s Dublin and London offices and occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.

Serious Bonus Points If You:


  • Have experience with UK legal practice management or legal research solutions.
  • Hold a recognised accounting or legal finance qualification, such as ACA, CA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA Ireland, AAT or the ILFM Diploma.
  • Have experience with conveyancing or probate accounting, such as completion statements and estate accounts.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate your work (e.g. draft tailored RFP responses, build demo environments, analyse data).

What you will find here:


Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:

  • Competitive, equitable salary
  • Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions to be in office minimum twice per week. (Find your Hub)
  • 25 days holiday + bank holidays
  • Private Healthcare with Life Insurance & Critical Illness cover
  • Pension contribution
  • Professional development and growth options
  • Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years
The expected salary range for this role is £42,500 to £57,500 GBP. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers

We're a Human and High Performing AI company, meaning we use artificial intelligence to improve all of our operations. In recruitment, AI helps us streamline the process for greater efficiency. However, we've built our systems to ensure that a human always reviews AI-generated output, and we never make automated hiring decisions.

jobs.excerpt: As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless!
jobs.description:
As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless! Let Nationwide help create your career journey! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Join Nationwide’s P&C actuarial team and help shape countrywide property pricing. In this consultant-level role, you’ll bring actuarial analysis, organization, and collaborative leadership to countrywide property pricing work—supporting accurate, well-coordinated rate indications and practical recommendations for business partners.


What you’ll do


  • Coordinate the schedule for state filing indications, helping prioritize work based on upcoming state pricing projects, due dates, and business needs.
  • Partner with state pricing teams to confirm the scope of each indication, including forms and companies in scope.
  • Assemble state filing indications for more complex states, as needed. Review and provide feedback on indications prepared by other analysts, promoting quality, consistency, and sound actuarial analysis.
  • Conduct ad hoc actuarial analyses and annual study refreshes; some assignments may involve developing an approach where no established precedent exists.
  • Help prepare initial responses to Department of Insurance (DOI) questions about filed indications.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to actuarial colleagues and business stakeholders; present project results when needed.
  • Look for opportunities to improve analytical templates and processes. Most work is completed in Excel; familiarity with code that supports templates is helpful but not required.

What you’ll bring


  • A strong actuarial foundation and familiarity with indication methodology and how indications support pricing decisions.
  • Strong Excel, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with care for documentation and quality.
  • Clear communication and the ability to organize work, manage competing priorities, and influence partners without direct authority.
  • Initiative and adaptability when priorities shift or an assignment has no established playbook.
  • Solid actuarial exam progress. ACAS preferred. Prior indication experience in any product line is a plus; property pricing experience is especially valuable. Coding experience is also a plus, not a requirement.

A chance to grow your influence


This individual-contributor role offers an opportunity to build leadership experience by coordinating a meaningful body of work, reviewing and coaching a colleague’s deliverables, and partnering with state pricing teams. You’ll have opportunities to contribute to visible analyses and share findings with business leaders—all without direct people-management responsibility. You’ll also join a P&C actuarial environment that encourages innovation, learning, and the use of analytical tools to strengthen work. This role can be staffed fully remote.


Job Description Summary

Our Property and Casualty (P&C) Actuarial team members have opportunities to use state-of-the-art tools, are encouraged to innovate and learn to master actuarial methodologies. If this sounds like a place you could thrive, then we want to know more about you!

As an Actuarial Consultant, you’ll need to be adept at actuarial functions and know P&C products to perform complex, quantitative actuarial analyses. In addition, we’ll count on you to provide expertise, including consultation and recommendations, on actuarial models and issues.

This position may have the opportunity to be a part of the P&C Actuarial Rotation Program, which will give you the potential opportunity to work on various actuarial, analytics, and risk management teams to learn and develop across different actuarial functions. Should you choose to participate in the program, you will participate in two to three rotations of two years each. Full program details will be provided to you upon your start date.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Has in depth knowledge of actuarial methodologies with the ability to source and manipulate complex data within standard requirements.

  • Conducts complex analyses, adhering to actuarial standards, by selecting appropriate data sources, making assumptions, recognizing considerations, and developing recommendations. Resolves unreasonable results/non-optimal solutions using experience and professional judgment.

  • Accurately documents assumptions, methods, sources, and considerations in an organized fashion.

  • Prepares and presents actuarial findings and documents that are suitable for technical and non-technical audiences at the senior Actuarial leadership level. May professionally represent company position with regulators, auditors, and external vendors.

  • Develops work plans and ensures accurate work product is delivered.

  • Leads peer reviews to increase collaboration, ensure quality work, and drive innovation.

  • Maintains relationship with business customers as well as builds new relationships.

  • Leads onboarding and training for new associates on standard work processes.

  • Applies data mining techniques used to identify new relationships in data and make recommendations based on findings. Builds and validates models in different software packages. Explores the use of new software packages. Has practical use of predictive modeling.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to an Actuarial, Analytics, or Risk Management leader.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, data science or similar background requiring modeling, programming or quantitative analysis.

jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing
jobs.excerpt: Position OverviewEndear is hiring a Director of Product Marketing to own product positioning, new product and features launches, and sales enablement as we expand into an enterprise one.
jobs.description:
Position Overview

Endear is hiring a Director of Product Marketing to own product positioning, new product and features launches, and sales enablement as we expand into an enterprise one.

This is a chance to build something from the ground up. You'll shape what the function looks like, show its impact through a few product launches, and set the direction for how it grows. You'll start as a team of one with a clear path to hiring your first report. You'll build that team on the wins you deliver.

You'll also be at the center of our biggest growth opportunity: moving upmarket. Endear is growing from supporting 10-store retail brands to also supporting 100+ store brands, and that's a different kind of sale: new buyers, more stakeholders, deeper security and procurement conversations, and bigger deals. You'll shape the messaging, proof points, and enablement that win those enterprise deals while keeping them sharp for the mid-market customers who got us here.

At the same time, we're shipping. You will run launches for new products and features end to end — from the positioning decision through the enablement, the campaign inputs, and the post-launch read on whether it actually moved adoption and pipeline. This is a hands-on, player-coach role to start.

What You'll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you'll…

  • Define the enterprise buyer: who they are, what they care about, what procurement and security ask for, and where our current story falls short.

  • Rebuild core sales enablement for the enterprise motion: pitch narrative, objection handling, competitive battlecards, and the collateral that shows up in a committee deal.

  • Partner with Sales leadership to identify the specific points in the enterprise cycle where marketing content changes the outcome, and build for those.

  • Establish a repeatable launch process: tiers, timelines, owners, and run at least one major launch through it end to end.

  • Audit our current messaging and build one research-backed framework (core narrative, persona messaging, and differentiation) that every function can use and that translates cleanly into pitch decks and collateral.

  • Interview customers and lost deals across both segments and bring back a documented, evidence-based view of why we win and why we lose.

In your first year, you'll…

  • Own the go-to-market for every significant product and feature launch, with measurable adoption and pipeline outcomes attached to each.

  • Establish product marketing as the source of truth for positioning across Sales, Product, Lifecycle, and Content so the story is consistent wherever a prospect encounters it.

  • Build the competitive intelligence practice: who we're up against by segment, how to beat them, and how to keep that current without it becoming a full-time job.

  • Partner with Product and leadership on packaging and pricing decisions for the enterprise tier.

  • Demonstrate the function's impact clearly in win rate, deal size, and launch performance to justify and make your first hire.

You'll Thrive in This Role If…

You Have Experience With

  • 8+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing. Retail or retail-tech background strongly preferred.

  • Both enterprise and mid-market sales motions, with a real understanding of how they differ: buying committees, procurement, security review, cycle length, and what enablement each one actually requires.

  • Leading a company through an upmarket transition, or joining one mid-transition and helping it land.

  • Owning product and feature launches end to end (positioning, enablement, campaign inputs, and the post-launch measurement) not just writing the launch blog post.

  • Building a function from scratch. You've worked without an established messaging framework, launch process, or competitive library and built them.

  • Doing your own customer and win/loss research, and turning it into positioning a salesperson will actually use.

  • Writing exceptionally well. Messaging is a writing job before it's a strategy job.

  • Partnering closely with Product on roadmap, packaging, and pricing, and being a credible voice of the market in that room.

  • Earning influence with a sales team, including AEs who have their own opinions about the pitch.

  • Working in a growth-stage environment where you are both the strategist and the person building the deck.

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here's how they translate into what we're looking for in this role:

Customer First: Positioning comes from customer conversations, not from a whiteboard. Talk to merchants and associates, and let what they say change the story.

Take Ownership: Own the outcome of a launch, not the launch checklist. If adoption didn't move, that's a product marketing problem to solve, not a data point to report.

Enable Autonomy: Build messaging, enablement, and launch systems clear enough that Sales, Lifecycle, and Content can execute against them without checking in first.

Under Promise, Over Deliver: Pick a small number of launches and land them completely. A function of one earns its second headcount by depth, not breadth.

Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: Ship the first version of the messaging, test it in live deals, and revise. Perfect positioning that arrives after the quarter is worth nothing.

About the Team

You'll report to the VP of Marketing and partner most closely with:

  • Sales Leadership and AEs: the enterprise pitch, objection handling, competitive positioning, and what's actually happening in live deals.

  • Product and Design: roadmap context, launch sequencing, packaging, and pricing.

  • Demand Generation: messaging and audience inputs for campaigns; the story that carries into paid and outbound.

  • Lifecycle Marketing: launch campaigns to the existing base, and the upsell and cross-sell motions that follow a release.

  • Customer Success: adoption signals, customer proof points, and the reference stories enterprise buyers ask for.

We're a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we're solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Positioning Exercise

  4. Panel interview with cross-functional leaders

  5. Final conversation with Co-Founders

  6. Offer

jobs.excerpt: About PolarGridPolarGrid is an early-stage Canadian company that runs managed AI inference.
jobs.description:
About PolarGrid

PolarGrid is an early-stage Canadian company that runs managed AI inference. Customers bring their own models, and we run them as fast, reliable production endpoints on GPU servers across many sites. We are a small team of about five engineers.

The role

You will own the routing layer: the service that decides which GPU serves each request. You will build it, run it in production and set its technical direction.

This is a hands-on staff role. Most of your time goes to designing and writing the router and the placement logic behind it. You will work closely with the engineers who run our network and our GPU sites, and you will help hire the engineers who join you.

The work

Every request has to land on a GPU that is healthy, has room and is close enough to be fast. The hard part is that capacity and health change constantly across many sites, and the router has to make good decisions quickly with information that is always slightly out of date. It also has to fail safely: when a site or server goes down, traffic moves without customers noticing.

What you bring

  • Deep knowledge of how networks, proxies and load balancers work underneath, from building or running production systems.

  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals: consistency, failure handling, retries and backpressure.

  • You write production code in a systems language such as Go or Rust.

  • You measure latency at the tail, not just the average, and know how to find where it comes from.

  • You have been on call for what you built.

  • You have set technical direction that other engineers built on.

  • You write clearly.

  • You use AI tools well and check their work.

You do not need GPU or ML experience. What matters is that you understand the systems underneath deeply and want to build a new one from the start.

What we're looking for:

  • 12–15+ years of progressive HR / People Operations experience in multi-country, high-growth tech environments.
  • People leadership: 7+ years managing and developing HR / People Ops teams, ideally across multiple regions and time zones.

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience in a high-growth SaaS, product, or platform technology company.

Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE JOB

The Visualization Director is responsible for leading the planning, coordination, and execution of all architectural, interior design, and concept visualization assets across our global venue development portfolio. This role serves as the central hub between brand, concept, and design teams, external visualization partners, architects and interior designers and project stakeholders to ensure the delivery of high-quality visual assets that communicate our design vision and support project development, approvals, and business growth.


Reporting to the Head of Brand & Experience, the Visualization Director will oversee the entire visualization workflow—from project intake and scheduling through final delivery—while maintaining quality standards, managing consultant relationships, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and within budget.


Visualization is one of the most powerful storytelling tools within our venue development process. From early brand and concept ideation to executive presentations and marketing assets, exceptional visualizations help communicate the vision, inspire confidence, and accelerate decision-making. The Visualization Director plays a critical role in ensuring every render, animation, and visual asset reflects the creativity, quality, and innovation that define Blueprint Studio and our global portfolio of venues.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO


Visualization Leadership

  • Manage the end-to-end production of all architectural, interior design, environmental, and concept visualization assets.
  • Oversee the creation of high-quality still renderings, animations, fly-throughs, and arena web platforms that accurately communicate brand, concept, and design intent.
  • Establish and maintain visualization standards that ensure consistency across all projects and global markets.
  • Review all visualization deliverables for quality, accuracy, brand alignment, atmosphere, and storytelling before distribution.
  • Create new standards, working efficiently and effectively across many priorities and with many teams.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging visualization technologies, workflows, and AI tools to improve efficiency and creative output.

Project & Workflow Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all visualization requests across the team and global markets.
  • Develop and maintain production schedules, priorities, and resource allocation across multiple concurrent projects, delivering on time and often with competing priorities.
  • Coordinate project kickoffs, establish deliverable timelines, and communicate milestones to internal teams and external partners.
  • Track project status, proactively identify risks, and resolve scheduling conflicts to maintain project momentum.
  • Ensure stakeholder feedback is collected, consolidated, and communicated in a timely manner to minimize revision cycles and maintain project schedules.
  • Assure budget approval and track scope and intercoding with the Blueprint Studio finance team.
  • Manage visualization asset libraries, file organization, and version control.

Internal Collaboration

  • Partner closely with architecture, interior design, concept, branding, and development teams to understand project objectives and visualization requirements.
  • Have clear understanding of project vision, understand the essence of each idea, design, or concept and be able to relay the intention to external vendors.
  • Collaborate with project managers and design managers to define visualization scope and priorities.
  • Support executive leadership with presentation-quality visual materials for presentations and strategic initiatives.
  • Foster strong communication across multidisciplinary teams to ensure visualization outputs accurately represent evolving design concepts and business needs for marketing, communications, and premium sales teams.

External Partner Management

  • Manage relationships with external visualization studios, freelancers, and production partners.
  • Develop scopes of work, coordinate project assignments, and monitor performance against quality and schedule expectations.
  • Provide clear creative direction, reference materials, and consolidated feedback throughout production.
  • Maintain overall excellence in visual output - attention to detail around lighting, atmosphere, finishes and experiential details that make sure our visuals are polished.
  • Evaluate partner performance and recommend opportunities for continuous improvement or expansion of visualization resources.

Financial & Administrative Management

  • Track visualization budgets across multiple projects.
  • Review, reconcile, and approve monthly invoices from external visualization partners.
  • Monitor project expenditures and ensure work remains within approved budgets.
  • Maintain accurate records of contracts, billing, project scopes, and deliverables.
  • Assist in forecasting visualization workload and consultant resource needs.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Environmental Design, Visualization, or a related field.
  • 5–8+ years of experience managing architectural visualization, design undefined
  • Experience coordinating visualization efforts across architecture and interior design projects as well as marketing assets to communicate new projects externally.
  • Proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience managing external consultants or creative agencies.
  • Strong understanding of architectural and interior design documentation and workflows.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to design quality.

Preferred

  • Experience working on hospitality, entertainment, sports, mixed-use, or undefined
  • Familiarity with visualization workflows using FrameIO, 3ds Max, V-Ray, Corona, Unreal Engine, Twinmotion, Lumion, Enscape, or similar rendering platforms.
  • Familiarity with Revit, Rhino, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, and presentation software.
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted visualization tools and emerging creative technologies.

    • Project & Workflow Coordination

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Strategic Planning

    • Time Management
    • Attention to Detail

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Summary

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to own a defined portfolio of computer vision machine learning capabilities in biometrics or document intelligence, end to end, from first idea to live and monitored. You will work within portfolio standards and priorities set by ML Product leadership, and connect customer needs, evolving fraud threats, and commercial priorities with the work of machine learning, data science, and engineering teams. This role reports to the Senior Director of Product Management, Machine Learning & Fraud.

The ideal candidate has experience bringing ML products into production, as a product manager or in a technical delivery role, and improving their performance over time. You will define which problems to solve, make clear prioritization decisions, and translate technical capabilities into measurable customer and business value. This is a hands-on role requiring strong product judgment, technical fluency, and the confidence to challenge assumptions and propose practical alternatives. It also carries direct customer exposure: you will be the named product owner for your portfolio with large banks and financial institutions, including their fraud, model risk, and audit teams.

ML Product owns product strategy, product definition, product development, product support, and customer outcomes. This includes target operating points, roadmap position, release readiness, enablement, and the governance record.

    Strategy and roadmap

  • Ensure delivery plans incorporate drift detection, feedback loops, rollout criteria, experimentation, and rollback guardrails.

    • Performance, data, and fraud defense

  • Enable Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing with accurate positioning, and make sure external performance claims are supported by validated results.

    • Portfolio Focus

    We are hiring two portfolios. Candidates should bring deep experience in at least one.

    Document fraud, capture, and model delivery

  • Evaluate third-party and partner models through benchmarking and shadow deployments, and make build, buy, or partner recommendations.

jobs.description:
Title: Opus 5.5 AI Video Creator (full time)

Salary: $1,000 to $1,500/month, depending on experience

Location: Remote, based in the Philippines (UTC+8).

About us

Process Street is the compliance operations platform. Teams use it to automate business processes, enforce policies and deliver audit ready proof. It is trusted by more than 1 million users at 3,000+ companies. www.process.st

We also build an AI teammate product for Slack and Microsoft Teams.

We are an AI first company: almost everything we do runs through agents, and our own video pipeline already runs on Claude and HyperFrames.

The role

We want one full time hire producing 10+ finished AI assisted videos per working day for our products. The core skill is directing Claude Opus 5.5: writing long, detailed briefs that describe scene, character, motion and brand intent; maintaining character and style sheets so every video stays visually consistent; having Opus 5.5 write each scene as code through HyperFrames' code layer (exact, editable, re renderable) rather than one shot text to video; and running a fast review loop (check a still frame, direct a correction, re render) until each video hits the bar.

This is a production line role: consistent daily output against repeatable Opus 5.5 direction patterns, not one off bespoke design per video.

What a great day looks like

  • 10+ videos a day, each delivered in 16:9 and 9:16.
  • Each video starts from a written Opus 5.5 brief plus a maintained style and character sheet for the brand, rendered through HyperFrames' code layer, with a storyboard still check before full render.
  • Every on screen claim traceable to our live site or the brief. Real logo, fonts, colors and product screens, never placeholders.
  • Music on every video, captions on the 9:16 cut.
  • Files in the shared folder by end of day with the brief, style sheet reference and a one line note on what was directed or corrected.

Tools we provide

  • Claude Max subscription for Opus 5.5 (we pay).
  • HyperFrames with our templates and brand skills (we pay and provide).
  • Generative AI clip tools for inserts as needed (we pay, agreed in advance).
  • ElevenLabs voiceover credits when a brief calls for narration (we pay).

You don’t need any of these to apply. Free or trial versions of any AI tool are fine for your samples.

How we review applications

  • We review work you’ve already made instead of running a trial. Please share links to videos you’ve created. If you don’t have work you can share yet, we won’t be able to move your application forward.

What to submit

  1. A portfolio link, or 3 video links, of your best motion or product video work (required). Please make sure the links open without a login.
  2. At least one sample made with AI tools (Claude, HyperFrames, Remotion or similar), with a sentence on how you made it.
  3. Your workflow in 5 lines: tools, how you use references, how you get from brief to final.
  4. Your timezone and how many videos a day you can realistically deliver.

How we judge

  • Motion craft (25): pacing, easing, transitions, typography in motion.
  • AI directed workflow (20): at least one AI-made sample with a clear, believable explanation of how it was made. We favor directed, editable workflows (briefs, code-based tools like HyperFrames or Remotion) over one-shot text to video.
  • Visual consistency (15): logo, color, type and style hold steady within a video and across samples.
  • Story and hook (15): clear first 2 seconds, one idea, a real payoff.
  • Clarity and accuracy (10): explains the product or idea clearly, with no made-up claims or numbers.
  • Native 9:16 (10): at least one vertical sample that’s recomposed for vertical, not cropped from 16:9.
  • Sound (5): music throughout, clean levels, no silent gaps.
  • Automatic fail: no shareable work, watermarks, a wrong or distorted logo, visibly broken frames, or samples the candidate can’t explain making.

jobs.excerpt: We're Hiring Remote Academic Coach & Student Assistant (Part-Time, ~10 hours/week) The steady partner who helps a high-achieving student master hard material and never miss a deadline.
jobs.description:
We're Hiring

Remote Academic Coach & Student Assistant (Part-Time, ~10 hours/week)

The steady partner who helps a high-achieving student master hard material and never miss a deadline.

About the Role

Seamless Assist is hiring a part-time Academic Coach & Student Assistant for a US-based family. You will work one-on-one, online, with their daughter, a motivated high-school student taking classes a year ahead of her grade, including several college-level Advanced Placement (AP) courses. This role reports to the student's parent.

Why This Role Exists

The student doesn't need to be taught from scratch. She is carrying a demanding, writing-heavy course load, and the pressure is in the volume: essays, problem sets, labs, tests and extracurricular deadlines all landing in the same week. This role exists to give her a sharp, organised partner who can keep up with advanced material, help her work through the hardest parts, and keep her schedule under control so nothing slips.

Her Current Classes

  • AP Microeconomics & Macroeconomics
  • AP Biology
  • AP English Language & Composition
  • AP US History
  • Pre-Calculus
  • Spanish 4
  • Journalism & News Production

You don't need to be an expert in every subject. You do need to be strong in several of them, especially writing-heavy courses (AP English Language, AP US History) and at least one of economics, biology or maths.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Academic coaching (about 70% of your time)

  • Run live one-on-one video sessions to work through homework, problem sets, essays and test preparation.
  • Explain difficult concepts clearly and check that she can explain them back.
  • Review essays and written work for argument, structure, evidence and citations, including AP-style timed essays.
  • Build practice questions, review plans and study guides ahead of tests and the AP exams in May.
  • Learn how each course is taught and graded (syllabi, teacher rubrics, the College Board AP course frameworks) and coach to them.
  • Coach, never complete. Her work must always be her own, in line with her school's academic integrity rules.

Planning and student assistant support (about 30% of your time)

  • Run a weekly planning session: map every class's assignments, tests and deadlines into a shared calendar and task list.
  • Keep her schedule current across classes, activities and appointments, with study time blocked in.
  • Send short reminders before deadlines and confirm work was actually submitted.
  • Track grades and flag early when something starts to slip.
  • Send the parent a short weekly progress update.

Schedule

About 10 hours per week. Sessions fall on weekday afternoons and evenings, US Pacific Time (roughly 3:30–8:30 pm PT), plus one short weekend planning session. You must be reliably available in that window.

Who Will Succeed in This Role

This is a high-trust role with a bright, busy teenager. You will need real subject depth, patience, and the organisational discipline of a strong executive assistant.

  • You explain things clearly and can tell the difference between "I get it" and actually getting it.
  • You are a strong writer and can give specific, useful feedback on an argumentative essay.
  • You run your own life from a calendar and a task list, and you follow up without being asked.
  • You are warm, steady and encouraging, and you hold a high standard.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or higher, ideally in education, English, history, economics, biology, mathematics or a related field.
  • At least 2 years of tutoring or teaching high-school or first-year university students.
  • Strong command of the material in several of the subjects listed above.
  • Excellent written and spoken English. Your writing will be assessed during screening.
  • Uses AI tools in your daily work (for example Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini) to build study materials and plan faster, and can teach a student to use them responsibly and within school rules.
  • Able to work US Pacific Time afternoons and evenings, about 10 hours per week.
  • Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, a webcam and a backup power or internet plan.
  • Willing to complete a national police clearance or background check and provide two professional references before starting.

Nice to have

  • Experience with the US Advanced Placement (AP) programme, or strong AP, SAT, IB or A-Level results of your own.
  • Conversational or better Spanish.
  • Journalism, editing or newsroom experience.
  • Comfortable in Google Workspace (Calendar, Docs, Drive) and a task tool such as Notion or Todoist.

How We Work

Because this role involves working one-on-one with a teenager, clear safeguards apply. All sessions run on a family-owned video account and are recorded. All messages go through a group channel that includes a parent. There is no private messaging or social-media contact with the student. A background check and references are required before the first paid session.

Pay

Competitive hourly pay, paid monthly in USD. Pay varies by country.

How to Apply

Apply with your CV. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short AI-led video interview, a written subject task, an interview with the family and a paid trial session.

About Karius

Karius is a venture-backed life science company transforming how pathogens and other microbes are detected throughout the body. By unlocking the information present in microbial cell-free DNA, we help physicians solve some of their most challenging infectious disease cases, accelerate biomarker discovery and clinical trials for industry partners, and ultimately reduce patient suffering worldwide.

Position Summary

This is an opportunity to join a growing life sciences company at the forefront of infectious disease diagnostics. Karius is expanding the adoption of its proprietary next-generation sequencing test across hospitals and health systems in the United States. Joining Karius offers the chance to accelerate your career while contributing to a mission that has a direct impact on patient care.

The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) plays a critical role in Karius’ commercial strategy by driving proactive outbound engagement and early-stage opportunity creation within a defined, region-based territory. The ISR focuses on initiating new conversations, securing meetings, and creating early commercial momentum, particularly within low-activity or early-stage hospital accounts.

Working in close partnership with Clinical Sales Managers (CSMs) and Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs), the ISR owns the front end of the customer journey, progressing opportunities to a qualified meeting and ensuring a smooth handoff to the field team for continued development.

Key ISR Job Functions

Key ISR job functions include, but are not limited to, the following:

Outbound Prospecting & Meeting Generation

  • Execute proactive outbound calling and multi-channel outreach to initiate conversations with targeted hospital stakeholders

  • Design and implement structured prospecting strategies and outreach cadences

  • Secure qualified meetings with appropriate clinical, laboratory, and administrative decision-makers

Early-Stage Account Engagement

  • Own early engagement for assigned low-volume or low-activity hospital and health system accounts

  • Identify unmet needs, access gaps, and opportunities for further engagement

  • Progress accounts to a defined next step, culminating in a qualified meeting for CSM/MSL handoff

Event and Program Conversion

  • Support regional events, speaker programs, and conferences through pre-event outreach and post-event follow-up

  • Convert event engagement into scheduled meetings and qualified opportunities

Opportunity & Activity Management

  • Accurately document outreach, interactions, and meetings in Salesforce

  • Maintain visibility into ISR-owned activity, opportunity progression, and handoff status

Why Should You Join Us?

Karius is advancing infectious disease diagnostics through innovations in genomics, machine learning, and clinical science. Our platform delivers unprecedented insight into the microbial landscape, providing physicians with powerful tools to diagnose complex infections and improve patient outcomes. As part of the Karius team, your work will have a meaningful and measurable impact on patient care at scale.

Reports to: Regional Sales Director

Location: GreaterSalt Lake City, Utah area

    Source new opportunities through structured outbound calling and targeted outreach

  • Conduct introductory, high-level technical conversations to assess fit and interest

  • Own early-stage opportunity progression through meeting creation and documented handoff

  • Partner with CSMs/MSLs to align on targeting, messaging, and territory priorities

  • Support regional meetings, events, and programs by driving pre- and post-event engagement

  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Product teams to share market insights and feedback

  • Maintain accurate CRM documentation related to ISR-owned outreach, meetings, and opportunities

  • Participate in training, team meetings, and industry events as required

  • Contribute to a collaborative, high-performance commercial culture

What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • Consistent, high-quality outbound activity

  • Meetings secured with appropriate hospital stakeholders

  • Clear opportunity progression and clean handoffs to the field

  • Strong partnership and alignment with CSM and MSL counterparts

Travel

Approximately 15% travel for meetings, training, and co-field engagement.

Physical Requirements

This role may require extended periods of sitting or standing. Work is generally performed remotely or in the field.

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree; advanced degree or MBA a plus

  • 2+ years of sales or business development experience in life sciences, diagnostics, medical devices, or pharmaceuticals

  • Demonstrated success introducing novel or transformational products in complex clinical environments

  • Strong communication, organization, and prioritization skills

  • Ability to engage a wide range of hospital stakeholders with confidence and professionalism
