jobs.title: Sales Operations Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About UsAt Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

This role owns how our sales process works across Direct-to-Consumer, Physician Partnerships, and Enterprise — how work flows, what the systems are asked to do, and what the sales organization sees when it opens them. It is the person who finds where reps lose time, designs a better way, and drives it into practice.

This role reports to the Director, Commercial Strategy and Operations and works as a close building partner to our Sales Operations Manager. The two roles design the commercial operating infrastructure together, with the Specialist bringing hands-on execution, workflow design, and a constant eye on where the process is costing reps time. This is a partnership, not a support function — you are expected to bring your own point of view on how things should work, not wait to be handed specifications.

How we work with Salesforce. Our IT team owns and maintains the Salesforce platform. Commercial owns the design: we determine what the business needs the system to do, build the proposals and requirements behind those changes, and partner with IT to implement them. This role works hands-on in the surface layer — reports, dashboards, list views, and the configuration available to us — and specifies everything deeper. Success here depends as much on writing a clear, well-justified proposal and shepherding it through a queue you do not control as it does on building things yourself.

The role also extends this thinking beyond Sales Operations. The same discipline — map the workflow, find the friction, redesign it, measure whether it helped — applies wherever the commercial organization touches other functions, including handoffs with Marketing, Clinical, Finance, Legal, and Sales Enablement. Where a process spans teams, this role is expected to see the whole of it rather than only the Sales-shaped part.

Prenuvo's commercial function is still being built, so there is real ownership available here. The processes you design will be the ones the sales organization runs on as it scales.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You'll Do

Workflow Design and Rep Efficiency

  • Map how work actually flows through the sales process today across each channel, and identify where reps lose time to manual steps, duplicate entry, unclear handoffs, or waiting on someone else.
  • Design improvements to sales workflows — automation, validation, templated processes, streamlined approvals, better-structured records — that measurably reduce the administrative burden on reps.
  • Sit with reps and sales leaders regularly to understand where the process gets in their way, and translate what you hear into specific, well-defined change proposals.
  • Apply the same workflow discipline to processes that extend beyond Sales Operations, partnering with Marketing, Clinical, Finance, Legal, and Sales Enablement to remove friction at the handoff points between teams.
  • Track the time and effort cost of process changes, and be honest about which ones worked and which added complexity without benefit.
  • Bring a continuous improvement mindset: treat the current process as a draft rather than a given.

Solution Design and Partnership with IT

  • Partner with the Sales Operations Manager to define what the commercial organization needs Salesforce and the wider sales tech stack to do, and how those systems should be structured to support the sales process.
  • Translate business needs into clear, complete written requirements — the problem, the proposed solution, the business justification, acceptance criteria, and downstream impacts — that IT can scope and implement without a second round of discovery.
  • Build the case for prioritization: quantify the cost of the current state, articulate the benefit of the change, and advocate for commercial requests within a shared IT backlog.
  • Manage the intake and triage of change requests from the sales organization, distinguishing genuine process needs from one-off preferences, and maintaining a prioritized queue with the Sales Operations Manager.
  • Partner with IT through the build, answering questions, resolving ambiguity, and flagging where a proposed technical approach will create problems for reps.
  • Own user acceptance testing for commercial changes before release, and validate that what was delivered solves the problem that was raised.
  • Maintain a record of what was changed, why, and what it was meant to achieve.

Reporting, Surface Configuration and Data Integrity

  • Build and maintain the standing reports and dashboards that Sales leadership uses to manage the business, including pipeline, activity, conversion, and channel performance.
  • Own the CRM surface layer available to Commercial — reports, dashboards, list views, and the configuration within our access — so the sales organization sees what it needs without a ticket.
  • Monitor data quality across commercial records, run routine audits that catch problems before they reach a report, and drive remediation — directly where possible, and through IT where a bulk or structural fix is required.
  • Maintain pipeline hygiene — stage definitions applied consistently, close dates kept current, stalled opportunities surfaced — working directly with reps and managers to keep it clean.
  • Flag anomalies and trends you notice in the data rather than only reporting what was asked for.
  • Partner with Finance to ensure commercial reporting reconciles with financial reporting.

Adoption, Documentation and Support

  • Document sales processes and system procedures so they are usable by a new rep in their first week, and keep that documentation current as things change.
  • Train reps and managers on new processes, fields, and tools, partnering with Sales Enablement where changes need to be reinforced over time.
  • Provide first-line support for process and system questions from the sales organization, resolving what you can and routing the rest to IT with enough detail to be actioned.
  • Drive adoption of process changes by making the right way the easiest way, and by following up where new processes are not sticking.
  • Maintain confidentiality and HIPAA compliance when handling patient, physician, and client data in commercial systems.

What You’ll Bring

  • 2–4 years in sales operations, revenue operations, business operations, or a comparable role supporting a sales team.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce as an advanced user and report builder — the data model, page layouts, list views, reports and dashboards — sufficient to scope a change, specify it precisely, and test what is delivered. Administrator certification is welcome but not required; the ability to define a change clearly matters more than the ability to build it.
  • Demonstrated experience improving a sales process or workflow, with a concrete example of what was inefficient, what you changed, and what it saved. This is the core of the role.
  • Experience translating business needs into written requirements, user stories, or change proposals for a technical or IT team to implement, and carrying them through testing and release.
  • Comfort operating through a backlog you do not control — making the case for priority, working within someone else's sequencing, and finding interim solutions when a request will not be built soon.
  • Experience building alongside a more senior operations partner — contributing to design decisions and owning delivery — rather than only executing defined tickets.
  • Strong reporting and analytical skills, including advanced Excel or Google Sheets. SQL or experience with a BI tool is an asset.
  • Genuine discipline around data quality, and the judgment to know which inconsistencies matter and which do not.
  • Ability to gather requirements from non-technical people, ask the question behind the request, and translate the answer into a defined solution.
  • Ability to see a process end to end across functions, including the parts that sit outside your own team's ownership.
  • Clear written communication and documentation skills, and comfort training others on process changes.
  • Strong prioritization and service orientation, with the ability to manage competing requests from multiple stakeholders without losing track of longer-term improvement work.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced environment where processes and infrastructure are still being built, and willingness to own outcomes rather than wait for direction.
  • Experience supporting more than one sales motion — high-volume consumer, partnership, or enterprise — is an asset.
  • Healthcare, diagnostics, or other regulated-industry experience is preferred, given HIPAA exposure across commercial systems.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • The base salary for this role ranges from $75,000-$87,750 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

About Us

Every employee is treated as a valued contributor that brings their own unique experience and perspective to the issues we are solving for our users. Summary

We are looking for a fully remote Senior Developer Experience (DevEx) Engineer to join our growing organization. Our DevEx team works closely with our other engineering teams to remove friction from the software delivery lifecycle — CI/CD pipelines, on-demand testing environments, internal developer platforms, and AI-assisted developer tooling, etc. In this position, you will contribute to the systems and processes that other engineers rely on every day, and you will see the outcome of your work through faster pipelines, shorter waits for environments, easier onboarding, and engineering teams that ship with less friction.

This role overlaps with DevOps and Platform Engineering — you'll work in AWS, write infrastructure as code, and be accountable for the reliability of shared systems but, rather than optimizing production operations first, you are optimizing the experience of the engineers who build on top of WellHive's platform. Having a strong background in software development is a must. As we scale to meet the needs of our customers, the speed and reliability of our own engineering workflows become as critical as the systems we ship. Do you thrive in an environment that encourages innovation and adopting new technologies and processes — including AI-assisted development? We continuously look for new ways to remove friction for our engineering teams and encourage innovative thinking and problem solving. If you are passionate about building tools other engineers love to use, writing maintainable code in an agile environment, and working with like-minded people, you might be a great fit.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Developer Experience, Developer Enablement, Platform Engineering, or DevOps related experience (AWS technologies preferred)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • Proficiency with modern software development practices across the full stack; this role will largely use Go and TypeScript, though prior proficiency in other programming languages is welcome.
  • Experience designing, maintaining, and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins experience strongly preferred)
  • Hands-on experience with core AWS services (ECS, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch)
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, ideally Pulumi (Terraform, CDK, or CloudFormation also acceptable)
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Bash, Python, and/or PowerShell
  • Experience with version control, especially Git and GitHub, including branching strategies, PR workflows, and CI integration
  • Experience building or maintaining self-service developer tooling — ephemeral environments, environment provisioning, internal platforms/portals, or similar
  • Ability to work fully remote within the continental USA in an Eastern or Central time zone (excluding New York)
  • High speed internet connection
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills — this role requires driving cross-team consensus on engineering standards, not just implementing them in isolation
  • Must be a US citizen or Permanent Resident

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with browser-based end-to-end and visual regression testing frameworks (Playwright preferred)
  • Experience with distributed tracing and observability stacks (Grafana/LGTM, Splunk, AWS CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry)
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) into engineering workflows, including CI-integrated AI code review
  • Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), or experience building tool integrations for AI coding agents
  • Experience designing or consuming OpenAPI/Swagger-based client generation and API versioning strategies across multiple repositories
  • Experience working in a FedRAMP and/or HIPAA-compliant environment
  • AWS certifications (Developer, DevOps, Solutions Architect, etc.)
  • Experience with Linux and/or Windows administration
  • Experience working in an Agile development environment

Essential Job Functions

  • Measure the development cycle, such as lead time, deploy frequency, change failure rate, and build and test time. Use it to pick what to improve next.
  • Improve CI/CD pipeline reliability, speed, and observability (e.g., build caching, merge queues, splitting shared pipelines per environment), and treat metrics like CI wall time and DORA metrics as owned, tracked outcomes rather than side effects
  • Evaluate, integrate, and support AI-assisted developer tooling — coding agents, AI-assisted code review, MCP servers — as part of the standard engineering workflow, balancing productivity gains against security and compliance boundaries
  • Write custom code for developer-facing tools, automation, and infrastructure as code in Go, TypeScript, and Pulumi
  • Partner with engineering teams to define engineering and testing best practices (e.g., end-to-end test data isolation, visual regression testing) and encode them into shared libraries, linters, and CI guardrails so they're easy to follow and hard to violate
  • Provide technical leadership through design reviews, written design docs and trade-off analyses, and detailed, constructive peer reviews
  • Proactively research emerging developer-tooling and DevEx practices, evaluate their fit for WellHive's stack, and drive adoption when business needs warrant
  • Participate in code reviews, design sessions, and all sprint ceremonies (standup, sprint review, retrospective, grooming)
  • Participate in an on-call rotation for developer-tooling and CI/CD pipeline incidents
  • Provide coaching and mentoring to other engineers, and champion developer-experience thinking across teams

The Accounts Receivable (AR) Insurance Analyst is responsible for managing and resolving outstanding insurance balances to ensure timely and accurate reimbursement for services rendered. About AllShore Talent

AllShore Talent partners with growing organizations to build high-performing technology and consulting teams. We connect skilled professionals with meaningful, long-term engagements across web technologies, digital experience platforms, and enterprise software delivery — offering competitive compensation, flexible engagement models, and a collaborative, remote-friendly culture.

About The Role

The Data Architect provides hands-on data architecture and technical delivery expertise for Adobe Analytics to Customer Journey Analytics modernisation. The role assesses the customer’s current analytics and data-collection implementation, defines the Adobe Experience Platform and CJA target architecture, maps existing data and components to the new platform, and guides implementation, validation and transition.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery covering current data collection, data models, identities, integrations and platform configuration.

  • Document the current-state architecture and define a scalable target-state architecture based on Adobe Experience Platform.

  • Translate business and migration requirements into schemas, datasets, identity designs, data flows and integration specifications.

  • Map legacy implementation components and data structures to the target platform, identifying what should be migrated, redesigned or retired.

  • Work with technical consultants and customer engineering teams to implement the agreed architecture.

  • Define data quality, governance, privacy, security, retention, validation and reconciliation requirements.

  • Investigate source-to-target discrepancies and guide their resolution.

  • Produce clear architecture, design, mapping and implementation documentation, and identify dependencies, assumptions and risks early.

  • Support architecture governance and technical quality throughout implementation.

  • Understanding of AEP guardrails and licensing constraints, including recognising when a design is technically possible but not available under the customer’s licence.

  • lead workshops, present and recommend solutions, document designs and gain customer agreement.

Requirements

Experience and skills

Essential

  • Strong experience with web data collection and digital analytics implementation.

  • Strong working knowledge of Adobe Analytics, including report suites, variables, events, processing rules and implementation design.

  • Practical experience with Adobe Data Collection, including Adobe Launch or Tags.

  • Practical experience designing or implementing Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK solutions.

  • Experience with Adobe Experience Platform Mobile SDK and mobile data-collection patterns.

  • Strong Adobe Experience Platform experience, including XDM schemas, datasets, datastreams, batch and streaming ingestion, identity namespaces, profile enablement, data governance and retention.

  • Experience defining the data foundation for Customer Journey Analytics, including connections, data views, reporting identity and stitching approaches.

  • Experience mapping an Adobe Analytics implementation to an AEP and CJA target architecture.

  • Ability to validate data across Adobe Analytics, AEP and CJA and investigate reporting differences.

  • Experience facilitating customer-facing technical discovery and design workshops.

  • GDPR and privacy/consent awareness

Highly desirable

  • Previous delivery of an Adobe Analytics-to-CJA migration or modernisation program.

  • Experience using the Adobe Analytics source connector for historical data while establishing Web SDK or Mobile SDK-based future-state collection.

  • Experience analyzing report suites, classifications, processing rules, marketing channels, segments, calculated metrics and workspaces.

  • Understanding of field-based and graph-based stitching.

  • Experience designing for online, offline or cross-channel datasets.

  • Experience defining reporting-parity, reconciliation and acceptance approaches.

  • Experience supporting Adobe Analytics retirement following successful CJA implementation and validation.

  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, SQL, JSON, REST APIs and data-query or validation tools.

Expected deliverables

  • Current-state Analytics and data-collection assessment.

  • Target-state AEP and CJA data architecture.

  • Source-to-target mappings and XDM schema and dataset designs.

  • Identity, profile, datastream and Edge Network design.

  • CJA connection, data-view and reporting-identity design.

  • Migration assumptions, dependencies, risks and customer-owned activities.

  • Validation, reconciliation and acceptance plan.

  • Technical implementation and operational handover documentation.

Engagement details section:

  • Contract role.

  • Starts soon; a two-week notice period is acceptable.

  • Lasts 1–3 years.

  • Remote anywhere in EMEA, preferably Central Europe.

  • Occasional business travel, with expenses covered.

Program context: two migration paths built on AEP (AA → CJA and Campaign Classic → AJO). Customers are mostly B2C, across the UK, France, Spain, Germany, Norway and Italy.

Languages: strong professional English is required. German, French or Italian is highly valued.

Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is a well-established martial arts and fitness centre in Melbourne, Australia, with over 500 members. They offer a variety of training programs, including MMA, Muay Thai, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, wrestling, strength and fitness, and kids' classes. Catering to different age groups and skill levels, the centre is committed to providing a welcoming and supportive environment where members can develop their skills, improve their fitness, and build confidence.

Role Overview: Our client is seeking a Virtual Receptionist to serve as the first point of contact for prospective and existing members. The role focuses on responding promptly to enquiries, converting prospective members into booked introduction lessons, managing trial bookings, and providing ongoing member support. The successful candidate will play an important role in delivering a welcoming and positive experience across phone, email, and social media channels.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Handle inbound calls, website enquiries, emails, and social media messages, ensuring timely and professional responses.
  • Manage prospective member enquiries and update lead information accurately in the CRM.
  • Book introduction lessons for new prospects and manage their trial schedules.
  • Follow up with prospects, confirm bookings, and coordinate rescheduling to encourage attendance at their first class.
  • Assist existing members with membership enquiries, bookings, payments, and general support.
  • Guide members through the online processes for membership cancellations and suspensions.
  • Conduct re-engagement calls to reconnect with inactive members.
  • Maintain accurate records of enquiries, follow-ups, bookings, and member interactions.
  • Prepare weekly reports and follow established procedures and call scripts.
  • Coordinate with the on-site front desk team to ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

How We Work

  • Free Trial Offers: Adult prospects are offered a 30-day free trial, typically starting with a one-hour introduction lesson. Children are offered two free lessons. Receptionists should focus on booking these introductory sessions rather than providing pricing over the phone.
  • Call Monitoring and Coaching: Calls are recorded and reviewed weekly against established scripts to ensure service quality, with regular coaching and feedback provided.
  • Membership Cancellations and Suspensions: Members are responsible for submitting their own cancellation or suspension requests through the website forms. The receptionist will guide them step by step through the process, including locating the correct form and completing the required details. All refund requests are subject to approval by the business owners.

Tools & Communication Channels

The Virtual Receptionist will manage enquiries and member communications across four main channels:

Phone: Handle incoming calls and return missed calls through the gym's VoIP phone system.

Website Enquiries: Respond to contact form submissions received through the company's email inbox.

Social Media: Manage enquiries and messages through Instagram and Facebook.

Mindbody Messenger: Respond to member messages through the Mindbody platform.

The business uses Mindbody to manage memberships, bookings, payments, and prospective member enquiries through its CRM. Training on the system and internal standard operating procedures (SOPs) will be provided. Experience with Mindbody or similar gym management and booking platforms is an advantage.

Requirements

  • At least 2-3 years of experience in phone-based reception, customer service, sales, or a similar role, preferably in a remote or virtual setup.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with a warm, confident, and professional phone manner.
  • Experience handling customer enquiries, following up leads, and converting prospects into appointments or bookings.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with attention to detail in maintaining records and managing schedules.
  • Comfortable handling multiple communication channels, including phone, email, and social media.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, appointment scheduling tools, or booking platforms.
  • Ability to work independently, follow established procedures, and consistently meet response and follow-up expectations.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience using Mindbody or similar gym management and booking systems.
  • Previous experience supporting Australian clients.
  • Background in the fitness, martial arts, gym, or membership-based industry.
  • Experience in sales, lead conversion, or membership retention.
  • Mandarin language skills.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Billing & Reconciliation Analyst to help Bask Health maintain accurate merchant billing and ensure commercial agreements are reflected correctly in our billing processes.

You'll work with Finance, Revenue Operations, Pricing, Sales, and Customer Success to review merchant agreements, compare approved terms against billing records, investigate discrepancies, and support accurate invoicing.

This role combines detailed financial operations with commercial contract analysis. You'll work with rates, discounts, credits, effective dates, and transaction information to identify inconsistencies and help resolve billing issues.

You'll also support improvements to reconciliation processes, documentation, and reporting so billing information is accurate, consistent, and easier to review.

We're looking for someone who enjoys working with detailed financial records, has strong analytical skills, and takes ownership of resolving discrepancies.

What You'll Do

  • Review merchant billing records for accuracy and consistency with approved commercial agreements.
  • Reconcile invoiced amounts against signed contracts and applicable pricing terms.
  • Verify that merchant rates, fees, and discounts are reflected correctly in billing records.
  • Review contract effective dates and confirm that billing changes are applied during the correct periods.
  • Investigate differences between expected charges and actual invoices.
  • Support the reconciliation of transaction activity and usage information against billed amounts.
  • Review credits and billing adjustments for accuracy and appropriate documentation.
  • Partner with Finance to investigate billing discrepancies and resolve outstanding issues.
  • Work with Pricing to understand approved commercial terms and pricing changes.
  • Collaborate with Revenue Operations to maintain accurate merchant billing information.
  • Support the implementation and validation of approved pricing changes in billing systems.
  • Compare contract terms with billing configuration to identify inconsistencies.
  • Maintain reconciliation spreadsheets and supporting documentation.
  • Prepare recurring reports summarizing billing discrepancies and reconciliation status.
  • Track outstanding billing issues and coordinate follow-up with relevant teams.
  • Investigate duplicate charges, missing charges, and incorrect billing amounts.
  • Review billing adjustments to confirm they reflect authorized changes.
  • Help maintain accurate records of merchant rates, discounts, and effective dates.
  • Support reconciliation of merchant transaction volumes and applicable fees.
  • Identify potential revenue leakage resulting from billing inconsistencies.
  • Escalate significant discrepancies or unusual billing patterns to senior team members.
  • Assist with reviewing historical billing records when discrepancies are identified.
  • Partner with Customer Success to support the resolution of merchant billing questions.
  • Provide clear supporting information for internal billing investigations.
  • Help maintain organized documentation of commercial agreements and billing records.
  • Support monthly billing review and reconciliation processes.
  • Develop spreadsheet models to compare expected and actual billing amounts.
  • Analyze recurring billing discrepancies to identify common causes.
  • Recommend improvements to billing validation and reconciliation procedures.
  • Support the development of standardized reconciliation templates.
  • Help establish consistent definitions for billing and reconciliation metrics.
  • Work with relevant teams to improve data accuracy across commercial and billing systems.
  • Support testing and validation of changes to billing configuration.
  • Document reconciliation methodologies and issue resolution procedures.
  • Assist with preparing information for internal financial reviews.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive billing checks and reconciliation tasks.
  • Support additional billing operations and revenue integrity projects as needed.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in Billing Operations, Billing Reconciliation, Revenue Operations, Finance Operations, Accounting Operations, or a related field.
  • Experience reviewing invoices, billing records, or financial transactions for accuracy.
  • Strong understanding of billing reconciliation and discrepancy investigation.
  • Experience comparing contractual or approved commercial terms against billing records.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.
  • Ability to work accurately with rates, discounts, credits, and effective dates.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills.
  • Experience identifying and resolving discrepancies in financial or operational data.
  • Ability to review and interpret commercial agreements or billing documentation.
  • Strong attention to detail when working with financial records.
  • Experience maintaining reconciliation reports and supporting documentation.
  • Ability to investigate root causes of billing inconsistencies.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple outstanding issues.
  • Experience collaborating with Finance, Revenue Operations, or commercial teams.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable working with confidential commercial and financial information.
  • Ability to follow established approval and escalation processes.
  • Experience meeting recurring billing or financial reporting deadlines.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of reconciliation tasks.
  • Ability to learn new billing platforms and internal business systems.
  • Availability to collaborate during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in billing operations at a SaaS or technology company.

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for an SEO Manager to own SocialPilot's organic growth across Google and AI answers, and to lead our SEO team while doing hands-on work alongside it.
jobs.description:
We are looking for an SEO Manager to own SocialPilot's organic growth across Google and AI answers, and to lead our SEO team while doing hands-on work alongside it. Search is being rebuilt by AI answers.

The role has two jobs. First, brand discovery. Grow how many new people discover SocialPilot every month, on Google, in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google's AI answers, on Reddit and YouTube, and in the lists and review sites buyers trust. Second, revenue. Turn that discovery into sign-ups, paying customers, and revenue. You are measured on both, not on traffic or rankings alone.

You report to the Head of Marketing on a weekly cadence. B2B SaaS experience is a must. You will do well here if you are revenue-oriented, AI-focused, and like to move fast.

What you will do:

Grow brand discovery

  • Measure brand discovery - Track how many new people discover SocialPilot each month, and where they find us, across Google, AI answers, Reddit, YouTube, lists, and review sites. Grow that number every month.

  • Set the organic strategy - Sort our searches by what the searcher wants, and put the team's effort where buyers search, not only where volume is. Build the topical map and decide where we play and in what order, across comparison, alternatives and "best tools" pages, product and feature pages, content, and international. Decide which pages to build, fix, merge, or retire.

  • Win in AI answers (GEO and AEO) - Grow how often ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and AI Overviews and AI Mode name, cite, and recommend SocialPilot, and how often they name us against our competitors.

  • Run outreach and collaborations. Get SocialPilot onto the "best tools" lists, review roundups, publications, Reddit threads, and YouTube videos that rank on Google and that AI answers cite. Set Reddit and YouTube targets with the teams that produce for them. Build lasting relationships with publishers, partners and creators, and earn links and mentions through digital PR.

  • Manage our listings and review sites. Own how SocialPilot appears on G2, Capterra, and other review sites, software directories, and AI app directories. Grow reviews and keep how we describe SocialPilot consistent everywhere, so Google and AI assistants understand what we are.

  • Get the right content published. Work with the content team to plan, brief, and publish the content organic growth needs, on time. Review the search side, so every page answers a real buyer question well enough for Google and AI answers to use it.

Turn discovery into revenue:

  • Grow revenue from organic. Own new sign-ups, paying customers, and revenue from organic search and AI answers, and keep growing them. Build the monthly forecast for discovery and revenue, and hit it.

  • Put buyer pages first. Win back the searches where buyers compare tools, and make sure those pages lead to a trial.

  • Diagnose and measure. Use Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, AI visibility tools and log data to find what moved and why. Check rankings live, by country and device, before reporting them. Tie every channel, including AI answers, to the sign-ups and revenue it brings, and turn data into decisions.

  • Bring new ideas and test them. Do not wait for a brief. Bring your own ideas for more discovery and revenue every month, from what the best SaaS teams, our competitors, and new AI search features are doing. Size each one, and test the best with the cheapest test, a clear hypothesis, and a kill rule set before the data comes in. Stay ahead of Google updates and changes in AI search, and act on them.

Lead and run organic:

  • Lead the SEO team. Lead the SEO team and do hands-on work alongside them. Set clear weekly targets, review work, coach, and hire. Manage SEO tools and agencies within budget.

  • Run technical SEO and guard every release. Own the SEO backlog with our web developers. Crawling, indexing, site architecture, structured data, page speed, migrations, and redirects. No page is removed, redirected, or moved without an SEO check, and every site change goes in a release log, so we always know what changed and when.

  • Use AI and automation. Build AI workflows and agents with the team to research, brief, audit, and report faster.

  • Work across teams. Partner with content, web, design, product, and paid to ship pages and fixes on time. Set the brief, hold the quality bar, and keep work moving.

Must have skills:

  • 3+ years managing an SEO team with direct reports, while still doing the work yourself. You have set their targets, reviewed their work, grown them, and hired. Informal mentoring does not count.

  • Proven revenue impact from SEO. You have grown revenue through organic search and can show the sign-ups, paying customers, or revenue your work brought. You measure SEO by how many new people discover the brand and the revenue that discovery brings, not by traffic or rankings alone. You know which searches bring buyers and which bring readers. You have built an organic forecast and owned a quarterly number. You can walk us through a drop you diagnosed and recovered, or growth you built, and what it was worth.

  • 8+ years of hands-on SEO B2B SaaS experience.

  • A deep, current understanding of how search is changing across SEO, GEO, and how LLMs find, choose, and cite their sources. You keep up every week and can show what you changed in your own work because of it.

  • Reddit and YouTube experience, such as growing a brand's presence in Reddit threads or in YouTube search.

  • Hands-on with AI visibility tools such as BrightEdge and Profound. You know what they measure well and what they miss.

jobs.description:
Corporate Security Engineer (Endpoint and ISG)

Reports to: Head of Security · Location: Remote (Greece, Poland, Spain, Portugal, Bosnia and Hercegovina, Serbia) · Works with: Corporate IT

The role

You secure every TRG laptop, account and browser. You turn the ISG Policy into enforced, measured controls across a mixed fleet of laptops and mobile devices. Corporate IT runs enrolment and user support; you define the controls, prove compliance, and respond to alerts.

Outcomes you will own

  • Keep every company device enrolled in device management and named to internal conventions.
  • Maintain CIS benchmark compliance across the fleet; report it from device management dashboards.
  • Patch critical OS and application vulnerabilities within a 7-day SLA across the fleet.
  • Run endpoint detection and response on every laptop.
  • Prevent data leakage across endpoints, email, browsers and cloud apps; detect and block exfiltration attempts.
  • Enforce device posture so only company-managed devices reach internal systems.
  • Run threat protection across endpoints and collaboration tools: malware, phishing, account takeover and insider risk.
  • Control third-party app sign-in with company identity through an allowlist.
  • Manage browsers centrally on every OS.
  • Separate work and personal data on mobile devices.
  • Maintain endpoint and identity standards under the ISG Policy, including naming and enrolment conventions; run security awareness training and phishing simulations.
  • Run the infostealer feed; for leaked TRG credentials, reset passwords, revoke sessions and check the device within 4 hours.
  • Write data leakage and threat response playbooks with pre-approved containment: disable account, isolate laptop, wipe device.
  • Own employee identity: SSO, MFA, joiner-mover-leaver access and quarterly access reviews.

First 90 days

  1. Review fleet enrolment, compliance and patch status; report findings to the Head of Security.
  2. Extend hardened configurations to developer laptops without breaking printing, video calls or local Docker work.
  3. Ship the first five data leakage and threat detections, starting with offboarding-window exfiltration.

What you bring

  • 4+ years in endpoint or corporate security across multiple desktop and mobile operating systems.
  • Hands-on with enterprise device management (MDM and UEM) platforms.
  • Hands-on with data loss prevention, context-aware access and OAuth app control in SaaS collaboration suites.

  • Rolls out restrictive controls to developers without stopping their work.

jobs.description:
About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure.

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot is hiring a Vice President of Site Acquisition to lead the sourcing, evaluation, and securing of powered land for data center development across the United States. You will lead execution and be a key voice in shaping our acquisition strategy, building the site pipeline that fuels Riot's next phase of growth.

This is a builder's role with real influence. Working within our corporate development team, you will help refine target markets and site criteria, source deals, run diligence, and drive transactions to close, partnering closely with our engineering, leasing, construction, power, finance, and legal teams to turn raw parcels into shovel-ready campuses. As the pipeline grows, you will build and lead a team of acquisition professionals.

We have a strong preference for candidates based in or near our Irvine / Orange County, California or Denver, Colorado offices, but remote is possible for an exceptional candidate, with regular travel as the pipeline requires.

What you'll do

  • Shape the strategy. Work within the corporate development team as a significant contributor to Riot's site acquisition strategy, refining target markets, utility territories, and site criteria, and helping direct where and how we pursue powered-land opportunities.
  • Source the deals. Identify, originate, and evaluate development sites across the country, including large industrial and raw parcels capable of supporting hyperscale campuses, prioritizing locations with deliverable power, transmission access, and fiber connectivity.
  • Run the diligence. Review and interpret technical and utility documentation, including interconnection studies, load letters, capacity availability, easements, title, environmental, zoning, and entitlement materials, to validate buildability and de-risk each site before close.
  • Underwrite every opportunity. Lead real estate underwriting, scenario modeling, and ROI analysis for each site, building the investment case and presenting recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Negotiate and close. Lead commercial negotiations and structure and negotiate purchase and sale agreements, options, and long-term leases, driving transactions from LOI through diligence to signature.
  • Structure creative deals. Develop joint venture and partnership structures with existing landowners and power partners, contributing land or power into a Riot development while sharing in the upside, to unlock sites that a straight purchase would not.
  • Engage utilities and authorities. Coordinate directly with utilities, ISOs/RTOs, municipalities, and economic development officials to confirm power deliverability, secure incentives and development agreements, and build community support.
  • Build the network. Cultivate and maintain relationships with brokers, landowners, developers, and power partners so a valid site is never missed and Riot is the first call when powered land comes to market.
  • Partner cross-functionally. Work closely with engineering, leasing, construction, power procurement, finance, and legal to assess feasibility and align each acquisition with Riot's development and commercial roadmap.
  • Build and lead the team. Hire, mentor, and lead a team of acquisition professionals, and represent Riot at industry and community events.

What you'll bring

  • 10+ years of experience in land or site acquisition, real estate development, or energy infrastructure, with a track record acquiring powered land or comparable mission-critical sites.
  • Demonstrated success sourcing deals and closing complex, high-stakes land transactions, from origination and diligence through negotiation and close.
  • Strong command of data center siting fundamentals: high-voltage power, interconnection, transmission and substation capacity, fiber, cooling, water, and tax and incentive structures.
  • Hands-on experience reviewing technical and utility documents and translating them into clear buildability and risk conclusions.
  • Proven ability to structure and negotiate purchase and sale agreements, options, and leases, with sharp commercial and financial judgment.
  • Financial fluency in real estate underwriting, scenario modeling, and ROI analysis, with the ability to build and defend an investment case.
  • Experience building, leading, and mentoring acquisition or development teams.
  • Experience structuring joint ventures or partnerships with landowners or power providers is a strong plus.
  • Deep familiarity with U.S. land use, zoning, entitlement, and permitting processes, and the diligence that surrounds them.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across brokers, landowners, utilities, and government, with the ability to operate independently in a fast-moving environment.
  • Willingness to travel as projects require.
  • Bachelor's degree required.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with behind-the-meter natural gas generation development for large-scale loads.
  • Substation and transmission capacity procurement, and powered-land structures where energy is committed before construction.
  • Experience securing economic incentives and development agreements, and a long-term land-banking mindset.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Base range (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant.
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans.
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Vulnerability and Exposure Management

Incident Response

  • Serve as the technical lead and organizer for cybersecurity investigations and incident response activities.
  • Coordinate technical response, evidence collection, containment, eradication, and recovery support.
  • Maintain incident documentation, facilitate after-action reviews, and translate lessons learned into operational improvements.
  • Function as an escalation resource for complex cybersecurity events, investigations, and technical security challenges.

Email Security Administration

  • Administer and maintain email security technologies supporting DECAL cybersecurity operations.
  • Manage security capabilities, policies, monitoring, and threat response associated with Exchange Online Protection (EOP), Microsoft Defender for Office 365, and Barracuda Email Security.
  • Investigate phishing, malware, business email compromise, and other email-based security events.

Technical Leadership and Collaboration

  • Support governance, compliance, audit, and risk management through technical implementation, documentation, evidence collection, remediation support, and subject matter expertise.
  • Participate in security reviews for new technologies and provide monitoring, detection, logging, vulnerability management, and incident response requirements.
  • Provide backup coverage for Microsoft Purview capabilities through cross-training and documented procedures.

Additional Duties

  • Participate in cross-training and continuity efforts supporting cybersecurity operations and assigned security technologies.
  • Support cybersecurity awareness and operational readiness initiatives.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

Technical Skills:

Demonstrated experience supporting, administering, engineering, securing, or connecting multiple cybersecurity technologies across security operations, monitoring, threat detection, vulnerability management, email security, automation, and incident response. Candidates are not expected to possess experience with every technology listed. Experience across a significant portion of the following technologies and capabilities is desired:

Preferred candidates will demonstrate hands-on experience with approximately 50% or more of the technologies and capabilities listed above, with particular emphasis on Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, security monitoring, detection engineering, threat hunting, vulnerability management, email security, automation, and incident response.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Linux Build & Integration Engineer – Yocto/AOSP
jobs.excerpt: Build the infrastructure and automation behind complex Android and Embedded Linux platforms.
jobs.description:
Build the infrastructure and automation behind complex Android and Embedded Linux platforms.

Before You Apply

This is a full-time employment opportunity. We are not considering B2B, freelance, consulting, or independent-contractor arrangements.

Hands-on experience with at least one of AOSP, Android BSP, Yocto, firmware, or Embedded Linux build environments is required.

This is not a cloud DevOps role.

If your experience is primarily AWS/Azure/GCP, Kubernetes administration, Terraform, cloud infrastructure, or CI/CD for web applications, this role will not be the right match.

We need an engineer comfortable with Linux build servers, native compilation, build systems, toolchains, CI/CD, release automation, SBOMs, and debugging broken builds hands-on.

About L4B Software

L4B Software is an embedded software and platform-engineering company headquartered in Munich, Germany, with an engineering presence in Pune, India.

We design, customize, integrate, secure, and maintain operating-system platforms based on Embedded Linux and Android/AOSP, tailored to the hardware, product architecture, security requirements, and lifecycle needs of our customers.

Our engineering capabilities span:

Customized Embedded Linux | Android/AOSP | BSP & Platform Integration | Product Cybersecurity | DevOps | System Validation

We support demanding and long-lifecycle products across medical technology, automotive, industrial systems, and other embedded environments.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Linux Build & Integration Engineer to own and improve the build, CI/CD, release, and software-supply-chain infrastructure behind our Android/AOSP and Embedded Linux platforms.

You'll work where Linux systems, native build environments, platform engineering, CI/CD, release engineering, and cybersecurity meet.

When a large Android or Yocto build fails, we need someone who can investigate the build host, toolchain, dependencies, permissions, storage, memory, scripts, source configuration, and build environment — and get it working again.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not pipeline administration from a distance.

What You'll Do

  • Own and maintain Linux build servers, build agents, runners, and build-farm infrastructure.
  • Build, integrate, and troubleshoot AOSP, Android BSP, Yocto, and Embedded Linux build environments.
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps.
  • Diagnose complex build failures involving toolchains, dependencies, disk, memory, permissions, environment configuration, and native compilation.
  • Automate engineering workflows using Bash and Python.
  • Own release packaging, artifact publishing, versioning, and release automation.
  • Improve build reproducibility, reliability, and traceability.
  • Implement automated SBOM generation using formats/tools such as SPDX, CycloneDX, and Syft.
  • Integrate vulnerability and software-composition analysis into build pipelines using tools such as Trivy, Grype, Dependency-Track, Black Duck, Snyk, and Yocto CVE tooling.
  • Maintain artifact repositories and release assets using tools such as Artifactory, JFrog, or Nexus.
  • Generate reliable release evidence showing what was built, from which source/configuration, and what components were included.
  • Work closely with Embedded Linux, AOSP/BSP, Product Cybersecurity, and Validation engineers to continuously improve platform build and release processes.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience in build engineering, release engineering, embedded DevOps, platform engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of AOSP, Android BSP, Yocto, firmware, or Embedded Linux.
  • Experience working with large native software builds and build environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Jenkins, GitLab CI, or comparable CI/CD systems.
  • Strong Bash scripting skills.
  • Practical Python scripting/automation experience.
  • Experience managing Linux build servers, agents, runners, or build farms.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to independently investigate failed builds and pipelines.
  • Good understanding of Git, source control, branching, build configuration, and release workflows.

Technical Experience We Value

Relevant experience across several of these areas would be particularly valuable:

AOSP / Android BSP | Yocto / BitBake | Embedded Linux | Jenkins | GitLab CI | GitHub Actions | Azure DevOps | Bash | Python | Artifactory / JFrog / Nexus | SBOM | SPDX / CycloneDX | Syft | Trivy / Grype | Dependency-Track | SCA / CVE Pipelines | Release Automation

Experience supporting regulated, security-sensitive, or long-lifecycle embedded products is an advantage.

What This Role Is Not

This is not primarily:

  • Cloud infrastructure engineering
  • Kubernetes administration
  • Terraform / Infrastructure-as-Code engineering
  • AWS, Azure, or GCP platform administration
  • CI/CD for web or enterprise applications
  • IT infrastructure administration

Cloud experience is not a disadvantage, but it cannot replace hands-on embedded/native build experience.

The core of this role is:

Linux Build Infrastructure AOSP / Yocto / Embedded Builds CI/CD Release Automation SBOM & Supply-Chain Security

What Success Looks Like

You'll help us reach a point where:

  • Android and Embedded Linux builds are automated and reliable.
  • Build failures can be diagnosed and recovered quickly.
  • Releases are reproducible rather than dependent on tribal knowledge.
  • SBOM generation and CVE monitoring are automated.
  • Release artifacts are traceable and controlled.
  • Every release has clear engineering evidence.
  • Manual release activity becomes the exception rather than the normal process.

Why Join L4B?

You'll work on the engineering infrastructure behind real embedded operating-system platforms, not generic web or cloud workloads.

Your work will directly affect how quickly engineering teams can build, integrate, validate, secure, and release customized Android/AOSP and Embedded Linux platforms.

If you enjoy getting close to Linux systems, build environments, toolchains, automation, and complex native software builds, you'll have meaningful ownership here.

Bucharest, Romania | Remote | Full-Time Employment
No B2B, freelance, consulting, or independent-contractor arrangements.

If a broken embedded build makes you want to find the root cause rather than escalate the ticket, we'd like to talk.

jobs.description:
Custom Ink is so much more than a t-shirt company. We’re a team of creative individuals who empower our customers to create the perfect custom apparel for their groups through an innovative and easy-to-use website and at multiple store locations throughout the country. We are also committed to community, empathy, diversity, and equity. Our end goal is for all Inkers to feel a deep sense of belonging.

We are always looking for great people to join our team, and with locations and stores opening across the country, there are new opportunities all the time. Headquartered in Fairfax, Virginia with offices in Dallas, Texas; and Prague, Czech Republic, with 500+ team members across the world. We have both location-focused and work-from-home jobs.

Overview:

  • Workstyle: Remote
    • This is a remote position; however, to be eligible for hire, candidates must reside in a state where Custom Ink is registered to do business as an employer. Eligible states currently include:
    • AL, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, KY, MA, ME, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, RI, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA, WI, WV.
  • Reports to: VP, Strategic Partnerships & Verticals
  • Travel Expectations: Minimal travel; will be determined by business needs and may include occasional trips for key meetings, collaboration opportunities, or area-connected events.
  • Physical Requirements/Demands: This is a primarily sedentary, home-based role that requires the ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while working at a computer. The role involves regular use of standard office equipment, such as a computer, keyboard, mouse, and telephone. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position

What we’re looking for:

We’re seeking a high-performing Strategic Account Executive to drive Custom Ink’s expansion within an assigned industry vertical. This is not your typical sales role — it’s a career-defining opportunity to lead a strategic vertical, build deep industry relationships, and shape how one of the country's most trusted brands serves enterprise clients.

This role calls for a consultative, entrepreneurial sales professional with a proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals and build enduring relationships with enterprise clients.

  • Bring 5–10+ years of enterprise sales experience, ideally in a vertical-focused or named account model
  • Demonstrate success managing long sales cycles and navigating multifaceted decision-making structures
  • A consultative, customer-first mindset with strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Exceptionally skilled at prospecting, solution selling, multithreading, and building trusted relationships with executive-level buyers.
  • Comfortable with a high degree of autonomy and accountability — you own your vertical and are expected to think and act like a business owner.
  • Strategic and data-driven — you know how to use insights, tools, and collaboration to drive outcomes.
  • Display exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Show familiarity with or deep interest in your assigned industry vertical

Who this role isn't for:

  • Transactional, single-threaded sellers: Someone used to quick, one-call closes or relying on inbound leads rather than hunting enterprise logos and navigating multi-stakeholder buying committees.
  • Playbook-dependent reps: Someone who needs a rigid, pre-built sales script or heavy day-to-day management rather than building a vertical go-to-market strategy from the ground up with high autonomy.
  • Lone-wolf operators: Someone who wants to keep market insights to themselves rather than collaborating tightly with Marketing on ABM campaigns and Customer Success on post-sale expansion.

What you’ll do:

In this role, you'll own a named list of top accounts in your vertical, prospect and close new logos, and partner closely with our Customer Success and Marketing teams to deepen penetration in existing relationships. You will be the industry expert for Custom Ink in an assigned industry with the freedom and accountability to build a multi-year, multi-million-dollar book of business.


  • Own the vertical, act as the go-to industry expert and AE for a curated list of enterprise accounts nationwide
  • Identify new enterprise logos while expanding revenue within existing accounts through solution selling and multithreading
  • Translate vertical insights and market trends into meaningful actions that guide sales motions and campaign development
  • Work closely with Marketing to influence demand generation and ABM campaigns, and with Customer Success to ensure world-class onboarding and growth
  • Focus on long-term value, delivering repeat business, increased share of wallet, and deep customer loyalty
  • Serve as a vertical voice across the company, sharing feedback, highlighting opportunities, and shaping go-to-market strategy

How you’ll be measured:

  • Growth in top-line revenue and gross margin by vertical, including year-over-year trends and performance to plan
  • Volume and quality of new business development activities (e.g., leads, outreach, demos, events, ABM follow-up)
  • New customer acquisition and revenue contribution, including stack ranking and revenue per teammate
  • Effectiveness of collaboration with Marketing and Customer Success on campaigns, onboarding, and retention
  • Customer experience metrics, including tNPS, CSAT, and order accuracy
  • Contribution to vertical strategy, including insights, pipeline quality, and campaign participation

How you’ll make a difference:

As a Lead Account Executive, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping Custom Ink’s industry presence and growth strategy. Your work will help unlock meaningful connections between our brand and the enterprise clients who depend on us for team gear, employee swag, branded kits, and more. By blending insight, relationship building, and commercial acumen, you’ll drive results that support our mission and create lasting value for our customers and our business.


Compensation:

We are committed to providing pay transparency and equitable compensation.

  • For this salaried exempt position, the base salary range is $80,000 - $120,000 plus a quarterly commission targeted at $17,500, tied to individual/company performance and continued retention. Placement within the range is determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to: knowledge, skills, years & depth of experience, and equity with internal team members.

The perks!

  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with flexible paid time off policies and major paid holidays.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Complete Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage at a low cost through a PPO or HDHP plan to support your and your family’s well-being.
  • Employee Wellness: Access to virtual medical consultations through MDLIVE, and mental health services through some of our preferred partners.
  • Family-Friendly Benefits: Up to 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents (6 weeks STD + 8 weeks of parental leave) and 8 weeks of fully paid parental leave for non-birthing parents, adoption assistance, pet insurance, caregiver leave, and fertility benefits.
  • Financial Wellness: Build for the future with our 401(k) plan featuring company matching, employer HSA contributions for eligible plans, Life & AD&D insurance, flexible spending account options, and resources to help you manage life’s financial moments.
  • Professional Development: Grow your career with access to training programs, certifications, and tuition assistance.
