jobs.description:
Analyst

Energy Program

Union of Concerned Scientists

Remote

Bargaining Unit Position: Yes

Our Organization

The Union of Concerned Scientists (UCS) is an independent nonprofit that puts rigorous, independent science into action, developing solutions and advocating for a healthy, safe, and just future. We envision a peaceful, healthy, and just world where science serves people and the planet by guiding policy decisions, reducing risks, and improving lives.

For over five decades, we have been working as scientists, engineers, economists, advocates, and everyday people to create and advocate for innovative, practical solutions to some of our planet’s most pressing problems—from combating global warming and developing sustainable ways to feed, power, and transport ourselves, to fighting disinformation, advancing racial equity, and reducing the threat of nuclear war. Values informing our work include:

  • Science in the service of people and the planet.
  • Justice and Equity for people of all races and incomes—now, and for future generations.
  • Courage to take principled, science-based stands in the public arena.
  • Integrity to always examine evidence critically, openly, and honestly.
  • Democracy to promote a voice for all in government decisions.
  • Action inspiring and mobilizing people to build a healthier, safer, and more just world.

The Position

The Analyst will represent UCS as a key stakeholder before one or more Regional Transmission Organizations/Independent System Operators (RTO/ISOs), tackling critical priority issues. The focus will be on promoting data-driven and forward-looking transmission system planning, advancing energy market structures that accurately reflect the contributions of clean energy resources, and fostering inclusive decision-making processes that drive equitable outcomes. This will involve direct engagement with RTO/ISO staff and leadership, active participation in stakeholder meetings, and collaboration with a diverse range of stakeholders to build consensus on vital issues. The analyst may also engage with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) as matters progress from RTO/ISO deliberation to FERC approvals.

The Analyst will provide thought leadership and technical support to further the mission of UCS's Energy Program. They will contribute to developing Theories of Change, design research objectives and strategies, and critically evaluate empirical evidence. They will represent UCS's values in science advocacy initiatives and engage in research and analysis related to current or potential policy decisions in mission-critical areas.

Additionally, the Analyst will provide subject-matter expertise on bulk electric system issues, supporting teams across the UCS Energy Program, including federal policy and state advocacy units. They will play a vital role in designing and implementing analyses that align with UCS’s advocacy efforts and strategic priorities.

Finally, the Analyst will actively elevate UCS's positions through various communication channels, including blogs, web content, media interviews, and social media, ensuring our messages reach and resonate with a wide audience.

The Union of Concerned Scientists (UCS) is an independent national nonprofit that uses science to protect our health, safety, and environment. We are scientists, engineers, economists, activists, and everyday people who develop and advocate for innovative, practical solutions to some of our planet’s most pressing problems—from combating global warming and developing sustainable ways to feed, power, and transport ourselves, to fighting misinformation, advancing racial equity, and reducing the threat of nuclear war.

Responsibilities

Research and Analysis

  • Design and implement research and analysis in accordance with legal requirements for human subjects and environmental protection and upholding principles of scientific excellence (e.g., regarding plagiarism, conflicts of interest, intellectual property and copyright, data governance and archiving, use of artificial intelligence).
  • Identify strategic opportunities for new areas of research for the Program and identify solutions to enable novel analytical or policy work.
  • Identify strategic opportunities for collaborative work across the Program to develop and test evidence-based solutions for policy, regulatory, and other decision-making challenges.
  • Plan, design, and implement scientifically rigorous research and analysis activities.
  • Develop research and analysis methodologies in accordance with scientifically sound principles and techniques.
  • Identify strategic opportunities for new areas of research for the Program and identify solutions to enable novel analytical or policy work.
  • Identify strategic opportunities for collaborative work across Programs to develop and test evidence-based solutions for policy, regulatory, or other decision-making challenges.
  • Lead or support development of science-based products.
  • Ensure accuracy, credibility, readability, and timeliness of all written material.
  • Project-manage reports; write and edit reports, fact sheets, issue/policy briefs, and other materials highlighting the results of various analyses following UCS protocols for review, production, and presentation of results.
  • Help coordinate peer review by external technical experts and internal UCS scientific and analytic products and make necessary revisions before submitting for publication. Tailor style and content of materials for technical and/or general audiences, as appropriate.
  • Manage research and analysis projects, including scoping, planning, execution, and evaluation. Manage day-to-day and long-term activities, budgets, and contracts, coordinating project staff, and maintaining project transparency and communication with project participants, programs, and the organization.
  • Maintain in-depth knowledge of, monitor, and assess current and emerging research, trends in the field, and related policy/regulatory issues, and apply learning to analysis and advocacy activities.
  • Apply research results and conclusions to the formulation and development of public policies, regulatory and political strategies to promote the Program’s goals.
  • Carry out research objectives, policy approaches, and engagement with others that foster inclusiveness and deliver greater benefits to underserved communities.
  • Provide a supportive and welcoming environment that addresses the needs of diverse stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities for broadening and diversifying the voices engaging in Program-related decision-making venues and to equip new stakeholders to engage successfully.
  • Apply scientific tools for advancing social equity.

Assessment and Learning

  • Understand and value accurate data for the assessment, learning, tracking, and reporting of UCS’s impact.
  • Routinely track the impact of work to share with internal and external stakeholders; maintain and safeguard confidential UCS supporter and ally data.
  • Maintain in-depth knowledge of, monitor, and assess current and emerging research, trends in the field, and related policy/regulatory issues, and apply learning to analysis and advocacy activities.

Campaign Support

  • Using expertise, support campaigns' scoping, planning, design, and implementation, including identifying key stakeholders, research questions, and policy opportunities.
  • Collaborate with the Program’s Campaign staff to keep the campaign on track, assess new opportunities, respond to changing conditions, and communicate key decisions.
  • Influence the development and implementation of policies and strategies within government and nongovernment institutions to advance the campaign’s goals; collaborate with UCS campaign and legislative staff to develop and effectively promote UCS-supported positions with senior government officials, legislators, regulators, opinion leaders, stakeholders, non-traditional allies, coalition partners, public and media representatives at local, state, regional, and national levels.

Expert Representation and Advocacy

UCS employees in external-facing roles are required to maintain awareness of the role as a representative of UCS, ensure activities and statements enhance the organization's reputation and credentials among press, public, and private sectors, promote UCS, advance organizational objectives, and improve funding opportunities.

  • Represent UCS, its values, and positions in coalitions, conferences, workshops, stakeholder negotiations, testimony and congressional hearings, national and state regulatory commissions, legislative committees, other government agencies and commissions, market operators, and other key forums.
  • Establish and maintain alliances with advocates, other organizations, community leaders, businesses, academics, and researchers, including regulatory and legislative staff and governmental agencies, to exchange information, provide technical information/education and guidance, share resources, advance shared objectives, engage in collaborative projects, and participate in coalitions.
  • Represent UCS in the media, traditional and social; work with UCS Communications staff to identify key media opportunities, help draft materials, and serve as direct contact to the media, including providing rapid response to media requests. Respond to inquiries and comments from stakeholders, media, members, and the public about issues related to the Program’s mission.
  • Report research results and recommend research directions in oral and written form to experts, the public, the media, and congressional representatives.
  • Communicate and uplift UCS’s priorities online and through social media by writing blog posts, web copy, and other digital content.
  • Serve as an internal resource to expand UCS staff expertise and visibility. Share research and insights with UCS staff and collaborate on understanding and applying that research to advancing UCS strategic priorities.
  • Support and provide strategic thinking with respect to UCS’s fundraising and development efforts through donor meetings, participation in meetings of the National Advisory Board, and other efforts to cultivate relationships.

Other Duties As Assigned

Up to 20% of any individual job may contain work that is not specifically listed in this document. This may reflect temporary assignments, individual professional development opportunities (e.g., learning a new set of skills, participating in a professional growth experience), and/or a requirement to serve in an organizational citizenship capacity (e.g., participating in JEDI activities, pitching in/volunteering for extra work, covering for a colleague on leave).

  • Support and participate in UCS's internal efforts to create an anti-racist and inclusive work environment. Contribute to creating a culture in which all staff on the team are safe, respected, and heard, and BIPOC people thrive.

People Management Authority

While this position typically does not have direct reports, it may coordinate, manage, and provide technical direction to staff, interns, fellows, consultants, and volunteers allocated to specific projects, as assigned.

Requirements

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree is preferred (depending on program team focus/mission), in one of the following fields: social sciences, economics, engineering, quantitative and qualitative modeling.
  • 7+ years of comparable and relevant professional experience, which could include academic-related work experience.
  • Qualitative and qualitative analytical skills, experience in designing and carrying out scientific research and analysis that relies on relevant data science techniques.
  • Innovation skills; ability to develop novel applications for existing data streams.
  • Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills, both internally and with external stakeholders from a variety of backgrounds.
  • Experience in campaign planning, coalitions and relationship building, legislative process, advocacy skills, and policy/planning analysis
  • Understanding of how science, economic and technical analyses, and advocacy inform public opinion, public policy, and litigation.
  • Excellent writing and presentation skills; ability to communicate effectively with technical experts and other professionals; ability to communicate about complex scientific matters to non-expert audiences.
  • Experience incorporating equity, inclusion, and justice into work/projects; experience centering equity in technical analysis.
  • Project management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in teams in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple projects and deadlines.
  • For people-management responsibilities in the Analyst and Senior Analyst roles, no formal people-management experience is needed. Must demonstrate an interest in managing individuals and coaching for success.
  • Knowledge and familiarity with racial equity and inclusion principles and ways that race and other identities intersect in the work, particularly in scientific, policymaking, and environmental communities. Must be comfortable talking about identities such as race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, class, ability, and its present-day implications.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position for long periods of time.
  • Continuously operate a computer and must have the ability to control a mouse and keyboard.
  • Communicate in verbal and written formats with internal staff and external constituents.

Work Schedule

Regular business hours, which may vary depending on time zone. Occasional work outside of standard hours for events, travel, or time-sensitive matters is required.

Travel Requirements

Periodic domestic and international travel is required.

UCS is an equal opportunity employer actively seeking to diversify its staff. We’re dedicated to broadening opportunities for individuals from demographic groups that are historically underrepresented in the sciences and in environmental advocacy. We’re also committed to building an inclusive workplace culture where talented people of widely diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe the inclusion of culturally diverse perspectives will improve our work and produce better societal and environmental outcomes for all, including historically disenfranchised communities.

Benefits

Details

This is a full-time remote position. For those who meet all position requirements, the salary is $97,575.81. UCS offers excellent benefits and a rewarding work environment. *CA Resident Only; we offer a 12% salary differential*

Information about the organization is available at .

Comparable training and/or experience can be substituted for degrees when appropriate.

More about the team

Our team is made up of a dedicated group of researchers, scientists, communicators, campaigners, and advocates from wide-ranging backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and a collaborative and supportive work environment where all staff can thrive. We continually strive to create an environment that is a welcoming place for the LGBTQ+ community, people of color, parents, empty-nesters, and people with a wide variety of interests and backgrounds.

To Apply: We know there are great candidates who won’t check all of these boxes, and we also know you might bring important skills that we haven’t considered. If that’s you, don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself. Please upload a cover letter and resume. In the cover letter, please confirm that the listed salary meets your expectations. Upload materials in Word or PDF format only. No phone calls, please.

This position is in the bargaining unit.

COVID Mandate for New Hires

For in-office roles, UCS employees must be fully vaccinated against COVID-19. Employees are considered fully vaccinated as defined by the CDC. All new hires who will be reporting to an office location must provide notice of their vaccination status and vaccination documentation on or before their first day of work. For all others, UCS strongly encourages full vaccinations among its employees, up to and including booster shots, even if working remotely.

All new employees must comply with the mandatory vaccination requirements outlined in UCS policies as soon as practicable. Union of Concerned Scientists will notify candidates for employment of the requirements of this policy before the start of employment.

About Us

SPICE is a restaurant growth platform. We give restaurant partners upfront capital in exchange for dining credits, connect diners with the best restaurants in Riyadh, and turn every payment into something that gives back. We are a small team that moves fast, ships what matters, and believes every decision should create value for us, our partners, and our users.

This role is remote. Our partners are in Riyadh, and our team works across KSA and Jordan, so expect real overlap with Gulf hours .

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Integrations Engineer with a builder's mentality to own how SPICE connects to restaurant point-of-sale systems. You'll bring our integration layer in-house, writing direct connections to platforms like Micros, Simphony, Revel, Posist, and Foodics across both cloud and on-premise environments. You'll work directly with the founding team, and the standards you set here will define how SPICE integrates with every external system we touch.

What You'll Achieve

  • Build and own SPICE's POS integration layer end to end

  • Design and ship direct API connections to priority POS vendors, starting with the systems our largest restaurant partners run

  • Build middleware that handles the differences between POS vendors so product teams work against one consistent interface

  • Deliver integrations across both cloud and on-premise POS environments, including the networking and VPN setup on-prem requires

  • Work cross-functionally with internal teams (product, onboarding, customer success) to get integrations live and keep them running

  • Define the technical standards and patterns SPICE uses to integrate with any external system

Skills You'll Need to Bring

  • 3 to 6+ years as a backend software engineer, building and running API integrations in production

  • Direct, hands-on integration experience with at least two of: Oracle Micros, Oracle Micros Simphony, Revel, Posist, Foodics. You have written code against the vendor's API, not used a ready-made connector

  • Comfortable with both cloud-based and on-premise POS systems, including the VPNs, networking, and on-site setup that on-premise involves

  • Experience building middleware or integration layers that connect to many different external systems

Nice to Haves

  • You have come from a POS integration or implementation company, or a POS vendor's partner ecosystem

  • Experience getting through POS vendor partner or certification programmes, for example Oracle or Foodics

  • Background in payments, fintech, or restaurant/hospitality technology

  • Familiar with our stack: Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL. Strong engineers from other stacks are fine

Want to Stand Out?

Tell us about the messiest POS integration you have built. What the vendor's API got wrong, what you had to work around, and what you would do differently now. A few paragraphs is plenty.

jobs.title: Employer Engagement Manager - Business Development (12-month Fixed Term/Remote)
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT GENERATION At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives.
jobs.description:
ABOUT GENERATION

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have a 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

POSITION OVERVIEW

We are seeking an exceptional Employer Engagement (EE) Manager to develop and maintain employer partners for Generation’s' training programs in the U.S. This is the second EE Manager hire for Generation US, and you will collaborate daily with the existing Employer Engagement team.

You will be joining at an exciting time for Generation United States, as we expand a new program offering called JobSprint that can serve a range of jobseekers who require last-mile support to secure employment. The training program is free to learners, part-time, online and mostly asynchronous, with personalized career coaching (by both human coach and AI-enabled coaching and feedback tools). We are also actively running diligence for new programming (e.g., AI Forward Deploy Operator), confirming employer demand and securing initial partners to support pilot programs, with an eye towards launching and scaling successful pilots to markets across the country.

Reporting to the Head of U.S. Programs, the EE Manager will be responsible for engaging new employer partners to become part of the Generation employers’ network, for maintaining relationships with existing employers and for collaborating with the U.S. Delivery Team to transition learners to full-time employment. This individual will also collaborate with Generation’s Global Employer Partnerships team to support global employment service lines of benefit to US learners and alumni. Overview

Serve as the AI Architect for the Support organization. Define the AI strategy, architecture, and governance that improve how Support resolves cases, communicates with clients, and shares knowledge. Design, build, integrate, and optimize AI-enabled solutions across ServiceNow, knowledge management, case triage, and incident response. As a secondary responsibility, provide help desk and after-hours technical support to clients, including call, ticket, email, and chat support, and coordinate timely escalation to the appropriate teams.

Primary Objective: Architect and deliver secure, reliable, and measurable AI solutions that improve Support efficiency, resolution quality, and client experience, while ensuring responsible use of AI and protection of client, patient, and company information. Secondary Objective: Provide responsive, professional help desk and after-hours support, maintain clear client communication, and work with internal teams to resolve critical and escalated issues with minimal business disruption.

Primary Responsibilities – AI Architecture

  • Define and maintain the AI architecture, roadmap, and standards for the Support organization, aligned with Support, Product, and Security priorities.
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI use cases across case intake, triage and routing, troubleshooting, case summarization, knowledge creation, client communication, quality audits, and major incident support.
  • Design, build, and deploy AI-enabled solutions and workflows, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and automation, integrated with ServiceNow and other support tools.
  • Architect and curate knowledge sources, including knowledge articles, SOPs, known-error records, and case history, so that AI outputs are accurate, current, and relevant.
  • Establish AI governance, including approved tools and models, data-handling rules, PHI and client data protection, output validation, human review, and compliance with applicable policies and regulations.
  • Partner with Information Security, IT, Product Development, and Support leadership to assess risk, select platforms, and implement secure integrations.
  • Define success metrics and report on AI adoption, accuracy, time savings, SLA and response-time improvements, and client satisfaction. Continuously test, tune, and improve solutions.
  • Use AI and data analysis to identify recurring issues, trends, and suspected defects, and share insights with Product Development to support product improvements.
  • Train, coach, and enable Support staff and managers on approved AI tools, effective prompting, output verification, and responsible use. Create guides, SOPs, and best practices.
  • Stay current with emerging AI technologies, healthcare IT trends, and supported Altera products, and recommend improvements to the Support AI strategy.

Secondary Responsibilities – Help Desk & After-Hours Support

  • Provide help desk and after-hours support by answering inbound calls and responding to email, chat, and monitoring alerts. Create accurate ServiceNow tickets that capture the issue, business impact, priority, contact information, and troubleshooting performed.
  • Guide clients through troubleshooting with clear, professional communication, confirm understanding of the issue, and set expectations for next steps and follow-up.
  • Troubleshoot client questions and technical issues involving system configuration, product functionality, SQL Server, and HL7 interfaces. Investigate issues using Windows Event Logs, IIS logs, and SQL queries, including multi-table JOINs.

  • Triage complex issues and route or escalate cases to the appropriate support, Development, Hosting, or Professional Services teams, providing complete troubleshooting details and business impact.
  • Coordinate with internal teams during critical or major incident calls, follow established after-hours escalation and notification procedures, and support P1/P2 incident triage by gathering logs, analyzing error patterns, and documenting incident timelines.
  • Maintain ownership of assigned tickets, communicate progress and blockers, and provide timely client updates in accordance with service-level agreements (SLAs).
  • Maintain complete case documentation, troubleshooting guides, SOPs, and known-error articles. Provide clear shift handovers covering open issues, business impact, actions taken, ownership, and next steps.
  • Use company-approved AI tools to assist with knowledge searches, case summaries, troubleshooting research, and drafting client updates. Verify outputs before use and protect client, patient, and company information.
  • Participate in scheduled evening, overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call rotations as part of the 24/7 support schedule.

Qualifications

Academic Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Nursing, Pharmacy, Nursing Informatics, or related discipline.
  • Equivalent combination of healthcare, clinical, and information technology experience may be considered.
    •

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in technical support, healthcare IT, or a related technical field.
  • Experience with generative AI tools and solutions, such as Microsoft Copilot or similar platforms, including prompt engineering and workflow automation.
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow or a comparable ticketing system.
  • Understanding of responsible AI practices and data privacy, including protection of PHI and other sensitive information.
  • Ability to define use cases and success metrics and to communicate results to technical and executive audiences.
  • Strong written, verbal, and telephone communication skills with a customer-focused approach.
  • Ability to troubleshoot software issues, prioritize multiple cases, and recognize when escalation is needed.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and working both independently and as part of a team.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL Server and Windows Server (including IIS) is preferred.
  • Familiarity with the U.S. healthcare industry, HL7 interfaces, and enterprise healthcare software is preferred.

Travel / Shift Requirements

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Manager, Editorial & Content is responsible for developing and producing clear, effective content across Empower Pharmacy's corporate communications, website, newsroom, and marketing channels. Reporting to the VP of Corporate Communications, this role serves as a lead writer and editor, supporting business priorities through audience-focused content that strengthens awareness, understanding, and trust in Empower's personalized, compounded medications.

This is a hands-on storytelling role for a strong writer; someone with a journalist’s instincts who can tell a great story in any format, producing a steady stream of articles, bylines, whitepapers, website copy, social posts, short-form stories, and marketing content. Success in this position requires strong writing and editing skills, comfort managing multiple stakeholders and review cycles, and the ability to translate complex healthcare and pharmacy topics into clear, compelling stories that audiences actually want to read.

The role partners closely with communications, marketing, digital, legal, and clinical teams to plan, develop, and optimize content within a highly regulated environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Content Creation and Storytelling

  • Content Creation: Serve as Empower’s lead storyteller and writer for corporate communications, website content, and other marketing collateral.
  • Volume Production: Write, edit, and publish a steady stream of content in every format — from long-form articles and whitepapers to quick-turn posts and short-form stories — across digital and marketing channels while managing multiple stakeholders and competing deadlines.
  • Narrative Development: Shape executive, corporate, and thought-leadership narratives that advance business priorities and strengthen stakeholder trust, applying strong news judgment to identify and develop story angles across the business, from patient impact to scientific innovation.

Editorial Standards and Collaboration

  • Editorial Standards: Help maintain editorial standards, content review processes, and quality controls to ensure brand consistency, accuracy, compliance, and reputational integrity.
  • Content Planning: Lead cross-functional content planning and execution in partnership with digital, marketing, clinical, legal, and freelance contributors.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Build alignment, resolve tradeoffs, and support complex work across functions and levels.

Content Innovation and Optimization

  • Format Innovation: Take an innovative approach to content, stretching a single piece of content across multiple formats and channels, including video, and using AI and analytics to build, shape, and scale content efficiently.
  • Technology Adoption: Advance responsible use of SEO, generative engine optimization, and emerging content technologies to improve discoverability, efficiency, and quality.
  • Insight Application: Use audience, search, social listening, competitive, and performance insights to prioritize opportunities, manage narrative risk, and optimize the content portfolio.

Performance and Accountability

  • Content Performance: Track content performance, including audience growth, site traffic, and contribution to marketing-qualified leads, and adjust the editorial plan based on performance against those targets.
  • Performance Reporting: Define success measures, report insights and recommendations to leadership, and adjust investments based on business and reputation impact.
  • Speed Precision: Balance speed and precision, moving quickly on time-sensitive content without sacrificing accuracy or compliance.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Exceptional writing, editing, and editorial judgment, supported by a portfolio that includes journalism-style writing and storytelling across long- and short-form content, executive and corporate communications, website copy and page development, B2B marketing campaigns, and long-form content.
  • Ability to translate complex healthcare, pharmacy, and business topics into engaging, easy-to-understand content that supports business and communications objectives.
  • Working knowledge of content analytics, SEO, social listening, content management systems, and responsible AI-enabled tools.
  • Skilled at managing multiple projects, deadlines, review cycles, and competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail and delivering consistently high-quality work.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Seven or more years of progressive experience in journalism, editorial, corporate communications, content strategy, or content marketing, including leadership of complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to build scalable editorial operations, influence senior stakeholders, and lead through others without direct authority.
  • Track record of driving measurable content outcomes, such as site traffic growth or MQLs, and working at speed on tight turnarounds without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience; experience in healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, or another highly regulated industry strongly preferred. Background in journalism, a newsroom, or an agency editorial team is a strong plus.

Key Competencies:

  • Customer Focus: Builds trust through customer-centric solutions.
  • Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation.
  • Optimizes Work Processes: Drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates: Partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
  • Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources efficiently.
  • Manages Complexity: Simplifies and solves complex challenges.
  • Ensures Accountability: Delivers on commitments with integrity.
  • Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
  • Communicates Effectively: Tailors messages to diverse audiences.

Values:

  • People: Empowering people defines who we are.
  • Quality: Excellence in every product, every time.
  • Service: Serving others is our highest purpose.
  • Innovation: Advancing care through technology and discovery.

jobs.excerpt: Assembled Intelligence (assembledintelligence. co), an integrated communications and commercialization platform designed to unite all of its capabilities to deliver smarter, faster, purpose-built solutions across the healthcare product lifecycle is seeking a Global Benefits Specialist to support the administration and evolution of our employee benefits programs across multiple regions, with primary expertise in the United States and United Kingdom.
jobs.description:
Assembled Intelligence (assembledintelligence.co), an integrated communications and commercialization platform designed to unite all of its capabilities to deliver smarter, faster, purpose-built solutions across the healthcare product lifecycle is seeking a Global Benefits Specialist to support the administration and evolution of our employee benefits programs across multiple regions, with primary expertise in the United States and United Kingdom. This role is ideal for a highly motivated and detail-oriented benefits professional with 5–7 years of experience who is looking to grow their career within a dynamic, global organization.

The Global Benefits Specialist will play a critical role in benefits operations, employee enrolment administration, vendor management, compliance support, and market benchmarking. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience managing employee benefit elections through vendor platforms and HRIS systems, partnering with global brokers and carriers, and helping shape competitive benefits offerings that support a diverse workforce.

Key Responsibilities

Global Benefits Administration

  • Administer employee benefits programs across the US and UK.
  • Manage day-to-day benefits operations, including eligibility, enrolments, life events, terminations, and employee inquiries.
  • Support annual open enrolment and benefits renewal activities.
  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of employee elections and benefit changes.
  • Conduct regular audits of enrolment data, auto-enrolments, payroll deductions, and carrier files to maintain data integrity.

Benefits Technology & Vendor Management

  • Serve as a key administrator for benefits enrolment and vendor platforms (e.g., Dayforce, Employee Navigator, Fidelity, Pension schemes, etc).
  • Coordinate eligibility feeds, enrolment files, and system integrations with HRIS and payroll team.
  • Troubleshoot employee enrolment issues and vendor related escalations.
  • Partner with brokers, carriers, and third-party administrators to ensure high-quality service delivery.
  • Support implementation of new vendors, programs, and system enhancements.

Employee Experience & Communications

  • Provide exceptional support to employees regarding benefits eligibility, enrolment, claims, and coverage questions.
  • Create and maintain employee facing communications, enrolment guides, FAQs, and educational materials.
  • Assist with benefits orientations, webinars, and information sessions.
  • Promote awareness and utilization of company sponsored wellness and benefits programs.

Compliance & Governance

  • Support compliance with applicable benefits regulations in the US and UK.
  • Maintain plan documentation, policies, and administrative procedures.
  • Partner with payroll and external advisors to support audits and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure accurate recordkeeping and benefits administration practices.

Market Benchmarking & Program Development

  • Monitor industry trends, emerging benefits programs, and employee expectations.
  • Participate in benefits benchmarking exercises and market surveys.
  • Analyze utilization, participation, and cost data to identify opportunities for program enhancements.
  • Provide recommendations to improve competitiveness, employee experience, and operational efficiency.
  • Support the development of global benefits strategies as the organization expands.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Prepare regular reporting on enrolment activity, utilization trends, vendor performance, and program costs.
  • Analyze benefits data and provide actionable insights to HR and leadership stakeholders.
  • Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and renewal processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5–7 years of progressive benefits administration experience, including exposure to global organizations.
  • Strong working knowledge of US and UK benefits programs, enrolment processes, and vendor administration.
  • Experience managing employee elections through benefits administration platforms and HRIS systems.
  • Experience partnering with benefits brokers, consultants, carriers, and third-party administrators.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience utilizing benefits data to support decision-making.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
  • Excellent organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a fast-growing technology, consulting, healthcare, or professional services environment.
  • Knowledge of leave administration and wellness programs.
  • Familiarity with Dayforce, Employee Navigator, Fidelity, or similar systems.
  • CEBS, CBP, SHRM-CP, PHR, or other relevant certification.

Key Competencies

  • US & UK Benefits Subject Matter Expertise
  • Vendor Relationship Management
  • Benefits Enrolment & Eligibility Management
  • Benefits Technology Systems
  • Data Analysis & Reporting
  • Market Benchmarking & Trend Analysis
  • Employee Experience & Service Orientation
  • Compliance & Risk Management
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We're building the next chapter: an agentic platform that understands operational context and takes action, with the ambition to make physical operations increasingly autonomous. External Platform EMEA owns critical capabilities behind that transition. Depending on the team, your work could include:

  • Reporting and intelligence. Own the reporting engine and products that turn the complexity of a fleet into answers customers can act on.
  • Enterprise administration. Build how customers configure and control Samsara at scale, from permissions and device metadata to AI-assisted onboarding.
  • Developer and agent platform. Build APIs, event systems, integrations, and tools that give applications and AI agents access to operational data and actions.
  • Business-critical infrastructure. Own billing, license assignment, and usage metering: systems central to how Samsara sells, delivers, and grows its products.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead technical discussions with teammates to identify gaps in our telematics data platform and influence roadmap by setting direction and recommending solutions
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams to make design decisions and understand downstream implications in our product to ensure a seamless customer experience
  • Ship features that deliver value to customers, consistently refining them based on gathered feedback.
  • Deliver full stack features across multiple tiers (front-end, back-end and mobile). GoLang, GraphQL, Typescript, React and ReactNative among other technologies. Direct experience with these technologies is not required.
  • Be responsible for maintaining the production systems that your team owns and provide operational support.
  • Make an impact on our core architecture, roadmap, and the wider engineering community.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 7+ years of experience designing and building products in a software engineering team
  • Proven experience leading the design, development, deployment, and ongoing maintenance of highly scalable, distributed software systems
  • Proven experience in building, deploying, and maintaining Machine Learning-powered products
  • Experience mentoring and supporting engineers and role modeling engineering practices within a technical lead capacity
  • Experience taking end-to-end ownership of product, feature designs, development and delivery of large scale and long running projects
  • Proactive growth mindset, always looking at ways to improve the status quo
  • B.S. in Computer Science or related technical discipline

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building customer-facing web and mobile workflow applications
  • Contributed heavily to driving significant value to their customers
  • Curiosity about our customers, and is eager to improve their day-to-day experience
  • Seeks to iterate on new products based on customer feedback
  • Exceptional problem-solving abilities and meticulous attention to detail.Strong communication skills for effective teamwork and project collaboration.
  • Enthusiastic and committed to innovating in a fast-paced and dynamic team environment.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

We are looking for a Deal Hunter with expertise in consumer electronics, health and beauty, groceries, home, apparel, and other categories. What You'll Do:

  • Identify and find amazing deals
  • Collaborate with partners to find and post deals
  • Analyze the current and historical performance of deals through data and using insights to make smart decisions
  • Collaborate with different departments (including Business Development and Publishing/Coupons teams to evolve our content across all devices)

  • Must be technically savvy and possess the acumen to quickly learn the company’s system as it relates to Deal Hunting
  • Extremely reliable and responsive
  • Ability to write high-quality content
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to keep up in a fast-paced environment
  • Must have basic Excel spreadsheet knowledge
  • Relevant experience (can be professional or personal) that makes you a shopping expert in one or more categories
  • Quick learner; pays close attention to details
  • Has an interest in data analytics
  • Team player who shows passion for their work

Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Iowa, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, North Carolina, New Jersey, and Nevada.

Strategic Leadership & P&L Management

Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

The Business Operations Coordinator is an entry-level, high-potential role built for a natural systems thinker; someone who's energized by figuring out how the pieces of a complex process connect. Using our CRM and internal data and reporting tools, the Coordinator investigates escalated customer and provider partner issues, digs past the symptom to find the root cause, and partners with toll agencies and internal teams to fix not just the individual case but the process behind it.

jobs.description:
Principal AI Engineer (AI / .NET Core / React)

At Mitratech, we’re a team of engineers passionate about building world-class products that empower Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR professionals at Fortune 100 companies. We thrive in a global, inclusive culture that values innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence.

With continued growth, we’re looking for a Principal AI Engineer to join our HotDocs Team. HotDocs is Mitratech’s flagship document automation platform, used by enterprise clients worldwide to streamline the assembly of complex legal documents and contracts.

You'll set the technical direction for AI at HotDocs - designing and delivering new AI-powered enterprise capabilities and driving our adoption of AI across the software development lifecycle. This is a remote-first role.

About the Role

As a Principal AI Engineer, you will:

  • Set the AI Technical Direction: Own the architecture for AI capabilities across HotDocs - model management, LLM and agent orchestration, retrieval strategy, evaluation, cost and latency management - and translate it into a pragmatic delivery roadmap.
  • Deliver Enterprise AI Features: Take new AI-powered features from prototype to production at enterprise scale, writing clean, maintainable code in .NET Core and React and holding the bar for performance, security, and readability.
  • Drive AI Adoption in the SDLC: Lead how we use AI across engineering - coding assistants, agentic workflows, test generation, code review, and documentation - selecting tooling, defining safe and effective usage patterns, and measuring the impact on delivery.
  • Build Trustworthy AI: Establish evaluation harnesses, guardrails, observability, and AI governance practices so that AI features are accurate, explainable, and safe for use in regulated, compliance-heavy environments.
  • Bring Deep Technical Expertise: Apply strong .NET and React ecosystem knowledge to complex problems, modernize and refactor legacy code where it blocks AI integration, and improve system scalability and reliability.
  • Lead and Mentor: Raise the AI capability of the wider engineering group through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, brown-bag sessions, and clear written guidance.
  • Influence Across the Business: Partner with product management, architecture, security, and customer-facing teams to shape the AI roadmap, evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, and set realistic expectations for what AI can deliver.
  • Enhance DevOps and AI Ops: Extend CI/CD pipelines to cover AI workloads - prompt and model versioning, automated evaluation gates, monitoring, and cost tracking - working closely with DevOps engineers.
  • Focus on the User: Ensure AI features solve real customer problems and deliver a great experience through attention to detail, responsiveness, transparency, and accessibility.

About You

You are:

  • A Technical Leader: You set direction without needing authority, build consensus across teams, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical peers.
  • An AI Practitioner, not a Spectator: You have shipped AI features to real users, keep pace with a fast-moving field, and can tell genuine capability from hype.
  • Evidence-Led: You care about maintainable code, testing, and measurable outcomes - you evaluate AI systems with data rather than intuition.
  • Adaptable and Pragmatic: You balance long-term architectural goals with the practical needs of a sprint-driven environment, and you know when a simple solution beats a model.
  • Security-, Privacy- and Performance-Minded: You build with scalability and resilience in mind, using secure-by-design principles, and you treat data privacy and responsible AI as first-order concerns.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 12 or more years of professional software development experience, including time in a principal, lead, or staff-level technical role.
  • Strong skills in .NET Core (C#) and React (TypeScript) or similar SPA frameworks - this remains a hands-on engineering role.
  • Demonstrable experience designing and shipping production AI solutions - LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG, MCP, and agentic or tool-calling systems.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud AI platforms and services (e.g. Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, or equivalent) and with orchestration frameworks such as Semantic Kernel.
  • Experience building and maintaining REST APIs.
  • Proficiency with Entity Framework and Azure SQL (or SQL Server).
  • Experience evaluating and improving AI system quality - test sets, benchmarking, human review loops, and handling non-deterministic behavior.
  • Understanding of web applications and AI-specific security, including secure coding, prompt injection, and safe handling of sensitive customer data.
  • Experience using Git and collaborating through modern workflows (e.g., pull requests, branching strategies).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or similar).
  • Comfortable working in agile teams using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Practical experience using AI tooling within the SDLC (e.g. coding assistants, agentic developer tools) and a view on how to adopt it well across a team.
  • A track record of technical leadership - mentoring senior engineers, leading design reviews, and influencing roadmap and architecture decisions.

Nice to Have

  • Deeper AI specialism in areas such as SLMs and fine-tuning, CAG, vector databases, AI observability, multi-agent systems, or AI/ML pipelines.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office Addins (office.js / VSTO)
  • Familiarity of .NET Framework / WPF
  • Experience with authentication standards such as OAuth and SSO.
  • Exposure to distributed caching (e.g., Redis)
  • Knowledge of Linux environments and containerization (Docker).
  • Scripting in PowerShell.
  • Familiarity with performance tuning and application diagnostics.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code or automation tooling.
  • Previous experience in enterprise SaaS or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., legaltech, fintech), particularly applying AI to document, contract, or natural language workloads.

What We Offer

  • A collaborative, supportive, and learning-focused work culture.
  • The chance to shape an AI strategy end to end, from architecture through to production, at enterprise scale.
  • Opportunities to grow your technical skills and career path.
  • Remote-first flexibility with optional in-person collaboration sessions.
  • Competitive benefits and a chance to impact how global organizations automate critical legal and compliance workflows.

Join Us

Ready to lead the application of AI to document automation at enterprise scale? Apply now to join Mitratech’s innovative, inclusive, and driven HotDocs engineering team.

Why Join Us

The Head of GTM Enablement reports to the Chief Revenue Officer and owns enablement for every customer-facing role, from first outreach through deployment and expansion. Sales development

ICP and persona fluency, qualification discipline, outreach that earns a conversation

Account executives

Platform narrative, discovery, methodology, pricing and negotiation, technical and security wins

Sales engineers

Demo and proof-of-value standards, architecture fluency, competitive technical positioning

Account managers and customer success

Expansion plays, value realization, adoption and renewal conversations

Forward-deployed engineers

Customer-facing selling skills, scoping discipline, handoff to the commercial team

About the Role

We’re looking for an organized, thoughtful, and highly collaborative Talent Acquisition Coordinator to help deliver an exceptional recruiting experience at Tailscale. This is initially a 6 month contract position with the potential to extend and/or convert to a full-time role based on business needs and performance.

Reporting initially to the Director of Talent Acquisition, you’ll partner with Talent Acquisition Partners, Sourcers, hiring managers, interview teams, and candidates to keep recruiting processes running smoothly and efficiently. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-moving environment, brings exceptional attention to detail, communicates proactively, and enjoys finding better ways to make complex processes feel seamless.

• Keep clients informed of progress in a professional, empathetic, and respectful manner.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Analytical Development
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:Cogent Biosciences is a publicly traded biotechnology company focused on developing novel precision therapies to treat a broad range of patients with unmet medical needs.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Cogent Biosciences is a publicly traded biotechnology company focused on developing novel precision therapies to treat a broad range of patients with unmet medical needs. Cogent’s lead program, bezuclastinib, is designed to selectively and potently inhibit exon 17 mutations found within the KIT receptor tyrosine kinase, including KIT D816V. KIT D816V is responsible for driving a rare and serious condition called Systemic Mastocytosis, and exon 17 mutations are also found in patients with gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GIST), a type of cancer with strong dependence on oncogenic KIT signaling. Bezuclastinib has exhibited promising initial data across all three trials: APEX in AdvSM, SUMMIT in NonAdvSM and PEAK in GIST, including an encouraging safety profile across 600+ patients in single agent and combination dosing.

The Role:

The Associate Director, Analytical Development, is responsible for leading analytical activities across Cogent’s development portfolio and commercial product. This role within CMC will partner closely with Regulatory CMC, Quality, and external CDMOs to ensure analytical data, reports, methods, specifications, and regulatory-supporting documentation are accurate, phase-appropriate, and aligned with program objectives. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership in the review, interpretation, and communication of analytical results while ensuring high-quality documentation supports development, commercialization, and global regulatory submissions.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the preparation, review, and approval of analytical reports, data summaries, protocols, specifications, methods, and other CMC technical documentation.
  • Review analytical data packages supporting release testing, stability studies, drug substance, intermediates, and drug product manufacturing activities.
  • Partner closely with Regulatory CMC, Quality, and external CDMOs to ensure timely delivery of analytical documentation and reports.
  • Support analytical method development, validation, qualification, transfer, and lifecycle management activities across development and commercial programs.
  • Author, review, and manage technical documents including analytical methods, validation protocols and reports, specifications, trend reports, and regulatory submission documentation.
  • Coordinate analytical reporting activities for drug substance and drug product stability programs and ensure data are accurately documented and communicated.
  • Support the preparation and review of CMC sections for regulatory submissions, responses to health authorities, and other regulatory filings.
  • Participate in analytical investigations related to deviations, OOS, OOT, and laboratory events, ensuring documentation meets quality and regulatory expectations.
  • Collaborate with external laboratories and CDMOs to ensure analytical deliverables are scientifically sound, compliant, and aligned with program timelines.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on analytical reporting processes, data integrity, document quality, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications:

    • PhD in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline with 8+ years of relevant industry experience, OR Master's degree with 10+ years of experience, OR Bachelor's degree with 12+ years of experience.
    • Experience in analytical development, analytical reporting, CMC technical writing, or related pharmaceutical development functions.
    • Strong understanding of small molecule analytical development, method validation, method transfer, stability testing, specifications, and control strategies.
    • Demonstrated experience authoring, reviewing, and approving technical documents including analytical methods, protocols, reports, and regulatory-supporting documentation.
    • Experience reviewing analytical data generated by CDMOs, CROs, and external testing laboratories.
    • Working knowledge of analytical techniques such as HPLC/UPLC, GC, dissolution, spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, wet chemistry, particle size analysis, and related pharmaceutical characterization methods.
    • Familiarity with ICH, FDA, EMA, and other global regulatory requirements related to analytical development and CMC documentation.
    • Strong scientific writing, data interpretation, problem-solving, and project management skills.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical information to diverse audiences.
    • Proven ability to work effectively within a cross-functional matrix organization and build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners.
    • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced biotech environment.

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience supporting late-stage development or commercial programs.
    • Experience contributing to IND, NDA, MAA, or other global regulatory submissions.

Salary Range:

$185,000 - 215,000 USD

Target Bonus: 20%
Exact compensation will vary based on skills, experience, and location.

Our Locations

Waltham, MA: Our headquarters is located in the Greater Boston life sciencescommunity, with an open, collaborative office environment designedto support teamwork and connection. Employees benefit from convenient on-site amenities, including free on-site parking and gym facilities in the building.

Boulder, CO: Our Boulder location is home to Cogent’s discovery research organization and a key scientific hub with strong leadership based on site. Situated in the greater Denver-Boulder biopharmaceutical corridor, this office plays a central role in advancing our discovery efforts and pipeline.

Our Offer To You

At Cogent Biosciences, we offer a competitive salary, bonus, and ongoing stock awards, alongside a benefits package that sets us apart.We cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your family, and help reduce out-of-pocket costs by funding up to 75% of in-network deductibles. Our benefits also include a 401(k) match with immediate vesting, generous paid time off, 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, paid family and medical leave for all employees regardless of location, and company-paid short-term disability coverage for up to 20 weeks.Additionalperks likewellness programs, tuition reimbursement, and inclusive family-forming support help you thrive at work and beyond.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our goal is to have a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, age, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status or disability, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

jobs.title: Finance Business Partner Manager (Sales & Marketing) - Remote
jobs.excerpt: Hello!  ✨We’re Wildix, a global leader in Unified Communications & Collaboration as a Service (UCaaS) and we’re on a mission to redefine how businesses connect.
jobs.description:
Hello! ✨

We’re Wildix, a global leader in Unified Communications & Collaboration as a Service (UCaaS) and we’re on a mission to redefine how businesses connect. Our secure, web-based and AI-powered solutions help companies around the world collaborate smarter, serve customers better and grow stronger — and we want you to help shape what’s next.

About Us…

In 2005, brothers Dimitri and Steve Osler set out to reimagine how businesses communicate, and that vision became Wildix. Today, from our headquarters in Tallinn, Estonia, Wildix is one of the world’s fastest-growing UCaaS companies, with 300+ team members from 15+ nationalities, working across Europe, the UK, the Americas and beyond. We serve businesses in 135+ countries through a partner-first ecosystem, delivering secure, intuitive solutions that keep companies connected, productive and ready for what’s next.

At Wildix, we don’t just build technology, we live it. As a remote-first company, we rely on our own platform every day to collaborate globally and innovate fast. With steady growth and a strong foundation, we offer real opportunities to advance your career as we scale, making an impact in a global team that’s shaping the future of work.

At Wildix, our mission is clear: Empower companies worldwide with seamless communication solutions that drive productivity, efficiency, and growth.

About The Role…

We are looking for a hands-on Finance Business Partner Manager, Sales & Marketing to connect our commercial activity to the MRR and revenue number — and to build the financial case behind every material Sales & Marketing decision.

Reporting to the CFO and working day to day with our CRO, CMO and country and partner teams, you will own the commercial model, the investment cases, and the economics of commissions, pricing and partner programmes — while keeping Finance’s independent view. This is a decision-support role, not a reporting role: you will be measured by the growth decisions you shape, not by the packs you produce.

What You Will Do…

  • Own the commercial driver model from pipeline to MRR to revenue — new, expansion, downgrade and churn MRR by country, partner tier and product — state the gap to target and the actions that close it, and run a regular forecast review with the CRO.
  • Build the investment case for growth: measure the return on Revenue Plan initiatives, marketing channels, events, partner incentives and commercial hires, and recommend where the next euro of S&M investment should go.
  • Lead the financial design and costing of the sales commission plan, modelling payout curves and cost of sales at different attainment levels, and run an independent monthly check that payouts match the plan.
  • Lead pricing and discount economics: price realisation, discount leakage, ARPU by product and partner tier, and the financial case for price and packaging changes before they go to market.
  • Size and measure partner programme economics — incentives, rebates, special projects and discounts — testing whether they create incremental MRR and scaling up what pays back.
  • Build the S&M budget, capacity and headcount plan with the CRO and CMO, reforecast it quarterly, and support non-standard deal approvals within agreed guardrails.
  • Protect revenue integrity: own the MRR definition, hold the independent check that monthly MRR and revenue reconcile to internal reporting, and co-own commercial KPI definitions (GRR, NRR, CAC payback, magic number) with FP&A and BI..
  • Lead and coach one direct report, and build a reliable S&M data foundation across Salesforce, SAP and Power BI — good enough to stand up to investor due diligence.

What You Will Bring…

  • 6–10 years in sales/GTM finance, strategic finance, FP&A, consulting or investment banking, including at least 3 years partnering commercial leaders directly in a B2B SaaS or recurring-revenue business.
  • Expert financial modelling: driver-based, scenario and capacity models you have built yourself from source data.
  • Fluency in recurring-revenue mechanics — MRR movements and the bridge to recognised revenue, retention and expansion, pipeline conversion, CAC and payback, quota, ramp and commission.
  • Hands-on ownership of at least one of: commission and incentive design, pricing and discounting, or channel/partner programme economics — and the appetite to own all three.
  • Credibility with senior commercial leaders: you can tell a CRO that a plan doesn’t add up, show why, and still be invited to the next conversation.
  • Comfort with incomplete data — you produce decision-grade answers from imperfect numbers, state the uncertainty honestly and improve the data as you go.
  • AI fluency: you already use AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) in your day-to-day finance work — to build and check models, analyse data, automate reporting or draft commentary — and can show concrete examples of where they saved time or improved the output.
  • Clear, conclusion-first written and spoken English.
  • Experience coaching or managing at least one analyst or operations specialist.

Nice to Have…

  • Experience with partner-, channel- or distributor-led commercial models, including rebate, MDF and incentive programme economics.
  • Commission plan design, or pricing and packaging work carried through to launch.
  • An international, multi-entity, multi-currency environment; venture- or private-equity-backed, or a business preparing for a capital raise or M&A..
  • Salesforce, Power BI, SQL, and SAP or a comparable ERP; experience with a planning platform.
  • Exposure to due diligence or a transaction process, especially on the commercial and revenue side.
  • Italian in addition to English.

Why You’ll Love It Here

👫 Work with a Supportive, High-Performing Team – We believe in trust, autonomy, and working with bright, passionate individuals who drive real impact.

🌍 A Truly International Workplace – Our diverse and inclusive team ensures you’ll always feel connected and supported, no matter where you are.

🚀 Shape the Future of Global Communication – Be part of a team transforming how businesses operate in an era of remote work and AI-powered collaboration.

💼 Join a Profitable & Stable Company – We’re not a startup experiment, we’re a two-decade-old success story with sustained profitability, meaning we can back your boldest ideas.

What We Offer

🏖️ Generous Time Off – Take the breaks you need to relax, recharge, and come back inspired.

💻 Top-Tier Tech – Love Mac? So do we! We equip our team with the best tools for success.

📚 Level Up Your Skills – Enroll in English classes with dedicated courses through Preply.com to boost your communication skills.

🚀 Career Growth & Development – Access to programs and events to keep you at the top of your game.

💰 Compensation – The total compensation for this role is between €90K and €150K gross per year, which will be discussed during the interview process. The final offer will fall within this range, and reflects the candidate’s skills, experience, and work location.

Happy with them? We offer even more! Our benefits are country-specific — ask your recruiter for more information.

Interview Process

🤝 Step 1: Initial Screening – A chat with our Talent Team to understand your background, experience, and motivations. (45 minutes)

🛠️ Step 2: Role-Specific Interview – A deep dive with the Chief Financial Officer to assess your modelling, recurring-revenue and commercial finance skills. (1 hour)

🧩 Step 3: Commercial Stakeholders Interview – A conversation with our Chief Revenue Officer and Chief Marketing Officer on how you would partner with Sales & Marketing. (1 hour)

🎯 Step 4: Final Interview – A conversation with our leadership to ensure alignment with expectations and company direction. (1 hour)

We Are Wildix

Wildix is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity and welcome all applicants regardless of race, gender, age, religion, or any other characteristic. Everyone is encouraged to apply and is welcome to join our Blue Ecosystem.

Please note that we exclusively recruit through Remote.com, an Employer of Record company, facilitating remote talent acquisition efficiently and compliantly.

Ready to join us? Apply Now!

At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.

Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

AS AN AWS SOLUTION ARCHITECT, YOU WILL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO:

  • Ensure customer success in building and launching Amazon Connect solutions for NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture customers
  • Conduct technology assessment and audits to identify the need (from an ROI and Outcomes perspective) to move to CCaaS AWS Connect Platform, improving agent experience and productivity
  • Facilitate business process reviews to identify customer requirements and processes
  • Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
  • Lead discovery for customers, help customers build ROIs for projects, and deliver presentations and estimate for delivering that ROI
  • Translate customer requirements into contact center design, leveraging best practices, and other AWS Services
  • Oversee and mentor technical teams, providing guidance and support to ensure that proposed solution (on Salesforce and AWS Cloud) is delivered on time, on budget, and to the required quality standards
  • Act as a liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders, communicating technical concepts in a clear and understandable manner, and managing expectations and priorities
  • Drive best practice contact center design into each and every aspect of solution delivery
  • Effectively manage all aspects of project and customer communications
  • Deliver customer end user training and documentation
  • Exercise independent judgment, and take the lead role on enterprise level projects with minimal direction from senior management
  • Lead vision and strategy discussions with contact center and customer service leadership and management

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Customer-facing contact center experience
  • Experience building integrations across WFM, CRM, and contact center solutions
  • Experience with communications protocols and APIs such as WebRTC and SIP
  • Experience with hands-on Scripting/coding (e.g., python, java, c#, .NET, Node.js)
  • Communication and presentation skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with executives, IT Management, and customers
  • API integration experience
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills
  • Experience with Cloudformation, Contact Flow Design, Lambda Integration, Lex Integration, and Call Center Routing
  • Knowledge of automation tools and frameworks for building, testing, and deploying software, such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CodeDeploy
  • Contact Center architecture knowledge
  • Experience in technology/software sales, pre-sales, or consulting
  • Advanced knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture
  • Salesforce knowledge and familiarity with Salesforce Service Cloud
  • Contact center product knowledge of other platforms (Genesys, Cisco, Avaya, Twilio, etc.)
  • Experience with WorkForce Management solutions
  • Experience working with outbound dialers and campaign management
  • Knowledge of software development methodologies such as Agile and Scrum
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner Certification
  • AWS Developer Associate Certification or Professional
  • AWS Solution Architect Certification or Professional
  • Salesforce Certified Administrator
